tei:div.tei:p: sa ra shā sdusangotsho'ab/ dasgrogalagacha 4 rwashākhu k+ṣatsho skyal rdo 35 ༷ snye sgorngotshodzo chig ཿ
ge / 4 phan di nga garti 51she byung cu ca dze+e / sgyur+sha rang mo snari ma duX01 1 — 7 7 ri cha 'iX

/ji 8// :ri lhan/351 the rga snye/ji ba na mar pa rnam thar grub pa ma ra ba da pa/she sa nga sa 'i 'chos dpa' ba gcug lag phrang ba' rang rnam stil pa' bzhan ras 'char ba' ma lang /dpa' bo gcug lag phreng ba'i gsung 'bum dkar chagamadzad pa po/dpa' bo gtsug lagazung ba/wā ṇa badz+rabacadabe mdzod khang /

rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar baljangad pa/dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam 'khrul pa'i bzhin rasa'acharaba'i melong /dpa' bo gcug lag phreng ba'i gsung 'bum dkar chagamadzad pa po/dpa' pogatsug lag phreng ba/zhu sgrig rigan 'khrur ba/dge slong tshe ring /dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/dge slong tshering dang /'jam dbyangs bkris/mdun shog rma/dzes ris pa/ringam dbyangs bkris/2010'o 'i zla 7pa la par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2010lo'i zla 7par ldi lir par thengs dang porgyab/pa ra thengs dang po/ 000pa ra btab/wā ṇa badz+ra bisdi dpe mdzod khang /)(mkha')( 75'a/ cu pa 'ji/khyinga'ang5〉kyi///sduḥkāshāstu1 /spya /5shā 'driḥ5shāt+ta 2/spyi:ཿ71rā 007sbyozlo 0/pyi/khyi1441ni:shārdohāhāXb

cagajoX ji 'i gu ra / don kun grub pa ma ma rme nga shākya'i tog /gang des legs gdams lde na da rgyud sne 'i don/ /'grel pa'i 'phags 'od legag ba /da nor bu'i mdzod/ /ba la rin zhe ngas der dus ring bsrel ba las/ /deng 'dir skal rin 'as ba'i re sgong sud/ /'dzad med du mar bkye ba'i par 'a snyel gyis /yodangs su spel 'dis sdu med lungs rto /sa ba ma/ /chu chen khyon 'dir yun ring ga sa ‘ dang / /bstan 'dzin jugs mju zhabs brtan jugs bzhed 'grub /ba na pa'i nang don ba ba gsam lham bzhesa'aphel/ /ba na la dad kun tsham ma gan bde dgas 'a / ba na gzhi sde 'di mi nyams ‘ /sa dar sgyu na/ /zhe / khri 'gu rin po che dang / dargo na gyi bla grwa rngams kyi sgru sa bzhed bzhin badz+ra'idu zhes pa'i gsung rab dpe sgrun spang nas ris med ras lugs spyi dang / bye brag bka' brgyud kyi yi / cha dkon rig par rdzun zhus dang su 'char gyi 'go brjod shis smon tshigs bcad mchos gsum sungs snan 'di bzhi kya'i dan sdong ba na 'dzin rgya masnangs zis pa dge/tsho(phreXsno 5544 4ci ri〈〈sna /tsho

— 4 cagajo'i 'gu 'a ༄tsho/ /da lam bdag cag rnams kyi yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhan ོ khra tso rin po che'i thugasabaskyed dang mdzad bzang gi legs spyad las nye bar 'ong /// )/rte /ji 1rngo/ ri / lha / nyeste/ /jirdozhe rib badz+ra byā gsung rab da bskun khang /sa gsar du dbu ba sa pa 'a nyad brgyud gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gna' bo'i dus nas ma nyams pa'i ga byung gtsug lag gi srol bzang rgyad med rgyun 'dzin dang / khyad par dpal 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa'i mkhas grub gong ma dag gi gsung rab rgya chen zab mo'i dpal yon gyisaphyug pa kun kyang sngar rjes shul 'dzin dang / phyi rjes dar spel gyi sgo nasaphan bde'i ching gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i nges don lung rtogs kyi chos tso lar nyan sgom gsum gyi gnas gang cir spyos 'degs su 'gro ba'i yid smon rnam dag thos da' mdzo 'dzin ༄ bdun pas/ nang lo 2547 rab byung ༅ bdun pa'i chu rta d+ku zla 11 tshes 18 dang /phyi lo 2002 phyi zla 12 tshes 22 la/

1) ri te/༷ ñtshadzāshā 7snu sku 822755 sa6 pa sa 005༅sngon brjod/༄7//srid pa'i 'jigs pa las stobs shing //rnam grol bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu//lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil chos//gus pa'i phyag gi yul du bsnyen//de yang gangs can bod kyi ljongs su sangasargyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas brtsams da lta'i bar du/mkhas btsun bzang grub kyi skyes bu khyad pa ra can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi nyams myong gi steng nas byung ba'i man ngag sna tshogs pa zhig ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rim byung rnams la thugasabartse ba chen pos nye bar dgongasate bstan bcos dang zhal gdams/zin bris dang /cho ga/lo rgyus dang /rnam thar sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rtsom 'bri gnang ste bzhugasapa de dag bar lam dusakyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mang po zhig chud zos su phyin r+sā ni bod phyi nang tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro yongasal gyong gun chen po zhig byung ste/shin tu phangs pa'i gnasasu 'gyur par ma zad/da lta 'gro ba'i bsod nams

kyi skal par bzhugs pa dag las kyang / kha shas dpe rgyun dkon pas mi mngon pa'i dbyingasasu phe bas la nye ba rnams mi nyams par dpe rgyun spel ba'i ched dang / yang phyag dpe shin tu mkho gal che ba khag /thos bsam dang nyams len gnang mkhan dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten de tsam med par spros med du bzhugs rgyur thugs mnyes pa rnams kyis stabs bde'i thog nas phyag dpe khag thob pa 'i ched/ badz+ra bisdi yi dpe mdzod khang gis spar bskrun zhus dang zhu 'char bzhin/da lam dpa' bothakhrin lag phreng bsamadzad pa'i 6 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamatharasgab ba'i ngo mtshar brjod pa dang / dpalagakhug lag zeng ba'i rang rnam 'khrul pa'i bzhin rasa'achar ba'i me longadang / gsung 'buyodakar chag bcasabadz+ra bisdi yi dpe mdzod khang nas 'gro gron btang ste deb grangs 1000 tham pa gsar du par skrun zhus skabs/ phyag dpe 'di nyid kyi zhu bsgrig 'gan 'khrur ba dge slong tshe ring dang / thon gsar rig mdzod du bcug mkhan 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dang / zhu dag pa bstan 'dzin shes rab dang / bkra shis phun tshogs bcas thams cad kyis phya ra gru 'degs gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugasarje che zhes zhu rgyu dang / ma 'ongs par phyag dpe gzigasamakhan rnamasakyisadape cha 'di'i steng nasabaslab sbyang / zhib lajug nyams len gang gzab kyis rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum / gnyis don du mkhas btsun bzang gsum ste dam pa'i ngang tshul dgu yis don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa zhig yong ba'i smon 'dun dang / de lta bu gnang rogs zhes kyang zhu ba lags/de bzhin ma phyi gsal po ma thob pa dang / zhu dag gnad smin ma song ba sogs kyi lhag chad dang / nor 'khrul byung ba thams cad mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi drung du bshags shing / nor bcos bka' bslab kyang lhug por stsol gnang bka' drin zhu /khra 'gu sprul ming pas/

15par skun gleng brjod/rjebatsun mar pa'irnamathar mdzad pa bodapa'26natsug lagaphrengab sna/ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing pho byi lo ste spyi lo 1504 lor 7 sa snye thang du yab bla ma dar dang / yum lam snyed sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ rab byung dgu pa'i me pho stag lo ste spyi lo 1566 spor sku gshegs/ dgung lo lnga nga ra dge bsnyen cha lung pas sku gong ma dpa 'a bo chosadabang lhun grub kyi sku phreng gnyis pa ra ngos 'dzin gnang ste/ lho brag gro bo dgon pa'i gdan sa'i khri la mnga' gsol/dgung lo dgu pa ra zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa chos grags ye shes las dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs te mchan la mi phazungachobangakyi rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu gnyis par dwags po paṇ+ḍi ta chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan las gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos mang po gsan zheng / dgung lo nyer dgu par rkarma ri mi skyod rdo rje dang mjal zhing chos 'brel zhus te mtshan la dpal gtsug lag phreng ba zhes gsol/ de nas bzung mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i slob gnyer mang che ba bla ma 'de pa'i drung nas mdzad de mkhas pa'i phul phyin du gyur/de ltar mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad de dgung lo drug cu re gsum par dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs so//khong gi gsung rtsom thamasacad bsdu na sde tshan bcu gsum du bsdusate/ mchod brjod bstod tshogs kyi skor/ rnam thar chos 'byung gi skor/ sgra dang sman dpyad kyi skor/ mdo rgyud lung bsdus kyi skor/ rnam bshad zin brisakyi skor/ mngon dkyil sgrub thabs kyi skor/ bya ba chas spyod kyi skor/rang gi rtogs brjod la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i skor/ nyams len khrid yig gi skor/gnad du rdzog pa ra 'doms pa zhal gdams su grags pa'i skor/ man ngag sna tshogasapa'i skor/dkar chag bkod yig gi skor/ sngo ba bkra shis kyi skor bcas gsung 'bum pod bcu drug lhag bzhugs pa las/ da lam 'di ga wa ṇa badz+ra bisdi dpe mdzod /spang nas khong gi dgung lo drug nas

so dgu bar gyi rang rnam tshigs bcad du yod pa ches rje kun spangs pa lcam sring dang rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyisabaskul te dgung lo so dgu par mdzad pa'i 2 rang/rtogasababarjod ba 'khrul pa'i bzhin rasa'acharaba'i me long mi zhes bya ba dang / gsung 'bum dkar chag gong gsal sde tshan bcu gsum phye yod pa smyo glegabatabam 'dirnamakhragakyi tho yigarangagisasbyar ba :zhesabya ba dang / dgung lodrug cugachu mo phag gi lo ste spyi lo 1563 lor/ sa skyong ba nor bu'i mtshan can dang / sa skyong gabul rgyalabartan pasabaskul te/ rngog pa'i rnam thar rim bzhi/ rngog pa rang gi rnam thar lo rgyus/ ras chung pa'i rnam thar snga ma/ rnam thar snga rabasam/ rnam thar phyi rabs pa/ tshal ba'i deb dmar/ deb sngon po/ spyan snga chos 'byung / lo rgyus the tshom sel byed bya ba zhe snang rdo rje dang mi skyod rdo rje'i sbyar byang yod pa gnyis/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes bsgregs pa'i rnam thar/ snga rabs kyi rnam thar jo bo btsun pa 'i blo nas byung ba yin zer ba sogs rnam thar mi'adrab bcugasumalas legs par btus te mdzad pa'i 2 rjerakhun mar pa'irnamatharagrub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod ba mi zhes bya ba de rnams deng dus dpe rgyun shin tu dkon rigs su mngon te/sdu/ / ༵ ṇa badz+ra bisdi dpe mdzod khang nas phyogs gcig tu sgrig ste pa ra skrun 'grems spel zhus 'dir mar pa'i rnam thar gyi ma dper spar du grub nas kyang lan du mar zhus dag bgyisaso/ /zhes yod rung 'dir byed 'brel dang tshig phrad sogs brda sprod pa'i rnam gzhag dang mi mthun pa ma dpe 'go nasamajug bar yod pa rnams da lam gya tshom du bcos 'gyur ma btang bar ma dper gang yod pa rang sor bzhag yod/ ma dpe ni 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas thabs 'tshol gnang ba'i par log 'dra bzhus shig dang / yang wa ṇa mtho slob bka' brgyud rang gzhung mkhan po bsod nams rgya ma/tsho'i phyag dpe shing pa ra rnying pa gnyis po yin/ ma dpe 'di gnyis gsal ma gsal gyi khyad ma gtogs par ma gcig yin 'dug/ 'dir mar pa'i 'khrungs lo shad gug 'di lta bu'i (phyilo98 da) nang yod pa 'di zhu sgrig

51 pas bkod pa'i mchan yin/ mar pa'i rnam thar nang sbyar ba'i sa bcad kyang zhu sgrig pas phyag dpe gzigs pa po rnams la klog bde ba dang thugs la 'jags sla yong ba'i phyir/ khrag 'thung rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mar pa'i rnam thar mthong ba don ldan gyi sa bcad rnams 'dir lhan cig tu sbyar te/ deb grangasagacig stong 1000 tham pa wā ṇa badz+ra bisdi dpe mdzod nasa'agro gron btang te par skrun 'grems spel zhus pa lags pas/ chad lug nor 'khrul gang byung la bzod gsol snying thag pa nas zhu ba lags/rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa'i bsdus don/'dir rje btsun mar pa sku skye ba bzhes nas dam pa 'i chos dang mjal tshul/ rgya gar du bla ma mjal nas dam chos bod du spyan drangs chul/ nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs tshul/ rgya gar du lan gsum byon chul/ sras dar ma mdo sde sku gshegs tshul/ bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i lung bstan mdzad tshul/ sku'i sdu'aphrul gyis bkod pa bstan chul/ gzugs sku chos dbyis su thim tshul bcas bstan to//rje mar pa lo tsā ba la chen po la rtogasatshadathe/'i bsam gtan dgu zhesabya ba rgya gar nas bod tshun chad du gsungs pa/ bla ma la rtogs pa phul ba'i mgur dbyangs ring taskru ra'i khong 'gyur/ chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa 'i mgur mya ngan dran byed/ mched grogs la byon skyes su phul ba'i mgur dris pa dad ldan gyi dbyangs/ bkra shis byon skyems kyi mgur seṅge nga ro bsgrags pa'i dbyangs/ bying ba sel ba la mchan bltas dran pa 'i mgur chu lcag gi zil pa/ 'thor ba bsdu ba la rig pa chos dang bsre ba'i mgur sems kyi lcags kyu/ 'bras bu zad sar skyol ba la chos nyid lta ba'i mgur mkha' 'gro'i smre sngags/ mdzad spyod rgya'aphrul ngo ma tshar gyi mgur

511 chosaskyong gi shugs glu/ sems gnad du bsnun pa la snying po don gyi man ngag do ha rdo rje'i mgur lta ba khyung chen gyi gshog rgyangs bcas rgyasapar bstan yod do//mar pas nā 3du pa ma mjal phebagapa'i ma(ga snangag bsal ba/bod kyi rma khasapa kha cig gis mar pa dang na ro pa dusami mtshungasapas ma mjal bya ba dang / mar pas mjal ba de na ro rdza mgo bya ba na ro pa dngos mi na bya ba sogs zer ba yod pa sa/ de la //// ma'i 'dod gabakod pa dang / de la rang lugasakyidagag babakod pa gnyis las/rje btsun sa pa grag pa rgyal mtshan gyisa'adul 'dzin byang seng gi dri lan du mar pa dang na ro pa dus mi mtshungs pas ma mjal zhes gsungs te/ de mang 'dul ba 'dzin ba rnal 'byor byang sengalo/bangazhus ba'i grin yig las/jo bo nā ro ta pa dang mar pa mjal lam ma mjal gsung ba'i lan/ spyir 'di dag la lung med pa'i phyir lo rgyus tsam la brten te brjod pa lasagazhan shes par dka' ste/ nag tsho lo tsāba'i zhalanas/ nga btsun chung gcig gis jo bo spyan 'dren du phyin rtsa na/ jo bo ma gha dhar stabs dasalo gcig 'gor bar byung nas/ jo bo rwa ro pa snyan pa che bas zhal lta 'gro snyam te ma gha ta nas zla ba gcig shar lhor phyin pa na/ pu la ha ri zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang na jo bo zhugs zhes thosate der ltar phyin pa sa/ nga bsod namasache bar byung ste sleb pa'i nyin bar jo bo la rgyal phran cig phyag 'tshal ba yin zer nas phyi na khri chen po gcig rtsigs nas 'dug nga 'i rtsar bsdad/de nas khrom thams cad 'ur langs nasajo bo byon kyin 'dug zer te ltas pas/ jo bo sku bongs che ba dbu skra dkar ba las thal nas dmar yang nge ba sin du ra'i thod bcings pa mi bzhi tsam

5111 gyisarten nasagod la mur gin byon pa mthong / zhabasal 'ju gsung thosapa bya snyam tsa na dbang che chesaphar phar phul nas mtha' ru ston/ der rjo bo'i zhal ni mthong gsung ni ma thos/ de nas tshur log nas/ jo bo rje dang nged dpon g.yog gi lo gcig bal por bsdad pa'i dus na/ jo bo nā ro pa sku ni bor thugs mkha' spyod du gshegs te lha'i rol mo du mas bsus nas pur sbyong ba'i sar yang lha'i rol mo dang me tog la sogasapa'i mchod pa mang po byung zhesathos/ desan nged kyi mnga' ris stod du lo gsum sdad/ ma ra 'ongs nasagung thang du lo gcig sdad/ de nas mar 'ongasanas snye thang na jo bo chosagasung zhin bzhugs rtsa na/ mar bsgo gro kyi chos thun 'ga' gnyan nas song ba yin te/ kho dang jo bo mjal nas chos yun ring du mnyan zer te/ kho rang zer ram mi zer ram gsung bya ba'i lo rgyus rju na med pa gcig nas gcig tu rgyud pa'i gtam las thos so/ /bla ma mar pa rang gi slob ma 'phan yul na/ gcang dar dad pa ye shesabya ba gcig na re/ gzhan ci zer dang / nga'i bla ma na re/ nga dang jo bo nā ro pa de'u mjal ba la ma sleb/ jo bo'i slob ma gha gha me tri bya ba la gdams ngag thams cad thob ces gsung ngo zhes dad pa ye shesakyi nying11ba cig la kho bos thos/ des na mar pa rang yang gsung nges med/ mar pa'i glu yin zer ba phal cher yang cag dang mid la dang mes tshon po la sogs pa rnams la ni ma byung / phyis ngam pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig la byung nas 'phel ba las mar pa rang ge ma byas pa mang po 'dug /mid las blangs pa phal cher ngam rdzong rasapasabyas pa lasamid la rang gi byas pa tsam mi snang ngo / /mar ri 'i min par gang gis shes na mar pa'i glu yin zer ba kun la yang nang 'gal dang rgya gar gyi yul rgyus med pa gcig gis yul nor ba mang po bres nas 'dug pas mar pa'i tshig ma yin par mngon no/ /zhes gsungs so//gnyibasapa de la rang lug kyi dgag sgrub bkod pa la/ zangs chen mkhan po skal bzang chos kyi rgya mtshos/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa la/ rje bcun mar pa sa paṇa chen nā ro pa ma mjal zhes rje bcun chen po grags pas rnal 'byor byang seng gi dri lan du gsungasapa dang /

jo bo'i lam yig gis phyi ma mjal ba la dngos su gnod par song ba 'di la/ khyed cag gi lan ji ltar smra zhes 'dre ba'i lan las/'di na mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis/ /nā ro ru ṇa chen dngos su ma/ mjal zhes/ /rje btsun grags pas rnal 'byor byang seng gi/ /dri ba'i lan du gsungs la legs so 'am/ /mi 'thad snyam zhes nyid kyi yi ge son/ /de 'dra mkhas pa'i gsung rab yin mod kyang / /rgyal ba'i bka' la'ang brtag dpyad rjes su gnang / /des na stod smad ce rigs thog mar dbyad/ /'brog mi/ lo tsā chen ge 'i snam thar du/ /khong dang stag lo grogs mched bal yul gyi/ /shān+ta bha dra'i drung du sgra bslabs te/ /yul dbus bi kra ma yi gcug lag tu/ /ma/khas pa sgo drug kun la chosa'abrel zhus / /na ro pa ṇa chen byang sgo bsrung ba yin/ //khyad par sharnyi pa la rgyud gzhung gsan/ /rgya bal gnyis su bcu gsum lor bzhugs nas/ /bod du byon te myu gu lung zhes par/ /ma/ra pa dgung lo bcu gsum bzhesapa yis/ /lo tsā bslabs shes (gsanga'adusarmosa'abyung du lhu/bas pa bu ston bzhed/ /kha rag gnyos dang mar pa lo tsā gnyis/ /bal por lo gsum chad pa goms bcug rjes/ /pham mthing sku ma ched spang por yod pa la/ /pudzi ha rir nā ro pa ṇa chen ma jal/ /gzhos los ba leng a car+sha la brten/ /ye shes zhabs lugs gsang 'dus la sogs mnyan/ /tshur lam la yang lhan du byon par snang / /'brog mi gnyos dang pham mthing bden srid na/ /rma ra r+sā lo tsās nā ro dngos su mjal/ /'brog mi gnyosadangapham mthing brdzun yin zhing / /gsanga'adus mar lugs gdan bzhi mā sī sogs/ /nā ro mar pa'i rgyud pa 'ded byed pa/ /sa skya pa yi bla ma gong ma rnams/ /thams cad brdzu na gyi phreng ba kho na zhes/ /khyed cag bsngags ju 'i ba dan 'phyar na mdzes/ /rta nag 'gos kyang 'brog mi mar pa dang / /thog mnyam mkhas pa sgo drug dus yi na smra/ /'di sogs lo tsā dus mchungs gzhan yang yod/ /jo bo'i nyer bzhi shing sgrul la 'khrungs pa/ /'brom ston seng bcun slob ma mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sgro yi tsher ma zhes bya'i paṇ+ḍi tas//da sna 'phags yul paṇa chen 'dran med ni/ /na ro pa ste di po ka ra nyid/ /deng sang bzhugs na

de rjes che zer ba/ /rnam thar bris 'di khyed la tshad yin na/ /dus mtshungs nges phyir ji ltar bston par nus/ /de ltar dus mtshungs tsam zhig 'grig mod kyi/ /skusna tshigs 'grig gam snyam du the tshom pa/ /rtsad nas 'byin slad lo yi rtsis thong la/ /sdig pa bsagasarnamasamyur du bshags na legs/ /nā ro pa ṇa chen chu mo glang lo pas/ /nyer drug bzhes pa'i sa pho stag gi lor/ /mar pa sku 'khrungs de yi nyi shu dang / /paṇa chen dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ /me mo bya la thog mar mjal ba ni/ /dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang pos nges par bshad// (lugs 'disan ropa brgyadacu rgyalngabazhugs me mograng la mkha' spyod lagashegasapa ra 'dod/) rnam thar gzhan las mar pa bya 61 pas/ /bcu bdun lon pa'i dus su nā ro pa/ /mjal zhes byung bas de yi gung snying yang / /shing mo bya yi lo par bzung ba ste/ /snga phyi 'di gnyis jo ba'i dgung lo yang / /lcags pho rta dang shing rta 'dod dang sbyar/ /bdag gi mkhan po rin chen zhal snga nas/ /lo chen rin bzang sapho rta lo pa/ /de yi nyer lnga chu pho rta yi lor/ /jo bo 'brungs sheng lo chen nga lnga dang / /di dzo ka ra sum cu so gcig pa / /chu pho byi ba'i lo la mar pa bltams/ /sa pho 'byug lo jo bo'i zhe bdun dang / /mar pas dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa yi/ /lo de nas bzung lo drug zla ba bdun/ /nā ro pa ṇa chen zhabasapad mar pas bsten/ /'phags yul snga phyi gnyis su byon pa yi na/ /jo bo chen po (lcagasa'abrug ) nga dgu'i steng phebs nas/ /bal po'i yul du 'byon gong nā ro pas// (khache sngo na ri sags subazhugasapaslar bikra ma dh+wa par byon/)bstan pa gtad nas yun rings ma lon par/ /zhi bar gshegs zhes lam yig de la snang / /'di dang dus mtshungs ma kha' 'gro mas bskul te/ /mar pasabyon nga 'i (ma ra — 'irnamathar lapar/ lam du jo bo mjal/ /jo bo'i dgung rta mar pa'i rnam thar yang / /lo yi dbang thang mi 'dra 'dug na yang / /so so'i 'dod sbyar rim pas brtsisakyang 'grig /lo tshigs 'di rnams 'khrul lam ma 'khrul zhes/ /rngog dang ma tshur ston mi la rgyud par bcas/ /bka' gdamasasku mched rnam gsum la sogs dang / /dus mtshungs sgrigs dang 'khrul pa'i skabs mi srid/ /mar pa sa rgya gar phyi ma byon pa dang / /paṇa chen nā ro gshegs pa mthun snang ste/ /'di dus ma mjal gsung ba yin grang na/ /gzu bo'i blo yis dpya da par 'os pa nyid//

ra /1 gal te sku gdung sbyangs pa sa ma mjal na/ /grub chen gzhan la'ang ma chul sna tshogs byung / /rgyud pa 'dis ni sku lus ma spangs par/ /mkha' spyo da bzhud la mar pas bka' spyad de/ /ri bo gser gyi dgon par mjal bar bzhed/ /lo chen rje btsun mi la'i dpe bzhin du/ /mthong snang tha dad gnyis ka bden du rung / /ci ste rje btsun grags pa samangon shes kyis/ /de dag ma ma/jal dgongs pa yin na ni/ /so so skye bos 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /khyad du gsod nga 'i bden brdzun 'byed par dka'/ /de sna na yang mar do chos dbang gis/ /dus der ma ra pa dang mjal rgya gar gyi/ /ti ra hunyir na ro paṇ+ḍi ta/ /spyod pa la gshegs dngos su mjal gsung ba'ang / /brdzun gyi khongs su gtogs pa ra mdzad dgos mchis/ /'di gnyis brdzun na khyed kyi gsung 'di la/ /bden par rjes dpag yid rjes gang gis bskyed/ /dpal ldan di paṃ ka ra'i lam yig 'di/ /tshad mar mjad na jo bos lo chen la/ /rgyud sde bzhi ma'i nyams len stan gcig steng / /byed dgos gsung la smod par ji ltar 'os/ /jo bo rje yi gsung rab 7da med par/ /klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin gsung la/ /rnam pa du ma ra bsngags pa min sgrog pa / /'di yang de la chad ma ra bzung na 'gal/ /blo dang mthun gyur mu stegs gzhung len zhing / /de dang ma mthun gsung rab 'dor ba'i tshe/ /tshur rol mdzesakye sems spyod sna tshogs kyang / /kho rang blo mtshamasasmad du ci zhig yod/ /bka' gdams pa yang rdzo bo'i lam yig gi/ /rjes su 'brangs nas de bzhin smra ba rngams/ /dus mchungs lo tshigs bsgrigs na brtag pa las/ /mar pas nā ro lan gnyis mjal bar nges/ /phyi ma 'di 'dras gnod par dogs pa'i tshe/ /nā ro paṇa chen dngos grub mchog shing / /spyod pa snga mar rjes bzung ḍom+bi pa/ /jo bo nyid kyi bla ma yin pa yang / /lam yig 'dir byung tshad ma ra cis mi/ bzung / /jo bo'i sku gdung bzhus rjes (lamayig tu )ston pa la/// ṭ+wāṃ //nga ba bstan pa mi 'gal na/ /'di la'ang mtshungs pas yid ches gnas su mdzod/ /na ro paṇa chen 'khrungs yul rigs cam zhig /'dod pa tha dad smra ba byung na yang / /mkhas

5711 pa sgo drug ya gyal gyur pa yis/ /tislo pa bsten dka' ba spyad pa'i ma/thar/ /chos nyid bden pa gzigs sheng slar yang ni/ /byang sgo srung ba'i pa ṇa chen mdzad mthun pas/ /nā ro gnyis su 'byed pa 'i rig bzo spong / /cis kyang me 'thad nā ro gnyis byed na/ /khyed kyang bya dang zhang li rigs gnyis dang / /byar dang gnyal gyi 'khrungs yul gnyis 'dzin pas/ /skal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho gnyes 'gyur la/ /bdag kyang kre shod kong yul gnyis 'dzin zhing / /zhwa dang gdan sa'i ming yang tha dad pas/ /chos kyi grags pa gnyis kyang yod pa la/ /skye bo phyi rabs 'khrul pa'i gnas srid pas/ /da lha rnyed nas gcig cesasgrogs na 'thad/ /de 'dra'i ngos 'dzin dgos pa med mthong na/ /sngar smos rje btsun byams pa 'phags pa lha/ /pa d+ma 'byung gnas nā ro'i 'khrungs yul dang / /rigs kyang tha dad rnam thar byung ba yi sa/ /rgyal sras de rnams gnyis gnyis yod do zhes/ /rnam thar 'gal bsdum dogs pa ma shar ba'i/ /mkhas pa snga ma 'i srol lugs bzung ba legs/ /zhes pa 'di yang bram ze'i rigs kha che'i nā ro pa dang / rgyal rigs shar phyogs nga 'i rwa ro pa gnyis byas na/ gzhan gye brtsod pa mi 'jug pa 'dra zhes pa'i gsung lan du byas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing /de dang mthun par dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba rje btsun mar pa'i rnam tharaX/ba pa'i ngo mtsharabarjod pa lasakyang / bka' rgyud rin po che'i phrin las rgya mtsho'i bar du nyi 'od ltar bdal ba'i zer ma bzod pa sadad pa dang dag snang gi mig sdongs/ phra dog dang log lta'i mun pa 'phel ba kha cig mar pa dang na ro pa dus mi ma tshungs pasam ma/jal bya ba dang / mar pas mjal ba de na ro rdza ma go bya ba na ro pa dngos min bya ba sogs zer ba ni/ chos dang gang zag la smad pa la ngang pa pad mtshor 'jug pa ltar spro ba/ mishesarnamadabye medabar rgyubazhi sa/ r+sāmadabye11ba'i kha nibadud kyisabye/ /zhes pa 'i sgo 'byed pa po byung ba/ sngon byung gi lo rgyus rnams chos can/rang bzo'i brdzun yin te/ lo rgyus yen pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bdag cag gis brjod pa'i lo rgyus rnam snyobazhin no zhes pa'i rtags kyi tshul gsum rang la rgyus yod du grub pa dag gis/ sngon

55111 de bzhin gshegs pa la 'od srung rdzogs byed la sogs pas dge spyong rgo ta ma spu gri'i ser ba 'bebs shing 'ong ste/ khyed thams cad 'jom sa pa ra 'gyur ro zhes sgrog pa dang mtshungs pas chos bzhin gyi rtsod yul ga la len/ na ro pa dang mjal chul mgur dang rnam thar 'di cam bzhugasapa sngon byung lorgyu kyi tshad ma dang / phu la ha ri na dpon slob gnyis mjal ba'i zhabs rjesayod pa sogs rgya gar na rlung ltar gragasapa gragasapa'igatan tshigasadang / brgyud pa 'di'i man ngag rgya bod na gzhan su la yang ma grags pa da lta'ang dngosagrub thob pa rgyun ma chad nga 'di snyed cig bzhugs pa da11sa spre rnyasnabs zhugs kyi tshad ma dang / yid chebangapa'i rjes dpag la sogs pa sa grub bo/ /gal ste rnam thar rnams ma gcig go zhe na/ gdul bya so so'i skal ba bzhin snang ba 'char ba la su zhig gis tshad 'dzin/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras ston pa mjal ba kho na la'ang mi gcig pa'i mdo 'di snyed snang ba ltos shig /rje btsun na ro pa spyod pa la gshegs pa 'di la'ang kha cig gis sku 'das shing gdung sbyangs par snang ba yang byung / slob ma phal cher la zhal gdams dang byin rlabs kyi rten so sor gnang ste/ nags dang dur khrod grong khyer la sogs par rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang / smyon pa 'i spyod pas rgyu zhing sku lus gzugs sna tshogs par bsgyur zhing snang ba dang mi snang ba du ma ston par snang / kha cig la sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod du byon par yang snang ngo / /zhes gsungs shing /bka'abargyudagaser phrengarnam mthar zla ba chu shel gyi phreng ba las kyang / gzhan yang blun po phyogs zhen yin du re ba 'gas mar pas nā ro ta pa ma mjal zhesas skya rje bcun gyi gsung du brdzus te byasapa la/ blun po phyi ma rnams kyisarjes zlos byed mod/ 'jam dbyangasasapaṇa gyis/nā ro'i chos drug lugs gnyis dang zhes gsungs pa dang dngos su 'gal zhing / de bzhin du lho brag mgon po zangs gri can gyi brgyud pa'ang gang la 'ded bsam dgos pa dang / gzhan yang jo bo chen posakhyod kyi bla ma nā ro pa ni mkha' spyod du gshegasazin gsungs pa de'i lhags rma chamasagang la byed shes ldan rnams kyis sems par byas na log rtog de rnams sel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so//

515༄༅/ /rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar dang gsung 'bum dkar chagamar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros ni/ lho brag chu khyer du yab mar pa dbang phyug 'od zer dang / yum rgya mo 'od zer gnyis kyi sras su sku 'brungs/ khong dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge'i 'bri klog legs par mkhyen/ de'i skabs su spyod pa rgod cing rtsub pas rtsed grogs sus kyang glags mi 'thel ba zhig bzhugs/ dgung lo bco lnga par mang mkhar myu gu lung du phebs te 'brog mi shākya ye shes las sgra bsgyur bslabs shing legs pa ra mkhyen/ bal po spyi ther ba las dang la gdan bzhi sogs rgyud 'ga' zhig gsan pa dang / sgra tshad gso rig bcas la'ang legs par sbyangs/ rgya gar la lan gsum dang / bal yul la lan bzhi byon/ nub lak+ṣi ṭa'i dgon par phebs nas dpal ye shes snyi nga po las gsang 'dus dang / sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/rim lnga sogs gsan/ myo dug mtsho khol ma'i gling du byon te dpal zhi ba bzang po las ma hā rmā ya dang / rnal 'byor gsum/ sgyu ma gsum sogs rgyud kyi gdams pa gsan/ shar phyogs kyi ri rab tu 'khyugs pa'i dgon nga ra phebs nas mnga' bdag mi tri pa las rgyud kyi gdams pa dang / phyag rgya chen po 'i man ngag gsan nas rtogs pa mngon sum du 'khrungs/ byang phyogs put+pa ha rir byon nas rje nā ro pa las dgyes rdor rgyud dang / bsre 'pho ma chams sbyor gyi gdam sa ngag gtum mo'i las rgya sogs lo ngo bcu drug tu gsan/ nā ro dang mi tri rnam gnyis kyis byang phyogs kha ba can 'dul ba'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ spyir rje btsun mar pa'i bka'adrin cheba'i bla ma bcugasumani/ mkhas grub ra ro pa ṇa chen/ rgyal sras mi tri pa/ dpal zhi ba bzang po / ye shes snying ngo// rnal 'byor ma rus pa'i rgyan can/ ka so ri ba dang / ri ri ba ste seṅge gling pa sku mched/dze rta ri pa/ ku su lu che ba/ pra dz+nya rak+ṣi ta/ spyi ther ba dang / pen ta ba ste bal po sku mched/ jo bo rje a ti sha rnams lags so//rje de'i rigasadang chosakyi sras gnyis las/ jo cho bdag med ma la 'khrungs pa dar ma

55mdo sde dang /dar ma dpal/phyag thung ma la dar ma bsam gtan/gzhan bzang nge /ngan ne+e/dge 'dun/bya ring 'bor lo stesngo byon/chosakyi zasabu mu byon tshul ni/rngog ston chen po shesarab kyis mnyes pa'i sras/mtshur ston sku dgra btul bsamanyesapa'i sras/me go zhabasatog gis mnyes pa'i sras/mi dzodad gus kyis mnyes pa'i sras te mnyesala'i bu bzhi/srasamado sde la grong 'jug gi bka' babs/dol ba gag ston la sgyu lusakyi bka' babs/gra'i mi chung la 'pho ba'i bka' babs/chu gong dpal le la rim lnga'i bka' babs/dge bshes kher gad ba la gzhung bshad kyi bka' babs pa ste bka' babasakyi bu lnga/klog skya lo tsā ba 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan/tsam lung gi mar pa mgo legs/la yag gi ba rang lnga ba can/'phan yul gyi nya ma dpal mo ste mos sacan bzhi bcas so// rtsomadangagasung rtsomathamasacadabakun:rdotshan brdzubaste/thog mar bka' bab byin brgyud kyi spyi bshad dang /de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar dang gsung mgur/de nas4 par dbang gi skor/daru la bde mag gi skor/phyag rgya ོ po'i skor/nā ro chosadrug gi skor/snyan brgyud kyi chos skor/gegs sel gyi skor/rgyud 'grel gyi skor/lasatshogs kyi skor/chosasrung gi skor bcas chos tshan bcu gcig deb chen stod smad bar gsum gyi nang du bzhugasapa las/dang po stod cha la/dang bo bka' babasabyin brgyud kyi snyi bshad la/bka' babs byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa spyi bshad/rtogasapa byin rlabasakyi brgyud pa/bka' babs nyams kyi brgyud pa/ring brgyud bka' bzhi bla ma'i rnam thar/gnyisabarnamatharadangagasung mgur/dpal tai lo pa'i rnam thar dang gsung mgur/dpal nā ro pa'i rnam thar dang mgur/rdo rje 'chang tai lo pa dang nā ro ye shes dngos grub kyi rnam ma gur/sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tswa'i rnam thar chen mo mthong ba don yod/mar pa lo tswa'i rnam mgur/

551 gsumabadabang cho khuskor/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ dbang bzhi nyamasaphyag rgya chen po/ dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdusatshigasabacad can/ dbang rgyud kyi gdams pa dpal he ru ma'i smin byed/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i me dbang gi cho ga /dbang 'brel rgyud kyi gdams pa 'od gsal nyi zla kha spyor gyi zhal gdams/ dbang bdud 'grol gyi gdams pa dang brda yi sgo nas gnyug ma'i don bstan pa/ dbang gi phyag len kha skong bstan pa bzhugs/bzhi bdapalabade mchogagi ro khu(ra/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lo rgyus/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lo rgyus/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha bcu gsum gyi cho ga /yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig /dpa la bde mchog gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag /blon po rigs gsum lasabyed dang dmangasa'aphrin lasamathun sbyor/ bde mchog gsang ba rin po che'i lhan cig skyes pa 'i bsdusadon/ dbang 'brel rgyud kyi gdams pa bde mchog gsang ba rin po che/ bde mchog gsang ba rin po che yid bzhin nor bu'i mngon rtogasargyas pa/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba/ rdo rje pha ga mo'i lhan cig skyesama'i sgom bzlas/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i gdams pa lan cig skyes ma'i sgrub thabasashes 'brel ma/ dpa la maba' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs rnams bzhugs/lnga pa rgyag rgya chen po'ilhar/ phyag rgya chen po gaṅga ma/ dpa la tai lo pa'i gzer drug nag po dge ba la gdam sa pa/ mnga' bdag mi tri pa 'i phyag chen gser gyi phreng ba/ me tri pa 'i man ngag zab mo lam dgu phrugs/ lta ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ phyag rgya chen po/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig brgyad pa/ rgyud kun gye bcud bsdus bar do ngo sprod lam bde chen blo phyag chen bzhag pa'i man ngag /rgyud bla ma'i tshig don rnam par 'grel pa/

drug pa nā ro chos drug gilhar/ chos drug gi rtsa ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gsung bka' yang dag pa'i chad ma/ sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā'i thugs kyi nying khu na ro chos drug sras ma khar ma/ chos drug ka dpe/ zab lam snying po nā ro'i chos drug gsang ba bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ thun cho nga gi zhal gdam sa chos drug gi nyams len du dril ba/ slob ma ra byin rlabs 'pho ba/ steng sgo rnam/ pa ra grol ba'i gdams pa/ gtum mo/ gtum mo a thung / sgyu lus kyi man ngag /rmi lam/ rmi lam lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa/ gnyid 'od gsal/ 'pho ba'i man ngag /sem/sa grong du 'jug pa'i man ngag /rnam shes bar dor sbyangs chul/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa le la bslab pa zab mo/ bka' bzhi lorgyus dang bcasapa bsre 'jo lag len du drel ba/ bsre ba'i man ngag skor gsum/ bsre ba'i gdams ngag sgom chul bco brgyad/ bsre ba'i man ngag /'od gsal don ba'i ma/ bar do'i rnam gzhag dang nyam sa len/ chos drug gi man ngag ces bya ba/ rtsa rlung de kho na'i rnal 'byor dra ba'i 'khor lo bdud rtsi 'od zer can/ rje mar pa'i zab rlung skor gsum/man ngag tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ mchog gi gtum mo sbar ba'i ma na ngag /ra sa ya nā'i bcud len rnams bzhugs/gnyisapa bar cha la/ bdun pa snyan brgyud kyi chos |ra/ dang la tai lo pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa/ snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i pra khrid lung bstan tai la'i gsung / lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi rtsa ba/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu'i gzhung las ma ra pas gdan drangs pa lnga/ lus med ma kha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu las ma ra pa sagadan drangasapa'i gzhung snga ma lnga'i rnam bshad/ snyan brgyud las bde mchog zab pa lhan skyes/ snya na brgyud gsang ba'i ma na ngag /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu las yab bka' 'khor slo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs/ snyan brgyud yab bka'i bum dbang gi dkyil chog rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me/ bde mchog snyan brgyud las rtsa ba drug yan lag so dgu gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad/ snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mchog dbang gsum dngos su bskur ba'i lag len/ snyan brgyud gdams

55111 pa rdo rje tshig gi mdud 'grol/ dpal bde mchog snyan brgyud gsang ba'i man ngag /dpal bde mchog snyan brgyud gsang ba'i man ngag gi mchan 'grel/ snyan brgyud bde mchog lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ snyan brgyud las bde mchog rgya che ba'i lhan skyes sgrub thabs/ dpal lhan cig skyes ma'i ma ngon rtogs rgyal mo chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i gdams pa/ yi dam dgyesapa rdo rje'i shog dril/ yi dam rdo rje phag ma'i shog dril/ bde mchog dmangs 'phrin las 'thun sbyor gyi shog dril/ mar pa lo rtswa'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo'i rtsa tshig /mar pa lo tswa'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo'i 'grel pa/ mar pa lo tswa'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ 'pho ba spyi rtol gyi rtsa tshig /mar pa lo tswa'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ 'pho ba spyi rtol gyi 'grel pa/ mar pa lo tswa'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ bar do blo chod kyi gdams pa / mar pa lo tswa'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ bar do blo chod kyi 'grel pa/ mnga' bdag mar pa lo cu'i snyan gyi shog dril las/ phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus rtsa tshig /rma nga' bdag mar pa lo tsā'i snyan gyi 3snag dril las/ phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus mchan 'grel/ phyag rgya chen po'i tshig bsdus 'grel pa / snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang / rlung gi zhal gdams/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rnam gsum/ spros med ting 'dzin dbar gi shog dril/ 'dod chagasardo rje'i shog dril/ ser sna rdo rje'i shog dril/ gti mug rdo rje'i shog dril/ nga rgyal rdo rje'i shog dril/ phrag dog rdo rje kun bkur sde/ zhal gdam sa shog dril/ las kyi rdo rje'i shog drel/ sgyu lus kyi man ngag skor rdo rje'i shog dril/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje grong 'jug gi shog dril/ gnod sbyin kul ngo dang thod can gyi shog dril/ rgyal po chos nyid rang grol gyi shog dril/ bha ga rdo rje'i shog dril rnam sa bzhugs/brgyad pa gegs sel gyilha ra/ gegs sel yid bzhin nor bu gsal byed snying ngo / rlung ge de nyid bdun ce/ 'byung bzhi ro snyoms/ na tsha bogs dbyung ba'i gzer/ 'chi ba grogs su 'khyer ba'i gzer/ nyon mongs lam du slong ba'i gzer/ rnam rtog rang sar grol ba'i gzer/bar chad g.yang du blan nga 'i gzer/ dpal gsang ba 'dusang 'i man ngag rim lnga/ gsang 'dus

5515rim lnga'i gdams ngag /rim lnga'i bsdus gsal/ rgyud sdegacig drel gye zhus lan/ bdo bstan rdo rje tshig rkang gi gdams pa/ dpal rgyud kye rgyal po kye'i rdo rje'i brtag gnyis pa'i khrid yi ga 'bum chung nyi ma/ kye'i rdo rje rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel nga bka' yang dag nga 'i tshad ma / kye'i rdo rje'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur gyi srog shing / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi man ngag de kho na nyid bcu ru rnaskyo/tha bsdokyib/tha /gsum pa smad cha la/ dgu pa rgyud 'grel gyi skor/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud gzhung / dkyil 'khor gye cho ga mdo dang sbyar ba/ ma hā rmā ya'i gdams ngag bka' bgros don drug /dpal bde mchog rtsa rgyud ṭīk+ka zin bris/ gnyis med rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud 'grel/ dmar mo khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i rgyud/ ma ru tse bshan pa/ sgrol byed kyi rgyud/ sgye badz+ra gyi sngags don/ rgyud kyi zhus lan/bcapa lasatshogasasnye/ra/ kye'i rdo rje'i las tshogs/ adzi'i bsrung 'khor/ kha sbyar dbye ba bstan pa/ dgra bsad pa/ las sbyor/ klu bsdigs pa/ byad bzlog /las rgya'i man ngag zab pa/ dgra myos pa dang / gzhon nu ma dgug pa gnyis/ bde ma chog 'khor lo'i lhan thabs gtor 'bul/ tshogs kyi 'khor so'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom/ pa'i sbyin sreg gi man ngag /dpa 'a bo gcig pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /las rgya'i man ngag shin tu zab pa tshigs su bcad pa/ 'phrin las gtor ma 'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhung / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gtor chog lag mchod phyi mchod gsum gyi gzhung / mar nga 'i zhal gdams phra men ske phrug /rdo rje lte dbab kyi 'grel pa mu tig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rim pa / phyag na rdo rje lte dbab kyi gsang ba'i yang bkol gyi sgrub thabs rnams bzhugs/bcugacigapa chosasrupaskor/ nag po chen po 'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dud sol ma'i gsol bsdus bcas bzhugs so//

dpa la ma nga' bdag sgra sgyur mar pa/ lo tsā ba chos kyi blo grosakyi gsung 'bum dkar chag 'di ni/ 'bri gung 7skyabs mgon che tshang 'phren las lhun grub mchog nas 'phags yul 'bri gung bka' brgyud byang chub gling nas spyi lo 2009 lor par skrun 'grems spel zhus pa gzhi bzung bkod pa lags/zhes bal bod kyi sa mtsham sa/ shar sba khang don grub sdings kyi bcun pa tshe ring shar pa sa/'phags yul grong khyer chen po wā rā ṇa si'i nye 'dabs su gnas pa'i badz+ra bisdi gcug lag slob gnyer khang du phyi lo 2010 zla 7 tshes 25 nyen sbyar ba'o//

5571 dkar chagag sngon brjod/ 3kha rje bcun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/ 1ga dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam 'brul pa'i bzhin ras 'char ba'i me long 229nga dpa' bo gcug lag phreng ba'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi dkar chag 267sgra ra mar pa lo tsā ba de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad garnam thar lar ba la lnga/1 sku skye ba bzhes nas dam pa 'i chos dang mjal tshul/ 22 rgya gar du bla ma mjal nas dam chos bod yul du spyan drangs tshul/ 63 nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs tshul/ 1614 bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 1755 gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim tshul lo// 223gnyi brgyagar du bla gamaralanasadam chos bod snyel duspyan drapasatshulal/rgya gar la lanagasum byon pa'i/ lan dang po lagasum/1 rgya gar du 'byon pa thugs la shar te chasapas grogs dang mjal te rgya gar la byon tshul/ — 62 rgya gar du phebs nas mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal te dam pa'i chos thob tshul/ ske — 83 dbang gdams pa sogs dam pa'i chos rnams thob nas slar bod du byon tshul/ 30rgyagar la lanaganyisapa 'byonab la mngasnga ma ltar donagasum/1 gser tshol du byon zhing bu slob rnams dang mjal tshul/ 47

55511 2 rgya gar la byon nasabla ma rnamasadang mjal te chos zhusachul/ 543 bod la byon chul/ 68rgyagar la lanagasum pa 'byon pa la yang snga ma ltar donagasum/1 gser la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bsgrub tu byon tshul/ 752 bla ma nā ro pa btsal zhing chos gsan tshul/ 813 bod la byon tshul/ 11/bzhi pa bstan pa dang semasacan laphan thogs mdzad tshul lagasum/1 sras sku yal bas skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi sgo nas kun gyi thugs dam la bogs thon tshul/ 1752 bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la dar rgyas 'byung bar lung bstan gnang tshul/ 200mi 'gro kun dang ba 'dren phyir bkod pa sku'i rdzu'aphrul bstan tshul lo// 209

༄tsho/ /rje btsun mar pa'i rnam par thar pa grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa bzhugs so//༄༅/ /rje btsun mar pa'i rnam par thar pa grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo//skad cig nyid la ye shes mchog/ lastsol mdzad rdo rje 'chang dbang po//he ru ka dpal lo tswa'i skur//snang mdzad dpal ldan bla mar 'dud//gang gi ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i mtha'//rgyal bas gzung bar mi nus mod//'on kyang dad pas drangs pa yis//cha shas tsam zhig 'dir dgod bya//gang rgyal ba thams cad dang rang bzhin tha mi dad pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gsang ba thams cad pa skad cig res kyang snang bar 'gyur ba grub pa chen po 'di rnams kyi tshul bdag cag gi spyod yul ma yin mod kyang dgos rdzu cung zad las/ ngo mtshar gyi gleng slong ba kun las btus pa cha shas cig gleng bar rno ༵/nga/ ston pa dngos kyis 'dul ba dag la chags bral gyis 'dul ba la de bzhin

2rje btsunamar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'ingo mtsharabarjodapa/gshegs pa nyid dang / chags bcas kyis 'dul ba'i ngor rdo rje 'chang chen por bstan zhing gsang ba sku brgyad la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bstan la/grub pa'i rnam pas 'dul ba'i ngor ḍom+bi he ru ka chen po la sogs par gyur cing /slar yang dngos grub dam pa de mi'i skye bos kyang tshul 'di ltar du bsgrubs na dka' ba med par 'grub bo ces spro sring ba dang /mchog gi gdams pa rnyed par dka' bas 'di ltar du lus srog la ma ltos par tshol zhing sgrub dgos so zhes 'doms pa'i ched du/bod yul 'dir mar pa sto brag pa'i mtshan du snang bar mdzad la/ de'i tshe'i gdul bya thun mong ba rnams la ji ltar snang bar bdag cag gis 'du shes pa de tsam zhig 'dir brjod par bya'o//sgro ra mar ba lo tsā de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa rnam thar las/1 sku skye ba bzhesanas :ra gyi dam pa'i chosadang mjal tshul/ bye brag tu rgya gar la byon nasachosaphyir dka' gaspyad cing / mkha grub kyi bla ma rnamasalasadam chosanod ba bod bul du spyan drangs tshul/ thugs nyams su bzhes pas nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs tshul/de'i sgo na bstan ba dang semasacan la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ bstan pa dang semasacan gyi don mdzad nasagazugs chosadabyingasasu zim tshuladang lnga'o//dang po sku skye ba bzhes nas spyir gyi dam pa'i chos dang mjal tshul ni/de yang sku bltamasapa'i gnasani/bod gangs can gyi lte ba dbus gtsang gi ru bzhi las/g.yo ru'i rgyud lho brag nang ma'i stod gangs lung spe sar dkon mchog stod kyi bkra shis ling nga zhes bya ba'o//chu khyer du 'khrungs par grags kyang /sngon chu khyer ru dgu zhes pa la spe sar 'dren pa'i dbang du byas pa'o//sa bcad 'di zhuzhig pas phyagadapegazigasapa po rnamasal klogabade ba dngazugasala'ajagasamayong ba'i phyar/khrag 'thungargyal pos mdzad pa'i mar pa' rnam thar mthong bdon ldanagyi sa bcad rnamasa'adar lhan cig sbyar ba lags/

skuskye babazhes nasadam pa'i chosadangamajal tshul/ 3gdung ni mar pa/ de la dkar nag gnyis las dkar po/ /mar pa khri 'jam bya ba la stod tam mar yul nas chad pa'i rgyud par bshad/ rngog ba'i rnam thar rim bzhin/ mar pa sha ru rtse bya ba yar lung nas chad par 'dod/ de las dkon mchog gi rgyud/ de las bab mched gsum gyi 'bring po dbang thog 'od ra/ yum rgyal mo blo gros lcam gnyis la sras lnga bltams pa'i gsum pa rje 'di'o/ /bum rgyal mo 'od ra 'tsho dang / sman mo khye 'dren dang / skal ldan da ces kyang snang la/ yab mar ston chos kyi 'khor lo zhes rnam thar gnyis na snang yang sngags pa'i rigs ma yin la/ mnga' bdag nyang gi yab myang ston chos kyi 'khor lo zhes grags pa dang nor ba'o//yab rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa khyim bdag gi tshul dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gror bzhugs la/ lhums su bzhugs dus mar me thogs nas dzam gling gi mun pa bsal ba dang / dung bus pa'i sgras stong gsum gang ba dang / nyi zla shar nas nu ma'i thad tu byung ba sogs barmis so//gzung lo la/ rnam tharasnga rabasam gcig du chu pho rta lo (phyi lo 982) zla ba bcu gcig pa'i bco lnga/ skar ma rgyal la 'khrungs par bshad kyang / de lta na jo bo rje dang dgung mnyam du 'gyur bas ma 'grig /jo bo rje 'brungs nas lo bco brgyad song ba'i lcags byi (phyi lo1000) la 'khrungs nas gya drug bzhugs par mtshur phu ba'i bka' rgyud gdung rabs las bshad/ tshal ba'i deb dmar las/ de las lo gnyis kyis snga ba'i me bya (phyi lo 997) la 'khrungs nas gya brgyad bzhugs par bshad/ 'o1 rgyubangathe tshomi se'akhabyed bya ba zhe sdang rdo rje dang / mi skyod rdo rje'i sbyar byang yod pa gnyis dang / ngam rdzong lugs gnyis sogs rnam thar drug bdun las/ de las gnyis kyis 'phyi ba'i chu stag (phyilo 1002) la 'khrungs nas/ brgyad cu'am don brgyad bzhugs par 'chad/ snga rabs ma gnyis na de las drug gis 'gyi ba'i me rta (phyi lo 1006) pa gya brgyad tam gya drug bzhugs

4rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa 'ingomatsharabarjod /par 'chad/ deb sngon po sogs mang zhig bcu gnyis kyis 'phyi ba'i chu byi (phyi lo1012)la 'grungs par 'chad/ sbyan snga chos 'byung na shing byi ba (phyi lo 1024) gya bzhi bzhugs par 'chad pa spyir lo rgyus thams cad dang 'gal med tu 'grig thub nga cig gang la'ang mi snang yang / re zhig lcags byi (phyi lo 1000) la 'khrungs nas gya drug bzhugs pa'i phyogs dag par sem mo//rngog pa'i rnam thar rim bzhi las/ byi ba lo pa gya dgu bzhugs par bshad pa'ang 'di dang 'grig zhing / gya drug la gya dgu zhes pa mig nor du snang ngo //sku chung ngu'i dus dge ba'i rtsed mo dang / rgya bal gyi lo rgyus nyin rtser gsung ba zhig byung / dgung lo bcu gnyis nas slob dpon rnying ma ba zhig la klog bslabs pas bri klog gnyi ga tshegs med du mkhyen/ bar du thugs gtum zhing mi srun pa cig byung bas 'dul ba'i phyir/ bu yul gyi sras na yul kha cig yod pa byin nas lung pa'i bdag po rdzo bo snyi ba zhig la btad pas der yang ma chun/ 'dis phyi nang du kha mchu sbyor ba 'dug pas chos la gtong ba 'thad ces gnyen rnams kha 'cham/ling ba bar du zhing rmo ba'i thong mkhan mdzad pas glang gis g.yang du bskyur/ rdo bsnun pas sna khrid pa la phog nas shi bas thugs skyo ste ga re mi lus glog 'gyu ba tsam 'ji la chos cig ma byung na cis kyang dgos pa mi 'dug khams su chos la 'gro dgongs/yang khams pa rnams dbus su 'ong / dbus pa rnams gtsang du 'gro bar 'dug pas rgyas pa ldang ba'i shog bu dang / gser sogs bskur ba bsnams ste lo bco lnga pa la gtsang du 'gos 'brog gi sar byon/ 'gobangal sgron gsal gsan pas tshegs med du mkhyen nas yig cha'ang mdzad/ 'phrog mi la yo byad kun phul yang 'di rnams kyis nga'i rgyud mchod gcig mi 'gro gsung nas chos ma gnang / 'on kyang dzo gi rnams la phal skad dang bla ma nyid la lo gsum du sgra mkhas par bslabs/ gur gyi dpe'ang g.yar ma gnang

sku skyeb bzhesanas dam pa'i cho dang mjal tshul/ 5ba dang / nor med na skal bar ldan rung chos mi ston par 'dug dgongs nas/ zur za brgyad kyi dbyangs kyang mdzad/ rgya gar la 'byon par dgongs/ 'dirnam mgur las/ lo bcu gnyis lon nas chos dang mjal//dang por mig tshangs ka kha bslabs/ /ces dang /dpal myu gu lung gi dgon pa sa/gsang sngags chos kyi mu ge la//sems yi dwags byed cing lo gsum bsdad/ /ces dang /sgra sgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la//sgra thang log skad kyi yig tshangs bslabs/ /ces pa'i don to//

6rjebatsun mar pa' rnamathar grubapa'angomatsharabarjodapa /rgya gar la 'byon thengs dang po/gnyisab bye bragatu rgyagar la byon nasachosaphyir dka' ba spyad cing /mkha grub kyi bla ma rnams las dam chos nod pa bod khul du sbyan drangs tshul la/ rgya gar la lan gsum byon pa'i dang bo la/ rgya gar du 'byon ba thugasal shar te mthun rkyen bsgrub nasachasab grogasadang mjal te rgya gar la byon tshul/ rgya gar du phebasanasamakhasagrub kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal te theg chen gyi snying po don gyi dam chosarnams thob tshul/thobarasasnar bod du byon tshul dngagasum gyi/dang po rgya gar du 'byon pa thugs la shar te mthun rkyen bsgrubs nasachas pas grogs dang mjal te rgya gar la byon tshul ni/de ltar rigs rus cho 'brang bar ma la gzigs pa dang / sku mched du ma mnga' ba dang /'jig rten pa'i blor mi 'tsham pa'i spyod pa mjad par ston pa sogs thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas dam pa'i chos la gegs dang bral bar gyur cing / 'brog mi chos ma gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis rgya gar du bskul bar gyur to//yul du nye 'brelarnamabangal/kye ma/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting re zab//mya ngan 'das pa ngang re spro//dal 'byor rnyed pa shin tu dka'//skyes nas 'chi bar thag chod cing //'dus byas nam 'jig cha med la//

rgya garal 'byon thengasangangaro / 7chos min cis kyang dgos pa med//chos phyir sdug grir shi yang rung //mi sdod rgya gar yul du 'gro//sprul sdidī bzhugs gnas do rje'i gdan///shā ༵ na /bye lhabadu ༵ zlog//sa pa'i//bla ma mtshan ldan tshol du 'a11//nor zog bcos slad ma byas pa'i//zab mo'i gdams ngag tshol du 'gro//zhes gsungs/ g.yu chen mthong ba nyamabangadaga'am skar chen 'od 'phro bsnams ste btsongs pas/ rta nag po seng ge srab med dang / seng ldeng rang gug gi sga dngul sgrogs sha ba can la sogs pa byung ba'am yul nas bsnams kyang zer/ de rnams rtag sde mdog ris su btsongs pas gser du byung ba bsnams/ klog skya ston chen de stag sde mig mangs su slob mas chos 'khor la spyan drangs ste/ phyir 'byon pa la lam grogs mdzad pas bkur sti cher mdzad ste skyer phur phebs tshe/ nga brgas pas khyed dang mjal mi thub/ jo sras 'di kun la zhabs tog byed tu 'jug pas 'dir 'byon par zhu zhes rdzong dar mdzad/kha rag gi gnyos 'byung po sngar yang rgya gar du phyin pa cig dang lam 'dzom nga la gser mang po yod lhan cig du bya zhes kha zho blud pas khong gi grogs dan kyang mdzad/ kyi rong du 'phagasab wa ti la gsol ba 'debs cing zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ der chos zhu ba 'ga' 'i gan+da/ngatha pa/

8 rje btsun marapa'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngo mtshar brjodapa/tshe 'di mdang gi rmi lam 'dra//phun sum tshogs kyang yud tsam yin//lto gos ji ltar byas kyang phyid//shi nas byang chub tshol ba med//sdig pa'i las la srog bzhin 'dzems//bsod nams tshogs chen 'bad nas sogs//skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum po la//sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su song //sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa yis//byang sems bslab pa gang bslabs pa//de yi rjes su sgrub bya zhing //'gro la ci phan dge la 'bad//ces sogs gsungs pas kun dad cing mos/(gnyis pa rgya gar du phebs nas mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal te theg chen snying po don gyi dam chos thob tshul ni/)de nas bal por byon/ lo gsum du tshad pa la 'dris su bcug zhing / bal po : ther ba la gdan bzhi dang / chos skyong dud sol ma gsan/ dgyes rdor gyi dbang bskur thob/nub du la k+ṣe r+shar dpal ye shesasnying po'i drung du 'gro ba la/ lam na chu dug can lus la

rgya gar la 'byon theng dang po/ 9reg na sha pags zul 'gro ba 'dug pa ri brags na yul chung zhig 'dug pa'i mi la rngan pa byin pas shing lo cig btsal/ de lus la byugs nas brgal bas sprul shun ltar lpags pa yam pa cig brjes song / der paṇ+ḍi ta ye she snying po la kṛ ya dang / u pa'i phyogs dang / sgrub skor mang du zhus/ der tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad cing 'dug pa na/rnal 'byor pa ce cang la zhon pa cig dang / byi la la zhon pa cig dang / rdzu 'phrul can bzhi byung / su yin dris pas thams cad na ro pa'i slob ma yin/ gnyis ku su li che chung bya ba/che bas tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi lta stangs grub/ chung bas thun mong brgyad thob/ ce cang la zhon pa 'di da parag po ba zer/ grong khyer nas tshogs rdzas 'gugs nus/ byi la la zhon pa 'di the pa zer/ sbyin sreg gi thab khung du yi dam zhal gzigs/ bzhi ga spyod pa nus pa yin zer bas dad ste gser cung zad re phul/ gdams ngag re zhus/na ro ba ces mtshan thos pa tsam gyis byin rlabs zhugs/ khyad par be〉bas rgya gar na yon la ma ltos par gdams ngag ston pa rje na ro pa las med/ nga'i bla ma sangs rgyas dngos de'i sar skyel ba yin/ zhes dge tshul shes rab seng ge la phrin yig mdzad ste nā len+dar byon/ de na paṇa grub rgya mtsho lta bu yod kyang / rje na ro pa la 'gran pa'i zla med zer/ rje na ro pa nub phyogs la byon 'dug /nang cig rje na ro pa nye ba na phebs yod/slar shar phyogs su 'byon pas mjal bar 'dod pa 'dug na shog gsung ba byung /der ljongs me tog brgyan pa'i grong khyer/ ri bo gser gyi dgon par mjal ma thag sgyi bor phyag bzhag nas/bla mas lung bstan bdag gis bu//sdod ldan mar pa blo gros kyis//kha ba can ljongs byang phyogs nas//rgyal tshab 'dzin phyir sleb pa legs/ /ces gsungs/

10 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/bal por dbang thob pa des chog gsung nas dgyes rdor rtsa bshad la tshogs bshad dang / slob bshad man ngag dang bcas pa bde mchog dang lhan cig skyes ma sogs gnang zhing / gtum mo a thung gi man ngag la gnad tu bsnun/ —spyir thos bsam sgom pa lhan cig du mdzad/ sngar gyi bla ma dpal ye shes snying po la gsang ba 'dus pa nyon zhes lung bstan ste 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi dbang bskur/ rtsa rgyud snga phyi/ bshad pa'i rgyud rnams/ gnyis med rnam rgyal sogs 'phags lugs kyi bshad pa rim lnga'i smar khrid sogs dbyis phyin par gsan zhing / lam rim pa lnga'i mthar phyin/ bla ma rnam gnyis la sangs rgyas su thag chod nas btang rag gi tshogs gral du bla ma la rdo rjeswā1'i maṇ+ḍalaphul ba/rje sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'i sku//bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal 61//zhing dag pa na ro paṇa chen dang //dpal ye shes snying po'i zhabs la 'dud//nga lho brag bod tu las dbang gis//pha ma gnyis kyis lus bskyed pa'i//mar pa blo gros dgyi ba 'di//chos la bkod pa'i bka' drin can//yab sdo/ma gnyis la gus phyag 'tshal//drin chos kyis 'khor bar byin gyis rlobs//rang bzhin skye med kyi maṇ+ḍal la//snang ba sna tshogs kyi me tog bkod//

rgya gar la'abyon thengasadangapo/ 11bla ma'isku lamachod bar 'bul//bdag gi lus la byin gyis rlobs//na mkha' rnam dag gi maṇ+ḍal la//'gag med rten 'brel gyi me tog bkod//bla ma'igasung lamachod par 'bul//bdag gis ngag la byin gyis rlobs//rang sems bde chen gyi maṇ+ḍal la//rnam rtog 'phral 'joms kyi me tog bkod//bla ma'i zugasalamachod par 'bul//bdag gi yid la byin gyis rlobs//rin chen sa gzhi'i maṇ+ḍal la//ri rab gling bzhi'i me tog bkod//bla ma'i skugasung snyegasal mchod bar 'bul//bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs//zhing khams sa gzhi rab 'byams la//'byung ba lnga las skyes pa yi//mchod yon me tog bdug spros dang //snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang //rol mo la sogs mchod rdzas rnams//legs par grub pa ji snyed pa//

12 rjebatsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/bla ma rje la mchod par 'bul//bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs//na mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi//gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo dang //bla bres yol ba la sogs pa//blo yis sprul nas mchod par 'bul//rtogs pa 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs//sangs rgyas ye shes snying po la//rgyud chen gsang ba 'dus pa nyan//thabs zhes zung du 'jug par go//chos kyi lde mig yin par go//rgyud kyi rgya mtsho yin par go//chos dang zang zing sbyin pa byung //snying gi ljon shing rgyas byed cing //tshig tshogs dri med lo 'dab rgyas//ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can//'gro ba'i don rnams mtha' dag 'byung //rim lnga'i lam mchog sgrod pas bde//'od gsal sgyu lus rmi lam gyi//gdams ngag rin chen thugs la btags//

rgyagar la 'byon thengasadang po/ 13sku drin che 'o dz+nya na pa//'di nas bzung ste mthar thug gi//bla med byang chub ma thob bar//spyi gtsug bde ba chen po'i rgyan du bzhugs//snying gi dkyil du 'bral thabs med//skyo 'jigs med par skyabs su mchi//thugs rje'i lcags kyu 'od zer can//ma rig mun pa bsal nas kyang //lus ngag yid gsum zung du gsol/ /zhes phul/yang bla mas dug mtsho'i gling na slob dpon casari ba bya ba ma rgyud kyi bdag po cig bzhugs pas der ma hā mā ba zhus shog /de la srin mo'i gling du 'khyams dogs pa dang /rtsi dug gi gnod pa dang 'jigs pa du ma yod pas byin rlabs bya'o gsung nas tshogs cig bshams/ na ros dur khrod la sdigs mdzub bstan pas rnal 'byor pa dur khrod 'dzin pa gsum byon/ nga'i bu mar ba 'di dug mtsho'i gling du gtong ba la khyed gsum gyi bar chad med par gyi cig gsungs pas rtsi dug dang / srin mo dang / sprul dang /gcan gzan sogs ste 'jigs pa re srung bar khas blangs/ 'di nas dug mtsho'i do la zla ba phyed kyi lam yod/ dang por bol nub/ pus mo/ rkang pa rnams rim par nub/mthar brkyal ste song / shing re re 'dug pa'i rtsa ba/ gnyis 'dug pa'i bar la song sa skya tha le gang 'dug du snga rung phyi rung sdod/ dug mtsho thon nas spyir rnal 'byor pa'i gzugs la nges pa med cing / khyad par casari ba de spre'u 'dra ba cir mang bsgrub yin ba the tshom ma byed bar chosazhusacigagasung /

14 rjebatsun mar pa'i rnam tharagrubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/spyir dug mtsho'i rlangs pas bya yang lhung ba/ rtsa shing thams cad dug gi rang bzhin yin pas/ srog chags gzhan gyis rdzi phyogs tsam du yang nye mi nus par de na dpal zhi ba bzang po de mkha' 'gro rnams 'dul zhing dug chu la sogs pas 'tsho ba mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams khyi mo'i rnam par bsgyur ba la sgrub pa'i rten mdzad cing bzhugs pa der byon/ lam du bya gnyis tshur yong 'phro la log nas song / dug mtsho'i ngo la thon pa dang thog ser sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa byung ba bla ma la gsol ba btab pas zhi ste/ bya seng ge'i mgo can cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa cig sdong po'i rtser babs pa na mi min spre min zhig du gyur/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin gsol ba btab pas sdong po'i rtsa bar babs nas bi du bi du/ na ro pa zer ba'i paṇa chung be ku tsam de kun la smon pa su yod gsung /yang ku re byas pa yin/ rgya gar na paṇ+ḍi ta dang ku su li gnyi ga la khong las lhag pa med/ ma hā mā ya khong rang mkhas rung bka' babs kyis nga'i sar btang 'dug thil phyin zhig ston pa yin gsung /khyod gsu ba la srung ma mir sprul nas btang ba yin ste/ byar mthong 'dug gsung nas dbang bskur/ gsang mtshan bde ba'i rdo rjer btags/ rgyud 'grel pa sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus pa sogs ma tshang ba med pa gnang / dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor/zab pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ btang rag gi tshogs gral du mgur phul ba/rje sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sras//'gro ba kun gyi rdo rje 'chang //rgyud gnyan po rnams kyi gter bdag po//dpal zhi ba bzang po'i shadasal 'dud//

rgya gar la'abyon theng dang po/ 15sku mthong bas nga rgyal ri bo snyil//gsung thos pas tha mal sems rgyud grol//thugs dran pas phyi nang mun pa bsal//deng sang dus kyi skal ldan bdag/bod nas rgya gar yul du mchis//bshul thag ring po'i mi zhig yin//dam chos paṇ+ḍi ta la zhus//brgyud pa nye ba'i dam chos thob//rje dngos grub can gyi zhabs la btugs//mi dang mi min bar chad zhi//gsang sngags pha rgyud ma rgyud thob//gdams ngag che ba'i ston pa yin//dpal zhi babazang bo thug labatags//bla ma bzang po'i bu gcig yin//bar chad med par lho bal bgrod//las 'phro can gyi brnye yin//bde mchog rgyud rgyal bde blag khums//sgrub thag nye ba'i dam chos yin//bkra shis lung bstan zhal nas thos//mi lus thob pa'i don go yin//

16 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/lho brag bod tu lte ba bcad//dkar po'i rgyu la las 'phro sad//grub thob mkhas pa rnams dang mjal//dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag thob//lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs//mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug zhabs drung du//rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la bslabs//sgyu ma chen mo'i ma dang mjal// kun tu bzang po'i pha rgan bsnyen//chags lam ting 'dzin nyams su bdar//shes rab gsum gyi sgron me rgyas//gti mug gsum gyi mun pa bsal//sgrib pa gsum gyi bud shing bsregs//ngan song gsum gyi dur sa stongs//bka' drin che 'o bla ma rje//skyid to chos kyi blo gros bdag/dga' 'o 'dir bzhugs mched lcam kun//zhes pa'i glu bod skad tu blangs nas sermi tar bsgyur bas kun ngo mtshar skyes skad/de'i tshe rje miX pa lho dpal gyi ri nas phebs/ mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa'i snyan grags che bas rje mar pa mjal 'dod cher yod cing / khyad par nub gcig mngon sum lta bur yang yang snang bas gsol ba drag du btab pas/ rmi lam na mi tri pa'i pho nya yin

rgya gar la 'byon theng dngapo/ 17zer ba'i bud med mdzes ma zhig gis bum pa spyi bor bzhag pa barmis ste nyams khyad par can skyes/ de'i phyi nub bla mas rdzongs kyi tshogs 'khor mdzad/ byin rlabs dang rgya dpe gnang ste phyag spyi bor bzhag nas khyod na ro pas skal ldan du gzigs nas 'dir yang brdzangs/ miX pa'i sar yang rdzong zhing kha ba can 'dul ba'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba 'dug pa ltar ngas kyang gdams pa yongs su rdzogs par byin nas bkra shis mnga' gsol byed pa yin no gsung bas/ rje mar pas bla ma sangasargyasadango rtsathag chod pa'i gdung bas mgur phul ba/'di na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rnams//snying grogs dpun rnams snyan gsan 'tshal//mgo rgod mar pa lo tsā ngas//las 'brel sad pas zhetho bal phyin//dngos grub can gyi bal po dang //ye shes snying po zhi bzang la//gdan bzhi gsang 'dus bde mchog skor//rgyud dang man ngag gter kha phyed//da lta slob dpon zhal mnga' nas//zhus pa gnang ba'i dam chos tshar//lung bstan bkra shis dus gcig thob//mdang sang thal ba'i khar nub tu//maṇ+ḍal yid kyis bshams nas kyang //

18 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa 'i ngo mtsharabarjod pa/miX pa la gsol btab snyam//'khrul pa'i bag chags rmi lam du//mnga' bdag mai tre'i pho nya mo//bud med sdo/sa la bzhin rgyas ma//lag na bum pa thogs pa yis//mi kho bo'i mgo la reg pa barmis//thugs rjes byin gyis rlob pa 'dra//sngon smon lam las kyis 'brel lam bsam//de phyir dad 'dun drag po yis//pha rgan de'i spyan sngar mchi//'di na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun la//mos gus ltems rkyang med par byung //skyabs su 'du 'bral med par mchi//ngan song med par byin gyis rlobs//tshe 'di dang phyi mar 'grogs pa yi//rdo rje dpun gyi grogs po kun//'khor ba'i slu brid rgyab tu skyur//dam pa'i gdams ngag nyams su long //dam tshig ngo lkog med par srungs//rtag tu bla ma spyi bor sgoms//

rgya gar la 'byon thengasadang po/ 19dge ba bcu la longs spyod mdzod//mi dge bcu po dug bzhin spongs//sgrub pa rgyun chad med par mdzod//ces phul/ tshur lam rlung sems las su rung ba'i nus pas phu la ha rir zhag gsum la phebs/ rje na ro pa dge tshul shes rab seng ge gcig pu la chos cig gsung gi 'dug pa grol nas drung du phyin pas chos thob bam gsung /dpal zhi ba bzang po la gdams pa thob zhus pas mi min spre min zhig la zhi ba bzang po zer nas/ chos bya ba mi'i bla ma la thob dgos mod gsung /a kyang khong nga la kha snang bre mo gsung gi 'dug pa'i lan du ku re byas pa yin/ ngas khong la ma hā mā ya zhus/ khong gis kyang dgyes pa rdo rje gsan pa yin/ grub thob la khong las lhag pa med garna/nga /ma hā mā ya tshar gcig gnang byung ba tshig gcig gi lhag chad kyang med pa la bla ma'i gsung rnams dod cing sgros thon pa cig byung bas/ 'o na kha sing nas nyid kyis gnang chog pa la zhus pas/ khong 'di'i bdag po yin pas bka' babs pa dang / chos rgyud la skye ba la dka' ba spyod dgos pa yin gsung /phal cher zhig 'dus pa sogs gsan pa'i rkyen gnye cadang chos gtam mdzad pa yin pa ra 'chad kyang / chos kyi rtsa ba kun slong yin pas gzhan gyi ngag sna gnon pa'i ched kho nar rgyud nyan pa la 'di lta bu'i phrin las ga la 'byung / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'byung ba rga nad shi ba gzigs pa ltar sad byed kyi rkyen tsam yin na lta zhog /gzhan du na sdod tram̐ slob bshad khyad par ba rnams chos gtam gyi sar gsang ba sgrog pa'ang mi srad snanyo//sakyi mā yu'i slob dpon 'dri ba la/ bla ma thar pa'i lam ston yin/ /zhes

20 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtsharabarjod pa/mtshan gsangs par smra la/ thugs rgyud las ni de na ro pa'i mtshan du bshad do/ /lo rgyus bsdus pa yid ches pa cig na gnyos dang glengs pas gshin rje gshed la bag grag par 'dug /man ngag gi rgyus ci yang mi 'dug zhes pa snang /de nas bla ma'i bka'as gnang ste mnga' bdag miX pa'i drung du chas/ khar sa pā ṇa rang byung gi lha khang gzigs/ 'o ma can gyi chu nad thams cad sel ba 'thungs/de yang ri me ltar 'bar ba zhes pa na rje mi ba bzhugs ste mtha' thams cad dur khrod gnyan pos gang bas ro sreg pa'i dud pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ ri de la mi ma yin dpag med gnas pa'i kha rlangs su grags pa'i dud pa lta bu rtag du 'byung ba/ de lus la phog na nad yams 'byung ba/ mtshan mo ri de me ltar snang bas ri bo me 'bar du grags pa na bzhugs ste/ nus pa dang mi ldan pas 'gro mi nus pas ma 'gro zer ba sha stag byung yang the tshom med par byon/ rje miX pa n+ya gro dha'i sdong po la sku rgyab bsten ste bzhugs pa dang mjal/ rang dbang med pa'i gus pa skyes/ brkyang phyag lan du ma btsal ste/ shugabanga'abyung du mgur phul ba/khyed 'gro ba'i don du dzam gling 'dir//rgyal po'i rigs su skye ba bzhes//phyi nang grub mtha' sna tshogs mkhyen//mi pa la phyag 'tshal 'tho//rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan nas//bar chad med par byin gyis brlabs//ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs rdul reg/ma wa /rta khyod la bstod//

rgyagaral 'byon thengasadangapo/ 21sku ni rin chen gser gyi ri//ye shes smon sogs rnam dag pa//nyon mongs nad rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i//snar+shagagyi nyi ma khyod la bstod//thugs ni stong nyid rdo rje yis//bdag lta'i ri bo chen po 'joms/chos rnams mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa'i//mnyam med bla ma rje la bstod//sprul sku dzam gling kun gyi rgyan//rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid//thugs rje'i gter ldan 'gro ba'i mgon//gtsug rgyan gyur khyod la bstod//mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs//gang zhig dregs can ma lus pa//brtul zhugs nus pas bka' nyan byed//rdo rje 'dzin ba khyod la bstod//bde gshegs bla ma thugs rje can//bdag pha yul bor nas dam chos byas//dpal ldan na ro la sogs pa'i//bla ma kun la gdams ngag sdokyis//

22 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/rgyud sde'i slob gnyer 'ga' re tshar//lho dug mtsho khol ma'i do ri la//dpal zhi ba bzang po'i zhabs drung du//dam pa khyed kyis thugs rjes bzung //srog 'phangs pa med par drung du 'ongs//ri bo me 'bar gyi dgon pa na//shing n+ya gro dha yi bsil grib la//mnga' bdag rgyal sras miX pa//pha sangs rgyas khyed dang da lta mjal//nyi ma shar 'dra'i dad pa skyes//shi yang phod pa'i dad pa g.yos//kha gting med par gsol ba btab//rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs//bram ze chen po'i srol 'dzin zhing //sprul pa ri khrod dbang phyug las//legs par 'ongs pa dam pa'i chos//theg pa'i yang rtse snying po'i don//mtha' bral phyag rgya chen po de//na mkha' lta bu gnang bar zhu//zhes gsol ba btab pas shin tu mnyes ste rjes su bzung / dbang bskur ba'i

gsang mtshan zug kyirdo rjer btags/ rgyud bstod pa glur blangs 'grel bcas/ do ha'i bshad pa phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rnams gnang ste nyams su blangs pas cig char ba'i rtogs pa na mkha' dang mnyam pa shar ste btang rag gi tshogs mchod kyi tshe rtog ba bul ba/ spyi bo bde chen gzhal yas na//dri med pad+ma nyi zla la//bla ma mnga' bdag byams mgon bzhugs//bdag gi sems rgyud byin gyis rlobs//dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang //yi dam lha tshogs ji snyed pa//dbyer med dpal ldan sgru ti pa//snying gi pad+mar bzhugs nas kyang //ngag gi bden pa sgrub tu gsol//rgya gar zhing khams rnam dag du//paṇa chen na ro la sogs pa'i//grub thob rnams kyi zhabs rdul de//mi bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug du blangs//rgyud sde'i tshig rnams mang po nyan//bdag des kyang chog shes ma byung bas//mnga' bdag rje btsun drung du 'ongs//

24 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa 'i ngomatsharabarjod pa/byin brlabs dam chos tshul bzhin zhus//khyad par phyag rgya chen po zhus//chos shes pa rnams kyi sgro 'dogs bcad//mi shes pa rnams slob gnyer byas//rje sa ra ha yi bka' srol gyis//byin brlabs dang rtogs pa dus gcig byung //rje la rtogs 'bul gyi dbyangs gcig len//phyi nang grub mtha' sna tshogs kun//rtogs cing phyag rgya chen por 'dus//snang ba bden med mtha' yas kun//zung 'dug mnyam nyid rol bar shar//rgyun chad med pa'i chos nyid 'di//rang gsal rig pa 'gag pa med//zung 'jug rig pa gnyug ma'i ngang //ye shes lhun grub lta ba lags//spyod lam bzhi yi mnyam rjes su//dus gsum 'bral med chu bo'i rgyun//rnal 'byor mngon gsal 'grib tu med//yengs su med pa sgom pa lags//dus gsum lus ngag yid kyi chos//

rgya gar la 'byon theng dang po/ 25sna tshogs nges med rgyun gcig du//ma 'gags 'bad med ngo bor mnyam//sprul pa lta bu'i spyod pa lags//rtogs pa'i ngo bo skad cig ma//gcig char ba la phri bsnan med//rang grol gnyug ma bde ba che//re dogs bral ba 'bras bu lags//tshig snangags ma nyan gu nyan kyang //gzhi sems nyid chos skur da gzod go//mi kho bo'i the tshom da gzod zhig/'khrul ba'i gzhi rtsa da gzod zhig/tha snyad la sangs rgyas mi re bas//rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhabs drung du//don nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dang //brgyud pa rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis//go ba nyams myong rtogs pa 'di//phul bas bla ma rje btsun dang //mched grogs 'dir bzhugs dgyes par mdzod//ces phul bas/ mnga' bdag gis kyang phyag spyi bor bzhag nas zhal gdams gsungs pa/ bu dad pa'i rtsa ba mi brtan na//

26 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngo mtsharabarjodapa/gnyis med kyi rtsa ba brtan mi 'gyur//phyogs med kyi snying rje ma skyes na//gzugs sku rnam gnyis thob mi srid//shes rab rnam gsum ma sbyangs na//rtogs pa rgyud la skye mi 'gyur//bla ma rje btsun ma bsten na//dngos grub rnam gnyis thob mi srid//sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod na//shes pa gang dgar btang mi bya//snang ba rgya yis ma thebs na//bde ba chen por dben mi gnas//zhen chags shes pa skyes gyur na//glang chen rab dga'i spyod pa bya//skabs su nyon mongs skyes gyur na//sems la ltos la ma yengs sgoms//rkyen gyis sems la gnod gyur na//dbang bzhi'i nyams len rgyun du gyis//nyon mongs rang rgyud shor gyur na//bla ma'i gdams pa dran par gyis//rtse gcig gsol ba ma btab na//

rgyagar la'abyon thengasadangapo/ 27dam pa'i thugs dgongs ga la longs//lha skyed rdzogs zung 'jug ma sgoms na//'khor 'das dbyer med ga la rtogs//bcu gnyis rdo rje'i mgur ldan pa//dran pa dang bcas bcu gsum 'di//rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa na//bcu gsum sa la gnas par 'gyur//zhes gsungs/ slar rje na ro pa'i drung du byon/ dug mtsho'i phar kha na ye she kyi ḍa zhi ma rnal 'byor ma mdog dmar ba/ skra ser ba/ spyan rtsa dmar chil ba zhig du sprul nas yod kyis/ de la gdan bzhi zhus shog /zhes dang / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dang / ku su li mang du lung bstan/ byin rlabs kyis dug mtsho skad cig gis bgrod ste/ ḍā k+ki ma chu shing gi snye ma can la gdan bzhi zhus/ gsang mtshan bde ba'i rdo rjer btags/gzhan yang dbang rgyud man ngag gis thugs tshim par gyur zhing / rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas re zhig gser tshol bar bod tu 'byon par dgongs/ bla ma dang mched lcam la btang rag du tshogs mchod bzang po cig bshams pa'i tshe/ don thams cad bsams pa las lhag par grub nas bod tu log 'gro ba yin pas/ de ring las dga' ba mi yong dgongs nas/ mgur chen rnam kyi thog ma dbyapasaring 'di ta ra'i khong 'gyur gyi skad la rta drangs nas phul ba/rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che//khyed sngon sbyangs bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir//

28 rjebatsun mar pa'i rnam tharagrubapa'ingo mtsharabarjod pa/sprul sku te lo dngos dang mjal//spang dka' srid pa'i sdug bsngal la//khyad du gsod pa bcu gnyis mdzad//dka' ba spyad pa'i thugs dam des//skad cig nyid la bden pa gzigs//shri dz+nyā na 'ji'i zhabasal 'dud//sgra bsgyur bod kyi ban chung nga //sbyangs pa snga ma'i las 'brel gyis//na ro paṇa chen khyedadang mjal//rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor bslabs//snying po ma hā mā yā gnang //yang snying bde mchog 'khor lo zhus//lar rgyud sde bzhi yi khong snying phyung //ma skal ba bzang mos rjes gnang ba'i//byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa'i//dbang bzhi'i don la ngo sprod mdzad//zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin skyes//zhag bdun bar du brtan pa thob//srog rtsol 'pho ba nyi zla gnyis//g.yo med na mkha'i khyim du tshud//

rgyagar la'abyonathengasadangapo/ 29rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams//bde gsal mi rtog khong nas shar//bag chags gnyid kyi 'khrul ba de//'od gsal lam gyi ngo bor rtogs//yid kyi g.yo ba gzung 'dzin gnyis//spros bral chos kyi sku ru thim//phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di//skye med phyag rgya chen por rtogs//nang 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam shes 'di//sngon chad mdza' bo phrad pa bzhin//sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes//lkugs pas rmi lam barmis pa bzhin//smra ru med pa'i nyams cig shar//gzhon nus bde ba myong ba bzhin//brjod tu med pa'i don zhig rtogs//sku drin che 'o na ro pa//sngar yang dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs//da dung bka' drin skyab tu gsol/ /zhes phul/rjen ro babangakyang spyi bor phyag bzhag ste gsungs pa/bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod//

30 rje btsun marapa'irnam tharagrub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjodapa/chos brgyad tshe 'di'i don ma sgrub//gzung 'dzin nga khyod ris ma gcod//nye du dgra la skur ma 'debs//gzhan gyi chos la sgro ma 'dogs//thos pa mun sel sgron me yin//thar pa'i lam mchog 'phrang ma gcod//sngar yang bla rje yin pa'i phyogs//phyis kyang khur zhing blos ma spang //rang sems nor bu rin chen 'di//dred por chu la ma skur bar//bag zon yengs med srungs mdzod dang //dgos 'dod bsam pa thams cad 'grub/ /ces gsungs/(gsum pa dbang gdams pa 31gas pa'i dam pa'i chose rnams thob nasashār bod du byon tshul ni/)chur lam yang gnyosadang gdongs byon/ kho la grogs 'ga' zung 'dug pa la chas rnams bskur 'dug /mar pas khres po sku rgyab tu bsnams byon pas lo cwa ba chen po khres po 'khur ba mi 'ong / 'di la skur zer nas a tsa ra zhig la bskur/ gaṅgā brgal tshe dpe chu la 31ra ba ltar byas nas chu la bskur/ gru thon 'phral a tsa ra bzung nas rgyal po la zhu

rgyagaral 'gron theng dngapo/ 31byas pas/ gnyos kyis bslabs tshul bshad byung bas/ gnyobanga'akhakhrel 'debs kyi mgur gsungs pa/gsan dang las kyis sdebs pa'i grogs//mthun nas mnyam du 'grogs pa'i mi//spyir gyis chos sgor zhugs pa dang //khyad par lo paṇa bla mar grags//bsam rbe1gas gcig tu grur zhugs la//phan 'dogs nus pa ma thon rung //spyir gyis gnod byed mi rigs cing //khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa dang //bdag dang sems can thams cad la//gnod pa 'di 'dra ga la rigs//nyon mongs dug lnga'i bsam sbyor gyis//mi bdag gi dpe dang lhan cig du//mi khyod kyis bsgrubs pa'i snyan grags dang //gser dang dam chos chu la pho//nga rang mthong che ba ma yin ste//gzhan la dkon pa'i khyad chos 'ga'//gzhan phan med pas blo ma bde//'on kyang nan tan zhus dag bgyis//

32 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/chos dang rang gi sems rgyud 'dres//tshig don ma rjed wal le bdog/slar yang rgya gar yul du yongs//paṇa chen na ro la sogs pa'i//grub thob rnams la zhus pas chog/mi khyed rang deng nas bla ma dang //chos bshad lo tsu'i khur bor la//gnong 'gyod dang bcas yul la byon//sdig la mthol bshags drag po gyis//bsam sbyor 'di 'dra byed bzhin du//bla ma'i rlos sems byas lags kyang //blun po 'ga' yi mgo skor las// skal ldan smin grol ga la 'byung //mi lus rin chen rnyed dka' 'dis//ngan song gsum po mi sgrub 'tshal//zhes gsungs pas kha skyengs ste/ da ngas ma phyi g.yar gtong zer skad/ de nas rje mar pas gnyos dang lhan cig ma mdzad pas 'gyes khar/ da de skad su la yang ma zer bar nga'i sar phyi mo g.yar du shog zer nas chad byas/ gnyos la paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis dang / rma bya dang / rne tso yod cing gsu mis kyang sleb ste lo rtswa'i grags pa'ang cung zad byung /bal por bla ma dang ha ku dkar po la sogs pa'i mched grogs rnams kyis sna len

rgya gar la 'byon theng dang po/ 33gyi tshogs gral du/ da res gnyos la rgyal po'i chad pa sogs ma skul bar dbyangs gsungs pa thos pas ngo mtshar che/ de lta bu thugs dam phyin ci ma log pa 'khrungs pa'i rta/sa yin pas/ gzhung gi tshig la ma bsnyen pa khyed rang gi rtogs ba'i mgur zhig ma da zhus pas/ khyed 'dren pa'i bla ma dam pa dang //ha mu dkar pos dbu mdzad pa'i//khyed mdo sngags kyi slob gnyer tshar ba rnams//yud tsam zhig bod kyi glu la nyon//mthar thug gi lta ba khyad par can//zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa//dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin//thabs shes ya bral 'dod pa gang //mtha' ru lhung ba dgag bya'i phyir//khyed mkhyen pa'i drung du brjod dka' yang //dbyangs sngon chad ma blangs brdugs par 'gro//bstan bcos dbyangs su blangs kyi gsan//dngos por 'dzin pa dgag bya'i phyir//bdud sde bcom pas med ces gsungs//don de 'dra bzhin gzung bas bsgribs//'khor 'das yon tan 'byung ba'i dpal//

34 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam tharagrub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/khyad par thabs su gyur pa spangs//rmongs pa stong pa chad par 'dod//dge tshogs sun 'byin chad pa'i mtha'//na mkha'i me tog zhen pa rnams//dkar po'i lo tog 'joms pa yi//ser ba log pa'i lta ba yin//na mkha'i mtshan nyid shes par gyis//stong pa mi shes skyes bu kun//med la yod par sgro yis btags//log pa'i mig rgyu chur 'dzin zhing //don la rmongs pa 'khor ba'i rgyu//sems tsam mu stegs grangs can rbe1gas//thabs dang shes rab ya bral 'dod//so so rang rang grub mtha' yang //shing skam me tog 'dod dang mtshungs//khas len thams cad bral ba yi//don de rab tu mi gnas pa'i//rab tu shes pa shes phyin ste//mi gnas srid dang zhi ba'i mtha'//snying rje stong pa'i snying po can//

rgya gar la'abyon theng dang po/ 35thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug/de ni rang byung lhan cig skyes//de ltar bde dang stong pa dang //rig pa dang ni stong pa nyid//tha dad med par bdag gis go//dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang //gdod nas rang bzhin stong pa nyid//dbyer med rang bzhin spros bral du//chos rnams de ltar go bar mdzod//lta bas mtshon pa'i tshig tsam du//zhen pa'i yul du bdag gir mdzod//'jig rten pa yi lta ba de//shrī/ 'bras las la yid ches byas//bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za//mkhyen pa mchog gis de skad gsungs//mi gang snying rje med pa rnams//til 'bras me yis tshig pa la//de la 'bras bu ga la 'do/nga //gzhi med khyad par ga la yod//de la theg chen yod ma yin//

36 rje btsunamar pa'irnam tharagrub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa /mkhyen rabs nā gardzu na gsung //dmigs yul lta ba ma mchis na//dam chos gnang ba don med yin//sbun pa 'bras bu med dang mtshungs//de skad mar pa lo tsā zer//khyed mkhyen pa'i don la thugs rgyas rnams//don gol bar gda' na bzod par bzhes//ces gsungs so/ /'brog mi'i sras rdo rje rgya gar du 'byon pa dang phrad/ bslab bya'ang mdzad do/ /spyir thog mar spyi ther ba dang bernya pa gnyi ga dang bal por mjal/ des na ro pa da/ /shā /ye shes snying po sogs rim par mjal bar 'dod pa dang / lugs 'di nyid lta bu las na ro pa dang ma mjal ba'i gong du lo lnga song / bod kyi slob mas gser skyel ba dang bal por phrad nas log /na ro miX mjal/ lo gsum bzhi tsam na bod tu byon pa bal por chu la ma thar nas spyi zer ba la gser zho bzhi bskyis nas log ste gdams ngag gzhi'i tshags mdzad pas na ro pa lhag par mnyes/ phyis spyi ther ba la skyin pa phul bas ma bzhes bya ba dang / na ro miX gnyis/ miX pa sngon du mjal bar bris pa dang / phyag dpe'ang dbus gtsang du rje mar pa sku bsod che bas phra dog skyes ste bod tu sgrubs/ mtsho la skur bya ba dang / chu la shor ba skad du sbas bya ba sogs sna tshogs pa snang rung /bar du sgra bsgyur lo tsā bslabs//lo gsum bal po'i thil du bsdad//

rgyagar la 'byon thengasadang po/ 37rje byin rlabs can gyi bal po la//rgyud gnyan por grags pa'i gdan bzhi nyan//chos skyong dud sol lha mo zhus//nga des kyang 'dod pa cung ma tshim//rgya gar yul du chos la phyin//chu mi zan dug gi mtsho la brgal//lus dug sgrul bzhin du shun pa brjes//srog 'dor bar phong ste dam chos btsal//nub du la k+ṣe dra'i grong khyer du//dpal ye she snying po'i zhabasala'akhulis//ces sogs dang 'di mtshungs sam snyam zhing / 'di'i yang go rim dngos ltar na rje na ro pa mjal phyi ba ltar snang zhing / la lar go rim brjes 'dug pa ni rang gzo yin par snang / der phyag dpe rnams med pas thugs kyang ma bde/ rgya gar du ldog gam yang sem bzhin bod tu chas pa las bal po'i tha khob mi sho kor bya ba sho gam chen po len par zhag 'ga' bzhugs dgos byung ba'i/ nub phyi ma la mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis do li la spyan drangs ste/ lho phyogs dpal gyi rir dpal bangar ha mjal ste sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ yige bzhi'i chosagasungs pa byung ste thugs dam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin/ phyi rol gyi dpe cha la ltos pa med par gyur ste bod tu byon/klog skya ston chen de sku gshegs 'dug /jo sras de sku bsod bdo nas yod pas dpal khud kyi lha mtsho srin mtsho nas gsu ba mdzad/ sgyer phur gdan phab nas zla ba gcig du chos gra chen po btsugs/ zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin dpa' po'i dga' ston

38 rjebatsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/rgya chen po bshams nas/ sngar yab nas bzung zhabs tog byas cing byed pa lags pas/sngon ma grags pa'i dbyangs khyad par can zhig gsung 'tshal zhus pas/ kho bos sto phyogs dpal gyi rir bram chen po'i zhal nas yid la mi byed pa snying po'i don 'di ltar /dī bye/ pa/ do ha rdo rje'i mgur chen khyung chen gshog brgyangs lding ba'i skad la rta drangs ste dpal de ring bkra shis yar gyi ngo //dus khyad par can gyi tshes bcu la//dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshogs gral du//bu 'gyur ba med pa'i dam tshig can//khyed klog skya jo zabangazhu 'bul ba//sngar ma thos pa'i glu long skad//nga bshul ring lam la bshar ba des//lus ngal dub dbang du song ba'i phyir//glu yid 'phrog snyan po ma mchis cing //tshig sdeb sbyor mkhas po mi shes kyang //grogs khyed pas ngo che med pa'i phyir//ngo che yi dpral ba mi lhogs pas//don sngar ma thos pa'i ya mtshan can//rje bramaze'i bzhed dgongasaglur len bas//khyed gdan gang bzhugs pa'i mdo sngags rnams//snyan lhan ne+e gsan la thugs dgongs 'tshal//

rgyagar la'abyon thengasadang po / 39dus kha sang dpyid zla tha chung la//gzhi bal po'i thil nas yar 'phags pa'i//gdugs dro lam mchis kyi shul kha na//bal po lid gri sho gam ri//gdol pa can gyi grong khyer du//mi brda mi mjal gyi sho gam pas//mgron kha zhan po yi bod rnams bskyil//mi ngas kyang dbang med zhag 'ga' bsdad//dgung nub gcig tham thum rmi lam na//rigs kyi mtshan ldan tshangs skud can//bram ze'i bu mo mdzes ma gnyis//cung zad 'dzum zhing zur mig lta//mi kho po'i drung du 'ongs nas kyang //lto dpal gyi ri la 'gro dgos skad//kho bos sngon chad phyin ma myong //rgyus med lam yang mi shes smras//bu mo gnyis kyi zhal na re//khyed ming pos dka' ba spyad mi dgos//nged kyi phrag la khur gyis zer//mdo li dar gyi lding khrir bcug/
