40 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar thub pa'i ngo mtshar bsto da pa/gdugs bzhin mkha' la bteg nas kyang //klog 'gyu skad cig yud tsam la//lto dpal gyi ri la phyin pa barmis//shing blag ljon pa'i gsil grib la//ti ra ro yi gdan steng na//rje bram ze chen po sa ra ha//zhal star ma mthong ba'i gzi mdangs can//btsun mo gnyis kyis mtha' bsnyen nas//sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan//dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum mdangs can//bu bde bar 'ongs sam zhes kyang gsung //rje mthong ba dga' bas ma bzod par//lus kyi spu g.yos mchi ma 'khrugs//lan bdun bskor zhing brkyang phyag btsal//zhabs thil spyi bor blangs nas kyang //pha thugs rjes zung zhes gsol btab pas//lubanga'akhu1 yimingabyin brlabaspob//phyag dbang spyi bor reg tsam gyis//lus zag med bde bas ra ro ba//glang chen chang gis spyos pa bzhin//g.yo 'gul med pa'i nyams cig shar//

rgya gar la 'byon theng dang po/ 41ngag 'khanasungagi byinasparlabasab//stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro yis//yi ge bzhi yi don gsungs pa//lkugs pas rmi lam barmis pa bzhin//brjod tu med pa'i nyams cig shar//yid la snyeg kyi byinabarlabasab//lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku//'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs pas//dur khrod gnas pa'i mi ro bzhin//bsam du med pa'i nyams cig shar//de rjes bde chen dag pa'i gsung //rin chen mgur gyi bum pa nas//tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi brda skad kyis//sprin bral na mkha' stong pa'i don//gnas lugs mtshon pa rdo rje'i mgur//skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos//na mo stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa//rgyun chad med pa gnyug ma'i sems//gdod nas dag pa de bzhin nyid//na mkhas na mkha' sbyor ba mthong //

42 rje btsun marapa'i rnam thar grubapa 'ingo mtshar brjod pa/rtsa ba khyim na gnas pa'i phyir//yid kyi rnam shes btson du zung //sgom pa shes pa phyi ma yis//sems la lhan pa gdab tu med//snang srid sems kyi rang bzhin shes//gnyen pos bcos ste sgom du med//sems kyi gnas sdo/gas dran du med//de'ang ma bcos ngang la bzhag/de don mthong na grol ba'i phyir//bu chung gdol pa'i spyod pa ltos//sha za spyon pa gang dgar thong //bsnyems dang bral ba'i seng ge bzhin//sems kyi glang po yan du chug/bung ba me tog rgyu ba ltos//'khor ba skyon du mi lta bar//mya ngan 'das pa thob byar med//tha mal shes pa rang lugs de//ma bcos so ma nyid tu zhog/bya ba rnams la khyod ma rtog/phyogs dang cha la mi gnas cing //

rgyagaral 'byon thengasadangapo/ 43spros bral na mkha'i dkyil du ltos//chos zad sar 'byol ba snying po'i don//lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che//sems gnad tu bsnun pa'i brda don zhig/bram ze chen po'i zhal nas thos//skad cig de la gnyid kyang sad//de ma rjed dran pa'i lcags kyus zin//ma rig gnyid kyi mun khung du//rig pa ye shes mthongs phye nas//sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ltar//'tshogal ba'i mun nag sangs nas thal//dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal mjal yang /phyin chad dri rgyu med to snyam//sems kho thag chod pa'i nyams cig skyes//yid 'gyu ba zad pa ngo mtshar che//e ma/ yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang //bla mas gsungs pa zab mo'i don//ngag smra ru mi btub gsung na yang //dgung do nub mi smra'i thabs ma byung //dus da res tsam zhig ma gtogs pa//

44sngon chad ngag tu brjod ma myong //da phyin chad bzlas sam rna ba nyon//nga sngon chad bshul ring rgyang gi mi//mdza' bshes gnyen med grogs kyang med//lus ngal dub bkres par gyur ba'i tshe//bu khyed kyis gang byas sems la yod//de ma rjed sems la shin tu bcags//drin 'khor bar thal lo snying gi grogs//rje gong na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang //dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha//bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong rnams//mi bdag la bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal//don 'khrul bar gda' na bzod par bzhes//ces gsungs pas/ klog rgya jo za kyis bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ngo / /'di'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ yi ge dang po chos kyi sku/ gnyis pa longs spyod rdzo gas pa'i sku/ yi ge gsum pa sprul ba'i sku/ bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ zhes ma hā mu dra'am phyag rgya chen po ces 'di nyid la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos bzhi bzhir bshad nas/ lam gyi skabs su dang por sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad pa/ gnyis pa sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa/ gsum pa sems kyi gol sa bcad pa/ bzhi pa sems kyi lam khyer bstan pa ces rgyag rgyachen po yige bsgobar grags pa de yin no//lo rgyus mi snang yang mes tshon pos kyang 'di res mjal bar snang zhing / snyeladabu

gtsang gi thil du thon tsa na/ /gdamasangag gi snyan ba kho posathob/ /ces pa ltar snyan grags cher byung bar snang ngo //de nas rje mar ba sngon gyi chad mdzad pa'i dbang gis kha rag tu byon nas gnyosal phyi mo dgos gsungs pas/ gser srang gang maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa cig phul ste/ ma rgyud la khyed rang 'dris pa 'dug pas dpe mi dgos par 'dug/khyed kyis pha rgyud bshad na nga la nyan mi mi yong bas khyed kyis ma rgyud kyi bdag gyis la shod/ ngas pha rgyud kyi bdag byas la bshad to zer/ phyis kyang 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs/ gshin rje'i gshed/khyad par 'jigs byed/ mtshan brjod rnams la gnyosakyi rgyud bzhi zer ro//de nas gsu mi ni su yang ma byung / 'khrungs yul du byon/ slob dpon dang a ne+e cig gis sna len re byas/slob dpon dang jo bo sogs kyis chang gral du 'bod/lo tsā ba zer zhing phad rtse'i gdan re 'dings/ rgya gar gyi lo rgyus shod zer nas 'dis rgya gar la phyin 'dug /chos la'ang dka' las byas 'dug zer ba tsam dang / chos ci shes zer ba la he badz+ra shes/ tsa kya bha ra shes/ mnyu shrī shes gsungs pas de rnams mi go bar 'dug zer yang mkhas pa tsam du rig/lan gcig jo bo la phu dor kha spang gshong la nga'i 'brog byed/ bar dro bo lung skyi srubs zangs phug rnams la nga'i dgon gnas byed/ mda' sras dang sa skyags gnyis su nga'i gnas gzhi byed pas 'di rnams slong dgos gsungs pas phul ste slob dpon dpang por bzhag nas mthos bskor zhing dro bo lung bzung / slob dpon des bskul ste khong gi rta dkar po cig yod pa la dpe cha 'dra bkal/ sras po de g.yog tu khrid nas byon/

47(rgya gar la 'byon thengs gnyis pa/bar ba la yang snga ma ltar donagasum las/dang po gseng tshol du byon zhing busgrob rnams dang mjal tshul ni/)rnam thar thams cad na gzhus du cha bzhes cig gi sar brnye cig gis dri rmed zhus pa rngog ston snar+sha(rdor du 'dug pas spyan drangs bya ba dang / la lar skyes pa mda' gzhu can zhig byung bya ba sogs 'dug yang / rngog ba rang rnam thar 'pha rgyus thams cad las/ se lung na bla ma dgyer chung pa la ning ma nyan tshe phyi dro cig gleng slangs byung ba la/ khong na re/chos gsha' ma zhig byed na rje mar pa'i drung du 'gro dgos par 'dug gsung nas/ mtshan thos pa'i mod la mi bzod pa'i dad pa byung / khong la rgyus kyang zhib par 'dug nas de dgongs rang chos 'phro dril/ sang rang yul du byon/ dpon slob gsum de ma thag byon pa yul mi la dris pas/ a khu blo grobangazer ba cam las rgyus mi 'dug /rnal 'byor pa bag dro ba phru rko ba zhig gis phrin bya zer/ nang du phyin pas/ rnal 'byor pa de stan gyi steng na 'dug pas phyag btsal/ mos gus skyes ste/ rta gcig yod pa de khal dang bcas pa phul bas/ rgyagarten yin na che yang che/ 'bul ba yin na chung yang chung / zhes ku re gsung /gdams ngag shin tu che bar rig /de'i tshe mes tshon po'i gdan 'dren byung bas thegs par 'dug pa la gtsang la 'gro bar rang yul na pha ma rgan gog yang yod/ gdams ngag yang mi tshar bar 'dug snyam nas gzhung du phebs par zhus pas mes ston rang chos nyams su len rgyu ni yod/ da res rngog pa'i sar 'gro ba yin gsung nas byon/ 'bri bdun bcu sogs phul zhes pa kho na yod pas 'di'i sngon tsam la mjal bar snang la/

48 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/lo rgyus snga ma de dol pa gag ston nam gzhung gi mes tshon chung lta bu zhig dang nor bar 'dug go/rngog ba snga ma rnams sngags pa sgra can yin pas rab byung dang / hor chas sogs mi 'byung ngo / /mtshur dbapange sdon mda'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po mdo sngags kyi ston pa cig yod pas 'di dus mjal zhing / ston nang na rje mar pa'i dkyil 'khor stegs bu yod pa'i gad pa 'od pas khyer ma thug pa maṇ+ḍal lta bu du ma yod do//de nas 'phan yul du byon/bras su sre'u mang po bsos/bzhugs khri dang phyag mkhar gyi mchod rten yang yod/ 'dam gzhung gi ru ba'i dpon mar ba mgo bags kyis spyan draXs/ lam du byin rlabs phug par cung zad bzhugs ste stag lung gi sde'i rten 'brel 'gra/ /za rtang rnying rnams la na ro miX mjal ba'i gos yin gsung nas 'dor ma bzhed pa dang / gsar pa rnams gser sgrub par bzhed pas 'phangs mdzad pa dang / ji ltar dgongs pa de ma gtogs thugs bcos dka' bas/ thog mar yul mi rnams dad dka' ba'ang byung / phyis thugs rje'i byin gyis non ste gson gshin gyi don mtha' dag spungs cing ci yod phul/ byang nam ra'i gser rdol dang dus mtshungs/ mgo bgasarang gis sangs rgyas dngos su mthong zhing /bla med byang chub sgrub pa la//dal 'byor rten 'brel 'dzom pa gces//brgyud pa grub thob rtsod med gces//bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pa gces//nyams len rus su 'don pa gces//gnas lugs gzhi rtsa chod pa gces//

rgyagar la'abyon theng gnyisapa/ 49thabs lam zab mo'i bogs 'don gces//don gnyis 'grub pa'i 'bras bu gces//ces gsungs cing / dbang gdams ngag gnang bas cis kyang dgos med du go ste chos sgor zhugs/ gser grang bco brgyad/ rta g.yu 'brug mgo dkar sogs yo byad dpag med phul ste phyags phyir 'brangs/ lam du rngog /mtshur/ ba rang lnga ba can rnams kyis so so'i gnas su spyan drangs/ dbang bskur gyis smin par mdzad/ rgyud dang //rdzus pa zhu phyir phyags phyir 'brangs ste dro bo lung du byon/ rgyud dang man ngag so so thon ston la jo bo yang bos ba'i tshogs gral du rje nyid la rgya gar na bla ma du bzhugs/ngo mtshar can du mchis/ chos ci zhus/ phar tshur ji ltar byon zhus pas/ rgyas par gsungs ste mthar mgur du gsungs pa/(snar+sha(phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i mgur/)rje rtsod ldan dus kyi rdo rje 'chang //dka' ba spyad pa'i skyes bu mchog/kun gyis spyi bor thod bzhin bskur//dpal na ro'i zhabasal: bosa'adud//nga sto brag mar ba blo gro 'di//lo bcu gnyis lon nas chos dang mjal//de sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags sad pa 'dra//

50 rje btso mar pa 'i rnamathar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/nga dang por yig tshangs ka kha bslabs//bar du sgra bsgyur lo tsā bslabs//lo gsum bal po'i thil du bsdad//rje byin rlabs can gyi bal po la//rgyud gnyan por grags pa'i gdan bzhi nyan//chos skyong dud sol lha mo zhus//kho bo des kyang 'dod pa cung ma tshim//rgya gar yul du chos la phyin//chu mi zan dug gi chu la brgal//lus dug sprul bzhin du shun pa brjes//srog 'dor bar phong ste dam chos btsal//nub du la k+ṣe dra'i grong khyer du//dpal me shebangasnying po'i shadathangal btugs//pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa nyan//sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zhus//lam rim pa lnga yi don la bslabs//sto dug mtsho khol ma'i gling du phyin//gdugs nyi ma'i gung la smag du sros//lam da lta gsal yang da lta stor//srog yal bar dor nas rje bcun btsal//

rgya gar la'abyonathengs gnyisapa/ 51dpal zhib bzang po dngosadang mjal//ma rgyud ma hā mā ya thob//dbyibs rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la bslabs//sgyu ma gsum gyi gdams ngag thob//shar dngos grub chu bo gaṅgā brgal//ri rab tu 'byug pa'i dur khrod tu//me tog mdangs 'phrog gi dgon pa mā/rje mnga' bdabashami89) zhababacal sa//rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blangs zhus//chos phyag rgya che la rtogs pa sbyangs//sems dngos po'i bzhugs tshul gtan la phab//gzhi ma bcos don gyi ngo bo mthong //gnas ngo mtshar mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa//byang phyogasapuṣ+ka ha rir phyin//dpal dngos grub can gyi dgon pa mā/sgo zung na ro paṇa chen la//rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje thob//bsre 'pho mtshams sbyor gyi gdams ngag thob//khyad par gtum mo'i las rgya zhus//chos snyan rgyud kyi gnad la ngo sprod mdzad//de yan chad dzam gling dbus su grags//

52 rje bsamar pa 'irnam tharagrub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjodapa/phyog bzhi rgyud pa'i chu bo yin//lar dur khrod myul ba'i rnal 'byor dang //shing drung gnas pa'i ku su li//yongs su ma grags 'ga' yod ste//rdzogs rim kha 'thor mang du zhus//ngo mtshar can gyi sgrub thabs dang //phran tshegs kyi gdams pa rtsis las 'das//lam bal po'i thil du phyin tsa na//nga lho brag mar pa lo cwa dang //kha rag gnyos kyi lo tsā gnyis//lo tsā gang mkhas gang mkhas zer//gdams ngag gang che gang che zer//bal bod mtshams su thon tsa na//nor zang zing gi sku bsod khong la skyes//yul la stod tsho bzhir phyin tsa na//sgra bsgyur gyi grags pa mnyam por thob//bod dbus gtsang gi mthil du phyin tsa na//gdams ngag gi snyan pa kho pos thob//bla ma grub thob dang mjal lags pas//gdams ngag la mi che'i dogs ma mchis//

tshig tha snyad la byang chub mi re bas//gzhung bshad pa kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod//ces gsungs pas/ jo bo yang dad par gyur zhing yul mi rnams kyang dad par gyur to//de'i tshe gsang ba 'dus pa'i ngo bo slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bod yul gyi skye bo'i ngor mi la thosapa dga'ar grags ste/ yum gyi bka' bsgrubs nas bla ma'i mtshan gsan pa tsam gyis ba spu g.yos cing drung du bsnyags pa na/ bud med du mas shel gyi rdo rje dri mas cung zad gos pa zhig khyer ste/ rje btsun na ro ba'i zhal nas 'di khrus la rgyal mtshan gyi rtser thogs gsung zer ste/ de ltar byas pas dzam gling 'od kyis khyab pa barmis pas gsu ba la phru slog pa'i tshul du byon/ bka' sgrub pa'i thog ma phru'i lhag slog du bcug /chang ban sa la bskungs ste dbu zhwa bkab/ phru slog pa ltar mdzad/ chang gnang ba lhag med gsol bas gdams ngag tshang ba'i rten 'brel 'grig /chang ban gyi shul du chu mig byung / zhing de la mthun rkyen du grags/ mthu ser gyi sdig pa sbyong ba dang / phrin las bzhi 'grub pa'i phyir/ phyogs bzhir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi mkhar bzhi/ brtsigs cing bshig /mthar zur bzhi logs brgyad/ rtse mo rin po che 'bar ba lta bu brtsigs/rjes su bzung nas mnal ltas las rdo rje rgyas mtshan du btags ste sgom du bcug go/de'i tshe rnal 'byor bla med ma rgyud kyis lam bgrod pa'i phyir/ jo mo bdag med ma dang /phyag thung ma gnyis khab tu bzhes ste rigs kyi sras kyang bskrun pa'i tshul du snang ngo //de yang jo mo bdag med ma la sras mdo sde thog mar 'khrungs tshe/ pe'u shāka rgyal la sogs kyis sras mo zhig gda' byas pas/ ngas glu zhig bya'o gsung /srid pa lte bsgyur gyi gdams ngag shes//

54 rje bas mar pa 'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/rtsa mo rgyud 'gegs pa'i gdams ngag yod//rtsa mo rtsa bkag nas pho rtsa glod//sras bu mor skye ba cang srid tam/ /zhes gsungs/yang za poragada' rte zhugasab gcig 'ong ba 'dra khukhasapas/khams dkar dmar gnyis la rang dbang thob//dngas rnyigs 'byed pa'i man ngag shes//khams rnyigs ma bkag nas dngas ma glod//sras lkugs par skye ba cang srid tam//zhes gsungs par grags rbe|//(gnyisapa rgya gar la byon nas bla ma rnams dang mjal te snar+shasdo zhus tshul ni/)de nas rgya gar du 'byon par dgongs ste gser srang brgyad cu tsam bsnams nas 'khor ma khrid par byon/ bal po sku mched dang mjal/ gser gyis mnyes par byas/ rgya gar du phebs ste na ro miXs gtso mdzad bla ma thams cad la bka' drin gyi gtang rag phul/ rgyud man ngag sngar ma gsan pa rnams gsan zhing / gsan pa rnams dogs dpyod mdzad/ dpe dgos pa rnams bris/de nas rje mar pa rgya gar shar phyogs su byon tsa na/ ra lnga'i tshong 'dus kyi grong khyer gyi srang du byon pa'i dus su/ rnal 'byor ma rgyan can gnyis/ rgyan med gcig dang gsum

rgyagar la'abyonathengs gnyis pa / 55gyis gar mang po byas ste/ rnam pa'i bye brag bzhin mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur mang du byas paX tshege/ rgyan med de la dpral ba'i dbus na yang spyan gcig 'dug pas spyan gsum par mtha/ ji ga// gis gar byas pa la brten nas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes ste/ ḍā zhi mar mkhyen nas/ de dag la 'bras snyim pa gsum yang phul nas yid kyis mos gus byas nas khyed ye shes kyi ḍā gi ma yin na bdag rjes su zung zhig bya ba'i gsol ba yid kyis btab pas/ dbus kyi dkar mo des sku'i sgo ba gcod pa rdo rje'i glu gsungs/'di'i ma phyimatshangaphyis rnyed na bas/ g.yas kyi dmar mo des gsungs pa ni/rtog ge'i blo yis brjod pas dpag par dka'//tshig tshogs gras brnyan brag chas bzung du med//thos bsam spros pa'i mtshan mas g.yengs pa rnams//ri dwags smi sgyu snyag pa nyid dang mtshungs//sgra blo'i phyir 'brangs lan tshwa'i chu 'thungs 'dra//brjod pas mi go bstan pas mi go zhing //bsams kyang mngon sum nyams myong 'byung mi 'gyur//'di ni bla med don dam lam zhugs pa//sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla ma dam pa yi//zhabs thil spyi bor blangs ste btud gyur na//dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin nyams blangs tshe//na mkha' sprin bral rab tu dngas pa ltar//rtog pa'i rlung gis mi skyod rang dngas pa//

56 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/pad+ma'i tshogs la nyi ma shar ba bzhin//mun tshogs rab dengs blo yis kha phye nas//zab dang rgya che gnyis su med pa'i sems//snang sems dngos po'i tshogs kyis rang stong pa//thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab las 'das nas//gsang ba'i shes rab ye shes rgya mtsho las//nyams myong drod rtags rba rlabs rtsol bral ba//snying po'i don ldan 'od gsal bla na med//ma bcos sems kyi gnas lugs lhan cig skyes//bden pas stong pa sangs rgyas kun gyi lam//gsang chen bde ba'i nor bu 'di rnyed tshe//gzhan don dri ma bsal phyir 'bad ste sgom//de nyid dmigs med ting 'dzin sgom rang bzhin//sgom du med pa phyag rgya che la ltos// ces gsung gi spros pa gcod pa rdo rje'i chosanyi shu ba gsungs so/ /de nas g.yon phyogs kyi ḍa zhi ma sku mdog nag mo des tshigasposabacad gzangasab ni/nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs//spros bral mi 'gag rnam par dag pa'i sems//gzugs med khams kyi sems can thams cad kyi//yid ni nga yi rang bzhin lhan cig skyes//tsitra ta badz+ra ḍā ki dzo gi ni//

rgyagar la 'byon thengs gnyisapa/ 57byang chub sems kyis gdul bya'i don rnams byed//lus de'i rang bzhin mkha' la spyod pa ste//e ma rang byung gdod nas lhun gyis grub//de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bdag gis brnyed//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bgrod pa'i gnas//rdo rje'i lus 'di la ni 'di ltar gnas//rin chen ljon shing dpag bsam shing chen la//brten nas grong khyer chen po bzhi dag dang //dur khrod chu bo'i 'ogs dang nags 'dab dang //chu klung rdzing bu bya tshogs gnas pa ste//gsang ba thabs dang shes rab grong gnyis la//g.yo ba'i tshe na don dam kun rdzob ste//skye 'gag gnas las grol ba'i gnas nyid ste//lhun grub gnas chen bzhi ni mi phyed pa'o//dbang po dang ni yul ni bcu rnams las//khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag gcig dang ni//brgya phrag drug dang srog rtsol nyi zla las//re re bzhi ldan phyed phyed nyi shur ldan//brgya phrag drug dang bdun cu rtsa lnga las//sgyu ti'i dbus su byung ste lte ba dang //gsang ba snying ga mgrin pa'i gnas rnams las//

58 rje btsunamarapa 'irnamatharagrub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/yang dag rgyu zhing slar yang gnas der thim//rlung rnams ldog pas rtsa ba'i gnas su thim//rtsol bas bskyed dang ma skyed gnas rnams las//dkar dang dmar dang sngo ba'i bye brag las//bde ba 'phel ba zla gnas gong du dpel//zag bcas bde ba 'dzin pa las 'das ste//zag med bde med bde ba'i rang bzhin las//thabs dang shes rab gnyis med bcu drug las//dkar phyogs mya ngan mtha' dang nag po yi//phyogs rnams srid pa'i mtha' las rnam grol zhing //phyed thim bco lnga byang chub sems 'di ni//gnyis gnyis thim zhing mi 'gyur bcu po rnams//rtsa yi 'khor lor bde ba'i lam rdzogs ste//gsang ba bla na med pa'i lam rdzogs pa'o//rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las//gnyug ma gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ste//bde gsal mi rtog gnas pa med pa nyid//gnyis med de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa las//rim pas bsgoms pas sa rnams bgrod 'gyur ste//zung 'jug rgyal ba'i ye shes lam mthar phyin//bla med theg pa sangs rgyas kun gyi lam//

rgya gar la 'byon thengs gnyisapa/ 59'bras bu'i rdo rje'i theg pa mthar thug pa'o//zhes thugs kyi spros pa gcod pa'i rdo rje'iglu chosabaco jib gsungs so/ /de ltar ḍā gi ma gsum po des spros pa gcod pa'i chos gsum gsungs ste/ de dag gi don ji lta bar thugs su chud nas/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos la nges pa bstan pa rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dri ma sel ba rdo rje'i11 'di lha mo gsum pos mgrin gcig tu gsungs so//kye kye rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams//bla med theg par rab zhugs nas//tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob byed pa//mtshan ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi//sprul pa sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed//mnyam med bla ma bsten par bya//maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas phul nas//lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis//sgo gsum bla ma'i phyogs su btang //brtson 'grus can gyis gsol btab pas//bla ma'i drin gyis rang sems kyi//ye shes skad cig nyid la thob//bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min//rtse gcig sems kyi ting 'dzin las//ma yengs brtson pas bsgrub par bya//

60 rje bas mar pa'i rnamathar grubapa'ingo mcharabarjodapa /dang por snang ba sems su rtogs//gnyis pa sems nyid stong par rtogs//gsum pa snang sems gnyis med rtogs//bzhi pa lhun gyis grub par shar//rang byung rang zhi mi rtog pa//rnam rtog chu yi rba rlabs bzhin//ngang las byung zhing de ru thim//'bad rtsol rnam par bral ba yi//chos nyid bde chen lhun grub kyi//'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos//dang po spros dang bral bar rtogs//de nas chos rnams thams cad kun//lan tshwa chu la thim pa 'am//chu bran sna tshogs tha dad kyang //rgya mtsho chen por ro gcig bzhin//de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa mchog/du ma ro gcig 'char bar 'gyur//e ma ho/ ma skyes chos rnams rang bzhin kun du stong //rang bzhin mi 'gag rol pa chen po'i klong //gdod nas rnam dag dri med chos kyi dbyings//

rgya garal 'byon thengasaganyis pa/ 61sgom med sgom pa'i mtshan mas stong pa'o//zhes gsungs ste/ lam rtsol sgrub dang bral ba rdo rje'i glur gsungs ste/ dus der gsang ba'i rdo rje sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur nas zag pa med pa'i bde ba bla na med pas rgyud gang bar gyur to/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma gsum po de dag na mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas 'dug sa de nyid tu nyin spug gsusna snang naX 'duX ste slar grong khyer du byon nas brjed kyis dogs nas ta la'i la mde dī sdu ra kā ༵ /dang ༷༷/ /gyi dbus na slob dpon nag po lu ba pa'i sku lus kyi lpags pa la bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sku rtsa ris su bzhugs pa yod pa de snyi ma la ma nanata ces bya ba'i lha khang cig na bzhugs so/ /de la tshes bcu'i nub mo ḍā zhi ma mang po 'dus nas tshogs 'khor byed ste/ rnal 'byor pa sems la dbang thob pa ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi bgrod pa yod pa der byon nas/ de yi nub mo rnal 'byor pa brtul zhugs spyod pa nag po pa dang / slob dpon a wa sgru ti pa dang / shārnyi pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor pa nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rnal 'byor ma tsun dha ma dang / a mi la bhad dra ma dang / rnal 'byor ma gang gha la sogs pa sum cu so bdun gyis dpal 'khor 61 sdom pa'i lugs kyi tshogs 'khor byas ste/ rnal 'byor ma bde mas rje btsun nyid la yang bde ba sku nyams su bstar ste ye shes kyi nyams bskyed do/ /lha khang de'i tha ma ni/ nub mo bzhin ce cang la sogs pa mang po 'thibs pas 'gro ba gzhan gyis rgyu dbang med to//de nas nam nangs pa'i tshe mar me yang slar cher gsal/ khang bzang 'od kyis gang /ga bur dang tsan+dan gyi dri bzang po yang byung / sa yang cung zad g.yos pa'i tshe yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas na mkha' gang bar gzigs ste/ de dag gis mgrin

62 rje bas mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/gcig tu rdo rje'i tshig 'di gsungs so/ /ha ha ho hi/ saṃ bha ra dha na la ba rda/ ra bhi ha sa pra ba ba ri/ dzu ka na tha a tha tsa/ ni ra ma tsakra rang na bha shaṃ/ zhes byung ste brda'i tshig go/thog mtha' dbus kyi spros pa las 'das pa//dug gsum sgyu ma na mkha'i ngang du thim//glang po seng ge rin chen nor bu rnams//mi phyed rdo rje gsang ba'i gnas su sbos//ces gsungs ste/ thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur nas ting nge 'dzin skyes so/ /de nas so so'i gnas su song ngo / /de nas slar rgya gar dbus su 'ongs nas dpal ldan ye shes snying po'i drung du 'ongs so/ /'di ni rje mar pas rgya gar la lan gsum byon pa'i bar pa'i res la gsungs so/ /ḍa zhi mgasum gyi11sapawakhesad ba'igadam ba zhes bya ba dpalasnyo na len+dar bsgyur cing gtan la phab nas gdan drangs ste mar pa mgo yags la gan/ r+shakā/ /lam du nā len+dar sna len gyi tshogs gral du na ro pas bsdus pa'i mched grogs kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shrī bha dras/ na ro miX dgongs pa gang zab par 'dug dris pa la mi pa'i dgong bzhed mgur du bzhengaspob/gsan dang snying grogs dpal bzang po//nga mar pa bya ba'i brnye la//na ro miX'i dgongs pa gnyis//gang zab gsung bas dbyangs 'di len//seng ge lta bu'i na ro pa//kun gyi nang nas rin po che//

rgyagar la'abyonathengs gnyisapa/ 63dgos 'dod thams cad skong mdzad pa'i//dgongs pa nyid kyi thugs la mnga'//rje dharma dha ras thugs rjes bzung //paṇa chen de yi zhabs pad ni//deng sang bdag gi gtsug gi rgyan//khong gi dgongs pa 'di ltar gda'//snyan lhan ne+e gsan la thugs gtad 'tshal//chos sku'i mkha' la ye shes sprin phung 'khrigs//char rgyun sprul bas 'gro ba yongs la khyab//rgyud la ma chad skyes bu bla ma mchog/de la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal 31//chos sku na mkha' lta bu de//sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen yin//ye shes sprin phung 'khrigs pa de//byang chub sems dpa' rnam gnyis yin//phrin las bdud rtsi'i char 'bab pa//rje btsun bram ze sa ra ha//sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa de//ri khrod dbang phyug sha wa ra//de yi brgyud pa ma chad pa//

64 rje bas mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/mnga' bdag rgyal sras miX lags//dam pa de las drin thob pa//go lugs dgongs pa 'di ltar gda'//'gyur med rig pa rang gsal 'di//chos sku skye ba med par bzhed//rang byung ye shes 'gag med ni//sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku ru bzhed//de gnyis zung 'jug lhan skyes de//longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru bzhed//de gsum gzhi rtsa ma grub pa//ngo bo nyid kyi sku ru bzhed//de dag zag pa med pa de//bde ba chen po'i sku ru bzhed//don gyi sku lnga de ltar lags//de thugs la bde 'am snying gi 〈snags/ /ces gsungs/yang lta sgom spyod 'brasaji ltar bzhed kyi lan du/thugs gzhan du ma sgomal gsan par zhu//tshig gi sdeb sbyor mi mkhas kyang //don gyi gdams ngag go lugs 'di//snyan chung dgyid pas 'jal bar mdzod//

rgyagar la 'byon thengs gnyisapa/ 65srid gsum ye nas rnam par dag/don dam ye nas go rgyu med//med pa ma yin rgyun chad med//'pho 'gyur med pa lta bar bzhed//gnyug ma'i ngo bo ngang gis gsal//zag med bsam gtan rgyun chad med//med pa ma yin 'du 'bral med//zhen chags med pa sgom par bzhed//sna tshogs rten 'brel shugs 'byung la//sgyu ma'i rol pa 'gag pa med//med pa ma yin dngos po la//blo bur nges med spyod par bzhed//sems rgyud byang chub snying por gsal//sku gsum sangs rgyas thob byar med//med pa ma yin re dogs bral//gzhi med rtsa bral 'bras bur bzhed/ /ces gsungs/bangagadamasangagacig char du 'debasasam/ rim gyi 'deb kyi lan du/khyed cag mched grogs gong ma rnams//nged kyi rje btsun miX pa//spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan pa'i//

66 rje bsamarapa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/'gro mgon klu sgrub thugs kyi sras//sha wa ra pa'i zhabs la gtugs//sum ldan tshang bar rjes gnang mdzad//gsang mtshan gnyis med rdo rjer btags//khong rgyud sde kun gyi lde mig 'dzin//gsang sngags thabs lam mngon du gyur//chos kyi rgyal mtshan chos kyi mdzod//chos kyi seng ge chos kyi rgyal//sgra dang dbu tshad mtha' dag mkhyen//paṇ+ḍi ta yis dngos grub brnyes//dngos po'i gnas lugs dri med mkhyen//rgyal srid rtswa bzhin dor byas nas//tshe gcig mchog gi go 'phang thob//rje btsun mkha' 'gros zhal bstan zhing //thun mong bsgrubs pas thams cad thob//de ltar yon tan dpag med brnyes//pha khong gi dgongs pa 'di ltar gda'/rim bar pa'i gang ga la//srog rtsol gtum mo'i gdams ngag dang //zhen med sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag dang //

rgyagar la 'byonathengs gnyisapa/ 67mun sel 'od gsal gyi ngo sprod dang //srid pa longs sku'i ngo sprod dang //skye ba sprul sku'i ngo sprod sogs//thabs mchog gzhi lam 'bras bus 'khrid//gcig char ba yigang ga la//phyag chen cer mthong ngo sprod mdzad//pha khong mthong sgo gsum dad pa skyes//thos na las kyi sgrib pa 'dag/mjal na ngan song 'jigs las grol//zhus na sangs rgyas lag bcangs gnang //dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gi rgyud pa 'dzin//paṇa chen na ro'i thugs kyi sras//sangs rgyas gnyis pa rin po che//rje miX pa yi yon tan lags//deng sang skye bo phra dog che//dpun khyed nyid ma gtogs bzlas pa na//yon tan mi 'phel zag pa 'phel//de phyir phal la gsang ba lags//bla ma'i mdzad spyod de ltar gda'//legs sam skal ldan rdo rje dpun//

68 rjebs mar pa'i rnamatharagrub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/zhes gsungs pas/ lo tsā ba'i 'dun ma grub gda' gsung ngo / kha che a kā ra sirnyi rje na ro pa la gsang 'dus sar du'ang gsan nas/ rgya nag la 'byon pa'i lam bod la mdzad pa la/ cung thugs ma bde ba mkhyen nas rdo rje dpun ma dgyes na/ rgya nag du bsgoms pas mi phan gsung ste o rgyan la bzhud/ gzhan yang bde mchog in+d+ra bo dhi'i lugs dang / sangs rgyas thod pa sa ra ha'i lugs dang / 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sogs mtha' dag gnang ngo //(gsum pa bod la byon tshul ni/)bod tu 'byon khar rje na ro pa'i drung du btang rag gi tshogs mchod mdzad pa'i tshe/phyag mar pa'i dbu thog du bzhag nas/ mgur gsungs pa/na mkha'i me tog skyes bu yis//mo sham bu yi rta zhon nas//rus sbal sbu yi thun brabs ste//ri bong rwa yi phur ba yis//dgra bo chos nyid klong du bsad//lkugs pa smra zhing dmus 31nga blta//'on pa nyan zhing zha bo rgyug/nyi zla gar mkhan dung 'bud cing //'khor lo bu chung skor bar byed//

rgyagar la'abyonathengs gnyisapa/ 69snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa khyad par ba dang / 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams pa la sogs pa yod pas lan gcig cis kyang 3snag zhig zhes gsung ba tshig thugs la 'jags pa tsam ma gtogs/ brda'i tshig ma dgongs bzhin du slar mjal ba'i dam bca' smon lam mdzad nas lam la ma thogs par bod tu phebs/me ston gyi sar chos 'khor bskor ba las mgo legs la sogs pas bsus ste gdan sar phebs/ rje mi lasatheg pa rim dgu'i mthar phyin pa dang / rgyud pa byin gyis rlob pa'i ched du sku mkhar dgu thog /zur bzhi logs dang brgyad/ rtse mo rin po che 'bar ba lta bu khyams dbu rtse dang bcas pa rtsig du bcug pa legs par zin/rngog gi 'bul chen gsum ba sogs bu slob rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher mdzad/rab gnas dga' ston dang sras kyi che 'don lhan cig mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje mar pa'i sras/yum bdag med ma la 'khrungs pa thugs dam mdo mang bzheng dus 'khrungs pas mtshan dar ma mdo sde'am mdo sde 'bum zhes bya ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan zla med pa/rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po cig bzhugs pa dang / bu chen rnams chos gtam mdzad pas sras rgyal ste sras kyis thugs rgyal mdzad/bu chen rnams la brnyas pa cung zad mdzad pas bu chen 'di rnams la 'di ltar mi rigs dgongs nas mdo sde 'bum nged rang pha spad chos gtam bya'o gsungs nas yab sras chos la glengs pas kyang sras rgyal bas/ sras kyis dka' labangarkya babangabyathangadrang dngos grub bzar bus len bya ba lags/ dka' las pha josamadzad drang chos bdag gisashesapar 'dug gsung nas bzhad pas/ bu chos mkhas pa pha jo'i bka' drin yin zhing / nga yang de ga 'dod rung / nga rgyal gyi sgang bu la yon tan gyi chu mi 'chags pa yin pas/ nga rgyal ma byed par 'di nyon zhig zhes gsungs pa/

70 rjebatsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/(sras la bka' non gyi mgur/)bugasanadang jo zasamado 'bum//nga che dang nga mkhas zer lags kyang //de kun pha jo'i bka' drin yin//ngas tshe sngon yang yang tshogs bsags pas//longs spyod ser po'i gser la byas//bla ma mnyes pa de ltar lags//bugasanadang jo zasamado 'bum//na ro mi tram̐ thar lam gsum//rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin//gdams ngag zab pa de ltar lags//bugasanadang jo za mdo 'gum//ngas sngon bla ma thugs sun ma phyung bas//mkha' 'gro mnyes phyir bu bzhin skyong //rkyen ngan bar chad med pa de ltar lags//bugasanadang jo za mdo 'bum//chos theg pa che la blo sbyangs pas//sems skyed kyis 'gro ba yongs la khyab//dam chos bod tu dar ba de ltar lags//

rgyagar la 'byon thengasaganyis pa / 71snye gsan dang jo zasamado sde 'bum//ngas sngon bla ma gsu skyel byas pa yis//rkang pa 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan//yul rgya gar 'khor ba de ltar lags//bu gsan dang jo zasamado sde 'bum//ngas rgyud dang rgyud 'grel man ngag gsum//tshig don ma nor mkhas par bslabs//bstan pa dar ba de ltar lags//bu gsan dang jo zasamado sde 'bum//mes rngog mtshur ston mgo legs bzhi//snying dang 'dra ba'i bu bzhi yin//rgyud 'grel 'chad pa de ltar lags//bla ma ci gsung sgrub pa de//mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan yin//gdams ngag ster ba de ltar lags//bugagan dang jo zas mdo sde 'bum//pha jo nga na so brgas nas gda'//chos nyid kyang zad sar 'khyol nas gda'//mdo sde'i dus la bab gda' bas//che mkhas kyis bstan pa spel mdzod cig/

72 rje bas marapa'i rnam tharagrub pa'ingomatshar bsna da pa/mi rgan gyi bsam pa grub pa lags//ces gsungs pas sras kyi thugs rgyal zhi zhing / yab la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes ste/ da ni ku re tsam du'ang gsung ldog par mi bya'o zhes dam bcas so//de nas rab gnas kyi bkra shis mdzad tshe/ rje mar pas bkra shisamanga'agasol gyi mgur gsungs pa/bla ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs//nga'i rgyud pa rin chen 'di nyid la//nyes lhung med pa'i bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/gdams ngag zab mo'i nye lam la//nor 'khrul med pa'i bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/nga rang mar pa lo tsā la//zab mo gnad kyi bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la//byin brlabs dngos grub bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/bu chen slob ma'i 'khor tshogs la//dad pa dam tshig bkra shis yod//

rgya gar la 'byon thengasaganyis pa/ 73bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/yon bdag yul mi nye ring la//mthun rkyen tshogs sog bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/las dang bya ba thams cad la//mdo don byang chub bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la//chad mdo btsan pa'i bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog/'dir tshogs khrom gyi lha mi la//bde skyid smon lam bkra shis yod//bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /zhes gsungs/

75(rgya gar la 'byon thengs gsum pa/phyi ma la yang sngar dang 'drabagasum gyi/dang po gser la sog pa'i 'o byad rnam bsgrub tu byon tshul ni/)slar dbu ru byang la gser gyi 'bul sdud la byon/ mgo legs kyi sar dbang bskur mdzad pa'i rjes chog mdzad dgongs pa la mnal du yid tsam song tshe/ mdun na tshur bud med rus rgyan can gsum bsgrigs ste/ sngar gyi brnamitshigabakrol nas mgrin gcig du/mkha' 'gro na mkha'i me tog gis//snyan rgyud mo gsham rta zhon nas//brjod med rus sngal spus brabs ste//skye med ri bong rwa'i phur pas//te lo chos nyid klong du bsad//te lo lkugs pa smra bsam brjod med kyis//na ro dmus long mthong med bden mthong grol//na ro 'on pa chos nyid chos sku'i ri bo la//blo gros zha bo 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med par rgyug/nyi zla dgyes pa rdo rje ste//gar mkhan du ma ro gcig yin//

76 rjebs marapa'irnam tharagrubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/dung gi snyan pa phyogs bcur grags//'bud pa snod ldan dag la 'bud//'bor lo bde mchog 'bor lo ste//bskor ba snyan rgyud 'khor lo nyid//bu chung zhen pa med par bskor//te los lung bstan na ro'i bu//lhun grub chos kyi blo gros khyod//phu la ha ri'i dgon pa rtswa/rnal 'byor dbang phyug na ro pa//skye ba med pa'i dbyings su yal//khyed bzhud na nged dang 'grogs la gshegs//zer bas thugs dam sad ste thal mo sbyar nas spyan chab phra la la 'dug /dpal na ro pa mkha' spyod la gshegs pa 'dra/ kho bo da lta 'gro dgos pa 'dug gsung nas myur du phebs/ dro bo lung zangs phug gi chos khri nas chos gcig gsung zhing /bla mas gsungs pa'i chos rnams la//thun gcig chos bshad thun gcig bsgoms//bar du bya ba'i las rnams sbyangs//rmi lam ji bzhin sgyu ma dang //dri za'i grong khyer lta bu sa/byed pa med pa nyid du rtogs//

rgya gar la 'byon thengari gsumapa / 77gsung zhing yod tshe bla ma spyan yengs 'dug /slob ma rnams kyis bud med shing lo'i gos gyon pa gcig gis phyag tu yi ge zhig phul nas mi snang bar song ba mthong / yi ge de gzigs nas spyan chab shar byung / rje na ro pa spyod pa la gshegs yod par 'dug nga da lta rgya gar la 'gro gsung / rje mi la gnya' gnya'i brag la bzhugs pa la'ang mkha' 'gro mas ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba dang grong 'jug zhus ces lung bstan pa zhus pas/ gdams pa khyad par ba 'di dag gnang ba'i dus la bab cing mkha' 'gros bskyel bas kho bo cis kyang rgya gar la 'gro/ mi mjal mi srid pa yin gsung /thams cad kyis gsol ba btab/ chu bo gaṅgā la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa sngar gsung ba rnams zhus ste nan gyis bzhugs par zhus pas/ 'jigs pa de dag gis mi gnod pa'i gdeng 'di lta bu yod ces/ rgyagar phar 'byon gyi mguragasungs pa/dpa la na ro dang mi tre'i zhabs la 'dud//ngas na ro'i drung du dam bcas pa//dgos pa mchog zhig yod pa'i phyir//gsung mkha' 'gros brda bkrol bskul mdzad pas//bla ma dran ste bzod glags med//nga las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//dpal mo dpal thang thang du che lagasakyang //nga la rnam shes rlung zhon gyi gdams pa yod//'di mdo phrug phal gyi do zla min//las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//

78 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//'angakha la bya la shin du grang lagasakyang//nga la gtum mo me 'bar gyi gdams ngag yod//'di snal gos phal gyi do zla min//las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//ba po lhan du tshad ba che lagasaspyang //nga la 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag yod//'di bzang drug phal gyi do zla min//las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//chu bogaṅgā chu ru che lag kyang //nga la rnam shes mkhar lding gi gdams ngag yod//'di gru gzings phal gyi do zla min//las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//rgyagar mtha' 'khob muge che lagasakyang //nga la dka' thub chu 'thung gi gdams ngag yod//'di bza' btung phal gyi do zla min//las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//

rgyagar la 'byon thengs gsumapa/ 79'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//lam bar dang snyel bran 'jig ba che lagasaspyang //nga la ma mo jag chings kyi gdams ngag yod//'di zla skyel phal gyi do zla min//las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//bla ma na ro dang mi tram̐ yang rgya gar na bzhugs//dpal zhi ba bzang po yang rgya gar na bzhugs//rten ma hā bo dhi yang rgya gar na bzhugs//nga las ci la thug yang rgya gar la 'gro//'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro//zhes gsungs/ gser thams cad dril bas/ rin chen gser gyis 'ol mo bkang / /zhes byung bas dkar yol gang yin yang zer/ bram ze'i bu mo lo bcu drug pa'i thod pa snying spru re ba gang yin yang zer/ de bsnams nas mgo yags sogs rta pa sum bcus skyi rong bar bskyal ste bod rang khyim du 'gro ba las sla/ nga rgya gar chu'ang rin gyis nyo bar 'gro da/sna ༷sa gos lham rnams kyang nga la skur gsung nas phul/ de nas gcig bur tram̐ ṭaṃ ༵ ༵nga // natha//ra kha cig na lan dang po'i dus ye shes snying po la 'pho ba grong 'jug gsan par 'chad pa byung yang dag par mi sem la/ rnam thar 'ga' las rje mi la la mkha' 'gros/ bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya ba chos spyi la yod/ ma bsgoms par sdig po che tsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba sprul shun brje ba lta bu'i man ngag de mi 'dug pa ces lung

80 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtsharabarjodapa/bstan byung nas zhus pas/ de da lta yid la mi gsal ba 'dug gsung nas phyag dpe kun btsal bas mi 'dug /rje na ro'i gsung nas nged rgya gar na btags pa ming gis che ba'i chos gsum bya ba lusamed mkha' 'gro'i chos (ra dgu ma sgoms par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba dang grong 'jug bya ba yod/ 'di kun yang zhus la song gsung yang / bla ma phrin las che ba dang / nga rang yang rgyags zad/ bod la yong ran pa'i sems g.yengs pa 'dzom ste zhu ba ma byung bar 'dug pas zhur 'gro ba yin zhes byon pa dang /tshalapa kunadaga' rdo rje ba ga pa'irnam thar las/ mi la mthu chen gyis bla ma rgya gar na ro pa la ma sgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag med dam zhes pa dang / sgom kho na dgos pa'i chos bod na mang bya ba dang / yang sgom bzhol na sangs rgyas bshol ba des gang zag le lo can gyi don ga na 'ong zer ba dang / mang rdo da cing bas ba su/skyes bus rtsol ba goms byas na//rdo las kyang ni lcags su 'gyur//btsubs pas shing las me yang 'byung //'grims pas lam yang grog por 'gro//de la ya mtshan ches cher min//zhes zer bas rgya sar la byon par bshad to//

rgyagar la 'byon theng gsumapa/ 81(gnyis pa bla ma nā ro pa btsal zhid chos gsan lhus ni/)jo bo rje bod tu byon pa na nyang stod gzhengs kyi glang po snar mjal/ sngar rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta na ro pa'i drung du 'byon pa cig 'dug pa de yin par mkhyen/ gus pa mdzad pas na ro pa spyod pa la gshegs pas mjal ste mi 'ong / de bas nga'i lo tsā la 'gro gsung ba la lan gcig cis kyang 'gro gsungs/'di la'ang dbang rdo rje phreng ba gnang ba'i zhar 'dug pas zhus zer ba rnam thar byi rabasapa cig na snang yang / dbang rdo rje phreng ba ni slob dpon a bh+yas bsgrigs pa yin la/ de ni rje sgam po pa dang dus mtshungs pas 'di dus rdo rje phreng ba ma byung zhing / snga rabs ma re gnyis na dbang rin chen phreng ba zer ba snang ba bya rgyud kyi rig btad la dbang gi ming du btags pa/ deng sang gi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtsho lta bu zhig yod na ma gtoXs jo pos bod tu thun mong gi gdul bya la rgyud sde gong ma'i dbang mdzad pa mi 'dra// /nas bal por phebs/ bal po sku mched la gser srang re phul bas khyed rdo rje'i slob ma dam tshig can yin zhing / bla ma ye shes kyi sku can yin phyir mjal nges pas tshogs mchod phul la gsol ba thob gsung /yul dbus kyi lam na mya ngam gyi thang zhag gsum gyi chu shing khur nas 'gro dgos pa yod pas de'i 'gram du phebs/ thugs 'tsher ba zhig byung / char zim zhig byung / mnal zi ba cig la gos shing lo gyon pa'i bud med cig gis shing sdong gcig sngo khyug skur byung ba la zhon snyam pa na thang de'i phar ngos na sleb/ bud med de zhal 'dzum me skor ba bskor zhing 'dug /de na re/ bod na nga'i ming po ḍi he ru ka bde bar 'dug gam zer/ de mi shes byas pas/ da lta mar pa zug tsā bya bar btags 'dug /da rgya gar du song zhig bar

82 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubaza 'ingo mtshar brjod pa/chad mi 'byung bar bya'o zer nas mi snang bar gyur/de nas nā len+dar byon/ dge tshul shesarab seng ge dang mjal bas sna len gyi tshogs 'khor mdzad/ khyed yong ba 'phyis/ rje btsun na snang lo sar gyi nya la spyod pa la gshegs/de tsam ci byed cing bsdad zer/ gser sgrub cing bsdad pa'i bar la mkha' 'gros brda bskul byung ba yin yang gser ma 'grub pas 'gyangs/ da bla ma dang mi mjal lam nga'i gsung sgos re tsam 'dug gam byas/ bzod med tu gdung shugs kyis gsol ba btab pas khong na re/ nga'i bu mar pa blo gros de/ sang phod 'ong bar 'dug gis kho la 'di gtod gsung nas rdo rje dril bu gcig /dgyes rdor gyi thang sku gcig /bde gsang dgyes gsum gyi rtsa rgyud re ka wa li dang bcas pa/ gdugs gcig gi yu ba la tshigs bcad shu lo ka bris pa rnams bzhag pa yin ste/ rdor dril de gcig gis brkus ngo shes ste 'dzugs ma stub/ gzhan rnams 'di yin/ da bla ma dang mjal ba dang khyad med kyi sasung /de'i rdo rje yin bya ba zhig da lta yod/ tshigs bcad de las rlung sems gnyis med kyi rtsa ba rnams byung / des kyang lhag par bla ma dran du song ste nyin mtshan bar med tu mchi ma shor bas/ dge tshul ba na re/ rje btsun skal ba dang ldan pa la da dung mjal ba srid gsung zhing / dam tshig ni khyed las gtsang ba med pas bla ma rnams la tshogs 'khor dang maṇ+ḍal phul las mjal bar gsol ba thob gsung nas/ thog mar dge chul shebangarab sengage rang la tshogs mchod zlo gcig phul bas/ khongalo/ zhal nas/ngas ni mya ngam thang chen la//dmus long khrid nas gcig la bstan//des kyang rab rib skyon bsal nas//sems kyi me long bstan par barmis//

rgyagar la 'byon thengasagasum pa/ 83dpal na ro pa dang mjal bar nges//da dpal zhi ba bzang po dug mtsho'i 'gram na bzhugs/ gsol ba 'debs pa la khong las ngo che ba med kyis/ der gsol ba 'debs grogs zhus gsung / rdo rje gdan la sogs rten khyad par can thams cad la mchod pa phul ste gsol ba btab/ dpal zhi ba bzang po dug mtsho'i chur 'gram na bzhugs pa la tshogs mchod zla ba gcig phul/gser mang du phul nas bka' drin che ste 'bul ba'ang mi zhan snyam tshe na za sa la brdabs pas mtsho 'gram gyi bye ma thams cad gser du song bas thugs rgyal zhi/ na ro ba dang mjal bar lung bstan pa/rje btsun dpal ldan na ro pa//glang po che yi gzigs stangs kyis//spyan mig gnyis las nyi zla gnyis//'od zer bod du bkye ba barmis//na ro pa dang mjal ste mchi//da dur khrod so sa gling na mkha' 'gro ma lusapa'i rgyan can bzhugs/ khong las ngo che ba su yang med kyi cho 'phrul ci ston yang ma 'jigs par gsol ba 'debs pa zhus gsung / de bzhin du byon pas ngas sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas/ dam tshig srog ltar // dīkā /sa ngo gnong ba med kyis gsol ba gdab gsung nas/ zla gcig mchod ri gsum rtse nas dung 'bud cing //lung gsum mdo nas lam sna 'dren//

84 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamatharagrubapa 'i ngomatshar brjod pa /bum nang mar me 'bar ba yis//dzam gling yongs la gsal ba barmis//na ro pa dang mjal ste mchi//khyod rang gi bla ma mnga' bdag mi pa las ngo che ba med kyis der song gsung / miX pa me tog mdangs can gyi dgon pa ces/ sa phyogs me tog dmar pos khyab pa'i 'od kyis skye 'gro dmar por byed pa na bzhugs par byon ste mi bas zla gcig na lung bstan pa/ nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse la phyar//ded dpon chen po gru rdzings gtong //sgeg mo me long zur la 'jugs//bya zhon na mkha'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar//bya mgo bod tu bstan pa barmis//na ro pa dang mjal ste mchi//da na ro pa'i mched grogs ri ri pa dang ka so ri ba la ngo chen zhus cig gsung / de gnyis lhan cig bzhugs pa la zla gcig mchod pas ri ri bas/sngon tshe bram ze bzang ldan gyis//rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po la//dge bzang dpang btsugs gsol btab pa'i//'bras bu 'dir 'ong mi mjal med//khyod sngon bram ze bzang ldan zhes dad can du gyur tshe/ na ro pa rigs ldan chos kyi

rgyagar la'abyonathengasagasumapa/ 85rgyal po bya ba'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur ba la/ nged gnyis ku swā li dge ba dang bzang por gyur ba dpang du btsugs ste phyi ma mjal bar smon lam btab/ zhal gyis bzhes pas nges par mjal gsung / rnam thar phyi ma zhig na 'di go ldog snang yang / snga ma kun na mar pa bram ze bzang ldan zhabs su bshad cing / gnas skabs gzhan du'ang rje mar pa 'di bram ze bzang ldan zhabs la sogs par gyur zhes bshad to/ /ka so ri bas/mi g.yo phu la ha ri sa/gang yang skye ba med pa yi//sems nyid chos sku'i me long de//zla brgyad nas ni ston par 'gyur//zhes zla ba brgyad na mjal bar lung bstan yang myur du mjal bar 'dod pas/ tshol du byon pas rigs ngan gyi grong du chud/ rgyal pos mchod gnas gyis zer/ yo byad mang du phul yang ma bzhes/ de'i tshe sbyin sreg zhig mdzad pa'i thab khung las bza' btung ci 'dod byung / nga mi sdod bla ma tshol du 'gro /gsungs nas 'bras dus ma zho gcig dang nya'i khog pa gcig rgyags su bsnam sa nas shar phyogs su byon/ res berdzabs lam grogs mdzad/ res bram ze'i khye'ugaser phreng can gyis grogs byas/ mthar grogs med tu dur khrod nags tshal thams cad btsal bas zla gcig na rmi lam du rje na ro pa seng ge la chibs/ bud med gnyis kyis mtha' brten/ nyi zla'i steng na gar mdzad pa mthong bas bla ma dang mjal snyam nas dga' ba'i che na mkha' nas/bud med gnyis kyis mtha' brten zhing //seng ge zhon nas nyi zla yi//kha nas gar bsgyur glu len pa'i//

86 rje btsun marapa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/rmi lam 'khrul pas mi slu 'am/ /zhes grag ste mi snang bar gyur/zlabaganyi sab la rnyed dam mi rnyed dam the tshom zhing btsal bas/dad gus rgyun chad med kyi rta//brtson 'grus lcag gis ma brabs na//le lo'i sgrog du chud par mchi'o/ /zhes grag/gsum ba la ma he'i rdzi mo zhig la rngan pa byin ste lam sna bcol nas btsal bas rjes cig brnyed pas/ maṇ+ḍapas 'di bla ma'i zhabs rjes su snang gsung nas spyi bor bkod cing gsol ba btab pas/rjes ni bya lam ji bzhin du//ngos bzung med par ma shes na//khyi yis bya 'phur rjes brtags bzhin//don med chal par shor nyan mchi'o/ /zhes grag/bzhi ba la rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can zhig nags seb la rib song bas nga'i bla ma rab byung du yod/ rnal 'byor pa de min ste 'ong snyam pa na/gang yang skye ba med pa yi//rang sems chos nyid chos sku sa/the tshom sgrul mdud ma glod na//rtse gnyis khab kyis don mi 'grub/ /ces grag/nas rdo ༵ ༵ /gas seb gcig du mjal/ me long gi maṇ+ḍal la gser gyi tshom bu bkod

rgyagar la'abyon thengasagasumapa / 87snang srid gdod nas dag pa yi//zhen med maṇ+ḍal mi 'bul bar//zhen bcas rin chen maṇ+ḍa95 gyis//chos brgyad sgrog du chud par mchi'o/ /gsung /maṇ+ḍal la zhabs tho rgyab nas thegs song bas phyags phyi yang ma zin/ kho thag yang ma chod/ gser yang med snyam tshe/ snga ma'i sa na maṇ+ḍal la gser ma god par 'dug pas bsdus ste cung zad kyang nyung du ma song bar 'dug/drug pa la grog nang zhig na mi ro'i thod pa bregs/ sto ba phye nas sha dang / klad pa dang / dri chen/ dri chu'i nyag nyog gis thod pa de bkang nas rtsib ma'i thur mas gsol zhing 'dug pa'i thur ma gang gnang byung ba ldag ma nus pas thur ma gang po sprugs nas/bde ba chen po'i snod chen du//bde chen longs spyod ro mnyam dag/bde ba chen por ma spyad na//bde chen longs spyod 'byung mi 'gyur//gsung nas mi ro sogs ci yang mi snang bar gshegs/ zer ma gcig gad pa la 'thor 'dug pa bzhes pas ro dpe med pa zhig byung / ting nge 'dzin gcig la zhag bdun du 'byams/ thur ma gang po de bldags na nga bod tu yong mi dgos par 'dug gsung /yang zla gcig btsal bas shel gyi brag logs cig la bla ma'i zhabs rjes lam pa gcig snang ba la gsol ba btab/ yang sa la zhabs rjes lam pa gcig la pad+ma dam ra po'i sdong po khru gang pa gcig skyes 'dug pa khyer nas phyin/yang pha tshad na spang la 'byar ba'i rdo sngon po gru bzhi che ba zhig la phyag gi rjes lam pa

88 rje ba' mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/gcig la tsan+dan dkar po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig btsugs nas 'dug pas rdo rje khyer nasdu phyin/ yang zla ba gcig na tsan+dan gyi sdong po gcig la dgyes rdor lha dgu gsal bar gza/sdu /pha tshad na rnal 'byor ma gcig ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i lus shel ltar gsal ba'i snying rtse mo gyen du bstan pa me tog ltar bye ba'i nang na adzi'i sngags 'khor gsal bar gzigs/ de dag la bla ma dang mjal ba'i gsol ba btab/ ri mun pa can gyi rtser shel gyi pha bong la/ bla ma'i zhabs gnyis kyi rjes spu shad tshun gsal ba drod ma yal ba mthong bas dri bzang byugs dar dkar la yang spar blangs nas da lta dad rten gral la bzhugs/ des zla ba brgyad kyang rdzogs/da ni ring por mi thogs snyam rtse gcig zhag bdun gsol ba btab pas/ rnal 'byor pa dmar sbug cer bu kha ṭaṃ dang / thod pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa gcig khrong gis byon/ sku la 'khyud cing yus pa'i smre sngags garbe|la/ gser srang bcu bdun thums kogs ba〈snal ste phul bas ma bzhes/ nan gyis bzhes par zhus pas bla ma dkon mchog mchod cig gsung nas nags seb tu gtor/ 'phangs sems cig shar bas khyod 'phangs na slar yod to gsung ste/ phyag gnyis snyim pa kha phye bas ma god par slar gnang / rje mar babangakyang ltos pa med par zhal ras la gtor/ gser gyis dgos pa yod na 'di thams cad gser gling yin no gsung nas zhabs sa la brdabs pas sa gzhi gser du song /rang grol ye shes nyi ma yis//phu la ha ri'i dgon pa sa/ma ti'i ma rig mun pa sol//

rgyagar la 'byon theng gsumapa / 89ye shes snang bas khyab par gyis//ces te lo'i lung bstan yod pas phul ha rir 'dong gsung / rje mar pa la mkha' 'gro rnams chos la 'bren pa'i cho 'phrul dang / 'jigs snang ci yang byung bas bdag la skyob tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/bla mas lung bstan bdag gi bu//snod ldan mar pa blo gros la//mkha' 'gro'i ming can bdud mo rnams//bar chad rtsom gyis byin gyis rlobs//gsungs ma thag te le'i sprul ba khro bo mang po byung bas mkha' 'gro rnams skrag zhing brgyal/ sangaspob dang mkha' 'grornamasan re/'jigs pa'i sku la 'jigs pa'i gsung //'jigs pa'i mtshon cha legs bsnams pa//'jigs chen sku la skyabs su mchi//bdag cag gnod skyel ma lags ste//bstan pa srung bar byed pa dang //rnal 'byor rnams kyi drod tshad nyul//lung bstan mar pa blo gros 'di//yang dag mthar phyin rnal 'byor ste// shing rta'i 'khor lo bskyod pa bzhin//phu la ha rir spyan drang ngo //

90 rje btsunamar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngomatsharabarjodapa /zhes zer ste/ skad cig gis pudzi ha rir phebs/ de na brag la khro bo dang mkha' ༷gro'i rjeX dang / rje mar pas te lo'i zhal gzigs pas dgyes ste bro mdzad pa'i zhabs rjas rno ༵ ༵ ṭā /// dang 'bras bu can gyi shing sna tshogs kyi tshal chen po yod pas saṃ kṛ ta'i skad du bu'i ha ri zhes dang / phal skad la de zur chag pa bu la ha ri zhes pa me rtag mdangathanga'aphrog gi dgon ba zer ba/ rgya gar byang phyogs stag gzig gi yul gyi phu na yod pa/ dben zhing yid tu 'ong ba/ sgo'i phyi cam kho na na yo byad kyi chu/ bza' ba'i tshod ma/ de la 'debs pa'i pod/ 'tshed pa'i me shing / dkon mchog mchod pa'i me tog rnams dus gcig la 31na pas rgya gar na bsam gtan pa'i sti gnas mchog tu grags/der bla mas bu snar+shagakyi blo 1snaba'isleb pa la sna len byed gsung nas/ na mkha' la spyan gzigs pas nya'i ro ma nyams pa so ma legs pa cig babs byung / 'di galhardos gsung ste bshas pas rang byung shel gyi phag mo sogs rten ngo mtshar can mang po dang / rang byung shel gyi mchod rten dang / tshogs kyi rdzas sha chang dang / 'bras chan sogs dang / bza' btung gi bye brag sngon ma mthong ba mang po dang / mchod pa 'bul ba'i yo byad mang po byung nas mchod pa bshams/ dbang bskur mdzad tshe mdun na tsan+dan gyi sdong po cig 'dug pa'i rtse la dgyes rdor lha dgu rten brten pa dang bcas pa dngos su byon/ bum dbang bskur tshe bla ma'i thugs ka nas lhan cig skyes ma dngos su byon nas dbang bskur/thugs ka na aspyi'i sngags phreng snang ba zhal nas byung ste thugs kur dngos su thim/ mtshan zhe ldang rdo rjer btags/ snang srid dkyil 'khor du gzigs cing bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang thob pas lus med pa 'i nyams skyes/ bla ma he ru dar dngos su bzhengs pa'i yab yum zung 'jug gi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba zhal du zhugs pas rtsa'i mdud pa ji snyed pa grol ste gsal stong sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams skyes/

rgya garal 'byon thengasagasum pa/ 91slar yang pad+ma'i ḍā zhi ma las lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ zag med kyi bde bas lus sems gang ste bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la zhag bdun 'byams pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i brjod bya'i don/mdo rgyud thams cad kyi yang snying / ḍā zhi ma thams cad kyi srog snying / mar gyi yang zhun lta bu nyams rtogs zung du chud pa/ dbang bzhi pa'i don de bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ da lta khyod kyi rgyud la skyes pa 'di yin gyi/ bu khyod nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyongs/spyir gdams pa'i mchog du gyur pa rgyud sde rab 'byam gyi snying po/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma zar ma chad par brgyud pa/ tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba chos drug gi gdams pa 'di yin gyis snod min la gsongs/ snod ldan la ston/ ye shes kyi ḍā gis te lo la nga lung bstan pa yin/ nga la yang te los khyod lung bstan pa yin/ khyod la slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang ba'i rgyud pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ste bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur/khyod las kyi phyag rgya bsten la snod ldan smin par gyis cigabla ma'i mtshan nyid rgyud par ldan//sems kyi mtshan nyid zung du tshud//snang ba'i mtshan nyid spros dang bral//'khor ba'i mtshan nyid gzhi rtsa bral//mos gus gnad kyis mtshams sbyar nas//stong nyid snying rje ro mnyam pa//rang byung 'od gsal brjod las 'das//rtogs na phyag rgya chen po yin//zhes gsung zhing / skyed rdzogs thams cad chos drug du ma 'dus pa med kyang / thabs

92 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngomatshar brjodari /la ma rmongs pa dang / rnam grangs mtha' yas pas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir/rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu/ smin lam yid bzhin nor bu/ grol lam yid bzhin nor bu zhes ston pa mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud/ rgyal po chos nyid skye med dang / blon po rigs gsum las byed dang / rmangs phrin las mthun sbyor rnams slob bshad tu ston pa thugs rgyud gdams skor bco lnga rim lnga stan thog gcig tu sgom pa 'dus pa'i mthar thug sogs dgyes gsang sgyur gdan gyi rgyud kyi shog dril bzhi/ rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo sogs man ngag gi shog dril bzhi/ rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med/ phyag chen gtso bor ston pa sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ gdan bzhi'i khyad chos 'pho ba grong 'jug sogs gdams pa thams cad rdzogs par gnang / mi la'i mas rgyubangazhus pas/byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum na//gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra ba'i//thos pa dga' zhes bya ba yi//skyes bu de la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes phyag thal mo sbyar/ dbu gug mdzad pas/ ri dang shing rtsi thams cad bod phyogs su mgo gug byung / phu la ha ri'i ri dang rtsi shing rnams da dung de ltar yod skad/ phyis bde mchog snyan rgyud kho na'ang rje mi las slob ma rnams la chags lam gtso por ston ste spros pa dang bcas gsungs pa ra chung snyan rgyud/ grol lam gtso bor ston nas spros pa nyung ngus ston pa rnam bo snyan rgyud/ chags grol cha mnyam du bar mar ston pa deng sang ngam rdzong snyan rgyud du grags pa/ ngo bo chu mig sngo 'bur du mjal ba'i zhu yas dar ma dbang phyug yin par bshad pas zhi ba 'od kyi snyan rgyud dang / ngam rdzong ston pa nyid la gnang ba ngam rdzong snyan rgyud ste mang du dar ro//

rgyagar la'abyonathengasagasumapa/ 93ma sgoms par 'tshang rgya ba zhes pa'ang spyir 'pho ba'i skabs su btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba sbyang ba la mi ltos pa dang / bar do blo chod kyis sngon ma sbyangs pa la yang bar do dang po ngo sprad pas grol ba dang / spyir sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba'i de ma thag grub mtha' pa spyi la ltos ste grol ba lta bu yin la/ gnyid dus kyi 'od gsal sogs gnad shes na 'tshang rgya byi 'a dziyun ring mi dgos pa'i gdams pa du ma yod pas tshegs chung ngus chog pa'i dan sdur// pa mnal du song ba zhig la dgyes rdor sprul ste yar longs dang yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje yang phebs 'dug khyod sngon la yi dam la phyag byed tam/ nga la phyag byed gsung ba na yi dam la phyag mdzad pas 'di dag kho bo'i sprul ba yin gsung nas yi dam thugs dar bsdus/ rten 'brel des khyod la mi rgyud sha ba'i mjug ma 'dra ba sdum log ge ba zhig las mi yong ba 'dug /chos rgyud sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas kyi bar du 'byung gsuzlo /rgyud kyi rten 'brel zhus pas pha spad thams cad tshe sgrub dam po lo gsum bar chad med par grub na rten 'brel zlog nus ste khyod kyis mi 'grub gsung / de dus rje mar pa'i sku la rgya tshad kyis bro 'tshal ba dang / rlung gis dran pa nyams pa sogs 'grongs la thug pa du ma byung yang bla ma'i thugs rje dang / rkyen ngan la ro bsnyams pas legs par dngas/bla ma tshol ba'i dka' las la da brnyed nas 'bral med byed/ bod tu log kha na med snyam pa na thugs dam pad+ma dmar po'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa de gnang nas/ bu khyod nga dang 'du 'bral med/ yon tan phrin las gnyis su med/ ngo bo dbyer med kyang rnam pa sgyu lus kyi phung po zhig pa'i dus su dag snang la bla ma yi dam dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gsu ba 'byung ba chos nyid yin pas de'i tshe kho bo gsu ba la yong / phyi ma rgya gar shar gyi rgyud ha ri ka ba'i gling du pad+ma las brdzus ste skyes nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la nga dang

94 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtsharabarjod pa /'phrad nas mi gyed sba pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bar gyur nas spyod pa mthar phyin ste/ 'khor tshom bu dang bcas pa mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ tshe 'dir yang byang phyogs kha ba can 'dul ba'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba yin pas cis kyang bod du 'gro dgos/khyod kyi slob ma dang yang slob nas bzung ste mi rabs bcu gsum mkha' spyod la 'gro zhing / khyod kyi rjes 'jug phal cher gsang sngags kyi don rtogs pa'i sar gnas kyi sems dpa' phyi nyan thos kyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa shas cher 'byung la/ gzhan cha lugs nges med kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes dbu thog tu phyag bzhag ste gasdo/ngas pa/sngon tshul bzhin sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can//bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod//'khor los bsgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin//zhen pa rdo la yi ge bris//rigs rgyud na mkha'i me tog yal//chos rgyud chu bo'i gzhung las ring //seng ge khyung gi ro/ sdo/ bzhin//bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang /theg chen snying po'i don bsdus nas//las can smin dang grol byed pa//skal ldan gdul bya'i rgyal po khyod//chos kyi rgyal srid la bskos phyir//da ni bod yul dbus su song //

rgya gar la 'byon thengasagasumapa/ 95byang phyogs kha ba can gyi phyogs//spos kyi shing snas brgyan pa'i sa//sman sna tshogs skye ba'i ri mgul na//skal ldan gdul bya sdod ldan yod//khyod de ru song la 'gro don sgrubs//bu khyod kyi sku don 'grub ste mchi//skye ba 'di nyid 'das gyur nas//mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i gnas//'od gsal gyi ngang du mjal bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs cing /'di la'ang rnam thar snga rabasapa cig na/sman sna tshogs skye ba'i ri mgul na//lho dro bo lung zhes grags pa na//brag zangs phug zhes pa'i gnas chen na//ma mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du ba yod/ /ces dang /zhen pa rdo la ri mo bkra/ /ces pa'i 'og du/'khor ba chu ris rang yal 'gyur//mkhar cig mar pa'i sku mkhar de//nang sral gnyis po jo mo gnyis//bar thog bdun po sras bdun ste//de ni mi nub rgyal mtshan yin//

96 rjebs mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/dzam bu gling pa'i mchod rten ste//bka' rgyud kun gyi mes po'i mkhar//'di la kun kyang dad par 'gyur//mkhar sgo byang du bstan pa yis//gdul bya snod ldan byang nas 'byung //'og sgo 'khor ba'i rgyun lam bcad//steng sgo byang chub thar lam phye//bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang //chos rgyud bstan pa dar bar 'ong //zhes snga rabs kyi rnam thar jo bo btsun pa'i blo nas byung ba yin zer ba zhig kho na na snang / phug pa zangs chung kha sbub yod//mi gcig ldang ba'i shing cig yod//mi gcig ldang ba'i chu cig yod//brag la thab ka rang byung skusnad//ces lung bstan par ngag sgos la zer zhing snang ngo / /de'i tshe rol mo'i 'ur gyis na mkha' gang ba dang dri zhim po'i ngad dang 'od zer dpag du med pa nyi zla'i 'od las lhag pa byung zhing / mchod pa'i lha tshogs na mkha' gang ba'i dbus na seng ge'i khri pad+ma brtsegs pa'i steng du bla ma na ro pa chen po bzhugs ste/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyag 'tshal/ skor ba byed/ mchod cing bstod ste/ na mkha'i dbyings je mtho je mthor mkha' spyod tu gshegs par gzigs so//

rgya garal 'byon theng gsum pa/ 97'jig rten mkha' 'gro dang sha za'i tshogs rnams kyis mchod gtor kun yang khyer ste med par gyur/ grogs mched lcam rnams kyang so sor gyes ste rje btsun rang gcig por bzhugs pa'i tshe/ thugs skyo bar gyur nas nyi shar la seng ldeng stug po'i nags khrod tu skyo bseng la byon ste gsol ba btab pas/ ḍa ma ru khrol gyis grag tsa na bla ma chen po na ro pa mngon sum du byon ste/ shing n+ya gro dha'i sdong po'i steng du bzhugs nas lo tsā ba'i skyo ba bseng byed chosadrug dril ba rdo rje'i mguragasungs pa/dal 'byor gzugs kyi phung po 'di//g.yar skyo tsam na 'di skad lo//lus kyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i gnad//sems kyi bzhag thabs lta ba'i gdeng //phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku//nang ni rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi//'og na a shad tsaṇ+ḍali//steng na ha yig rnam pa can//bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams//steng 'og rlung gi 'khor la'i dbyibs//ming yang gtum mo'igadamasangag zer//sems gnad tu tshud tam lo ts+tsha ba//dus rmi lam tsam gyi 'khrul pa la//gnad mgrin pa oṃ gyi sa bon can//

98 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'ingo mtsharabarjodapa/phyi ni snang ba sgyu ma tsam//nang na nyams myong smrar ma stub//nyin mtshan snang ba sprul pa'i sku//ming yang lusakyigadamasangag zer//zhen pa sku1ga gam 61 ts+tsha ba//gnyid dang rmi lam bar shed na//gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo can//brjod med 'od gsal bde ba'i nyams//rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis gdab//ming yang 'odags gyigadamasangag zer//sems skye med tu rtogs sam lots+tsha ba//sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i skar khung can//sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po'i lam//sgo brgyad bkag nas sgo gcig 'byed//sems kyi mda' la rlung gi gzhu//hika da'i rgyud kyis rab bskul ste//rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas 'don//rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das//ming yang 'pho ba'igadamasangag zer//rlung dus su khegs sam lots+tsha ba//

rgyagar la 'byon theng gsum pa/ 99rmi lam dus kyi shes pa de//bar do'i shes par sre dgos pas//longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ngo bo can//rmi lam bar do bsre 'pho'i gnad//ming yang b.rarda'igadam ngagazer//rmi lam 'byongs sam lots+tsha ba//rang lus dus kyi tshad la phebs//gzhan lus mtshan ldan rten gyi 'phrul//bar na yig 'bru rlung gi rta//rang lus khang stong bzhin du bor//gzhan lus sprul sku'i ngo bo can//ming yang grong 'jug /gdamasangag zer//rlung las su rung ngam lots+tsha ba//rmi lam yul gyi snang tshul de//skyes pa barmis na pho 'drer bzung //bud med barmis na mo 'drer bzung //byol song barmis na klu ru bzung //dga' ba barmis na sems spangs mtho//ngan pa barmis na snying mi dga'//'dre rang sems rtsa bar ma shes na//bgegs la zad pa med par 'gyur//

100 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grubapa'i ngomatsharabarjodapa/phyi nang gi chos la thos pa dgos//goms pas mtha' gnyis spong ba yin//yin min sgro 'dogs chod lags sam//gol bas mi 'jigs gdeng thob yin//lam de las skyel sa ga na yod//༷sa gsungs pas/ thugs skyo ba sangs cing bla ma dang 'bral med kyi gdeng thob par gyur / /na/sa ri bo me ltar 'bar bar mnga' bdag mi pa'i drung du byon/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa gzi brjid nyi ma lta bur n+ya gro dha'i shing drung na bzhugs pa mthong bas dga' ba tshad med pa skyes/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag bla ma dang dngos su mjal/ dbang gdams pas tshim/ bsams pa'i don grub kyang bla ma mkha' spyod tu gshegs pas skyo bar yang byung / da bdag la bka' drin gyis skyab tu gsol zhes zhus pas/ bla ma mkha' spyod tu gshegs nas kyang mjal ba de skal pa rab tu gyur pa yin/ ngas kyang kho bo rang dang gnyis su med par byin gyis rlab bo gsung nas dbang bskur ba'i tshe tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dri bzang gi ngad byung / sgron shing mdzub gang spar ba'i mar mes nyin mo ltar gsal zhing zhag bdun thub/ de ḍā zhi'i lag gis 'dzin pa'i rtags su sgron shing de g.yo 'gul dang phan tshun du 'gro/ lha'i rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra grag /bde mchog gi dbang gnang tshe sa gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams sku mi mngon par sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa byung / gtor ma skyod tshe zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa ce cang dmar mo bdun bsgrigs nas gtor ma dngos su len pa byung / gnas 'og min dang bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen por dngos su thag chod pa'i gzigs snang dang byin rlabs byung / spyi por phyag bzhag nas bu khyod skye ba gsum gyi mthar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ da lta bod yul gyi 'gro ba'i don gyis

rgyagar la 'byon thengasagasumapa / 101cig /dus kun du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la tshogs kyi mchod pa ma bcad/ gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma spyi bor khur/ rang sems yid bzhin gyi nor bu zung la rang gzhan gyi dgos 'dod grub par gyis cig zhes dam tshig /ra dril gyi phyag gi sor gdub cig gnang / ltas 'di dag re zhig rgya gar du gsongs ga / /dri /ga// mtsho'i 'gram du dpal zhi ba bzang po la phyi phyag la byon pas mnyes cing / tshogs 'khor zhig gnang ba'i gral du bud med cig gis mi ro cig bskyal byung /de'i thod pa bregs/ dpal zhi ba bzang po'i gsang chab blugs ste klad pa dang bsres nas dam tshig gi rdzas su 'grems kyi 'dug pa rje mar pa'i thad du sleb pa dang chil chil khol ba la gzigs pas mahā mā ya'i yig 'bru sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyi zhal gzigs/dam rdzas de'ang ro mchog brgya dang ldan par myong / rnal 'byor gsum gyi rtogs pa la rgya mtsho ltar bri gang med par gyur ste bla mas byin rlabs dang ched tu brjod pa mdzad to//de nas dpal ye shes snying po la phyi phyag la byon pas nags tshal chen po na rigs ngan ma zhig gis zham ring mdzad ste bzhugs/ gar dgar 'gro sa med cing lam yang mi rnyed/ rigs ngan ma de chu len du 'ong / sgugs zer nas chu mig gi drung du bzhugs pas rigs ngan ma des bum pa cig khyer nas chu zed pa rnams byang sems dkar por skya mer song / bud med des bum pa'i khar 'khrul 'khor zhig bcas pas gsang gnas nas rak+ta'i rgyun phab ste gang ba la chu 'di'i sum gnyis kyis khrus gyis sum cha 'thung zhig gsung zer bas/ rnam rtog bcom nas byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa de 'thungs cing khrus byas pas gsal stong sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams skyes/ bum nang du bltas pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rten brten pa thams cad zhal mthong / de'i mod la dpal ye shes snying po byon nas bu khyod rgyud yongs su sbyangs sam/ sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol lam/

102 rje batshun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/de kho na nyid kyi don khong du chud tam zhes dbang bzhi'i don ngo sbrad/ slar gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa mthar phyin pa mdzad ste gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs so//mdor na rgya gar la lan gsum du byon/ bla ma thams cad tshogs dang khyad par gyi mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ dpal na ro pa dang lo drug zla ba bdun du 'bral med tu 'grogs/ snga phyir ci rigs su bsten/ spyir rgya gar du lo nyi shu bzhugs/ na ro/ mi tram̐/ku ku ri pa/ ye shes snying po/ rus pa'i rgyan can ma ste grub thob zhal lnga'i gdams pa thamagu cad yongs su rdzogs cing / khyad par na ro mi lhas rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur bar gyur /zha//na yang sirnya gling pa rol pa'i rdo rje la gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gsan/ ka so ri pa dang ri ri pa la bde mchog /o de bi sha'i nag po dam tshig rdo rje la gshin rje'i gshed/kha che dz+nyā na kā ra la rdo rje bdud rtsi/ de wa a kā ra sirnyi la sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ a bhi dzu ga la sangs rgyas thod pa/ pham thing pa la gdan bzhi/ poṇ+ḍapa la ral gcig ma/ ma na ka shri la nges brjod/ ka na shri la rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ ḍā gi ma mngon par dga' ba'i yid can daX bde ba'i myu gu can la rnal 'byor ma'i skor gsan ste snang ba 'gyur nges bcagasu/ // ya/ nga paṇ+ḍi ta dang rnal 'byor pa mtha' yas brten ste rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi rgya mtshor gyur cing / rgya gar gyi man ngag zab gu thams cad bsnams par grags so//de ltar bla ma rnams dang mched grogs gong ma phyag gi 'os thams cad la phyi phyag mdzad/kun gyis kyang byang chub kyi shing dang / lum+bi'i tshal gyi blak+ṣa dang / rtsa mchog gi su la dang /shing chen po brgyad dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang / 'og min sogs 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan gyi shing sogs shing khyad par can gyi dum bu chung ngu re/ ston pa 'khor bcas dang / grub thob gong ma'i sku bal gyi ring srel dang / sku gdung gi ring srel sogs

rgya gar la'abyon thengasagasumapa/ 103sna re/ rang gi gdams pa dang / myong rtogs dang / yi dam gyi snying po sogs phyag gis shangs mtshal sogs kyis bris pa'i shog dril chung ngu re rnams byin rlabs kyi rten du gnang zhing / 'og min du mjal ba'i smon lam mdzad/ rten khyad par can rnams la yang phyi phyag dang mchod pa mdzad/khyad par rdo rje'i gdan du srin po mchod pa byed pa dang dus mtshungs pas mtshan mo zhig mi ma yin gyi ku co'i sgra chen po byung / sang nyin ga'o la'i mdun na srin po cig shi ba'i ro 'dug ste gdong pa la mtho bcu drug 'dug khru gsum zer ba'i yi ge gnyis snang /der mi thams cad sgrag zhing reg mi nus par 'dug pas rje mar pas rang gi lus srung ba'i grogs bzhag ste grong 'jug mdzad/ srin po'i ro la zhugs ste rong khung zhig du bskyal bas mi thams cad dga' zhing grub thob rtsod med tu grags so//de nas bram ze sa man+ta girti dang / rnal 'byor ma su kha dha ri dang / mi mnyam rdo rje dang / bu mo tsakra ma dang / kuṇ+ḍali dang / bram ze'i khye'u gser phreng can la sogs mched ltam thugs nye ba rnams kyis ring mor bskyal zhing / khyad par a smra'i tshal du skyel thung gi tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i tshe dgyes pa dang / skyo ba dang / 'tsher ba dus gcig du byung nas/rgya gar tshur 'gron ma zhesabya ba mgur chen lam glu ring mo 'di bung ba rtsi bcud blangs nas/ rgyang ring du 'phur 'gro ba'i rnam pa la rta drangs nas gsungs pa/rje 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bka' drin can//grub thob rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams//mi 'bral spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs//bzhugs nas dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs//rgya gar gyi na ro paṇa chen dang //

104 rje ge'i mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā gnyis//dang po zhal mthong snga ma nas//lo drug dang ni zla bdun du//dus skad cig yang ma bral 'grogs pa'i phyir//thugs la mi 'dogs kyi dogs ma mchis//dpal me tog mdangs 'phrog gi dgon pa der//dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs par bskur//snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag mthar thug gnang //bla med theg pa mchog gi lam//gnyis med rtse gcig gzhir bzhag nas//sems stong pa nyid la par zin byas//kha ba can ljongs byang phyogs su//lung bstan rgyal tshab bskos pa'i phyir//da ni ban chung bod tu 'gro//ban chung bod tu 'gro ba la//shul na phreng ba rnam gsum yod//yid la bcags pa rnam gsum yod//lam na 'jigs pa rnam gsum yod//bar na 'tsher ba rnam gsum yod//mdun na brod pa rnam gsum yod//

rgyagar la'abyon theng gsum pa/ 105ngo mtshar che ba rnam gsum yod//glu de'i phyir rjes ma skyar na//tshig des don gyi brda mi 'jal//na ro dang miXs dbu mdzad pa'i//grub thob kyi bla ma rje btsun rnams//'di shuladu lu rte ma ba phreng //dpal 'jigs med grags pas dbu mdzad pa'i//dam tshig can gyi mched grogs rnams//'di shuladu lu rte gab zeng //gnas puṣ+ṭha ha ris sna drangs pa'i//byin rlabs can gyi sgrub gnas rnams//'di shul du lu rte ma ba phreng //dharma bo dhi a sho ka/drin can gyi gnas po pho mo rnams//'di 'bral ma 'od rte yid labacags//bram ze'i khye'u gser phreng can//tshe srog 'thud pa'i grogs po byas//'di 'bradzom phod rte yid la bcags//ded dpon gyi bu mo sngo sangs ma//

106 rje ba' mar pa'i rnamathar grubapa'ingo mtshar brjodapa /mtshan ldan gyi phyag rgyar rten brten nas//'di 'bral ma phod rte yid la bcags//shar chu bo gaṅgās sna drangs nas//mtsho dug mtsho khol ma da gdod rgal//'di ma mthong gonganasang re 'jigs//grong khyer ti ra hu ti der//khrel med kyi sho gam bcu gcig 'bebs//'di ma mthong gong nasang re 'jigs//ri u shu ri yi nags 'dab na//mi rkun gyi jag pas rdzun nas gsu//'di ma mthong gong nasang re 'jigs//phrang pa la ha tis sna drangs pa'i//gcan phrang zam pa brgyad bcu yod//kye ma dngul chu bsakyang 'tsher//la kha la bye las sna drangs pa'i//la chen brgya dang brgyad cu yod//kye ma dngul chu bsakyang 'tsher//thang dpal mo dpal thang gis sna drangs pa'i//thang chen brgya dang brgyad cu yod//

semasal dngul chu ba kyang //sgra ka la tsan+d+ras sna drangs pa'i//sgra skad brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes//grog lo tsā tsho tshogasanang re brod//dpal dgyes rdor dang gdan bzhis sna drangs pa'i//rgyud 'grel brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes//grog ston chen tsho tshogasan nga re thod//na ro'i chos drug gis sna drangs pa'i//gdams ngag brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes//grogasasgom chen tsho tshogasan nga re thod//bsre ba dang 'pho ba ma gtogs pa'i//khyad chos brgya dang brgyad cu shes//ngo mtshar che na de che mod//rim lnga'i smar khrid ma gtogs pa'i//rdzogs rim brgya dang brgyad cu shes//che na ngo mtshar de che mod//dud sol lha mo ma gtogs pa'i//bstan srung brgya dang brgyad cu shes//che na ngo mtshar de che mod//

108 rje bas marapa 'i rnam tharagrub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/de thams cad bla ma rje yi drin//'bangs drin lan gzhal gyis mi 'khor gyis//rje mi 'bral spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs//de 'og mched dang lcam dral rnams//ban chung bod tu 'gro ba la//rkyen bar chad med pa'i byin rlabs zhu//tshe 'di la mjal ba yong mi mchi//o byen gnas sam mkha' spyod tu//tshe phyi ma cis kyang mjal bar zhu//zhes gsungs pas thams cad spyan chab shor/ gdung ba'i sems kyis tshe phyi ma mjal ba'i smon lam mang po btab skad/ der byin rlabs kyi rten sna tshogs pa rnams dbu sngas su bzhag ste mchod pa phul/ 'di rnams gcig du bsdoms pa'i rten ji lta bu zhig byed snyam pa na/ mnal lam du bud med shing lo'i gos gyon pa des kha che'i lha gzo ma yin zer ba'i bud med dkar mo zhig khrid nas gzo byed pa barmis pas/ nang par mnal sad tshe shing rnams rtsig pa dang gzhan rnams rten rdzongs kyi tshul gyis mchod rten sgo mang gi rnam par rang byung du gda' skad/mchod rten rang byung dang / glang po che'i ko ba las zhal ras byas pa grub chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa dpal ldan lha mo'i sku 'bag dang gnyis po mkha' 'gros na mkha' la gdan drangs pa phebs pa'i dus gzhi'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis gsu ba byas pa'i rgyun yin zhes zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga la deng du'ang srol ma chad pa snang /

rgya garal 'byon theng gsumapa/ 109chu bo gaṅgā brgal tshe shi skyid bya ba srog la mi lta ba'i chom po ka ra wī rwa'i me tog gis mgo bkris pa ri dang thang la rlung ltar mgyogs pa/ chu la nya ltar 'dzul pa gnyis bsdigs mo byed cing byung bas sngangs cing sgrag pa na/ mnga' bdag gshin rje srog 'phrog zlog zhes rje miX pa spyi bor bsgoms pas tshur yong 'phro la ma mthong bar log song /yang bltas nas tshur byung / de lta bu lan bdun gyi mthar mig yang mi lta bar song /ba li pa dra bya ba'i grong zhig na bu mo zhig shing tog srung gi 'dug pa la slongs pas a ma la slongs zer/ ma rnal 'byor ma zhig 'dug pa la slongs pas des lta stangs cig byas pas shing tog bzang po sna tshogs pa shab kyis bo byung ba bsdus/ gcig gi nang kha phye nas gzigs pas bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga bdud rtsi 'od kyi lugs su zhal gzigs/ de gnyis mkha' 'gro mar 'dug gsung /bka' rgyud rin po che'i srin las rgya mtsho'i bar du nyi 'od ltar bdal ba'i zer ma bzod pas dad pa dang dag snang gi mig ldongs/ phra dog dang log lta'i mun pa 'phel ba kha cig mar pa dang na ro pa dus mi mtshungs pas ma mjal bya ba dang / mar pas mjal ba de na ro rdza mgo bya ba na ro pa dngos min bya ba sogs zer ba ni/ chos dang gang zag la smad pa la ngang pa pad mtshor 'jug pa ltar spro ba/mi shesaramadabye med par rgyu bzhi yis//rnam dbye smra ba'i kha ni bdud kyi gye//zhes pa'i sgo 'byed pa po byung ba/ sngon byung gi lo rgyus rnams chos can/ rang gzo'i brdzun yin ste/ lo rgyus yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bdag cag gis brjod pa'i lo rgyus rnams bzhin no zhes pa'i rtags kyi tshul gsum rang la rgyus yod tu grub pa dag gis/sngon de bzhin gshegs pa la 'od srung rdzogs byed la sogs pas dge sbyong go ta ma spu

110 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/gri'i ser ba 'bebs cing 'ong ste khyed thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro zhes sgrog pa dang mtshungs pas chos bzhin gyi rtsod yul ga la yin/ na ro pa dang mjal tshul mgur dang rnam thar 'di tsam bzhugs pa/ sngon byung lo rgyu kyi tshad ma dang / phu la ha ri na dpon slob gnyis mjal ba'i zhabs rjes yod pa sogs rgya gar na rlung ltar grags pa/ gragasapa'i gtan tshigasadang / brgyud pa 'di'i man ngag rgya bod na gzhan su la yang ma grags pa da lta'ang dngos grub thob pa rgyun ma chad pa 'di snyed cig bzhugs pa/ dngo po stob zhugasakyi tshad ma dang / yid chesapa'i rjesadabag la sogs pas grub bo//gal ste rnam thar rnams ma gcig go zhe na/ gdul bya so so'i skal ba bzhin snang ba 'char ba la su zhig gis tshad 'dzin/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras ston pa mjal ba kho na la'ang mi gcig pa'i mdo 'di snyed snang ba ltos cig/rje btsun na ro pa spyod pa la gshegs pa 'di la'ang kha cig gis sku 'das cing gdung sbyangs par snang ba yang byung / slob ma phal cher la zhal gdams dang byin rlabs kyi rten so sor gnang ste/ nags dang dur khrod grong khyer la sogs par rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang / spyon pa'i spyod pas rgyu zhing sku lus gzugs sna tshogs par bsgyur zhing snang ༵ // tram̐ /nga ba du ma ston par snang / kha cig la sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod tu byon par

rgyagaral 'byon thengasagasumapa/ 111(gsum pa bod la byon tshul ni/)yang rgya gar nas tshur 'byon gar rnal 'byor pa gcig gis tshogs 'khor byas ste/tshogs gral du rnal 'byor pa rdzu 'phrul thob pa bzhi bcu/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta thub pa'i gsung dang mi 'gal ba bzhi bcu la sogs pa tshogs pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pa de na re/ lo tsā ba khyed kyis rje na ro pa'i drung du ngo mtshar gyi ltas ci gzigs zer ba la lan gsungs pa/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//dpal dz+nyā na sirnyi'i zhabs la 'dud//kha sang dgung zla yar 'das kyi//khyad par yar ngo'i bcu bzhi la//dur khrod chen po so sa gling //'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang du//zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas//ngo mtshar mthong snang sna tshogs byung //spyi gtsug dbyings rna/ bla ma gsal//'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma de//bcom ldan bde mchog dngos su mthong //yab yum sku yi dkyil 'khor la//theg mchog gsang sngags lha tshogs rnams//gang yang ma lus gsal bar mthong //

112 rje btsun mar pa'irnam tharagrub pa'i ngo mtsharabarjod pa/mi skyod nor bu yan chad la//dus gsum rgyal ba 'di 'dra mthong //zla ba phyed pa'i ngo bo la//bde mchog yab yum dkar dmar mthong //yab yum snyan mchog g.yas g.yon la//dpa' bo dpa' mo tshang bar mthong //skra smad stag gi sham thabs la/nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa//'gying bag 'jigs pa'i tshul mdzad cing //gad rgyangs ha ha sgrog pa mthong //lar mang po mthong ste brjod mi lang //rje sku drin can gyi sku drin lags//zhalan bka' bstsal 'diskadagasung //rin chen sems nyid ma rtogs tshe//mthong snang la blo gtad ma byed cig/grub thob thogs rdugs ma mchis pa'i//rnal 'byor pho mo snyan gson dang //thub pa'i gsung dang mi 'gal ba'i//mkhas pa paṇa chen snyan gson dang //'gyu ba dngas sangs ma gtogs pa'i//

rgyagar la 'byon theng gsum pa/ 113zab don logs na yod ma yin//'gyu ba dag yang yid yin la//yid kyang 'gyu ba yin par nges//gnyis ka rig pa'i ngo bo de//mnyam par bzhag na mya ngan 'das//ma rtogs dus su 'khor ba yin//gzhi rtsa chod na rdzogs 'tshang rgya//de rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams myong yin//khyed 'dir bzhugs thugs dgyes de la mdzod//lar bsams cing sku drin che ba'i phyir//dpal dz+nyā na sirnyi rjed thabs med//rgyud sde bzhi yi don snying gnad//rin chen rtsa rlung rang gi lus//'khor lo bzhi yi them bar du//rig pa'i rtsal chen de nyid kyis//ma yengs tsaṇ+ḍa'i me chen bus//de sgom pa'i gnad kyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun//byang chub sems mchog 'bab pa la//snying nas gnad du bsnun gyur na//rdo rje'i lus sems rtogs par nges//
