114 rjebatsun mar pa'i rnamathar grubapa'ingo mtshar brjod pa /ces gsungs pas/ de thams cad dad par gyur skad/ de'i tshe lha dang mkha' 'gros snyan par bsgrags pa'i phyir/ rgya bal thams cad tu dpal na ro pa spyod pa la gshegs nas bod kyi mar pa lo tsās mjal ste grub pa thob ces nyi zla ltar grags pas/ gar byon du ngo 'tshal ba rnams kyis phyag dang mchod pa rub rub tu byung skad/lan phyi ma 'di la rgya gar du lo mang du ma bzhugs par 'chad pa mang bar 'dug kyang / srin po rdo rje gdan du mchod pa byed pa 'di bya lo'i dus mchod la yong bar grags cing / tshur 'byon pa'i ge gā brgal ba de/ dusan ning gdug pa sprul gyi lo/ /zhes byung bas 'di la'ang lo brgyad dgu tsam bzhugs pa 'dra bar snang ngo //de nas bal por phebs/ : ther ba chos kyi spyan can de ni sku yal 'dug /berdzab la sogs pas sna len du tshogs cig bshams pa'i gral du maṇ+ḍapa'i zhal nas/ khyed dpon slob kyi thugs rje dang mos gus mtshungs pas mjal nges byas pa ltar mjal ba'i snyan pa ni shin tu che/ nga log nas gang gang du btsal/ gang du mjal/ ngo mtshar ba ci byung /gzhan bla ma ji lta bu bsten/ nged rnams kyi tshogs chung 'di lo tsā ba can skyesakyi dga' ston yin pas/ de rnams kyi glu zhig len dgos gsung bas/ bla ma dang mjal tshul ngo mtshar lta brgyad kyi mgur chen 'di/ yid gdung bas skyo ba gseng byed chos skyong gi gshugs glu'i skad la rta drangs nas bzhengs pa/dpal ka na ka shrīs dbu mdzad pa'i//'dir bzhugs gsan zhig mched grogs rnams//mi nga rang gang yin zer tsa na//mtshan snyan mar pa lo tsā yin//lte ba bod yul dbus su bcad//

rgya gar la 'byon thengasagasum pa/ 115sbyangs pa lho bal rgya ru byas//rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin//dus da res nan tan zhus tig byas//zhabs pad spyi bos reg mdzad cing //gsung don bdud rtsi'i rjes gnang ba'i//spyir chos 'brel pa tsam gyi bla ma mang //dpal sing gha gling pas sna drangs pa'i//mngon shes rig pa mnga' brnyes cing //snanga'ab 'a snangarwasdibs sdo mkhabazhugs//kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong bzhin//rje 'gran gyi do med na ro pa//rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can//rje khong gi drin la 'khor thabs med//pha yid la bcags so sprul pa'i sku//mi kho bos ma btsal sa phyogs med//zhal yang de mjal de ma mjal//ri mun pa can gyi nags 'dab tu//ngo mtshar shel gyi pha bong la//rgya yis 'bur du bkos pa bzhin//pha rje btsun gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes mthong //

116 rje ba' marapa'irnamathar grubapa'ingo mtshar brjod pa /lar ngo mtshar chen de che mod//shing tsan+dan sman gyi sdong po la//na ro'i thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gyi//dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu yi//yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas//aṣ+ṭa sngags kyi 'khor lo de//spu shad rtse mos bris 'dra las//'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pa yis//bdag la rjes su gnang ba mdzad//ngo mtshar che na de che mod//nga rang dbang med par mchi ma shor//ngu snying 'dod pa'i gdung sems skyes//rab tu ma bzod smre sngags bton//rtse gcig yid kyis gsol ba btab//thugs rjes gzigs nas mdun du byon//mthong lam lta bu'i dga' ba skyes//1du mtshar chen de che 31da//ngas dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye phul//nga ni de kun mi 'dod gsung //yang yang bskyar ste bzhes par sdokyis//

rgya garala'abyonathengasagasumapa / 117pha bla ma dkon mchog mchod cig gsung //ltos med nags kyi gseb tu gtor//kho bo 'phangs sems skyes pa las//khyod 'dod na slar yang yod to gsung //phyag thal sbyar snyim pa kha phye bas//ma god ma nyams snga ma bzhin//ngo mtshar che na de che mod//zhabs the bong sa la brdabs pa las//rdo dang bseg ma gser du gyur//thams cad gser gling yin no gsung //ngo mtshar che na de che mod//spyan lta stangs mkha' la gzigs pa yis//ltang dkar nya yi khog pa nas//tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa bshams//ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas byung //ngo mtshar che na de che mod//yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu mā/khrus byas srung 'khor khā tas khyer//lta stangs sdigs mdzub mdzad ma thag/khu ta rengs nas sa la lhung //

118 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/bar chad bdud las rgyal lo gsung //ngo mtshar chen de che mod//khyod 'di ru ma 'dug bod la song //ljongs byang phyogs kha ba can rgyud na//gdul bya snod ldan yod do ces//lung bstan rjes su gnang ba thob//ngo mtshar che nade che mod//sprulasku na ro paṇa chen la//ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lug brgyad//khyed rdo rje dpun rnams ma gtogs pa//khong gzhan la zlas na yid mi ches//da dus bstan pa'i rnyigs ma la//log rtog skye bo phra dog che//yon tan brjod na sgro skur 'debs//de phyir rang min gzhan rnams la//bka' mchid mi dpel gsang bar zhu//dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo bla ma rje//thugs dgyes par mdzod cig snying grogs rnams//ces gsungs pas kun ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /yang dge slong 'jigs med grags pa

rgya gar la'abyon thengasagasum pa/ 119sogs kyis spyi ther ba'i dus mchod tshes bcu'i mchod pa cig mdzad pa'i tshe/ khong na re/rje mi ba de lta ba ji ltar bzhed zer ba la/ lan gsungs pa/dpal ri khrod zhabs kyis byin brlabs cing //dgongs pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don//chos phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa//rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhabs la 'dud//grogs snying dang 'dra ba rdo rje'i dpun//'bral thabs med do mched lcam rnams//tha dad sdo/sa la sems rgyud gcig/dpal 'jigs med grags pa ma lags sam//nga rgya gar yul nas yong ba dang //khyed bal yul mthil du bzhugs pa gnyis//tshe 'du byed dbang du ma thal bar//kha sang de ring dus bzang la /mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i tshogs gral du//dus mtshungs zhal yang 'dzom pa de//dam tshig ngo lkog med par nges//mi kho bo shin tu spro ba skyes//khyed dga' ru tshor ram 'dir bzhugs rnams// nga blo rmongs bod kyi ban chung la//

120 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar bshe da pa/mi khyed kyis mtshan snyan lo tsār btags//khyod bod kyi sgra sgyur glu long zer//ngag 'dren pa'i gre 'gyur mi bde yang //khyod gong ma rnams kyi bka' ma chogs//rje na ro miX rnam gnyis la//sku drin rjes su dran pa'i glu//ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lugs yod//snyan lhan ne+e gson zhig mched grogs rnams//rje rnyogs pa can gyi miX pa//mi gleng gi snyan pa rgyang nas khums//sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yul//ljongs yangs pa can gyi ma ga dhar//sa skyong rgyal po'i cod pan gyis//zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru bsnyen mdzad cing //gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas rnams kyi//mnga' bdag gtsug gi rgyan yin zhes//snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur grags//cho 'phrul bya yi lo dus su//bde gshegs mchod pa mnga' mdzad phyir//mtshan mnga' bdag zhes byar yongs su grags//

rgyagar la 'byonatheng gsum pa/ 121rje sangs rgyas de yi zhal mnga' nas//theg pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don//chos phyag rgya che la ngo sprod bgyis//phyi gzung ba yul gyi snang ba 'di//bde ba chen por rgyun chad med//skye med chos kyi sku ru rtogs//nang 'dzin pa sems kyi rnam shes 'di//'gyu ba ngos gzung med pa'i phyir//rig pa rten med gcer bur mthong //spyir snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun//gdod nas ma grub skye ba med//ngo bo spros dang bral bar rtogs//'khor ba spang byar mi 'dod cing //mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub byar med//'khor 'das rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang //zung 'jug bde ba chen por rtogs//dus gasdo/ma sangs rgyas thugs phyung yang //mthar thug de las med do gsung //mi kho bo'i sgro 'dogs de nas chod//rje miX pa yi bzhed pa yin//
122 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngomatsharabarjod pa/khyed lta ba bzhed na de la mdzod//dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo dkon mchog gsum//ces gsungs/ thugs dgyes par mdzod cig gdan gang rnams//

rgya gar la 'byonathengasagasumapa/ 123(bkra shis byon skyems su phul ba'i mgur/)de nas me dza gling na bla ma mi mnyalardo rje zhes pa miX pa'i slob ma/ rje rang gi kṛ ya'i slob dpon zhig yod pa la phyag skyel du byon pas/ khong grogs po kha che'i lha gzo ba zhig gi gsang 'dus kyi dkyil thang gi rab gnas mdzad cing 'dug /de'i tshogs gral du khong rnams na re/ khyed kyis rjen ro ba ji tsalabarten/ chosagang mkhyen/ rtog pa ji lta bu 'tshod/ gsungs dang zer bas/ gsungs pa/rje grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs//nga mos pa'i bu yi lam sna drongs//lar mi nga la glu long mi rigs ste//khyed mched grogs gong ma'i gsung ma chogs//nga ni 'chi brod kyi dbyangs cig len//khyed gdan gang gi thugs la 'di bzhes la//chos tshul bzhin nyams su len pa zhu//nga bod kyi mar pa lo tsā dang //rgya gar gyi na ro paṇa chen gnyis//ljongs me tog brgyan pa'i grong khyer dang //ri bo gser gling gi dgon par mjal//de tshe rabs kyi smon lam dag pa 'dra//

124 rjebatsun mar pa 'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngo mtsharabarjod rī /gnas byin rlabs can du grags pa der//sku snyan pa can gyi rje bcun de//lo bcadrug zla ba bsnyen du brten//dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs lan bdun zhus//dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i byin rlabs mdzad//rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje gsungs//yi dam lhan cig skyes ma gnang //gdams ngag bskor tshe bskor tshe zhus//lam rtsa dang rlung la spar zin byas//sangs rgyas lag pa'i thil na gda'//dus lan gcig 'chi ba'i tshul ston ste//rnam smin gyi lus rgya grol ba'i tshe//'da' ka zab mo'i gdeng yod ste//bsre 'pho gnad kyis mtshams sbyar nas//dpa' bo dpa' mo'i bsu ma yod//rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas//bde chen mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro//dpa' na ro pa dang mjal bar nges//da ni 'chi yang nga re brod//khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi jo bo sngags pa kun//

rgya gar la'abyon thengasagasumapa / 125don snyan rgyud kyi ngo sprod mi mnga' bar//bshad rgyud tshig gi tha snyad la//tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas ma re mdzod//lar snying nas dam chos mdzad dgongs na//na ro dang mi trore rgyud pa zung //bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang //bde ba nas bde bar 'gro ste mchi//dbyangs snyan du byon nam 'dir bzhugs rnams//don 'khrul bar gda' na bzod par bzhes//ces gsungs pas/ spyir bla ma ji tsam bzhugs/ rje mi pa'i drung du ngo mtshar ci gzigs zer ba'i/ lanagasung pa/rje bram ze chen po'i gdung gsob pa'i//mtha' bral gnyug ma'i don rtogs phyir//dpe med na mkha'i rnal 'byor pa//mtshan mi ce byar 'ong su grags//pha rje btsun de yi bka' srol 'dzin//lam 'bral med sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa//mi nga rang mar ba lo tsā 'di//skye sa pham ste 'gro sa rgyal//rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin//

126 rje bas mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/lus srog la ma ltas dam chos btsal//rje sprul sku sangs rgyas rnams dang mjal//dbang gdams ngag bcas pa thugs la btags//dus da lan drin lan skyel du mchis//lar khyed la bla ma du yod gsung //chosasmon lam gyisa'abrelab bcagasum bzhugs//khyad par grub thob zhakhasalnga bzhugs//rje 'gran gyi do medarnamaganyisabazhugs//gtso bo paṇa chen na ro pa//de 'og rgyal sras miX pa//khong lhag par ma bas brtse ba'i phyir//yang yang yid la phreng nas kyang //shar chu bo ge gā'i 'gram du phyin//ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dgon pa sa/shing n+ya gro dha yi bsil grib la//rje mnga' bdag chen po bzhugs pa mthong //sa dang po lta bu'i dga' ba skyes//ḍā zhi mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul//bla ma mnyes pa'i maṇ+ḍal la//gu lo gser gyi me tog bkod//

rgya gar la 'byon thengasagasum pa / 127lus kyis thal sbyar brkyang phyag btsal//sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba btab//rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blangs dang //yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje zhus//don mthar thug phyag rgya chen po gnang //dpalaganyi'angamedaspu wa /rta pa//rje btsun de yis thugs rjes bzung //nang zab mo brda yi dbang bzhi bskur//rgyud yongs su dag par byin gyis brlabs//gzhi 'dun pa'i sa bon gting nas g.yos//nang rig pa sems kyi 'dug tshul de//'od gsal skye 'gag med pa'i phyir//ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo bstan//blo bur gyi rnam rtog dbyings su thim//zag med kyi bde ba nang nas shar//gdod nas dag pa kun gzhi'i rgyud//gzhi lam sku gasdo/ma gtan la phab//sems chos nyid ma dang zhal yang mjal//dus da res ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas//sgron shing mar me mdzub gang la//

128 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/zhag bdun bar du snang ba byung //bems por gyur pa'i ljon shing des//rab tu ma bzod g.yo 'gul byas//sprul pa'i ce cang dmar mo bdun//dngos su gtor ma len pa mthong //sa gsum gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams//gzugs med sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog/bar snang gang ba'i zhing skyong rnams//sna tshogs rol mo sgrog pa thos//bu skye ba gsum gyi 'og rol du//mchog gi dngos grub thob bo ces//rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhal nas thos//lar mi nga rang ngan ste bla ma bzang //chos lta ba'i yang rtse phu thag chod//lam grub mtha' dma' ba'i dogs ma mchis//de rje mi chen po'i bzhed ba lags//mi khyed kyi thugs dgyes de la mdzod//ces gsungs/ yang dur khrod ra ma do lir bla ma ye rang pa tshogs byed pa'i gral du spyan drangs/ rje na ro ba dang mjal tshul sogs khyed rangalhathangamadzad tshularnams gsungs dang zer ba'i/ lan du gsung ba/

rgya gar la 'byon theng gsum pa/ 129rje gong ma rnams kyis byin brlabs pa//bod kyi sgra bsgyur lo tsā nga //skyes pa mon bod mtshams su skyes//las 'phro mang mkhar phyogs su sad//sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la//sgra thang klog skad kyi mig tshangs bslabs//dam chos rgya gar yul nas btsal//rkang pa rlung gi lubor lo 'dis//yongs pa bod kyi yul nas 'ongs//khong sangs rgyas na ro paṇa chen dang //nga bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā gnyis//sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su mjal//dbang yongs su rdzogs pa lan bdun zhus//lar na bla ma bcu gsum la//na ro mi tri nyi zla 'dra//gtso bor na ro paṇa chen bzhugs//ngo mtshar che ba 'di 'dra mthong //shing tsan+dan sman gyi sdong po la//dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang //yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas//

130 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam tharagrub pa 'ingomatsharabarjod pa /aṣ+ṭa sngags kyi 'khor lo mthong //ltang dkar nya yi khog pa nas//ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas dang //rang byung longs spyod rdzogs sku mthong //nang sems nyid chos kyi sku ru mthong //phyi snang ba sprul pa'i sku ru mthong //sangs rgyas na ro'i sprul pa de//bar snang kun la gshegs pa mthong //rang byung shel gyi pha bong la//na ro gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes mthong //ngo mtshar de las che ba med//mnga' bdag rgyal zabangami pa//nags su dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe//dur khrod rgyu ba'i ce cang rnams//dngos su gtor ma len pa mthong //sa gab/ma gnas pa'i ḍā ki rnams//dngos su mdzad spyod byed pa mthong //phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di//g.yo med na mkha'i khyim du tshud//bag chags rmi lam snang ba de//

rgya garal 'byon thengasagasumapa/ 131'od gsal ngang du yal ste thal//sgron shing mar me mdzub gang la//zhag bdun bar du snang ba byung //lam 'bral med sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ba//miX chen po'i zhabs la reg/nga bram ze chen po'i rgyud pa 'dzin//ngo mtshar che ba de 'dra mthong //bdag gi rtogs pa bshad na yang //khyed 'ga'i thugs la mi shong ste//zur tsam bshad na 'di ltar gda'//'od gsal gdeng dang ldan lags pas//lta ba la phyogs ris med do ang //sgom rgyun chad med pa chu po'i gzhung //thun bzhir sgom du mi snang ba//tshul chos rtog pa bor ba yis//mnyam rjes rtog pa mi 'dug gi//rlung sems gnyis la dbang thob pas//'khor ba'i 'jigs pa yal nas thal//de rnams bdag gi rtogs pa lags//ces gsungs pas/ grub thob tu yid ches par gyur ste dad pa thob bo/ /de nas ce

132 rje bas mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'ingo mtsharabarjodapa /cang gi skad dang 'ur sgra zhig byung bas khong rnams tshogs myur du gyis/ dur khrod 'di gnyan pas bar chad 'ong zer bas/ nga'i bla ma na ro mi tram̐ sogs yin na gang gnyan pa la tshogs kyi gnas mchog tu byed/ sha za'i mkha' 'gro rnams gral la mi bzhin du bsgrigs yong ba la 'jigs pa med pa yin ste/ 'di kun dud 'gro'i rang skad dang / 'byung ba'i rang sgra la'ang 'jigs par 'dug /'di kun bal po'i grag shos yin pa la 'di 'dra na bod na lta ci smos snyam nas tshur 'ongs pa la 'gyod pa chen po skyes/ slar rgya gar la 'byon par thag bcad pa'i tho rengs rmi lam du bud med shing lo'i gos gyon pa des spyi bor phyag bzhag nas/ da khyod bod tu 'gro don che bas bla mas lung bstan pa bzhin bod tu song zhig /skal ldan gyi gdul bya yod cing bar chad mi 'byung ngo gsung /sad pa dang bla ma'i pho nyar mkhyen ste thugs spro bar gyur/ bal yul rin chen chul gyi gtsug lag khang na bla ma meṇ+ḍa pa la ral gcig ma dang bdag med ma bdud rtsi 'od kyi lugs sogs du ma gsan tshe nub gcig rje mi tre pa seng ge la chibs nas na mkha' la gshegs/ 'o dod bos gsol ba btab pas/ dpes mtshon pa'i brda bstan/ dpe dang bral ba'i chos gsungs/ mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs/ sngon chad ma skyes pa'i nyams skyes pa gcig barmis/ sad nas spyan chab mang du byung zhing gsol ba btab/ de'i phyi nub chos thon pa'i btang rag dang / mi tram̐ pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshogs mchod gcig bshams pa'i gral du bla ma'i gsung gis bskul ste/ mtshan ltabasasgromabasapa'i mgur chen yid bying bgaseng ba chu lcagazel ba can gyi skad la rta drangs nas gsungs pa/rje snying po'i don rtogs chos kyi sku//mtshan yongs su grags pa'i miX pa//khong bsams cing sku drin che ba'i phyir//

rgya garal 'byonathengasagasum pa/ 133mi kho bo'i yid la shin tu bcags//nga rtse gcig gdung ba rgyun mi 'chad//pha byin gyis rlobs cig sprul pa'i sku//khyed 'dren pa'i bla ma sku drin can//dpal perdzab yis dbu mdzad nas//khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi rnal 'byor pho mo rnams//glu 'di la dar cig snyan gsan mdzod//dbyangs 'di la mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs chags//nga mar ston chosakyi blo gros 'di//tshe sdo/ma cha rgya gar sdo/la du bskyal//lo bzhi bcu'i bar du thos bsam byas//dus na snang gdug pa sprul gyi lo//cho 'phrul rta yi zla ba la//mi kho bos lam la zhugs nas mchis//chu 'jigs su rung ba'i ge gā brgal//rigs ngan shi skyid kyi jag pa gnyis//chu la nya ltar 'dzul zhing byung //thang la rta ltar rgyug zhing byung //tshe snga phyi dran pa'i dngangs skrag myo nga //

134 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/pha rje btsun spyi bor bsgoms pa las//khong yang yang lta zhing 61ga nas thal//srog chu nas bton no sku drin can//pha khyed kyi drin la 'khor thabs med//dus kha sang zla ba snga ma yi//khyad par yar ngo'i tshes bcu la//dur khrod ra ma do li der//bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul//mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs 'khor bskor//khong der tshogs kyi rnal 'byor mthong ba'i tshe/rje na ro mai tram̐ tur gyis dran//thugs brtse bas 'bral med bskyangs pa'i phyir//pha'i mdzad spyod bsams cing yid la dran//sems gdung bas ma bzod mchi ma rbe/ra//slar rgya gar yul du ldog gam bsam//nam tho rangs tham thum rmi lam na//gos shing lo gyon pa'i bud med cig/phyag g.yas pa brkyang mdzad sor mo rnams//mi kho bo'i mgo la reg mdzad ste//khyod rgya gar yul du ma ldog par//

rgya gar la'abyon theng gsumapa / 135slar bod yul dbus su song zhig gsung //ljongs kha ba can du ma phyin bar//phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung zhing //gdul bya snod ldan yod do zhes//lung bstan byin gyis brlab pa mdzad//de zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro yin par nges//de yang rje btsun khyed kyi drin//mdang bag chags gnyid kyi rmi lam na//rje mnga' bdag rgyal sras miX pa//khong seng ge chibs nas mkha' la gshegs//mi kho bo'i mdun du byon nas kyang //skye med mtshon pa'i bde gsum bstan//yi ge med pa'i chos cig gsungs//brjod tu med pa'i don zhig rtogs//sngon chad med pa'i nyams cig shar//nam nangs gnyid de sad tsa na//rje yang yang dran no miX pa//mi kho bo'i mig sngar 'bral ma phod//gdong mchi mas gang ba'i ngu 'bod shor//dbugs kha nas ma thon byang khog brgyangs//

136 rje btsun mar pa 'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngomacharabarjod pa/pha snying la 'dod do skom chu ltar//mi kho po'i gdung sems mkhyen lags sam//pha yis lam sna drongs cig sprul pa'i sku//lar rmi lam bag chags yin mod kyang //pha rje btsun byon pa ngo mtshar che//sems dga' la mi dga' mtho dman byung //khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi snyan du zhus pa lags//ces gsungs pas/ 'esgrub bla ma la ji ltar mthong ba bzhin yon tan 'byung tshul ston pa dang / mtshan lta de dag dri ba'i phyir/ lanagasupasapa/grogs snying dang 'dra ba'i lo tsā ba//bu khyed la dad pa gting nas yod//gzhi rang dbang thob pa'i 'dun pa yod//yid lhag par brtse ba'i snying rje yod//rgyud yongs su dag pa'i sems bskyed yod//rigs khyad par can gyi skyes bu khyed//྅༷na chad bla ma ma brnyas pas//da ltar grub thob dngos dang mjal//de yang grogs po nga yi drin//byas pa drin gzo yod pa'i phyir//mi nga yang gtsug gi nor bur mthong //

rgyagar la 'byon thengs gsumapa/ 137bu byas pa shes pa ngo mtshar che//gsang sngags rgyal po mchog gi lam//bgrod pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa//lhag pa'i dam tshig khyed la yod//lha dang mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing //bla ma'i man ngag snying la zhugs//dus 'dir bde ba thob par rigs//dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma rje//sprul sku mchog gi rje btsun la//na mkha' lta bur ngo shes na//skye ba med pa'i don rtogs 'gyur//nyi ma lta bur ngo shes na//bdal ba'i snying rje chen po 'byung //zla ba lta bur ngo shes na//nyon mongs gdung ba sel bar byed//rgya mtsho lta bur ngo shes na//mi g.yo mchog gi ting 'dzin bsnyes//nor bu lta bur ngo shes na//dgos 'dod re ba lhun gyis grub//

138 rje btsun mar pa 'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjodapa/ded dpon lta bur ngo shes na//thar pa'i rin chen gling du skyel//dmag dpon lta bur ngo shes na//log lta dgra yi g.yul ngo 'joms//ral gri lta bur ngo shes na//dngos 'dzin 'ching ba gcod par byed//'khor lo lta bur ngo shes na//mtha' la mi gnas don rtogs 'gyur//seng ge lta bur ngo shes na//gzung 'dzin ri dwags zil gyis gnon//rgyal po lta bur ngo shes na//kun gyis mchod cing bkur bar byed//rigs ldan khyed kyis gang mthong ba//drin can pha ltar ngo shes pas//chos kyi rgyarme srid rgyun mi 'chad//bu khyod kyi bag chags rmi lam na//rje mnga' bdag chen po byon nas kyang //skye med mtshon pa'i brda bstan zhing //yi ge med pa'i chos gsungs pas//mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs nas//

rgya gar la 'byon thengasagasumapa/ 139sngar ma skyes pa yi nyams shar ba//de don gang lags smra bar rigs//ce gsung ba na man lam du byung ba'i rtog ba bul ba/rje brtul zhugs spyod pa'i meṇ+ḍapa//mtshan lha yis lung bstan ngo mtshar che//dpal gnyis med rol pa'i phyag 'og na//sems tha dad med pa'i rdo rje dpun//shrī gu ṇa ma tis dbu mdzad pa'i//gral g.yas na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo gsan//de 'og sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma//lcam su kha badzis dbu mdzad pa'i//gral g.yon na bzhugs pa'i dpa' mo gsan//spyir chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma ste//rmi lam sgyu ma khyad par 'phags//nam srod la bag chags rmi lam 'byung //de la bzang btad ci yang med//nam gung bdud kyi cho 'phrul ston//de la yid brtan byar mi rung //tho rengs lha yis lung ston pa//che na ngo mtshar de che mod//

140 rje btsunamar pa 'i rnamathar grubapa 'irngamatshar brjodapa /dgung da nang skya rengs shar ba la//rje mnga' bdag chen po byon nas kyang //mthar thug ston pa'i chos gsungs pa//de ma rjed dran pa 'di ltar gda'//spyir chos rnams thams cad sems nyid ste//rang sems nyid las bla ma byung //sems las gud na gzhan med pas//cir snang thams cad sems kyi ngang //de yang gdod nas ma grub pa//ma skyes ga〈snan ma'i gnas sdo/gas 'a/sa//rnam rtog rtsol bas spang du med//ma bcings rang so lhug par zhog/de nyid brda yis mtshon pa'i phyir//mi ro gdol pa khyi dang phag/bu chung spyon pa glang chen dang //nor bu rin chen ut+pa la//dngul chu ri dwags seng ge dang //bram ze spos mthong ngam gsung //brda yis mtshon pa'i don rtogs pa//'khor 'das gnyis su mi 'dzin zhing //

rgya gar la'abyonathengasagasum pa / 141spang blang rgyud la mi sbyor ba//gzhan nas 'bras bu mi re zhing //yid la byar med spros dang bral//mtha' bzhi dag du lhung ba med//sgom du med cing yengs su med//dran du med cing brjed du'ang med//gang gis kyang ni mtshon du med//bla ma'i drin gyis de ltar rtogs//de don rtogs pa'i nyams shar ba//sems dang sems byung 'gags pa yi//dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med ste//skyon dang yon tan skye 'bri med//bde stong gsal la ma 'gags pa//'od gsal 'gro 'ong med par shar//gnyug ma ngo sprod lta ba'i gnad//skye med mtshon pa'i brda don rnams//rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhal nas thos//ngag brjod pa glu ru mi blang du//rje gong du bka' nan ches pa dang //mched grogs rnams kyi zhal ma snamags//mkha' 'gro ko long mi mdzad zhu//

142 rje btsun marapa'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngomatshar brjod pa/zhes phul bas bla ma mnyes/ de'i tshe mar ba masgo legazangakyis rgya bal na bzhugs kyang bla ma gsur 'gro snyam nas byon pas/ skyi rong gi nye lam ma ma bya ba'i grong dgon du mjal nas phyags phyi byas/mang yul glang po mkhar du mar pa phyug po cig gis chos 'khor zla gcig btsugs/la stod tu zur ban gtsug tor gyis zhabs nas bteg zhing bur gsal skyid ces bya ba mtshan ldan zhig phul ste jo mor bzhes/ ston pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsnyen bskur/ rnal ༷byor ma zhig la rlung sems gnyis med gnang bas lus 'dis mkha' spyod grub pa ga // /tshon po yod 'bul 'bul chen lan gsum byas pa'i/ dang po la rong bdo'i gnas gzhir rtsa brgyad kyi mchod rten re la khrab rmog re g.yogs/ g.yu re btags/bar du ral gri re bzhag /lcags ri'i nang thams cad nor sna sna tshogs pas bkang ste phul bas/ rten 'brel 'dis khyod kyi mi rgyud dmag dpon du 'gyur ba 'dug gsung ste/deng sang gtsang thob rgyal ba rnams yin par 'dod par snang / bar ba la rtsa brgyad re la gos ber re bkon/ nang nor sna sna bkang ba'i bar gyi gtso bo na mthong ba 'dzum shor yin par grags snang / de'i tshe glamaramabangalabastod ba'i mgur zhus pa la/ gsungs pa/rje mi skyod bde ba chen po'i sku//rdo rje mkha' 'gros mnyam sbyor ba// dpa' bo rnamasakyi gtsor gyur pa'i//lha ru kodab rgyag 'tshal bstod//bka'i gsang sngags ma lus bsdud pa po//gsang ba'i bdag po nyid dang ni//

rgya garal 'byonathengasagasumapa/ 143dam chos mi yul rgyas mdzad pa'i//rje sgrub bab grasarnamasal bstod//mi bzad rdo rje'i lte 'bab pa//'jigs las skyob pa'i thugs rje can//rnal 'byor dbang byug te lo pa//mchogashadangosagrub brnyesal bstod//bcu gnyis dka' spyad bla ma bsten//sde snod rgyud sde ma lus pa//skad cig nyid la thugs su chud//rje sang rgya migakhug khyod la bstod//mi phyed phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs//ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo 'chang //spros bral bde ba'i don rtogs pa//rje rgyal zas ༷'i zhabasal bstod//bstan pa bka' yi rgyud pa 'chang //gsang 'dus zab mo'i dngos grub brnyes//mkhyen pa thugs rjer ldan pa yi//ye shesasnying po'i zhabasal bstod//dur khrod dgon dang shing drung na//

144 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa 'ingomatshar brjodapa /ro bcud gsol ba'i ku sa li//mkha' la gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul can//caku ri ba'i sku la bstod//phun sum tshogs pa'i don rtogs pas//zla ba 'od kyi bcud dang ldan//mthong ba'i bde bas tshim mdzad pa//rnal 'phyor ma yi sku la bstod//gser gyi cod pan rab mdzes pa'i//gdugs mchog gsil na bzhugs pa yi//kha gdan nyi zla mnga' brnyes pa'i//rje btsun bal po'i sku la bstod//'jig rten gzung 'dzin 'khri ba chod//bla ma bsten pa'i phan yon can//byang chub sgrub la gtsor ldan pa'i//theg chen slob gnyer mgo 'don dang //gegs dang log 'dren bar chad sel//bla ma bzang dang sprod pa'i grogs//'dren pa'ithu(ba dponarnamasal bstod//bla ma bstod pa'i phan yon ni//dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod dang mtshungs//

rgyagar la'abyonatheng gsum pa/ 145slob dpon bstod pa'i phan yon des//'gro kun bshes gnyen bsten par shog /zhes gsungs/lho brag tu man thang ba'i dge 'dun gyis gsu ba dang sna len byas/ ba rang lha ba can gyis chos 'khor btsugs/ gdan sar phebs tshe bu slob du mas byon legs kyi dga' ston du tshogs 'khor bshams nas/ mgo legs kyis bla ma dang mjal tshul sogs gsung bar zhus pas/ bla ma'i mdzad spyod dzu'agrul yonatan gyi mgur chen snang ba la gyisaganon ba dpa' bo snang bsgyur ba'i skad la rta drangs nas gsungs pa/rje sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yul//ljongs yangs pa can gyi ma ga dhar//mu stegs rgol ba tshar bcad ste//sgo srung chen por mnga' gsol ba//rje na ro zhesabyar grag pa yi//pha sprul sku de yi zhabasal 'dud//shar khri sgo brtsegs pa'i pho brang na//rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje la//mi nga rang lta rtog byed pa'i tshe//sems cig ma bde yid cig 'phyo//sems gzhu ltar bkug yang mda' ltar shor//paṇa chen na ro tur gyis dran//gdung ba'i sems la bzod glags med//

146 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/sa mtha' nags la ཿṭāl du phyin//rgyus med rigs ngan grong du tshud//rgyal po dregs pas btson du bzung //dpal me tog spungs pa'i pho brang du//zhag gsum rgyal po'i mchod gnas byas//'bar ba'i sbyin sreg thab khung du//ci 'dod bza' btung 'byung ba mthong //che na ngo mtsharade che snyam//yang cig bskyar nas tshol du phyin//'bras dkar mo bre gsum rgyags su khyer//ltang dkar nya la bya na byas//rje brtul zhugs spyod pa'i pe'o pa//sa mkhan lam gyi grogs su khrid//zla phyed bar du phyogs bzhi bskor//dur khrod nags tshal khyab par myul//der yang rje btsun cung ma rnyed//paṇa chen na ro ma rnyed kyang //ngo mtshar cheba'i lta rnamasamathong //shing tsan+dan sman gyi sdong po la//dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu rnams//

rgya garal 'byon theng gsum pa/ 147cung zad ma reg reg la khad//'ja' yi gur phub lta bur mthong //ltad mngo mtsharade che mod//yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas//aṣ+ṭa sngags kyi 'khor lo de//me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin//phyi sku yis ma sgribs gsal bar mthong //ltad mngo mtsharade che yod//shin du sra 'khregs rdo rje'i brag/dkar gong shel gyi pha bong la//rje na ro gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes de//spu shad ri mo rdzogs par mthong //ltad mongo mtsharade che mod//da ni ring por mi thogs snyam//zhag bdun bar du gsol ba btab//pha gzhan rig mngon mkhyen mnga' ba'i phyir//de nas rje btsun dngos su byon//rab tu dga' ches ngu 'bod shor//dman pas zhabs thil gtsug du blangs//thugs rje chung zhes smre sngags bton//

/48 rjebatsun mar pa 'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngomatsharabarjodapa /gdung ba'i mchi ma khrag ltar zags//ltad mo ngo mtshar de che mod//lus btsun mo lta bur sku la 'gyud//thugs la snying btad dpral ba btugs//dus der dbang rdzogs sems la bskur//chos rdzogs thugs kyi nying khu phyung //ltad mo ngo mtshar de che mod//lar rgya gar gyi na ro paṇa chen dang //nga bod kyi mar ston blo gros gnyis//sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis su mjal//grub thob mi 'byung gi dogs ma mchis//ltad mo ngo mtshar de che mod//bu snying dang 'dra ba'i dam tshig can//dus gzhi snang rgya gar du 'gro ba'i tshe//longs spyod 'byor bas phongs dus su//rin cherno gser gyis yol mo bkang //gtam grags su rung bas ngo mtshar che//khyod longs spyod 'phangs sems med pa'i phyir//gos dang lham gyis mjug bsdus nas//ci 'dod thams cad rdzongs su btab//

tshe phyi ma'i rgyags phye gter du sbas//de phyir bsams cing ngo mtshar che//bu pha las lhag pa'i gdung sems can//khyod mar pa mgo legs ma lags sam//nor sgyu ma gtong ba smos ci dgos//srog 'phangs pa med pa khyod kyi lugs//ngo mtshar de las che thabs med//dus da res mdun nas gsu ba de//lam bshul thag ring bas ga la rjed//lho kha nag bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams//dgun lo sar sgang la me tog skye//'bras dkar swā li 'debs pa'i sa//mon skad rigs mi gcig yul khams su//nad 'tsho bar dka' ba'i tshad pa la//shi tshad kyis mi 'jigs srog la bdos//bu dka' ba'i dam tshig srung ba'i phyir//pha ngas kyang ma rjed sems la 'jog/dus 'di la mi 'bral a cang che//tshe phyi ma mi mjal thabs med pas//yi dam mkha' 'gro'i spyan lam du//

150 rje btsun marapa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtsharabarjod pa/'o skol pha bus smon lam btab//nga byas pa drin du gzo ba'i phyir//glu de kun khyod kyi ngo ru blangs//khong gzhan la ma sgrog gsang bar zhu//drin lan gyi chos skyes da gzod ster//snying gtam yod pa khad kyis bzlo//'o skol sngon la 'phrad pa grogs kyi mchog/nga ma shi bar du 'grog par bya//zhes gsungs nas/ snying gtam zhigabod ba khad kyi bsgo/ /gsung ba'i don mgo legs la thugs rgyud gdams skor bco lnga gnang / 'on kyang 'di dpel ba'i dus la ma bab ces gter du bzhag /na ro'i thugs dam dang miX pa'i sor gdub gnang nas yab sras 'bral med kyi bka' bsgos cing / de phyin sku dang grib ma ltar zham ring bgyis so//de nas rngog mtshur sogs bu slob mtha' yas 'dus ste tshogs gral du chos phyir dka' ba spyad tshul ston pa/ 'phro rgod 'thor ba sdud pa'i mgur chen rig pa sems kyi lcags kyu mkha' 'a11re smre sngags la rta drangs nas gsungs pa/rje mi skyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang //mi kho bo'i spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs//mi bdag gi dka' las kyi dpe bshad na//khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi jo bo ston chen rnams//chos sla bar ma dgongs tshul bzhin sgrubs//

rgya gar la 'byon thengasagasumapa/ 151kho bo mar pa lo tsā 'di//skyes pa lho brag thil du skyes//las 'phro dkar po'i chos la sad//dpal myu gu lung gi dgon pa der//sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la//sgra thang klog skad kyi yig tshangs bslabs//khong sku drin mi chung che bar khums//dam chos rgya gar yul nas btsal//bdag bal po'i lam du zhugs tsa na//bca' 'phrang dang chu la thar dus med//nags mthug po cig la thon dus med//lam ring po cig la bgrod dus med//shing sdong po mi ro rengs pa 'dra//lam de kun gyi sdug bsngal mthong tsa na//bya dgung la 'phur ba gshog pa 'dar//'on kyang ngal dub bya rin chog/yul lha las babs pa'i bal po mthong //phyi 'dod yon lta bas chog mi shes//mi 'dod khams kyi lha phran yin no snyam//dus bskal pa bzang por 'dug go snyam//

152 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam tharagrub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjod pa /lam bgrod par dka' yang phyin pas 'tshengs//nga de nas rgya gar du phyin tsa na//mtha' 'khob kyi jag pa shi skyid la//srog ci bder thon pa'i re ma mchis//gcan zan gyi ngar skad thos tsa na//lus gtsang sar thon pa cung ma bsam//sprul sbram chen gyi kha rlangs mthong ba'i tshe//yid brtan par phyin yang gom tshugs 'khyor//lam de kun gyi 'jigs pa mthong ba'i tshe//dus da lta dran yang glo snying 'dar//chu grags pa can gyi ge gā brgal//'on kyang dka' ba spyad rin chog/yul dbus gyur tshal gyi bkod pa mthong //dpal rdo rje gdan gyis sna drangs pa'i//rten ngo mtshar can la mchod pa byas//kho bo phyin pa 'phyis so snyam//chos snying nas tshol ba'i gdung sems kyis//yul rgya gar shar nub chu bzhin myul//thang chen po cig la chod dus med//me 'obs kyi thang la phyin to snyam//

rgya gar la 'byon theng gsum pa/ 153yid chos la bsams kyang snying rlung 'phyo//nad 'tsho bar dka' ba'i tshad pas thebs//do shi do chad bcu gsum byung //kha chems tshig gsum bzhag sa med//dbugs 'gyu ba chad pa lan gsum myong //dus de kun gyi sdug bsngal mthong tsa na//sdang dgra yi mig nas mchi ma 'chor//'on kyang srog bdos bya rin chog/rje na ro paṇa chen gyis sna drangs pa'i//bla ma grub thob lnga dang mjal//spyir rgyud sde bzhi la nyan bshad byas//khyad par ma rgyud mtha' dag dang //pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa bslabs//shar chu bo ge gā'i 'gram du phyin//rje miX pa yi byin rlabs kyis//gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs//sems stong pa nyid la spar zin byas//don spros bral gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong //sku gsum ma dang dngos su mjal//mi kho bo'i spros pa de nas chod//

154 rjebatsun marapa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/slar bod yul dbus su log tsa na//gdams ngag yang nga rang che'o snyam//grub thob kyang 'ga' re 'byung ngo snyam//'gro don yang mang po 'grub bo snyam//de kun kho bo'i zhe gdeng lags//dka' ba spyad pa'i spyad lugs lags//chos de tsam du dka' bar thugs dgongs la//le lo ma mdzad sgrub par zhu/ /zhes gsungs/yang mes rngog mtshur sogs bu chen du ma 'dzom tshe/ me ston gyis tshogs kyi sbyin bdag byas nas/ tshogs 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgya gar du ji ltar mdzad pa lta bu zhig zhus pas/ zhu sa'angang bzang / zhub po'ang khyedarnam bzang / gsung nas brdasa'adu ba sogs ma rgyud kyi tshogs 'khor ji lta ba mdzad/ byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / rgya gar du tshogs 'khor ji ltar gzigs pa zhus pas/ tshogasamaguragasungs pa/tshogs kyi 'khor lo skad pa de//smin lam dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshe//tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin//rab tu gnas pa byed pa'i tshe//tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin//mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i tshe//tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin//

rgya gar la 'byon thengasagasum pa/ 155rgyud sde'i nyan bshad byed pa'i tshe//tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin//gdams ngag zab mo zhu ba'i tshe//tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin//kho bo mar pa lo tsā 'dis//rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin//spyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bsam mi khyab//dgos ngo mtshar che ba 'di 'dra mthong //rje btsun na ro paṇa chen la//rje rigs kyi ded dpon 'bor lo dang //chang 'tshong gi bu mo kuṇ+ḍa lis//rin chen 'khor ba'i maṇ+ḍal la//kurgya pa ṇa'i rgyan bkod phul//lo gcig gong nas gsol ba btab//rje na ro chen pos zhal gyis bzhes//seng ldeng nags kyi dur khrod tu//tshogs khang rim pa gsum du bskor//longs spyod 'byor pa dpag med pas//tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen bshams//dpal ldan na ro'i byin rlabs kyis//

156 rje btsunamar pa'irnam tharagrub pa'ingo mtsharabarjodapa /dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang //grangs mnyam gsang sngags rnal 'dresar pa//pho mo drug cu rtsa gnyis tshogs//zab mo brda dang skad kyis 'dri//rje na ro paṇa chen thugs ka nas//bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams//dkyil 'khor dbus su legs par bzhugs//cho ga'i rim pa rgyas par mdzad//rje btsun na ro chen po des//rdo rje dril bu phyag du bsnams//rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol//khru gang tshad kyi na mkha' la//g.yas brkyang gar gyi rol pas bzhugs//rnal 'byor pho mo gzhan rnams kyang //phyag g.yas ḍa ma ru 'khrol zhing //g.yon pa ting ting shag bsnams nas//gar gyi nyams kyis rol ba mthong /kho po mar ba 'o tsā ngas//lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku//zab mo dbang bzhi'i ngo bo mthong //

rgya gar la'abyonathengasagasumapa/ 157nga de 'dra'i rje dang mjal ba yin//tshogs 'khor de 'dra mthong ba yin//phal dang phal gyi chos ma yin//de ngo mtshar che'am gtsang ston pa/ /ces gsungs/yang rgyang ro shad ston gyis g.yu gser srang drug cu ri ba phul nas/ bar do'i gdamasapa ṭa/sa pa la/ gasdo/ngas pa/khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can dang //mya ngan 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis//dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs gcig/lta ba'i bar do de la mdzod//sna tshogs 'char ba'i dkar dmar dang //brjod tu med pa'i rang sems gnyis//gnyis med lhan cig skyes par gcig/spyod pa'i bar do de la mdzod//mdang gsum rmi lam bag chags dang //sad nas rdzun du shes pa gnyis//sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du gcig/rmi lam bar do de la mdzod//ma dag phung po rnam lnga dang //

158 rje btsun marapa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/dag pa'i phung po rigs lnga gnyis//mi rtog rdzogs rim ngang du gcig/skyed rdzogasakyi bar do de la mdzod//thabs las byung ba'i pha rgyud dang //shes rab las byung ma rgyud gnyis//gnyug ma lhan cig skyes par gcig/gdamasangag bar do de la mdzod//rang don chos sku skye med dang //gzhan don gzugs sku sna tshogs gnyis//gnyis med gnyug ma'i ngang du gcig/sgrogasum gyi bar do de la mdzod//ma dag sgyu lus mngal sgo dang //dag pa lha yi phung po gnyis//bar do 'od gsal ngang du gcig/'brasabu'i bar do de la mdzod//skye shiganyisagyi b.rado la//rnam rtog gi snang ba ci shar yang //gzhan snang ma yin rang snang yin//snang ba rang bzhin med pa la//'khrul pa cig byung na log non thong //

rgyagar la 'byon theng gsumapa/ 159log non rang gi sems la ltos//bltas pas dngos med rang sar grol//mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che//don ma nor gyi lam sna chos la drongs//mdang rmi lamaganyid gyibarado la//bag chags kyi snang ba ci shar yang //gzhan snang ma yin rang snang yin//snang la rang bzhin med pa la//'khrul pa byung na log non thong //log non du rang gi sems la ltos//bltas pas dngos med rang sar grol//sgom brtang 'dzin gyi bar do la//bying rgod kyi snang ba ci shar yang //gzhan snang ma yin rang snang yin//snang la rang bzhin med pa la//'khrul pa byung na log non thong //log non du rang gi sems la ltos//bltas pas dngos med rang sar grol//lu bem rig bralaba'i bar do la//zug gzer gyi snang ba ci shar yang //

160 rjebs mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingomatsharabarjodapa/gzhan snang ma yin rang snang yin//snang la rang bzhin med pa la//'khrul pa byung na log non thong //log non du rang gi sems la stos//bltas pas dngos med rang sar grol//'di bar do drugagi mgur zhes mi la'i mgur sogs su bris pa 'dug rung / rnam rtog gi snang ba ci shar yang / /man chad mi mtshungs par 'dug pas bris so/ /dad pa dgyi ba'i g.yer po che/ /sogs rje 'di'i gsung mgur yin par bris pa gcig gnyis snang rung / rtsom rigs mi mtshungs pas gsung mgur dngos min par snang ngo //

161(gan+da/ma pa gdams ngag n+da/gas nyams n+da bzhes pa thugs la 'tshogangs tshul ni/)de'i tshe dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha mo dgu po ni mi'i bud med yon tan dang ldan par bstan ste jo mo'i tshul du snang ste/ phyag thung ma dang / gsal skyid dang / dar skyid dang / snye mo bzang mo dang / pad+ma mdzes la sogs pa yin la/ gtso mo rdo rje bdag med ma nyid ni ltam bu lhung bza' ho re zhes bya ba yum bdag med ma nyid ste thams cad kyang rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rigs ldan ma'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kho na'o//nam zhig bdag med mas kho mo cag rnams bla ma dang mjal phyin chad 'jig rten 'di'i rnam par rtog pa mi 'gyu zhing / rang byung gi ye shes lhug par 'char ba kho na byung ste/bla ma'i thugs rje lags mchi zhus pas/ de lta bu 'ong ba yin/ khyod rang yo byad shoms dang tshogs 'khor zhig bya'o gsung /phud cung zad tsam dang nya skam po 'ga' zhig las med/ 'phyis pas gzhan du tshol yang mi thub/ sang dgyi na zhus pas/ de gas yong bas da lta rang gyis gsung / en zhig 'thogs pas 'phyis gsung yang bka' ma bkyon/ de ma thag chang gi rgyun dri ro dpe med pa byung / sngon ma mthong ma thos pa'i bza' btung mchod rdzas sna tshogs pas nang thams cad gang / spos kyi dri zhim po dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / lha mo'i glu dbyangs shin tu snyan pas bar snang gang / me tog dang mar me'i phreng bas sa gzhi khyab par byung / de'i mod la bla ma chen po nyid dgyes pa'i rdo rje dngos su bzhengs pa'i 'od kyis yul dang khang pa yang gzhalha ༵ ༵༵༵ nā sdiwa/ reg pa'i mod la rdzo mo nyid yum bdag med ma dngos su gyur/

162 rjebatsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/gzhan rnams go ri sogs lha mo brgyad tu gyur ste phyogs mtshams su 'khod/ phyogs bcu nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rgya mtsho lta bu 'dus ste tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad/ lo zla dpag tu med pa'i nyams byung / tho rangs su gyur pa na sku'i bkod pa bsdus ste tha mal gyi rnam par bzhugs ste jo mo khyed rnams rgyud drang zhing g.yo sgyu chung bar 'dug /khyed rnams zer ba ltar 'ong rigs pa yin ste/ kho bo la gsang sngags rgyud sde'i snying po dpal na ro pa'i dgongs pa ma sgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag las kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bya ba yod de/ 'on kyang rje btsun na ro pa chen pos/ rig rgyud na mkha'i me rtag mal/ /gsung ba de khyed rnams la thugs rjes gzigs pa'i gsung du 'dug /zab mo rnam pa bdun dang mi ldan na shin tu nyes pa che bar yang bshad/ 'on kyang 'jig rten pa bzhug pa'i phyir kho bos rigs rgyud kyang bzhag pa yin/spyir gsang sngags 'di zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gnad phul du phyin pa dang ldan pa yin ste/ khams byang chub kyi sems 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bde skyid kyi rtsa ba yon tan gyi 'byung gnas yin pa la/ 'jig rten pa rnams nyon mongs pa'i dbang du shor bas nyams cing zags/ nyan thos pas nyon mongs spong ba la lam du byas pas yon tan 'byin ma nus/ mtshan nyid theg pa ba gdams ngag dang bral bas bskal pa grangs med gsum 'gor/ gsang sngags su bde ba lam du byas pas khams de nyid 'ching ba dang / brtan pa dang / dag par bsgyur bas tshe gcig gis byang chub thob pa yin/de la yang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang gdams ngag gi gnad zab mos zin pa gal che/kho bo la 'dod chags kyi rtog pa med kyang sngags kyi che ba 'byin pa'i phyir/ bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin tha mal gyi spyod pa byed pa yin gsung /yang mi la la gsungs pa/ rdo rje 'chang nas nga'i bar snga mas phyi ma rim par lung bstan pa yin/ nga la yang rje na ro pas khyod lung bstan pa yin/ khyod dka' ba chen po la

nyamadrangartogs thugs la 'khrungasangatshul/ 163bkod pa dang / mkhar las dang / phru dang / gnag lug skyong ba sogs ma dag pa'i sems can gyi snang ba yin mod/ kho bo la ni de rnams dang dpal na ro pa yang gnyis su med/ kho bo dro bo lung gcig pu na 'dug pa yang min/ de lho brag pa rnams kyi snang ba yin mod/ bu khyod kyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang ba'i las can gyi skyes bu yin/gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang khyod kho na la dga' nas 'tshog par 'dugakhyod kyis mkhar de dgu thog du brtsigs na khyod rang dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa'i rgyud pa mang du 'byung ba yin na'ang / bdun las ma khol bas bdun rgyud tu rang dang mnyam pa dang / rgyud pa gnyis tsam du spyod pa rtsing mo 'ga' re 'byung / kho bo las ngang che bar bag re mthong bas khyod kyi thun mong gi dngos grub la cung zad gnod/ 'on kyang nyams rtogs kyi rgyud pa ni bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung / rnam pa gcig du na ma 'ongs pa'i tshe slob ma ngan pas bla ma yar gnad la 'bebs pa 'byung bas de lta bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ kho bos de ltar du bstan pa yin gsung /de'i tshe don dang mthun pa'i snyan grags kyis kyang bod yul khyab pa na tshogs gral zhig du de skad zhus pas/ bod tsam du ma zad dzam gling tsam na snyan par grags pa yin/zhes gsungs pa/ rgyud pa snyan par mi grags su//rgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin//bka' babs snyan par mi grags sdo///ḍā zhi chos kyi sku can yin/mes po snyan par mi grags su//te lo sangs rgyas lhag gcig yin//

164 rje btsun mar pa 'i rnam tharagrub pa 'i ngo mtshar brjod pa /bla ma snyan par mi grags su//na ro chos kyi spyan ldan yin//mi nga rang snyan par mi grags su//na ro'i thugs kyi sras gcig yin//gdams ngag snyan par mi grags su//kun la med pa'i nor bu yin/ /zhes dang /rgyud pa kun la yod mod kyi//mkha' 'gro yod na yod pa yin//mes po kun la yod mod kyi//te lo yod na yod pa yin//bla ma kun la yod mod kyi//na ro yod na yod pa yin//gdams ngag kun la yod mod kyi//snyan rgyud yod na yod pa yin//bsgoms na 'tshang rgya kun yang rgya//ma sgoms rgya na rgya ba yin//btsal bas sangs rgyas kun gyis rnyed//ma btsal rnyed na brnyed pa yin//ngas khyed rnams la ma btsal ba'i sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gtad pa yin no/ /dga' bar gyis cig gsung nas/

nyamasartogs thugasal 'khrungasatshul/ 165skye shi'i dus su ma bcos bzhag/rmi lam dus su ma slad dran/bar do'i dus su ma bcings rig/'bras bu'i dus na ma sgribs shar//na ro'i rjes 'jug skyes bu rnams//gdams ngag zab pa nyams su sku1nga //rigs pa yod ste nges shes skye//sun pa med par nyams su long //the tshom med par byang chub 'thob/ /gsung /yang jo mo bdag med mabangalug sha bsregs pa sogs pa phyed dang chang bum pa gang mi la la gnang ba ma bzhes par khyer ste/ bla ma la phul bas khyod la 'di ga nas byung gsung /jo mos gnang ba lags zhus pas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub tu gda'/ mi'i zas su mi 'dug gsung nas khong rang la'ang phyed bgos nas gnang ba zos pas ro brgya dang ldan pa cig byung / de phyin rje mi la yum gyis gnang ba'i zas skom thams cad ro mchog brgya dang ldan par myong skad/de ltar bla ma chen po de yon tan gyi gting mtha' mi mngon yang / khyad par sgyu ma gsum gcig tu 'dres pas grong 'jug mang du mdzad par snang ste/ sras mkhar nang du rgyang ro zhang ston gyis tshogs 'khor zhus pa'i tshe/ phug ron khras ded pa cig skar khung nas nang du byung / en cig na shi bas ngas khyed rnams la ltad mo zhig bstan gyi/ mthu chen dkyil 'khor steng nas gzungs thag long shog gsung ste/ phug ron gyi ro'i rkang pa la btags nas dmigs pa gtad pas/ bla ma dbu 'jog ste spur gyi rnam par gyur/

166 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/phug ron gshog pa theb theb 'phur grabs byed pa'i rtsar phug ron phru gu zhig yang byung ste/snying rje rje ltar byed tshe shad ston gyis ngus cing bla ma'i sku'i drung du 'di ltar mi mdzad par zhu/ kyang byen gnod ma byung / phug ron gyi drung du zhus pas phug ron shi ba dang bla ma ba ngas / rang lus khang stong bzhin bor nas//phug ron gzhan lus grong du zhugs//galhasnag brkyang mkha' la do 'phur byas//bya ma bu phrad nas rtse ba de//kun gyis mthong ba ngo mtshar che/ /gsung zhing bshad/yang gdan bzhi gsung ba'i chos gra zhig du mchil ba'i ro la grong 'jug mdzad 'phur ste byon /sa byis pas ded/ bla ma bzhengs nas dud 'gro rten dman pas srog gi bar ho / nga / lha ༵ / sna ༵/sa gsung tshe khyis sha ba ded byung ba chos rar bros byung nas shi/ de la grong 'jug mdzad nas bzhengs tshe khyi ra ba mi gnyis byung / nged kyis thag ring nas bkug pa'i sha ba gtong zer/ nga rang gis brnyed pa'i sha ba mi gtong gsung / bre mo mdzad/ gzhan gyis grong 'jug mdzad pa yin/ des gsung bar 'dug byas pas/ 'o na da dung snying 'a// mdzad par zhu zer ste/ grong 'jug mdzad nas gzims khang du bskyal/bla ma ba ngas / bla ma'i bka' bzhin bdag gis ni//gdams ngag zab mo nyamab(blangs pas//'dod pa mtha' dag 'byung byed pa'i//sha ba yid bzhin nor bu brnyed//

nyamasartogasathugasala'akhrungs tshul/ 167ces gsung / rngon pa gnyis dad ste chos sgor zhugs pas sgom chen bzang po gnyis byung skad/ yang phug ron la zhugs ste 'phur lding mdzad nas de'i dus shin tu bde bar byung gsung ba dang / chos ston la gdan drangs cing jo bo'ang mgron du bos pa'i sar lu gu'i ro zhig la grong 'jug mdzad nas bzhengs ste/dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed yum gyi//bcud len 'chi med ye shes ni//grong 'jug bdud rtsi'i sman sbyar bas//lu gu shi sos gar dang ldan//zhes gsungs/ der jo bo de yang thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa thob par gyur to/ /yang rngogababakhaphul ba'i 'bri rgan g.yang lcam ma bya ba gnya' gnya'i 'dab/ chu mig 'bri nu/ du bying nas shi ba la grong 'jug mdzad/ lung mo'i lcags ri'i nang du bskyal nas ba ༵༵ /sngon gyi slob dpon des phul ba'i 'bri rgan ma chu 'thungs nas ldang ma nus par shi bas/ ngas 'bri'i ro blang gi gsung nas grong 'jug mdzad/ g.yag rgan zhig gi sha len par las mi rnams chas pa na/ nga'i las skal la g.yag ro blang gi gsung grong 'jug mdzad ste/mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang //rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rta//ro snyoms lcag gis yongs bskul ste//g.yag rgan 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral/ /gsung skad/yang skyab tu ljang pa btab nas sras kyis g.yag lo bkal nas blangs pas g.yag shi

168 rje batshun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/ba la grong 'jug mdzad/ sras kyis khal la yo rdo bcug pas slar bzhengs tshe skug pa/ngas g.yag ro dang ljang pa khur bas mi chog par rdo bkal nas gsung ste zhal ras rdul sham 'dug skad/ lar dud 'gro'i rten la zhugs nas zhag du mar blo mi gsal ba 'dug gsu/ nga/ du mgo leg kyi sar yang lha g.yag dkar po gnyan sar shi ba zhig dang lu gu dang gra'i mchod phur phug ron la grong 'jug mdzad par bshad pas dbus dang byang la rjes su'ang spyan drangs pa snyam mo//de'i tshe mar ba bya bya bas kho sha chang bud med bsten/ phru rko sogs byed pa de/ nged rang mi nag pa zang ma yin mod ces zer bas/ ngagadam ngag gi che ba 'byin pa'i phyir/de dgabarten ba yin/zhes gsungs pa/kho bo mar pa lo tsā ngas//rgyud kyi rgyal po dgyes rdor shes//na ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag yod//dgon par mi sdod rang la sdig/rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan bzhi shes//'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams ngag yod//tha mal du shi na rang la sdig/bsam gtan gnyid dang sre ba shes//rmi lam 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag yod//tha mal du nyal na rang la sdig/

nyams rtogasathugs la 'khrungasatshul/ 169sems 'dzin gyi rgyal po gtum mo shes//sems gnad tu bsnun pa'i gdams ngag yod//don nyams su mi len rang la sdig/rlung gi de nyid bdun cu shes//na tsha bogs 'don gyi gdams ngag yod//sman pa 'gugs na rang la sdig/rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shes//rtsa rlung thig le rgyas bya'i phyir//sha chang mi bsten rang la sdig/gzhan lus lam du slong tsa na//las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag yod//phyag rgya mi bsten rang la sdig /zhes gsungs/de thos pas lhag par yang skur ba btab pa gsan pas/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa la'ang skur ba 'debs pa byung / skye bo ngan pa'i kha la tshad med/ snying rje dang / sgyu lus kyi ngang du bor la zhog /zhes gsungs pa/bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen de//lnga brgya phrag bcu'i snyigs ma la//las can smin grol mdzad pa'i phyir//rje na ro chen por sku sprul pas//

170 rje bas marapa'i rnamathar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/'khos chung mar pa lo tsā 'di//gsan nam gzigs sam thugs kyis mkhyen//pha thugs rjes zung dang sprul pa'i sku//dhu ti byang chub gzhung lam du//rlung sems bde 'od zung du tshud//zag med bde ba chen por 'gro//sgrib bral rig pa'i ye shesashar//bla na med do bla ma'i gsung //ma rig mun pa dbyings su dag/gzung dang 'dzin pa'i sgrib gnyis bral//bde gsal spros dang bral bar shar//rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba 'di//rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs brnyan ste//de ltar rtogs pa'i snang ba rnams//rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin du//chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur shar//lha dang lha min mi rnams dang //dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang //sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i snang ba 'di//sgyu ma lta bur med par rtogs//

nyamasartogabangathugasal 'khrungasatshul/ 171yul dang yul can dmigs pa dang //'byung ba'i sgo dang rlung gnad kyis//gang 'dod don du 'gyur 'gyur 'dra//bsre 'pho dri ma med par shar//skye ba'i dus su ma bcos bzhag/rmi lam dus su ma slad dran//bar do'i dus su ma bcings rig/'bras bu'i dus su ma sgribs shar//na ro'i rjes 'brang skyes bu rnams//gdams ngag zab pa nyams su long //rigs pa yod kyi nges shes skyed//blo chung log par rtog pa rnams//sangs rgyas la yang skur 'debs cing //rang grib la yang gshe byed pa'i//skye bo g.yom la rgyug pa la//don la 'di yin 'di min med//blun po bong rgyug byed pa la//mkhas rnams de yi rjes mi 'brang //tha snyad tshig gis chos rnams stong //nga sku ni lha yi 'khor lo yin//

172 rje bsamarapa'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngo mtsharabarjod pa /gsung ni chos kyi rang bzhin yin//thugs ni ye shes ngo bo yin//bu sun pa med par nyams su long //the tshom med par byang chub 'grub/ /ces gsungs/phyis sha ba la grong 'jug mdzad sar kho yod pas dad pa skyes ste/ khyed sha chang bud med bsten pa la gdeng zhig yod par 'dug pa gsung 'tshal zer ba la/ gsungs pa/pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal 31//rje gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin gyis//ngas sos dal dben tshe rtsa rlung bsgoms//lus sems bcun zhing bcun zhing bsgoms//'byung ba 'khrugs kyang nyam nga med//bog 'don du shesaba'igadeng zhig 'od//gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal bsgoms//snang ba bsdus cing bsdus cing bsgoms//gti mug tu song yang nyam nga med//zung 'jugatu she pa'igadeng zhig 'od//rmi lam gyi dus su sgyu lus bsgoms//snang ba spro zhing spro zhing bsgoms//rnam rtog tu song yang nyam nga med//sgyu mar shesapa'igadeng zhig 'od//

nyams rtogs thugs la'akhrungasatshul/ 173'dod yon spyod tshe lha skur bsgoms//ro bro myang zhing myang zhing bsgoms//bza' btung du mthong rung nyam nga med//tshogasamachod du shesapa'igadeng zhig yod//thabs lam gyi skabs su gzhan lus bsgoms//bde ba skyed cing bskyed cing bsgoms//tha mal du 'dug yang nyam nga med//lhan skyesagashesapa'igadeng zhig 'od//'chi ba'i dus su 'pho ba sgom//'pho ba sbyong zhing sbyong zhing sgom//'chi ltas byung yang nyam nga med//rdzog rim du shesapa'i gdeng zhigabod//shi ba'i dus su bar do 'dzin//bar do sprin dang na bun 'dra//chags sdang skyes kyang nyam nga med//rang grol du shesapa'i gdeng zhig 'od//stong pa rki po lta ba min//zhi gnas ltengs po sgom pa min//bcos ma'i tho co spyod pa min//yin min re dogs 'bras bu min//

174 rje ba' mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/bka' dri ma med pa'i gdams ngag yin//gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi nying khu yin//rig pa'i sdod dang ldan pa yin//rgyud chen rnams la mkhas pa yin//gdams ngag la phra zhib shes pa yin//bla ma rgyud pa las byung ba yin//rang gis nyams su blangs pa yin//yang dag gi tshad mas grub pa yin//mchog tu gyur pa'i gnad bsdus yin//brtson byas shes rab che ba yin//ma rig yongs su zad pa yin//rig pa'i ye shes phyogs med tu//gsal zhing kun la khyab pas rgyas//de dag dbyer med spros bral du//nga mar pa blo gros 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/gdams ngag gnang bas phyis grub thosabya zhes grags par gyur to//

175(bzhi pa thugs dam mngon du gyur pa'i sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan 11gas mdzad tshul la ga༄/ma/za sku mal bas skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi sgo nas kun gyi zugs dam la bogs thon tshul/ bstan pa la dar rgyas 'gung bar lung bstan nas gdams ngag dang byin rlabs kyi rten zhal gdams dang bcas te gnang tshul/ 'gro kun dang ba 'dren phyir bkod bsku'i rtsa'aphrul bstan tshulalo//dang po sras sku yal bas skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi sgo nas kun gyi thugs dam la bogs thon tshul ni/)de nas/ mi rgyudan mkha'i mertag bal/ /zhes pa'i rkyen zlog pa'i phyir/ yab sras lo gsum gyi sku mtshams mdzad par bzhed ste/ sku mkhar gyi yang rtser bla ma chen po bzhugs/de'i 'og du sras mdo sde bzhugs/ bar khang rnams su bu chen ci rigs rim par bzhugs/ yum dang rje mi la/ mar pa mgo legs/ ba rang lnga ba can rnams kyis zham ring mdzad/ sgrub khong nas gdams pa gnang zhing / khyad par sras mdo sde la gdams ngag mthaX dag gnang bas sgyu ma gsum gcig tu 'dres pa'i grong 'jug la dbang thob par /zlo ṭ+wāṃ /yu/ma bdag med ma'i gcen po de/ yul de'i jo bo khas drag zhing dbang che ba nor shin tu phyug pa bu med pa gcig rnga mong lum bya ba na yod ste/ yul de na lo lo bzhin ltad mo'i srol yod pa las/ de lo jo bo des gzhi blangs pa'i lo dus kyi ltad mo dang /glegs bam zhig bzhengs pa'i rab gnas gson dge dang bcas pa byed par brtsams/

176 rje btsun mar pa 'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/gral dbu la yab sras gang rung spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba byas pa yum gyis ma bzhes na'ang /nan gyis gnangs nyin spyan 'dren mi zhig btang ba des yum la zhal lta zhus pa sras kyis rgya snazlo / ṭ+wāṃ /ṭā/ /mtho zhing thag ring bas tshig 'byu go ba gsan thub pa'i gnas med naXng / bar ༷snan kyi dus su son pas tshig 'byu gsal bar gsan ste thugs bteg nas sti/ ༵ kā / pa/ rnyi/ rgyu yin/ phyin na mi 'ong dgongs pa bag re yang byung / gnangs zhogs snga bar rang bzhin dang sprul pa'i mi mang po ltad mos yid dungs pa'i gtam zer zhing song / khyad par rgan mo mgo pra ba'i me tog ltar dkar ba gsum/ da res ltad mo 'di ma mthong na sngar mthong ba don med zer nas/ dka' dka' ltar song ba gzigs/bud med de dag chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed bzhad pa mo dang / longs sku bdud 'dul gyi mkha' 'gro zhi ba 'tsho dang / sprul sku las kyi mkha' 'gro za byed 'jigasarung ma ste/ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo gsum sras spyan 'dren du 'ongs pa yin skad/de rnams sprul par ma mkhyen par/ rgan mo ma gi tsho 'gro na/ nga gzhon pa pha ma gnyisa'adzom gyi gces phrug /cis mi 'gro dgongs ste/ na za ber dkar de/ phrag la bkal nas sku mtshams bshig ste thal byung du byon skad/sku mkhar gyi sgor yu ma bzhes pa zhur byon pa dang mjal yang phyag brel bas 'dzin pa ma byung / bzhugs su ni ma gsan/ cis kyang 'byon na de ring gi nyi ma la gral dbu ma byed gsung ba sogs dam bca' bdun bsgos ste/ mtshur ston/ mgo legs/ ba rang / mi la bzhi phyags phyir btang / phyi mig yang mi gzigs par sngar dang mi 'dra bar bzhud pasacher thugs ma bde/ gral dbur shugs kyis byung bas lugs gnyis ga'i khrom thog chod/sku zhang des rta pho rog pung dkar bya ba shin du bzang bas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen

bstan padang semagacan la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ 177byas/ rta de la bcibs 'khor rnams sngon la btang nas/ grong de dang mi ring ba sreg pa lung bya bar phebs pa na/ shing phung zhig nas sreg pa kha cig 'grogs pas chibs 'grogs ste chibs thog nas lhung / zhabs g.yas pa yob la bya 'dos nas ra lam gan pa bya ba na/ dbu pha bong dkar sre zhig la bdabs pas chag /thugs dran nyams pa na mi las gzigs ste rlung bzung nas byon pas skad cig gis phebs/ chibs las phab nas bzhugs tshe bu chen gzhan rnams kyang phebs ste/ phyag zhabs phur pas thugs dran rnyed ste rke rags 'di gshags pa'i phyed kyis me chings/ phyed ska rags gyis/ a po mthu chen sngon la song la yab yum la zhus cig /ngas rta la chags sam lta'i gsung ste bcibs nas byon/ rje btsun gyis sku mkhar rtser byon phyag phul bas/ bu khyod sleb pa na dga' yal gyis yong ba yin ste/ da res ma dga' lhang gis byung / ci yin gsung / lo rgyus zhus pas da ga tsam na sleb gsung / zhan tsam phebs zhus pas/ me chas kyi rten 'brel sogs kyis pha bu 'gyes dgos par 'dug /rmi lam na'ang lus kyi snying phyung ba/ nyi zla na mkhar brgas pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus rdol ba sogs barmis/ phyin rung phan gnod mi 'dug rung / snying rje bas 'gro dgos gsung /byon pa na sras kyis khyamagatog kum ra zhes pa mdo khyams kyi phyi bla yel du phebs pa dang mjal/ dbu gnad tshabs che bas thod pa dung dkar gyi 'khor lo chag pa tsam rgya mdud kyi chings kyis gso thub kyang / klad pa bud+dha'i lha tshogs 'thor na gsor med snyam du sras ring du mi 'tsho bar dgongs ste/ 'pho bgasal 'deb kyi mgur gsungs pa/rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che//bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs//byin gyis rlob par mdzad tu gsol//

178 rje btsun mar pa 'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/bugasan dang jo za mdo 'bum//kho bo mar pa lo tsā ngas//rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin//mtshan ldan bla ma gus pas bsten//rje na ro miX rnam gnyis la//rgyud 'grel gdams pa mang du zhus//dbang bzhi'i gnad la ngo sprod byas//khyad par 'pho ba grong 'jug zhus//de ma gsangs gong du bu la bstan//rgyud 'grel gdams pa dran nam mdo sde 'bum//spyir rang 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid 'di//mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can la//bu sgyu ma lus kyis rtag ma thub//blo bur bdud kyi bar chad byung //thod pa dung dkar gyi 'khor lo chag/klad rgya dar dkar gyi yol bar la//klad pa bud+dha'i lha tshogs 'thor//bu sgyu lus 'jig pa shin tu bden//pha jo lha yi dkyil 'khor yin//rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas thon//

bstan pa dang sems can laphan thogasamadzad tshul/ 179da lan pha jo'i thugs dar 'phos//gsungs kyang thugs dran nyams pas ma gsan/ yum ring thabs su byon pas gzigs ma thag dran med tu brgyal/ sangs pa na sman yan lag brgyad pa la ni khyed rang mkhas/ bu 'di 'tsho bar gda' 'am zhus pas/ sman yan lag stong shes rung / ro mgo med la gso ba'i thabs mi 'dug /chu zangs gang gi nang na zhag nya mig tsam zhig yod pa ṭ+wāṃ // /kāswā la gtor tshar 'dug /bu masgos kyi sgang la ltad mo la gtong mkhan khyod lar bud med kyi gros mgo/ ra'i lam sna/ phyi ba'i bya ra/ thal ba'i la btsas mar gyi nyi 'de rnams la dga' mo byung ba'i dpe med gsung nas dbu gtums ste bzhugs/der sum gyibatasras kyi snyan khung la zhal btad ste/ 'pho ba gsal 'debabangakyi mgur gsungs pa/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//mchog gi sprul pa rin po che//mtshan ldan mar pa lo tsā yi//zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal 31//bugasanadang ro zasamado 'bum//bu 'di nas pha rol gshegs pa'i phyir//'dus byas phung po 'jig pa la//thugs khral cung zad yod ste mchi//pha jo mar pa lo tsā yis//

180 rje btsun mthapa'i rnam tharagrub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa /rgya gar yul la lan gsum byon//sku srog la ma bltos dam chos btsal//mtshan ldan bla ma du ma bsnyen//khyad par na ro paṇa chen la//snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus gsan//pha jos ma gsangs bu la gsungs//dus da lta thugs la gsal mi gsal//na ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag rnams//da lta gdeng dang ldan mi ldan//khyad chos bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag la//da lta nges shes skyes ma skyes//skye med phyag rgya chen po la//da lta mnyam bzhag brtan mi brtan//'pho ba grong 'jug gdams ngag la//da lta gdeng dang ldan mi ldan//'dus byas sha khrag phung po 'di//mi rtag na mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra//sgyu ma lus kyis rtag ma thub//bumar rang lha mo bdag med ma//dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum//

bstan pa dang semasacan laphan thogs mdzad tshul/ 181snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad seng ge'i khri//nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan stengs na//skye mchog mar pa lo tsā bzhugs//dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu yin//bu rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas thon//da lan a ma'i thugs gar 'phos//ces gsungs kyang / thugs dran nyams pas ma gsan/ yum gyi spyan chab snyan khung du song bas thugs dran sos pa na sngar ltar gsungs pas/ sras kyi zhal nas a pho mthu chen nga yar slong zhig gsung nas/ dbu thod tshal pa brgyad tu bye ba de/ sras rang gi phyag gnyis kyis bsdams/ gdong pa 'di ma bde bas phyis dang gsung nas/ rje btsun gyis zhal ras kyi sku mtshal phyis pas/ ngas tshe 'di la yab yum gyi drin lan ma 'jol ba'i khar thugs khral la bkod pa cig byung / da thugs khral mi mdzad par zhu bas ram theg zhig gsung ba na/ rje mi las sku tshe'i bar chad tu 'gro bas de skad mi gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ a pho mthu chen tshe'i bar chad 'di las gzhan 'dug gam/ sems can spyi'i lam po che 'di la nga yang 'gro ba'i dus la sleb byung bas 'gro ba yin/ phyin nas 'jigs pa can bar do'i 'phrang ring la 'jigs sgrag gi sdug bsngal mtha' yas na'ang / nga la pha jo'i bka' drin gyis sgyu ma gsum gcig tu 'dres/ gar skye la rang dbang thob pas mgron po rang khyim du sleb pa lta bu'i gdeng yod/lar mi lus thob nas chos mi byed pa 'di rnams snying rje/ yab kum thugasakhral mi mdzod par zhu ba 'bul bas/ a bos ram theg zhig gsung nas phul ba/rje gsum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che//

182 rje bas mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/dpal rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i//yab dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang //yum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i bdag med ma//yab yum gnyis la gus phyag 'tshal//yab yum gyis dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs//nga 'di nas pha rol 'gro ba la//ya nga dang bag tsha mi gda' ste//yab yum drin lan ma khor 'chi ba 'di//cung tsam sems la 'phreng bar gda'//'on kyang ma phan 'chi ba la//yab yum thugs khral mi dgyid 'tshal//yab pha jos gsungs pa'i rgyud 'grel rnams//dus da lta sems la gsal bar gda'//thabs lam na ro chos drug la//da lta gdeng dang ldan par gda'//khyad chos bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag la//da lta nges shes 'drongs par gda'//skye med phyag rgya chen po la//da lta mnyam bzhag brtan par gda'//khyad chos 'pho ba grong 'jug la//

bstanapa dang semasacan laphanathogasamadzad tshul/ 183da lta gdeng dang ldan par gda'//yab yum gnyis spyan chab mi gtong 'tshal//skye med spros bral phyag rgya che//phung po khams dang skye mched rnams//lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin gsal//spyir 'pho bya 'pho byed rten dang bral//skye med chos kyi dbyings su 'pho//yab yum gyi thugs kur gtad mi 'tshal//rnam shes gyen la 'phang mi 'tshal//bla ma na ro dang mairta'i rgyud 'grel rnams//rngog ston mthu chen la sogs pa'i//khong bu chen rnams la gnang mdzod la/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dpel bar zhu//bdag gson yang byed rgyu de las med//shi yang zhu rgyu de las med//'o skol yab yum sras bcas rnams//skye ba 'di la mjal snyam mi gda' ste//au byen yul lam mkha' spyod tu//phyi ma cis kyang mjal ba zhu//

184 rje bas marapa'i rnam tharagrub pa'ingomatsharabarjodapa/zhes phul ste/ smon lam mang du mdzad/ de nas nang du gdan drangs nas 'phan yul gyi nya ma dpal mo sogs kyis grong 'jug mdzad par zhus pas/ ma sgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i chos bod tu dar bar 'dod na/ khye'u gtsang ma'i ro chud ma zos pa zhig tshol gsung bas kun tu btsal yang gtan ma rnyed/ rje btsun mi las rdzu'aphrul gyis dzam gling lan gsum bskor yang ma rnyed/ dur khrod gsil ba tshal du ro gsum bzhi re rgyun mi 'chad kyang de'i dus lan gsum byon pas ma rnyed/ ces bris pa cig snang /sngags pa gcig gis rgan mo sba ba log nas shi ba'i ro zhig khyer byung ba la 'pho bar zhus pas 'gro don mi nus pas mi 'pho gsung / yang slob ma lug rdzi zhig gis phug ron hal nas shi ba'i ro zhig khyer byung ba la 'pho bar zhus pas/ dud 'gro'i lus kyis 'gro don mi 'ong / nga lus rten je dmar btang nas khyed ci byed gsung / der lug rdzi de sogs ma dag pa kha cig grong 'jug yod zer ba mi bden par 'dug /sngar bla mas mdzad pa rnams kyang mig 'phrul du 'dug zhes skur ba 'debs pa na/ sras kyis khyed rnams kyi log rtog zlog phyir ngas phug ron la 'pho bar bya'o/ /phug ron sngas mgor zhog la mchod pa shoms cig /skyed rim ma bsdus par 'phos na lha bsad pa'i lhung ba yod pas ngas rdzogs rim du bsdus nas 'pho yi gsung tshe/ dgyes rdor du gsal lam pa kun gyis mthong ba dang / tha mas kyang 'ja' tshon gyi gong bur mthong ba byung /de nas rdzogs rim du bsdus pa na sras kyi zhal ras pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu de mdangs ser yal song ba dang phug ron cung zad 'gul/ sras grongs pa dang phug ron sos ste sprug zhing yab yum la phyag gi tshul dbu gug gug ngang 'phur nas bskor ba gsum byas/dro bo lung na yar 'phur song bas bu tshur log shog zhig gsungs pas tshur byung ste/ yab yum la bskor ba byas nas yab kyi sku pang du byung bas phyag gis byil byil mdzad cing /sku pung g.yon pa'i thog tu bzhugs su bcug /de'i sku 'dra la mar ba bya khur mar grags

bstan pa dang semasacan la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ 185pa yin no/ /der bdag med ma 'o skol la bu phug ron la re ba'i dus byung mchod khang du gdan drongs mchod pa phul dud 'gro dga' ba'i zas khrom gsung /de nas ring po ma lon par skya ser gyi 'dus pa chen po la gshegs rdzongs kyi ston mo yang mdzad/ pur khang sgo bzhi pa gcig brtsigs ste yab dang bu chen so sos phyogs bzhi nas me mchod mdzad pas phyogs mtshams nas 'ja' 'od mi 'dra ba sna brgyad zug /me ༷ga gi char bzung du rung ba byung / sum thug khralachen pos/ pur khang gi phyogs so sa nas/ nga'i buganyesabarabargyang ba'i mdo 'bum//dpral ba'i dkyil gyi mig dang 'dra//mdo sde mi bzhugs dgung la gshegs//lam 'od gsal gyi ngang la yal nas thal//dus de ring nas dpral ba'i mig dang bral//rgan mo mig med ma nga me nang 'di ru 'phyong //de bzhin du/ byang khog nang gi snying dang 'dra/ /sogs dang /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /sogs dang /pha bla ma gcig las bka' drin che//sems skye ba med pa'i chos cig gsungs//bla ma snying la'adod do mdo 'bum//ma rgan mo phyags phyir mi 'khrid par//shul du 'jog pa sku drin chung //gsung zhing me la 'phyong grabs mdzad pa bzung / grong 'jug mdzad pa'i phug ron

186 rje btsun marapa'irnam thar grub pa'i ngo mchar brjod pa /dar lam la gdan drangs nas bu pur khang la skor ba gyis zhig gsungs pas bskor ba mdzad/ bla ma chen pos kyang thugs khral gyi rnam pa mdzad/ gsol 'debs dang dud me'i sgra chen po byung zhing / thams cad la ye shes phebs pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/de'i tshe sngar rgan rgon gnyis la bu zhig yod pa shi ba'i tshe/ rmi lam na bu gcig byung nas shi na sdug bsngal 'byung ste ma skyes pa la shi ba'i sdug bsngal byas pa yin/ da lta'i bu yang de dang khyad med/ rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma yin/ gsungs pa de gnyis byung ste/ bla ma lags/ bdag gnyis kyi bu gcig po shi tsa na de skad gsung gi gda' ba/ bla ma la da dung sras drug tsam gda' bas/ sras mdo sde grongs pa yang rmi lam lags mod/ sgyu ma lags mod/ thugs khral mi mdzad par zhu zer bas/ ngas khyed gnyis la yin lugs kyi chos bshad pa yin/ nga la dngos por 'dzin pa'i sdug bsngal med/ khyed gnyis kyi bus dang por lus kyi mdangs/ rang kha'i zas phyogs/ bar du khang gzhis dang yod gu 'phrog /mthar ngan song du skur ba dang nga'i bu mi 'dra/ nga'i bu de bzhugs na bod 'dir mtha' dmag mi lhags/ chos pa rnams 'thab rtsod mi 'byung / 'pho ba grong 'jug dang ༷stan ༷ daX zhing rgyal khams bde ba zhig 'byung ba yin pas rmi rgod dang sgyu rgod cig yang zlo ༵ shā sna /lasu zlo ba/sa dbu thod la bde mchog lha lnga rang byung sogs ngo mtshar gyi rten mang du byon no/ /der bla ma chen pos thugs chos nyid la bzhag ste sras kyi 'gro don gar yod gzigs/ bod yul na gdul bya mi 'dug par mkhyen/ rgya gar gyi yul ge ga'i bye ma'i steng na bram ze'i khye'u skye ba bdun pa shi ma thag gi ro zhig 'dug pa de skye ba len pa lus kyi 'brel par gzigs/ lho phyogs bde ldan gyi brag phug tsan+da na'i gsil khang na sgrub pa mdzad pa gnas kyi 'brel pa yod par gzigs/ 'gro don mdzad pa gdul bya'i 'brel pa ni nub phyogs o byen na 'dug par gzigs nas/ bdag med ma dbu rtse nas

bstan padangasems can laphan thogasamadzad tshul/ 187phug ron gdan drongs shog gsung ste/ phug ron dar dkar gyi mdo li la bzhugs/gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs kyis spyan drangs pas na mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od tu song / sa gzhi kun 'od zer gyi dra bar song / sa gzhi g.yos/de nas sku mkhar dgu thog gi rtser phug ron la lung bstan pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod la bod na gdul bya mi 'dug go/ 'di nas shar lho drang por phyin pa na ge gā'i 'gram bye ma'i steng na bram ze skye bdun gyi ro gtsang ma zhig 'dug pas grong 'jug gyis/ lho phyogs bde ldan gyi phug du sgrub pa gyis/ nub phyogs o byen du gdul bya yod pas der 'gro don gyis cig par lung bstan nas btang bas/ mda' rgyang gang tsam nas yab yum la chags nas tshur sgor tsam 'khor nas byon song / ci zhig na bla ma'i zhal nas bdag med ma mchod pa la 'ur shoms/ bu slob thams cad gsol ba drag du thob nga'i bu'i lam nor ro gsung nas sku mkhar gyi rtse nas na za'i g.yab mo mdzad de/ dpal na ro pa nga'i bu'i lam nor ro rig pa khug zhig zhes 'gugs 'dren mdzad pas/ phyi dro tsam na phug ron de thang shin tu chad pa cig byas nas phyag dang skor ba'i tshul mdzad ste yab kyi sku pung gi khar bzhugs/ der sras la lam gong ma ston pa'i phyir du bde mchog lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'a41ra zhal phye ste phug ron gyi mgul la gzungs thag btags nas zhag bdun du yi ge bdun pa'i bsnyen sgrub dang dbang bskur mdzad/ phug ron la zhabs tog legs par mdzad ste bu khyod kyi kha sang gi lam de nor ba yin no/ /chags na yi dam lha la chags na'ang phung ba yin ste yab yum la ma chags par dro bo lung gi ri rgyud 'di g.yas su zhog la song zhig zhes lung bstan pa bzhin byon pas srod kher tsam na rgya gar gyi sa la zin pa'i mtsho 'gram zhig tu lha'i khog pa zhig du gzims/ nang par byon pas ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin bram ze'i khye'u'i ro 'dug pa la zhugs/ phug ron sreg chog byas/ ro gos kyi ras yug gsol nas grong du byon pas sngar gyi rtsed grogs rnamasadaga'

188 rje btsun marapa'irnam tharagrubapa 'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/zhing mdun du byung / khye'u'i pha ma mya ngan gyis non pa yang sangs/ 'on kyang bu snga ma ma yin par shes nas dris nas ngo mtshar du byas/ bde ldan du grub pa brnyes ste ti snye ro lang ces bya ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad cing da lta au byen na bzhugs skad/spyir grong 'jug byas pa la lus rten sems rten gnyi ga'i skyon yon sngar yod rnams 'byung ba yin no/ /rnam thar phyi ma zhig na sras grong 'jug mdzad pa 'di dang / ti phu dri med bshes gnyen gcig par byas snang yang / de ni yig mkhan gyi rigs ga ya dha ra'i sras yin zhing / yab sras lhan cig na 1du pa la dbang zhus tshe sras lo bcu gnyis pa tsam de la ye shes babs/ tai los de'i spyi bor phyag 'jog pa byung bas na ro pa mnyes ste khyod te lo'i bur 'dug zhes gsungs par ra chung ba'i rnam thar snga ma kun las bshad cing /te bu zhes sam te lo putra ces saṃ kṛ tar byas na te bu zhes 'byung ba 'di na ro miX gnyi ga'i rgya gar na chos kyi bdag po yin no//'di la'ang me ston gyi phul ba'i rta gling bzhi bde 'khor la chibs nas byon pas sku lhung zer ba dang / gzhan kha cig yang snang / spyir grong 'jug gnang nas rtsal sbyang dus phug ron gyi ro la zhugs pa khol mo zhig gis sgo drag rdab byas pas phug ron phyir byon nas 'gugs dgos byung ba 'di bar chad kyi snga mar snang /yang rwa 'tho rdo rje gragabasakyis gral dbu zhig la phebs pa ma bzod par sbyin sreg byas pas dgyes rdor du byung ba bsregs kyang zer/ spyir sras de zhabs brtan na de'i gdung rgyud kyis bod kyi rgyal po byed pas hor sogs mtha' dmag mi 'jug zhing / bod kyi bdag po'ang sa hor 'bri tshal rlangs lha gzigs sogs yang yang mi 'pho bar brtan pa dang / sar rnying bka' phyag sa 'bri sogs chos pa'i 'thab rtsod rnams mi 'byung ba dang /khyad par grong 'jug gcig nas gcig du brgyud pa rgya gar na shārnyi pa grong 'jug lan lnga brgyud pa'i phyi ma la bod tu byon par bshad pa lta bu mang du 'byung bar snang yang / bod

bstanapa dngasems can laphan thogs mdzad tshul/ 189yul ba rnams la de lta bu'i skal ba dang ma ldan par snang /rten 'brel 'di ma 'grig pas bod tu grong 'jug nus pa mang du byung yang dngos su grong 'jug byas pa ma byung ste/ rje sgam po pa'i slob ma grong 'jug nus pa rnal 'byor chos g.yung yin zhes ce('angaka nga gis nus pa dang / sbyo1la lha/ma snar+shagabs nga gis/ se mo dor dpal sgro 31 dang nus pa 'gran tshe ngang pa'i ro la zhugs nas mtsho mtha' lan gsum du bskor/ khong gi mdun du skad mang du bston pa dang / grub thob rkarma bsgosarang gi gdung la 'jug tu byon pas bzhu zhing 'dug /stod lung 'phar tshang du rgan rgon gyi byis pa'i ro la zhugs pas mig khab kyis btsabs nas thon pa dang / yang dgon ba lug gu'i ro sogs 'gul nus pa la sbrang ma'i ro la ma nus pa de skams pas lan par bshad pa dang / phyis sang rgyasamanyan ba kyang thod pa la sbyangs tshe thod pa dro ba dang 'tshag pa sogs byung bar snang bas nus pa ni da lta'i bar du yod do//'brog mi lo tsā ba grong 'jug grub pa yin ste/ 'grongs dar sras dang yum la nga'i ro 'di la zhag bdun du ma reg par zhog gsung yang bdun pa la mes sbyangs/ de tsam na drod ma yal bar 'dug pas ma bsregs na slar 'jug rgyu yin zer zhing / grong 'jug mthar phyin 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ /zhes zer ba ni grong 'jug gi tshig la dga' tshor tsam ma gtogs rang bzhin ma 'tshal ba yin ste/ grong 'jug ni snga ma'i rnam shes thon pa'i ro grang mo la rnal 'byor pa'i rlung sems las rung 'jug pa yin gyi/ drod ma yal na 'byung ba me ma thim pas rnam shes ma thon par zad mod/ 'di lta bu las sos na ye shes kyi mthus yin na zhu ba glus bskul gyis bzhengs pa dang / las dbang gis yin na shi log byung ba sman bla'i mdor gsungs pa lta bu yin no//de nas bu slob mtha' dag yang 'dzom tshe sras kyi dus mchod kyi tshogs gral du/'dus byas kyi chos nyid kyang 'di ka yin/ bla ma'i lung bstan dang yang mthun par byung /

190 rje gzha mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/su la'ang mi phan zhing chos 'chad pa la'ang gnod pa rgan rgon gnyis kyi lta bu yin pas/da sems khral ma byed cig gsung nas/ myacan sangasaba'i mgur/ gsungs pa/rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//chos bshad cing go ba'i shes rab ma//bdag med ma la 11sa cig 'debs//tha mal dang ma bsre dran pa snyen//nges shes skyed la mya ngan spongs//snyegartespobar bskyang bamimado sde 'bum//'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs pa de//rje dang bka' drin mnyam par byung //dran 'dun sgyu ma'i gsal thebs phyir//mya ngan la bya yul mi 'dug zhing //sems can la nye ring mi 'dug pas//'gro kun brtse bas skyongs cig bdag med ma//bu yi mya ngan sangs bdag med ma//gser las bzhengs pa'i mdo mang sogs//sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod rnams//bu mdo sde'i don du bzhengs lags kyang //mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs//rten bdag med na mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra//

bstanapadang sems can laphan thogs mdzad tshul/ 191snang zhing stong par rtogs pa des//zhabs tog la bya yul ma rnyed rung //kun gyi mchod gnas zhus shig bdag med ma//snye yi mya ngan sangs bdag med ma//dka' ba spyad pa'i rgyud 'grel dang //thugs bcud bsdus pa'i man ngag gnad//zab gu 'dus pa'i snying po dang //sgra thang klog skad kyi lo tsā rnams//bu mdo sde'i don du bslabs lags kyang //mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs//chos bdag med gter gyi kha byang 'dra//chos mnyam pa nyid tu rtogs pa des//kun la ster ro bdag med ma//snye yi spya ngan sang sobadag med ma//ser snas bsags pa'i zas nor dang //grwa pas phul ba'i gnag lug rnams//bu mdo sde'i don du dpel lags kyang //mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs//nor bdag med sa 'og gi gter dang 'dra//phyugs bdag med spang kha'i ri dwags 'dra//nor phyag rgya chen por rtogs pa des//

192 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/'tsho skyong la byed don mi 'dug pas//kun sbyin par thong zhig bdag med ma//bu yi mya ngan sang so bdag med ma//pha yul spe sar gyi mkhar zhing dang //mi las brtsigs pa'i sa mkhar rnams//bu mdo sde'i don du bgyis lags kyang //mdo sde/ mkhar bdag med dri za'i grong khyer 'dra//yul snang stong sgyu mar rtogs pa des//'dzin spras la byed don mi 'dug pas//mkhar gyi 'dzin spras bor cig bdag med ma//bu yi mya ngan sang so bdag med ma//pha dpun mar tsho'i ngo 'dzin dang //dgra zun skye bo rgyab skur sogs//bu mdo sde'i don du bgyis lags kyang //mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs//snang ba sems su rtogs pa des//dgra gnyen la khyad par mi 'dug pas//thams cad chos skur sgoms cig bdag med ma//bu yi mya ngan sangagaso bdag med ma//spyir 'dus byas chos kyi mtshan nyid la//

bstan pa dngasems canal phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 193mthar thug rtag pa kun la med//dgos 'o skol dang dar ma mdo sde yi//gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba rdzogs nas thal//bya thabs med pa'i las skal la//mya ngan ma byed bdag med ma//bu yi mya ngan sangs bdag med ma//rang la bya rgyu chos las med//brtse bas dbul phongs kyi 'gro ba dang //shul na lus pa'i bu drug la//bstan 'dzin gyi re bzhed ma mchis ste//mdo sde bzhin du brtse bas skyongs//bu yi mya ngan sangs bdag med ma//paṇa chen na ro'i lung bstan ltar//kho bo'i bu slob rgyud bcas rnams//zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du//gong nas gong du 'phel rgyas pas//bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas 'byung //bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen grub//nyams dga' yo skyid to bdag med ma//bu yi sbya ngan sang sobadag med ma//zhes gsungs/ 'di la'ang phug ron la zhal bkos mdzad nas gtong ba'i dus yum

194 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa 'i ngomatsharabarjod pa /gyis thugs khral ci yang mdzad pas/ phug ron phyag g.yon du bsnams nas gar dang bcas ste gsungs ces rnying pa du ma na snang /yang jo mo dang mi la la gsungs pa/ mdo sde la bsnyen nas thams cad kyi tshogs rdzogs/ skyo shas dang sgyu lus la bogs thon/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin shes sam/ kho bo dang kho bo'i chos kyi sgra thos pa thams cad ngan song du mi 'gro/ lam sna zin gtan gyi so nam tshar ba yin gsung /yang yum la da 'o skol gnyis kyang yun ring po mi sdod/ mi'i snang ba brtul zin gsung / jo mo dang jo lcam 'di rnams kyang sdug /sems can yang snying rje bas yun ring du bzhugs par zhu zhus pas/ bar do'i rnam par shes pa rang rang gi las la spyod pa la ngas skyid par bya mi nus khyod rang phyir song gsung /me ston gyis zhing zho gcig gis ltang tses bkang ste 'bul ba gsum ba bgyis nas mgur zhus pa na/ khyod kyis kyang sgod ldan la bka' yongabangasu ston zhig zhes gsungs pa/rje bla ma dang mi skyod tha dad med//spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs su gsol//dus de ring rgyud bshad tshogs gral du//nga mar ston chos kyi blo gros 'di//dgos pa'i lo rgyus glu ru len//yul rna bas thos pa'i gtsang du phyin//dpal myu gu lung gi dgon pa sa/gsang sngags chos kyi mu ge la//sems yi dwags byed cing lo gsum bsdad//
