bstanapa dang semasacan la phan thogasamadzadatshul/ 195lar mi tshe stong skyel byas pa 'dra//lto bal phyogs su 'gro bar bsams//chos skom chus dkon pa'i sdug bsngal gyis//lan cig shes pa'i dus byung na//'dod pa'i mi la sbyin dgos bsam//chos dka' la srog dang do bdos pa'i//zab mo'i gdams ngag nub par 'phangs//mes ston dang rngog ston ma gtogs pa//khong gzhan la gzhung bshad byas pa med//chos 'dod pa rnams la shod cig byas//nor 'bul ba can gyi slob mas kyang //bla ma la bka' rgya btab pa med//nor ci yang med pa'i mthu chen dang //zhabs tog can gyi rngog ston la//gdams ngag la dam lhod ma byas pas//dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa gyis//mi nga yis dka' las 'di tsam byas//nor chud zos can du ma song ba//lag du gser srang brgyad cu khyer//rten khyad par can la mchod pa phul//

196 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/bla ma rnams la 'bul ba bgyis//gnas khyad par can du tshogs gtor byas//bu khyed kyis byas pa'i zhabs tog la//drin lan dam chos dpag med sbyin//chos kyi zho sha nyams su long //'gro ba gzhan la ci phan mdzod/ /ces dang /rje bde ba'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon//sprul sku zung 'jug he ru ka/gar dgu'i nyams ldan bde stong dang //zhal sbyor lhan cig skyes la 'dud//brda mthong tsam gyis don rtogs cing //zur gyis go ba'i gang zag la//thos pa tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur//tha snyad tshig gis mi mtshon pa//zag med don gyi ye shes gter//skyod pa bde ba'i skad cig la//sdug bsngal med pa de lta bur//zag bcas yid 'di mi ches pas//bde stong ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun//rtog pa bral ba'i sems la bzhag/

bstan pa dang semasacan la phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 197sangs rgyas lta bu'i bla ma gsung //bang rgyud bgazhanan 'di da gsung //mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma la//rgyu rtsal goms par gyur pa yis//skyes bu bya la mda' rtse bzhin//goms pa rgyud la rtag brten na//ji ltar zhen pa'i bag chags 'byung //gdod nas dag pa'i sems rgyud 'di//blo bur rkyen gyis ma bslad na//na mkha' bzhin du 'dus ma byas//phyin ci ma log gnas lugs yin//yid la bya rgyu rdul dang bral//bzung du rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang //man ngag rgyud la goms pa yis//tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe/pha rol phyin pa'i dbyings su thim//de la skyo ba yod ma yin//na mkha' lta bu'i rang sems de//na bun lta bus ma slad cig/rjer ro paṇa chen 'diskad gsung //

198 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/chos ༄75 bzhin nyams sdo len pa la//gnyug sdong bcug pa'i sgrul bzhin du//rtsol ba bral ba'i lus mi 'gul//yid la chags pa'i mya ngan rnams//gnad la phog pa'i zug rngu ltar//bya ba btang ba'i sems mi yengs//sems gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gdod nas stong //tho bas dngos po 'joms pa bzhin//mthong dang reg dang dran pas grol//don 'di legs par go bar mdzod//'di phyag rgya chen po'i sgom dbyangs yin//dam chos gzhan la phan gyur na//3/spar cangarnam me lhaman ba//skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la//sba bar mi bya man ngag sbyin//zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe bla ma chen po chos dang gdams ngag gi dkor mdzod thamasacad phye ste nyin gsung zhing mtshan sgom pas rtse gcig du dus 'da' ba'i tshe/ bdag med ma'i zab dbang zhig mdzad pa'i tho rengs rten 'brel brtag par dgongs nas 'od gsal gyi ngang nas bu slob rnams la gzigs pas/ rngog dgyes rdor gyi rgyud 'grel bshad/ mtshur ston 'pho ba sbyong / mes ston 'od gsal 'dzin/ mi la gtum mo sgom pa gzigs pas/ rngog ba la rgyud tshogs bshad dang / slob bshad kyi rim pa mu tig ltar la

bstan pa dang sems canal phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 199brgyus pa lta bu dang / na ro'i rgyan drug /thugs dam pad+ma rā ga /dgang gzar blugs/rgyud 'grel gyi phyag dpe rnams gnang / bshad rgyud chu bo lta bu 'di khyod kyis zung zhig gsung / mtshur ston dbang rdo rje la 'pho ba'i man ngag dang / na ro'i dbu lo/ phyag sen/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rnams gnang / 'pho ba rgya mthongs la bya 'phur ba lta bus gzhan don gyis cig gsung / gtsang rong gi me ston tshon po la 'od gsal gyi man ngag /na ro'i rdo rje dril bu/ ḍa ma sa ka pā la rnams gnang / 'od gsal mun nang du mar me spar ba 'dra ba 'di zung zhig gsung / rje mi la la gtum mo a thung gi man ngag dang / miX pa'i dbu zhwa/ na ro'i na za rnams gnang / gnas ri khrod 'grims la lta sgom nyams su 61nga zhig gsung / gzhan yang slob ma mchog kun la gdams ngag dang /byin rlabs kyi rten so sor gnang bas thugs tshim par gyur to//

200 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/(gnyis pa bstan pa la dar rgyas 'byung bar lung bstan nas gdams ngag byin rlabs kyi rten zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang tshul ni/)de'i tshe sras kyi dus mchod cig gi gral du bu chen rnams kyis zhus pa/ sras de lta bu ni bdag cag gi bsod nams kyis ma thub/ da bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa ji ltar dar lung bstan du gsol zhus pas/ na ro mizhwa'i bu rgyud 'di rmi lam sgyu lus la mnga' brnyes pa yin/ dpal na ro pa'i lung bstan bzang po yang yod/ khyed rnams kyis rmi lam rtog cig gsung nas so sos brtags pa na thams cad la bzang po du ma byung zhing / khyad par rje milha'angalung bstan gyi rmi lam byungab phul ba/rje rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du//mdang sum nyal ba'i rmi lam na//byung tshul bla ma'i drung du 'bul//snyan dar cig bdag la gsan par zhu//dzam gling yangs pa'i byang phyogs 'dir//lhun stug gangs ri chags pa barmis//gangs rtse mo dgung la reg pa barmis//rtse la nyi zla 'khor ba barmis//'od kyis na mkha' gang ba barmis//rtsa bas sa gzhi khyab pa barmis//

bstanapa dang sems can laphanathogs mdzad tshul/ 201phyogs bzhir chu rgyun 'bab pa barmis//chu des 'gro kun tshim pa barmis//chu sna rgya mtshor 'bab pa barmis//me tog sna tshogs bkra ba barmis//spyir gyis rmi lam de ltar barmis//bla gdusagasum sang rgyasalazhusab lags//sgos lhun stug gangs ri mthon po de'i//shar du kachen btsugs pa barmis//ka thog tu seng chen 'gying ba barmis//seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa barmis//sder bzhi gangs la dgrad pa barmis//spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa barmis//seng gangs dkar gyi stongs su 'phyo ba barmis//bla ma dusagasum sangasargya la zhusab lags//sto ru kachen btsugs pa barmis//ka thog tu stag mo ngar ba barmis//stag gra 'dzum mtha' nas rgyas pa barmis//khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa barmis//sder bzhi nags la dgrad pa barmis//spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa barmis//stag nags kyi gseb tu 'phyo ba barmis//

202 rje bas marapa 'i rnamathar grubapa 'i ngo mtsharabarjod pa/nags thang shing brgyud tu 'brel ba barmis//bla ma dusagasum sang rgyasal zhusab lags//nub tu kachen btsugs pa barmis//ka thog du khyung chen lding ba barmis//khyung gshog sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa barmis//khyung rwa gnam du gzigs pa barmis//spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa barmis//khyung na mkha'i mthongs la 'phur ba barmis//bla ma dubakhanasum sang rgyasal zhukhyi(ba lags//byang du ka chen btsugs pa barmis//ka thog du rgod po lding ba barmis//rgod rtse sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa barmis//rgod tshang brag la bcas pa barmis//rgod de la bu cig byung ba barmis//bya bran gyis na mkha' gang ba barmis//spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa barmis//rgod na mkha'i mthongs la 'phur ba barmis//bla ma du'akhanasum sang rgyasal zhusab lags//de ltar barmis pa'i rten 'brel gyis//bzang po'i dge ltas yin nam snyam//

bstan padang semagacan la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ 203bdag ni nyams dga' shes pa spro//ngo sprod lung bstan gnang du gsol//zhes zhus pas rmi lam bzang 'dug /bdag med mas tshogs mchod bzang ba zhig shoms gsung / de'i gral du mi lardo rje rgyalamatshan gyi rmi lam 'di rnams ngas lung bstan no gsung nas/ ma 'ongs lung ston dbasgobarda 'grolagyi mgur chen rgyal po'i rnga sgra la rta drangs nas gzhengs pa/rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon//paṇa chen na ro'i zhabs la 'dud//'dir bzhugs gdan gang bu slob rnams//rmi lam brda las byung ba yi//ngo mtshar ma 'ongs lung bstan 'di//pha gon nga yis bshad kyis nyon//dzam gling byang phyogs sa steng de//bod na dar ba'i thub bstan yin//de steng gangs ri chags pa de//pha rgan mar pa lo tsā dang //bka' rgyud yongs kyi bstan pa yin//gangs rtse mo dgung la reg pa de//k+ṇi ༵ rnyiXn / sdidī r+sha yin//

204 rje btsun marapa'i rnam thar grubapa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/sgom pa 'od gsal mkhyen brtse yin//'od kyis na mkha' gang ba de//thugs rjes ma rig mun sel yin//rtsa bas sa gzhi khyab pa de//phrin las kyis sa gzhi khyab pa yin//phyogs bzhir chu rgyun 'bab pa de//smin grol dbang bzhi'i gdams ngag yin//chu des 'gro kun tshim pa de//gdul bya smin zhing grol ba yin//chu sna rgya mtshor 'bab pa de//'od gsal ma bu mjal ba yin//me tog sna tshogs bkra ba de//'bras bu skyon bral nyams myong yin//spyir rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang //'dir tshogs gra pa bu slob kun//sgos lhun stug gangs ri mthon po de'i//shar du kachen btsugs pa de//dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge yin//ka thog du seng ge 'gying ba de//kho mi gzhi seng dang 'dra ba yin//

bstan pa dngasems can la phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 205seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa de//snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin//sder bzhi gangs la dgrad pa de//tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa yin//spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de//'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin//seng gangs dkar stongs su 'phyo ba de//thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin//shar rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang //'dir tshogs gra pa bu slob kun//snyo ru kachen btsugs pa de//gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin//ka thog du stag mo ngar ba de//kho mi gzhi stag dang 'dra ba yin//stag gra 'ingosam mtha' nas rgyas pa de//snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin//khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa de//sku gsum rang ngo 'phrod pa yin//sder bzhi nags la dgrad pa de//phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa yin//spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de//

206 rje btsunamar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar bshe da pa/'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin//stag nags kyi bseb tu 'phyo ba de//thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin//thang nags shing rgyud tu 'brel ba de//bu tsha bos rgyud pa zin pa yin//lto rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang //'dir tshogs gra pa bu slob kun//nubasku'in/chen btsugs pa de//gtsang rong gi me ston tshon po yin//ka thog du khyung chen lding ba de//kho mi gzhi khyung dang 'dra ba yin//khyung gshog sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa de//snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin//khyung rwa gnam du gzings pa de//lta sgom gyi gol sa chod pa yin//spyan mig gyen du gzigasapa de//'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin//khyung na mkha'i mthongs su 'phur ba de//thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin//nub rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang //'dir tshogs gra pa bu slob kun//

bstan pa dang sems canal phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 207byang du ka chen btsugs pa de//gung thang gi mi la ras pa yin//ka thog du rgod po lding ba de//kho mi gzhi rgod dang 'dra ba yin//rgod rtse sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa de//snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin//rgod tshang brag la byas pa de//tshe phyog brag las sra ba yin//rgod de la bu cig byung ba de//'gran gyi do med cig yong ba yin//bya phran gyis na mkha' gang ba de//bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin//spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de//'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin//rgod na mkha'i mthongs su 'phur ba de//thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin//byang rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang //khyed 'dir tshogs rnams la bshad pa yin//nga pha rgan gyi bya ba byas cing tshar//da khyed bu slob kyi dus la bab nas gda'//nga mi rgan gyi kha la gtad yod na//

208 rje btsun marapa'i rnam tharagrub pa'ingo mtsharabarjod pa/nyis sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa dar nas yong //zhes gsungs pas/ thams cad spro zhing gzengs mtho bar gyur to/ /'di la'ang rje mar pa'i mnal lam yin par bshad pā dang / mi la'i snanal lam yin na'ad ka ba bzhi

bstanapa dang sems can la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ 209(gsum pa 'gro kun dang ba 'dren phyir bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul bstan tshul ni/)re zhig gi tshe yum dang mi la la gsungs pa/ kho bo zla gcig tsam dben par sdod ste/khyed gnyis kyis 'tsho ba skyel ba las gzhan su yang ma btang zhig gsung ste/ gzims chung du bzhes pa 'dren pa'i slo skar cung zad ma gtogs zhal ba byas nas sku mtshams la bzhugs/ 'di sku mkhar gyi gzims chung 'og ma yin par snang /nyin gcig chu gong dpal le mtshams la yod pa'i rtsar mi las sgrub pa'i dri rmed byas pas/ nga deng sang rim lnga'i khrid zhu bas mi khom zer/ su la zhu byas pas/ bla ma rje btsun chen po da lta kho bo'i nang na bzhugs pa mi shes sam zer nas nang du song / bla ma ni sku mtshams la bzhugs/ khong rang gi dag snang yin mchi snyam nas bskor ba byas cing nyan pas rje btsun gyi gsung lhang lhang thos/ nges par bzhugs par 'dug snyam nas 'ongs pa'i lam khar gra'i mi chung ri khrod tu 'gro ba dang phrad/ gar 'gro dris pas bla ma chen po ri khrod na bzhugs pa'i drung du 'gro zer nas song / yang lam du dol pa gag ston yul nas byung ba dang phrad/ gar 'gro dris pas rje btsun chen po lung pa'i mda' na yul mi mang po la chos gsung gi 'dug /ngas kyang der chos nyan nas 'ongs pa yin/ 'bul ba rnams skyel mi yong ba yod zer ste 'bul ba mang po skyal byung / de rnams yum la zhus pas khong rang rnams kyi dad pa'i snang ba lags mchi rje btsun gzims chung nas gar yang gshegs pa med to gsung /yang zhag 'ga' na mi lasajo mo gsal skyid kyi drung du phyin/ khyed la gdams ngag ji lta bu gnang zhus pas/ jo mo gzhan dang mi 'dra/ kho mo rang la thugs rjes gzigs

210 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/dbang dang byin rlabs mdzad pa nas da lta'i bar skad cig yang ma bral/ gdams ngag khyad par can rlung sems gnyis med gnang / khyed rang yang de zhus cig gsung / de bzhin du jo mo gzhan bdun gyis kyang so sor de kho na gsung / gdams ngag yang phyag rgya bzhi khrid/ lam sre ba sogs so sor lung bstan/ re re zhing 'bral med tu bzhugs gsung / yum la zhus pas de lta bu kho mos kyang mang du mthong zhing thos/ gzims khang du'ang phal cher dgyes pa rdo rje'i skur bzhugs/ res bde mchog/ res ma hā mā ya la sogs yi dam sna tshogs su bzhugs pa dang / res rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa rus rgyan can gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang / de'i tshe kho nar phyi rol na rgyud 'chad pa dang man ngag 'chad pa dang / phru dang / mkhar las dang / byis pa'i khrod na rtsed mo mdzad pa dang / bu mo mang po dang glu bro mdzad pa dang / ri khrod tu skyo bseng la 'byon pa sogs dus mtshungs pa'i mthong snang mang po mthong zhing gzhan las kyang thos/ nga rang gi snang ba la'ang 'bral med tu chos gsung gi yod ste thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i snang ba lagasamachi/ gang na'ang nged rang gnyis lan cig zhu'o gsung /snang ba la thogs brdugs med pas ri ra ba khang khyim la zang thal du byon pas sras rnams na re/ nged rang gi pha jo 'di srung dgos byung na cis kyang thub pa mi 'dug gsu/ /shā/ cig yum dang mi las bla ma chen po nyid dus gcig la sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs su 'byung ba ji ltar lags zhus pas/ rgyu mtshan zhig yod/ tshogs 'khor zhig gyis gsung / nang na phud gcig las med pas tshol dgos zhus pas/ tshol mi dgos/de gas 'ong gsung ste/ dam rdzas gcig po de la btsags tshad chang ro mchog dang ldan par byung / tshogs kyi yo byad mang po lhun grub tu'ang byung ste bu slob mang po la tshogs 'khor mdzad/ gral der 'khod pa thams cad kyis dgyes rdor bde mchog sogs yi dam

bstan pa dang sematshocan la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ 211sna tshogs par mthong ste/ shud bu lnga banangaji ltar lags zhus pas/gnas pa rtsa la g.yo ba rlung //bkod pa byang chub sems kyi rta//ro snyoms lcag gisu yongs bskul nas//'od gsal 'gro 'ong med par rgyug/dkyil 'khor gyi lha de thams cad kyi gdams ngag kho bo la yod pas cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyang 'ong thad pa yin gsung / de nas rje mi la gnya' gnya'i brag la sgrub pa la bzhugs pa la mnal lam du ḍā gis stod phyogs bal bod kyi mtshams su sgoms na dngos grub myur ba'i lung bstan byung ste/ zhur byon pas bla ma chen po sku mkhar gyi gzims chung na bzhugs pa mnal du song / sku mkhar la nyi ma shar zhing skar khung nas bla ma'i dbu la shar/ yum bzhes pa 'dren du byon pa rnams dus mtshungs pa la gtsang la yar 'gro'i glu phul bas/ bu khyod 'ongs pa dang nga gnyid tu song ba thug pa de 'o skol pha bu tshe 'dir mi phrad pa'i rten 'brel yin/ 'on kyang mkhar dang khyad par nga'i mgo la nyi ma shar ba de khyod kyis bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par nga'i bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa nyin mor byed pa yin/ bdag med mas zas khyer bas bu khyod ting nge 'dzin gyi zas kyis 'tsho ba zhig 'ong ba yin gsung nas gdams ngag gi lhag thams cad kyang dbu smyung mdzad nas gnang ste/ khyod la byin dang gzhan la byin/ /gal te srang la bcal yod na/ /sum 'gyur las kyang mi lhag ri/ /gsung /bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan/ sgrub pa ma nus pa'i tshe ngan rings la dgos pa med pas rem zhig /gangs ti se hi ma la ya'i gnas yin/ la phyi gangs ra go ta wa ri yin/ brag dmar sbo mthon ri bo 'bigs byed yin/ ri bo dpal 'bar dang yol mo

212 rje btsun marapa'i rnam thar grubapa'ingo mtsharabarjodapa/gangs ra phal po che nas lung bstan pa'i gnas yin pas de thams cad tu sgoms/ shar phyogs na de li ko ṭa'i nags rgyun ma chad pa na tsā ri tra yod ste da lta zhal 'byed pa'i dus la ma bab/ ma 'ongs pa khyod kyi sgrub rgyud kyi gnas su 'gyur/ zas nor dang tshe 'di'i ngo dga'i ched tu chos ma ston/ sdod ldan byung na zang zing gi 'bul ba med rung rjes su zung /te los na ro tshar gcod pa dang / ngas rngog dang khyod rang tshar gcod pa ltar byas na snyigs dus kyi skye bo mi thul bas thabs mkhas su gyis/ skabs cig sdug thug pa cig yod pas/ de'i dus 'di ltos/ de bar ma lta ces shog dril la tham ma zhig gnang / phyag spyi bor bzhag nas shasagadams gsungs pa/na ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs//bka' drin can gong ma'i rnam thar la//bsams na gdams ngag de ga yin//mang po thob 'dod g.yeng ba'i rgyu//gnad kyi gsung dag snying la chongs//de de mang yang de nyid med//sdong po mang yang 'bras bu med// yon tan yin yang don ldan min//de snga bslabs kyang 'di mthong med//bshad rgyu mang yang phan pa med//phan snying la thogs pa dam pa'i nor//nor phyug po 'dod na 'di la dril//

bstan padang sems can la phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 213chos nyon mongs 'dul ba thabs kyi lam//lam btsan sa 'dod na 'di la dril//sems kho thag chod pa chog shes dpon//dpon bzang po 'dod na 'di la dril//'khor ba ngu bro sgyid lug sgyur//mi med kyi rdza brag pha yi mkhar//grogs med gcig bu lha yi yul//sems la sems zhon chad med rta//rang lus dgon pa lha yi khang //yengs med dge sbyor sman gyi mchog/don dang ldan pa'i skyes bu la//don la thogs med gdams ngag byin//nga dang gdams ngag khyod dang gsum//ma rul ma sad ma skams par//bu yi lag tu bzhag pa 'dis//'bras bu lo 'dab rgyas par shog /zhes gsung zhing /bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan/ yum gyis kyang skyo ba ltar mdzad cing / ka pā la mtshan ldan gser mdog bcud kyis bkang ste gnang nas gsungs pa/khyod snying rus can gyi sdug sran can//phyi thag ring zhing ngang ring po//

214 rje btsun mar pa'i rnamathar thub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/skal ba can gyi bu khyod kyis//bla ma'i bdud rtsi ye shes chang //ngoms par 'thung la bzhud par zhu//pha dang ma gnyis ma brjed par//gsol ba yang yang 'o dod bos//snying la phan pa'i gdams ngag la//'grangs par za yin bzhud par zhu//drin dang phan pa ma brjed par//bka' drin bsam gyin snying rus mdzod//mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs zab mo'i gos//dro bar gon gyin bzhud par zhu//ma nus sems can ma brjed par//rang sems byang chub lam la chug/skal ba bzang mo'i bdag med mas//bu la snying gtam bskul bskul ba//bus kyang ma brjed snying la chongs//mas kyang yi dam mgon du bzung //sems yid mthun pa'i ma bu gnyis//o byen yul du mjal bar shog/drin lan chos kyis khor bar shog/

bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ 215zhes gsungs/ chos la'i bar du skyel thung mdzad ste der tshogs 'khor mdzad nas/mthu chen the tshom dang som nyi mi dgos/ 'o skol pha bu gnyis 'bral ba med/ khyod kyis kyang sgrub pa la rem zhig rem zhig zhes gsungs pa/ rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs//las can chos dang mthun pa'i bu//chos sku sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa bdud rtsi'i ros//rten 'brel longs sku 'grub par 31ga/sems rtsa ba byarnga chub sdong po la//sprul sku'i lo 'dab rgyas par shog/bla ma'i bka' tshig rdo rje'i gsung //snying la rjed med gnas par shog/yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs de//sgog gi rtsa bar gnas par shog/chos skyong srung ma'i rgyab rten des//'bral ba med par skyong bar shog/rten 'brel zab mo'i smon lam de// myur ba nyid du 'grub par shog/chos mdzad kun gyi thugs rje des//dus gsum kun du 'dzin par shog/

216 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/gtsang sil ma la yi la thog tu//brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gsu ma yod//sang nyin 'gro ba'i lam bar la//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma yod//pha yul zhen pa'i mkhar zhing na//mi rtag sgyu ma'i slob dpon yod//a ne+e sring mo'i nye 'khor la//sgyu ma bshig pa'i slob dpon yod//mi med lung pa'i brag phug na// 'khor 'das rje ba'i tshong dus yod//snying rus lus kyi dgon pa na//lha bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchod khang yod//nad med zwa yi tshogs 'khor la//mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i bdud rtsi yod//'phrul 'khor gnad kyi kha sgyur la//'bras rin chen skye ba'i so nam yod//yul mi rtsis chung rang yul der//'phral g.yeng ba med pa'i dge sbyor yod//mtshams dam po mi med khyi med na//rtags myur du mthong ba'i sgron me yod//

bstan pa dngasemasacan la phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 217zas dkor zas med pa'i rang zas la//bde ba lha yi pham phabs yod//grib dngas pa lha yi gzhal yas na//rang don chen 'grub pa'i ltad mo yod//ngo lkog med pa'i lha chos la//dam tshig gtsang ma'i phrin las yod//bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i so nam la//dngos grub kun gyi gter kha yod//dam chos mkha' 'gro'i srog snying la//'khor 'das 'gyes pa'i so mtshams yod//mar pa lo tsu'i bu rgyud la//gtam snyan mang po'i yong sgo yod//mi la ras pa'i snying rus la//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing yod//srog shing 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la//brgyud pa bzang po'i bkra shis shog/bka' rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog/yi dam bzang po'i bkra shis shog/bde dgyes gsang gsum bkra shis lha/ga/dam chos bzang po'i bkra shis shog/

218 rjeb0 mar pa'i rnamathar grub pa'ingo mtsharabarjod pa/mkha' 'gro'i srog snying bkra shis shog/mkha' 'gro bzang po'i bkra shis shog/gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog/chos skyong bzang po'i bkra shis shog/dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog/bu slob bzang po'i bkra shis shog/bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bkra shis 31ga/rgyud nas rgyud bcas bkra shis 31ga/bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog/don de dag ma rjed nyams su long //zhes gsungs/ zhabs spyi bor blangs ste smon lam btab nas byon no//yang lo tsā ba la chings 'on tan 'bar gyis rgya gar la byon pas lam du chom rkun gyis gsod da'i tshe bud med shing lo'i gos gyon pa cig gis sdigs mdzub btad pas jag pa rengs/ da khyod rang rgya gar la ma 'gro bar bod du nga'i ming po khosnyi he ru ka mar ba lo tsā ba bya bar yod kyis der song zhes lung bstan ste mjal nas snod ldan gyi slob mar gyur // da/ ge bshes grwa ba macan shesadang rgyag la ma dum bsamagur gsungs pa/rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//nga thang zhig dpal 31 dpal thang la//nyin rgyugs mtshan rgyugs byed tsa na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang du nyal//

bstan pa dngasem can la phan thogs mdzad tshul/ 219chu chen gaṅgā sis la//mnyan pa badz+ra sidha la//gru btsas gser du rdzong tsa na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang du nyal//gcan phreng dog mo rgal tsa na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang du nyal//'phrang bcas gser gyisardzong dus su//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang na nyal//rgya gar yul gyi mthil shed tu//sgra bsgyur lo tsā slob dus na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang na nyal//rje na ro miX la sogs la//gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul tsa na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang na nyal//gnas pudzi ha ri'i dgon pa na//gsang sngags kyi gdams pa zhu tsa na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang na nyal//bi kra ma la shi la'i gtsug lag na//dus mtshungs paṇa chen bzhi po la//

220 rje ba' marapa'i rnam thar grubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul tsa na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang na nyal//rgya gar shar phyogs pa rnams la//bsod nams chen po 'phel ba'i phyir//mchod sbyin chen po byed tsa na//khyod dwags po'i glang bu gang na nyal//zhes gsungs pas dge bshes gra pa 'gyod pa skyes ste zhabs spyi bor blangs gdams ngag du ma zhus so/ /grwa pa 'di 'khrungs sa dwags po/ mtshan dbang phyug 'bar du byas pa dang / 'khrungs sa gra skyi ru ba/ mtshan rgyal ba shes rab tu byas pa gnyis snang yang 'di ltar na dwags po yin pa dag pa 'dra'o//de ltar 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che mdzad nas sku sgros su snang ba phyin chos 'khor chen po la sogs par spyan drangs pa'i tshe'ang gzhung gi chings dang nyams len du 'di ltar dgos pa yin gnad du dril nas gsung ba ma gtogs rgyud dang / gzhung tshan can mi gsung / grong pa dang pha dpun go 'dris khyer ba tsho'i sar yug re byon nas/ bu tsho lus drang por srong la/ dar cig sems lhod snye zhog zhig ang gsung /sngar gser bres bcal phul na'ang chos la phangs pa byed gsung nas gnang dka' ba la phyis mi su gzigs tshad dang / chu la rgal 'gro ba gzigs kyang /tshur shog kho bos gdams pa sbyin//mi tshe stong zad byed pa 'phangs//gdams ngag kha rog sdod pa 'phangs /byang sdob mchog tu sems skyed dang //

bstanapadang sems can la phan thogasamadzad tshul/ 221na ro chen po'i gdams pa sbyin//gsung zhing dus 'di tsa na sems la 'di 'dra ba'i 'char sgo 'ong / de'i tshe rig pa 'dir gtod/ lus gnad 'di ltar sgyur dang / bogs 'di ltar 'ong zhes nyams len gyi gnad kho na gsung / sgang mtho sa nas bya ra mdzad/ lug gu re'u sogs sems can gyi ro gzigs so cog la grong 'jug mdzad/ slar bzhengs nas ro de snum zhul le ba rer song ba dang / spyan cer re gzigs ste/rang rang las kyis nyen pa yi//nyam thag sems can mthong tsam na//grong 'jug yal bar 'jog du 'phangs//kun yang srog la gces 'dzin na//mkhas pa nga yi gan du shog/gsung zhing shi ba'i ro kho na bya ra mdzad skad ste rnal 'byor pas grong 'jug byas na lus rten snga ma'i sems de gnas spar 'gro ba yin pas de la dgongs pa'o/ /dud 'gro 'chi ga'i rtsar byon nas 'pho ba dang chos gsungs ste/ khyod ni thos pas shin tu 'tshengs khyab la sogs pa gsungs/ mtshan mo'ang sku la 'od dkar sgor re byas nas glu gar dang /phyag rgya dang / rnam 'gyur mthong thos med pa sha stag mdzad/ lta ba rgya mtsho'i glu dang /spyod pa rgya mtsho'i glu la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig 'ba' zhig gsung / skabs skabs su/mkhas pa chen po na ro pa//'jig rten rmi lam sgyu ma yin//dus la bab na 'byon par spro//

222 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'i ngomatshar brjod pa/༵ gā ༷༷ ༵ /bye/ // // sngu/ // /zhes gsung ngo //dge bshes gra pa dang mjal ba man tshal ba bsgrig pa'i rnam thar nas byung ngo / /de lta bu'i bla ma chen po des gdan bzhi'i bshad rgyud chen mo/ /'dus pa gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud chen/ gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs/ gur dud sol gyi skor sogs la 'gyur mdzad/ spyir sngon ma rnams kyis rnye badz+rakyi rdo rjer bsgyur ba la/ rje 'dis dgye ba'i rdo rjer bsgyur ba sogs 'gyur shin du bzang po yod kyang rang skabs su der 'chad pa tsam ma gtogs/ 'gyur bcos la bsnyad nas lo tsā ba gzhan gyi ming phyis nas rang gi ming 'gyur byang du 'jug pa mi mdzad pas/ phargyud ma rgyud kyi rgyud kun 'brog 'gos kyi 'gyur sogs 'gyur byang snga ma kho na mdzad/ brtag gnyisakyi brtag ba dang po'i le'u drug ba man gyi 'grel ba bka' yang dag ba'i tshad ma/ 'bumachung nyi ma/ gur gyi sgog shing /rgyud kyi shog drilabazhi la 'grel pa/ shogadrilabaco lnga / za kyi don du chosadrug bsnyed rtsi'i chu rgyun/ ye 〈lha mnangag sogasachosachung ma bo mdzad/spyir rgyud gsung ba na dbang po rab la mtshan bstan pa/ 'bring la gleng gzhi phun tshogs bstan pa/ tha ma la tshig don thar chags su 'bru gnyer ba zhes 'chad cing / rgyud nyid 'khrugs sdebs ste mngon rtogs/ dbang chog /rab gnas/ sbyin sreg rnams su re re zhing slong ba la rgyud kyi phur pa 'don pa ces 'chad cing / 'di ltar slong nus pa na rgyud de shes par 'jog pa yin no//

(lnga pa bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad nas gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim tshul ni/)sprul pa'i sku thams cad ni gdul bya tha ma'i rtag 'dzin ldog pa dang / 'bring la skyed rim rdzogs rim du bsdu ba dang / rab la chos thams cad snang mched thob gsum las 'od gsal du dag pa ston pa'i phyir/ sku tshe ring thung gang yin yang sku des 'dul ba'i bya ba zin pa na 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom zin yang mya ngan las 'da' bar ston pa ni chos nyid yin pas mthar gzugs sku sdu ba yang bstan ste/ nga'i dro bo lung 'di la dar gud shin du che ba sna tshogs cig yong bar 'dug /tshe lo bcu pa mgo 'bur byung tshe nga'i sprul pa rnal 'byor ba cig gis zangs phug gi gnas 'dir mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus ste skal ldan gyi don byed pa cung zhig 'byung / spyir bskal chung bdun phrag re'i 'pho mtshams la nga'i sprul pa re sus kyang ngo mi shes par 'byung / sras mkhar 'di mi nag pas bzung nas dkor la 'bag pa'ang 'byung zhing / mthar mchod rten du gyur nas thams cad kyis bskor ba zhig 'ong / nga'i bka' rgyud kyis dzam gling thams cad khyab par 'gyur gsung /de nas gra slob rnams bsdus ste/ khyed rnams le lo mi khom par gda'/ kho bo la ḍā zhi'i gsu ba byung bas 'gro dgos par 'dug /dpal na ro pa gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa kho bo gsu ba la phebs byung / khyed rnams maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa shoms la gsol ba thob/ lar grong 'jug gcig nas gcig du rgyud na 'chi ba'i ming yod la med cig yong bar 'dug ste/ bla ma'i bka'as mkha' spyod 'gro don che bas shog gsung ba ltar 'gro/ bla ma yi dam thams cad kyang kho bo dang dbyer med du 'dug /lar te lo na ro bya ba yang kho bo rang yin go'am gsung nas ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i mod

224 rje bas mar pa'i rnam thar grub pa'ingo mtshar brjod pa/la/ bdag med ma rdo rje lus kyi 'du byed sdus gsung nas 'od dkar po cig yum la thim pa'i mod la yum 'od dkar po cig du gyur ste bla ma'i thugs kur thim/deng sang yum bdag med ma'i dbu thod yin zer ba du ma yod pa rnams yum gzhan gyi dbu thod yin srid la/ yum bdag med ma dngos ni sku lus ma bzhag pa yin no/ /de'i mod la sku srang mnyam bzhag ma mdzad nas bu kun 'pho ba sgom na 'di ltar sgom pa yin gsung nas/ dbu'i tshangs bug gi dbu thod zur gsum pa dbu skra dang bcas pa tsheg sgra dang bcas nas/ na mkha' la 'dom gang tsam 'phar/ sa la babs byung ba la/ nang la dgyes rdor rigs lnga ring srel las grub pa 'dug /de'i mod la dbu gtsug nas 'od kyi gong bu zla ba tsam zhig na mkha' la song ste/ lho brag gi lung pa thams cad khyab pa'i 'ja' 'od dang / me tog gi char dang / ḍa ma ru dang / rol mo'i sgra zhag so bdun du rgyun ma cha/ ṭ+wāṃ /lu/nga gi sa la spur sbyang du ma stub par kyi srubs su spyan drangs ste/ thugs kyi sras mtshur ston dbang ngesasbyangs pas yi ge a yig dang gdung ring srel tshan can byon ste/ gdung phal cher phyis rngog du spyan drangs ste dngul gyi gdung khang du bzhugs pa phyis gdung khang chen mor bzhugs la/ gdung thal dang so phag na za bzhugs stan sogs bzhugs pa'i sku 'bum thugs kyi sras mgo legs sogs kyis sngon gyi mchod khang spe'u dmar ༵ dbyi sbrel nas bzhengs ste/ spre'u dmar po sgo nub la lta ba bsgyur ste sku 'bul lta bar ṭ+wāṃ /kā kā/ /rnam thar rnams na mi snang yang dro bo lung zangs phug yin pa snyam la/ rngog pa sogs dgung lo gya drug shing mo glang lo la thim par 'chad cing / yig cha rnying ma kun na dgung lo brgyad bcu pa bya lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba zer ba mang bar snang bas/ de lta na lo bzhis snga ba'i lcags mo bya lo dang dgung lo gya gnyis par snang / tshes kyang tshes gsum

gzug sku chosadabyings su thim tshul/ 225dang bcu bzhi bco lnga sogs mang du snang yang / zla ba bcu gnyis pa cho 'phrul gyi zla bar byed pa sngon gyi lugs byas pa'i tshe bco lnga yin nges par snang ste/ sngon skyes mchog mchod pa yul mis byed pa cig 'phyi mo tshun yod par snang ba'ang hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga la byed par snang bas/ de gso ba'i phyir bdag gis dro bo lung du tshul btsugs pa'ang de dang dus bsgrigs pa yin no//rje de'i rig dang chosakyi zasaganyisalas/ jo mo bdag med ma la 'khrungs pa dar ma mdo sde dang / dar ma dpal/ phyag thung ma la dar ma bsam gtan/ 'di la sras dar ma grags bya ba snang yang gdung ma zin/ gzhan bzang nge / ngan ne+e/ dge 'dun/ bya ring 'khor lo ste lnga byon yang gdung rgyud ma byung / rngog mdo sde rje mar pa'i sras su nan gyis sgrub pa de 'dra snang yang / de lta na rje mar pa la rigs rgyud mi 'byung bar lung bstan pa dang / rje mar bas/ nag thang shing rgyudasgyu 'brel pa de/ /bu tsha po rgyud ba 'dzin pa yin/ /zhes rngog la gdung rgyud 'byung bar lung bstan pa gnyi ga brdzun par skur ba bta~X ༵rnyi ༷tri~X che//na byon tshulani/ spyir bsam gyis mi khyab kyang yongs su grags pa rngog ston chen po shes rab kyis mnyes pa'i sras/ mtshur ston sku dgra btul bas mnyes pa'i sras/ me ston zhabs tog gis mnyes ba'i sras/ mi la dad gus kyis mnyes pa'i sras ste mnyejigapa'i bu bzhi/ yang spyal pa shud sgom sba ba rtogs pas mnyes pa'i sras sdon zhing / mi la thod rgal gyi sras gcig du'ang byed/ sras mdo sde la grong 'jug gi bka' babs/ dol ba gag ston la sgyu lus kyi bka' babs/ gra'i mi chung la 'pho ba'i bka' babs/ chu gong dpal le la rim lnga'i bka' babs/ dge bshes kher gad ba la gzhung bshad kyi bka' babs pa ste bka' bababangakyi snye lnga/ gzhung gi mes tshon chung la gtum mo'i bka' babs kyang zer/

226 rje btsun mar pa'irnamatharagrubapa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/dge bshes kher gad pa 'di kher gad lo cwa ba 'khor lo grags yin par byed snang yang / de a bh+ya'i slob ma yin pas rje mar pa mjal tsam las med pa 'dra zhing khong gi khu bo lta bu zhig yin par snang ngo / /klog skya lo tsā ba 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan/ tsam lung gi mar pa mgo legs/ la yag gi ba rang sba ba can/ 'phan yul gyi nya ma dpal mo ste mobangagu can bzhi/ yang klog skya ba rang gi khar zhang rgyang mkhar ba dang / rta shul ba shud gong dpal le snon pa'ang lugs gcig go/gzhan yang lha rje se ring / 'phrang gi rgya ston zhig po/ mar pa bya ze/ myang sgom grang ltag pa/ gtsang pa dang yos/ ra sangs sgom pa/ lto smad pa dam pa lha ras/ yar lungs pa bug rme brtsegs/ rgya 'ching ru ba ting 'dzin bzang po la sogs pa dpag tu med la/chibasakha ba sto ba rta sgom ni/ snga phyi gnyis las/ snga ma des chibs pa 'jog pa'i ne+e sing khong rang gi gzims mal nas mthong ba mdzad ste bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes/ lus 'dis mkha' spyod grub/ dbu rtse dmar po'i nang na sku 'dra dang dbu zhwa yod/ chibs pa'i rte'u skyes sar chu mig yang byung / chibs pa de'i zhabs rjes kyang dbu rtse dmar po'i skor lam 3 yod/ phyi ma des sku che'i smad kyi chibs khab mdzad de phyis 'gro don yang che bar byung ji /la/sa rngog ston chen po ni sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod grub/ rngog mdo sde'i sras gtsang du 'khrungs pa jo sras tshul khrims shes rab nas bzung ste gtsang tsha rgyud ces rngog tshur gong ma spre zhing bzung ste bstan pa'i srog rtsa bzung zhing / ri bor 'brungs pa jo sras thogs med grags pa nas rgyal che rgyud ces rngog tshang 'og mar gdung rgyud 'phel/ 'di dag las bshad rgyud kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu byung ngo //mtshur stonadabang gi rdo rje nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstan pa kun mkhyen bu ston nasabazung shar tsong kha pa chen po dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i mkhas pa

gzugs chosadabyingasasuzim tshul/ 227dpag med byung zhing shin du dar ro/ /me ston tshon po nas brgyud pa mang po'i bar grub thob zar ma chad cing / ma hā mā ya 'dzin no cog 'di'i slob rgyun yin no// gzhan slob ma rnams kyang so sor phrin las che bar byung la/ rje mi la la ras chung pa dang / zhi ba 'od dang / ngam rdzong pa sogs snyan rgyud 'dzin pa'i bu chen du ma'i chos rgyud da lta yod pa dang / khyad par zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po 'dzin pa'i ched tu byon pa rje sgam po pa nas rje sgom tshul dang / zhang rin po che sogs tshal pa'i bka' rgyud/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa nas rkarma bka' rgyud/ 'bab rom pa nas 'bab rom bka' rgyud/ dpal phag mo gru pa nas/ 'bri khung pa/ stag lung pa/ khye1 phu ba/ smar pa/g.yam bzang pa/ shug gseb pa sogs dang / grub thob gling nas dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bka' rgyud sogs re re 'ang yan lag mang po dang bcas pas rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du khyab par dar zhing rgyas so//rgyud kun gsung ba rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid//rdo rje slob dpon mchog dngos grub pa'i skur bzhengs pa//mnga' bdag mar ston zhes grags bdag med lha mor bcas//dpal ldan dgyes pa'i rdo rje de la bdag phyag 'tshal//'khor lo'i 'du bas mchod dgyid nongs kun 'chags//mdzad la yi rang theg mchog gsung bar bskul//nam yang mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol//'gro kun he ru ka dpal nyid 'grub shog/mgon de'i dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs dgyid cing //theg mchog snying po'i bstan pa rin chen dngos//

228 rje bas mar pa'i rnam thar grubapa'ingo mtsharabarjodapa/skal ldan gdul bya'i rgyud la dpel med pas//mi nub bstan pa mtha' dbus kun khyab 31ga/bstan pa'i dben dang mi mthun phyogs med cing //bdud kyi las rnams mthu med rang sar zhi//'gro kun dam pa'i chos kyi sdod gyur pas//dgyes mdzad he ru ka dpal myur 'grub shog/rje lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gyi gleng slong ba 'di ni/ rje mar pa nyid la gsol ba btab cing / rnam thar mi 'dra ba bcagasum las legs par btus ste sngon nas 'dun pa dang ldan pa du mas bskul ba dang / khyad par stag lung thang pa chen po'i ga zi'i gdung las sa skyong ba nor bu'i mtshan can gyis bskul ba dang / bka' rgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag stobs kyis sa skyong ba chen po sku rabs nas sa skyong gasnyel rgyalabartan ba 'phral du bskul ba las/ lo tsā ba chen po de nyid kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dpalar/lngan lag phreng ba/ ming gzhan mi pham snar+sha(kyi rgyal po don yongs su grub pas rang lo drug stob chu mo phag gi lo la/ rje de nyid kyi gdan sa chen po dpal dro bo lung sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho brang chen po sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang // zlozlo / ༵ bar sbyar ba legs par grub bo/ /spar du grub nas kyang lan du mar zhusarig byedapa ni bdud 'dulardo rjedang / rigargyal/ bkrasadagos/ bkrasalegs/ dgos dgosadang/ chosadabangardorje/ rdorjebasam 'grubasogs/ mched pobargyad kyis rnam rgyal rtse rubasgrubs/ dgebasabla med byangachubamyur thob shog //ma la//

dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam/༄tsho/ /rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa 'khrul pa'i bzhin ras 'char ba'i me mthong zhes bya ba bzhugs zag//'tsha/ kās bdag bcom ldan 'das mi skyod zhabs kyi pad+ma la gus pas rtag tu phyag bden pa'i sku gsung thugs grub bden par gsung / /bden pa mthar phyin bden pa'i lam gyis dkri/ /bden pa'i mthar thug mi skyod zhabs btud nas/ /rang gi ngang tshul bden par bri bar bya/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi 'byung khungs bdag ma yin/ /rdzun du smras na rang gzhan gnyi ga nyams/ /mngal nas skyes pa tsam zhig kun gyis shes/ /srid pa grub tshul brjod na ha cang mangs/ /deng sang grub rtags mngon sum ston skad dang / /sprul par grags pas sa steng gang ba'i dus/ /bdag tshul ngan pa tha shal 'di brjod pas/ /kun gyis brnyas pa'i gnas las gzhan cir 'gyur/ /'on yang rnyed bkur grags pa rgyun chad na/ /chos kyi gegs sol thar 'dod bsam pa grub/ /rang rgyud byang chub lam dang ma 'gal na/ /'gro kun rdog pas bdag lus brdzis kyang sla/ /che 'di'i che thabs tsam zhig kho na'i slad/ /mi chos bla ma'i rdzun chen smra byed cing / /yon po'i blo can mtshams kun las 'das pa/ /de 'drar bdag sogs nam yang ma gyur cig/de lta mod kyi deng sang thub pa'i bstan/ /ston zla tha ma'i me tog lta bur gyur/ /tshig gi bklag lung tsam re ma gtogs pa/ /gsung rab phal gyi bshad rgyun sgrub rgyun

230 dpa' bogatsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam nyams/ /rgyud dbang gdams ngag phal gyi byin rlabs yal/ /man ngag thams cad tshong dus 'o mar song / /rang gzo'i chos zab sar byung grangs mang yang / /phal cher dmus long mig 'byed mkhan ltar mthong / /thos bsam sgom pa ltar snang byed rnams kyang / /phal cher tshe 'di'i zang zing sgrub ched 'dra/ /zas gos med rnams phal cher chos sgor 'jug /chos pa rnams ni sde dpon 'dod nas g.yengs/ /sngags rnams rtsed mo'am grong chog rgyu ru song / /klog po mang zhig ne+e tsho'i tshig 'drar zad/ /dus 'dir bdag 'dra ngan pa'i spyod tshul ni/ /bri bas ci bya bris kyang su la phan/ /tham thom kun gyis rnam thar bka' 'bum byed/ /'di 'dra thub bstan nub 'gyur ltas kyang yin/ /de phyir bdag nyid k+to rdzu sna tram̐ shā dī lha/ / /nan gyis snga phyir bskul po dag gi ngor/ /skyon sbas yon tan ltar 'di yang yon tan dpag yas cig yod nas/ /gsangs so snyam pa 'gog phyir kho na yin/ /bdag yul dbu ru'i snye thang zhes bya ste/ /rus ni shar gyi snyags ces bya ba yin/ /rigs ni rgyal rigs rgyal srid nyams gyur nas/ /rje'ur lhung ba zhig yin pha ma gnyis/ /dbul po chos ldan dad can zhig yin no/ /sngon tshe rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa cig /mtshan ni chosadabang lhun grub ces bya ba/ /mngon shes thob cing brtul zhugs grub pa byung / /de la gzhan gyis dpa' bo'i mtshan du bsgrags/ /phyi nas spyan ras gzigs dbang bdun pa'i bka'as/ /dpal ldan dro bo lung byon seng khrir bzhugs/ /lo 'ga' zhig na mya ngan 'da' nye tshe/ /nyi 'og dbus kyi dbu g.yor gnyis su byon/ /rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs phyi ni/ /dbu ru'i bsnams nas bzung ste zhag zung mdzad/ /snye thang mkhar nag thad tu gdan phebs tshe/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rje'i nyams 'ur ste/ /ya nga cher bzung med pa'i spyod mang mdzad/ /da ni bdag rang ci bde'i gnang ba stsol/ /khyod spyan bdag la ring zhig rtag tu gzigs/ /bdag gi tshab mar 'di nyid skos

'khrulapa'i bzhinarasa'achar ba'i melong / 231cig zhes/ /nyid slob mkhas grub sangs blo'i phyag nas bzung / /de ltar gsol btab 'da' bar bzhes nas/ /rdo rje'i spyod 'gros shugs 'byung 'ur bzhin pas/ /nyid kyi gzims gur nang byon zhag gsum du/ /bsnyun pa'i tshul mdzad chu phag gro bzhin zla'i/ /tshes bzhi'i tho rengs gzugs sku'i g.yo ba bsdus/ /'ja' 'od me tog char sogs kyis bskul ste/ /yul de'i mi rnams bskor mchod bya phyir 'dus/ /tshes brgyad nyin gung dus la bab ru 'i tshe/ /bdag gi ma yis tshogs 'khor khyer nas ni/ /ngu zhing gdung zhal mjal bar gsol btab nas/ /yol ba'i bar nas spyi bos gtugs pa'i mod/ /thugs dam 'phos pa'i rnam pa gsal byung bas/ /'di las sku skye 'byung zhes kha tshon bcad/ /grib zas sogs la 'dzems ces ngag yang bsgos/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud mang gis gleng bar gyur//de nas zla dgu ngo bcu 'das pa yi/ /shing pho byi ba dpyid tha sa ga'i zla/ /zla ba snar ma lhan cig spyod pa'i dus/ /bdag ni bud med de las btsas gyur pas/ /kun gyis bla ma de yi sku skyer bsgrags/ /la las grong 'jug byas ces sgrog pa'ang byung / /mig ni ma zum bye bar skyes ces grag /ring por ma lon ngag yang bye gyur ste/ /ngag du sems can rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /byis pas 'gro don nus par shog zhes pa/ /'di sna gtam gyi thog ma yin no skad/ /phyin chad lo grang bzhi lnga 'on gyibar/ /ngag du phal cher 'di nyid zer bar grags/ /cung zad lon nas gra slob che phran kun/ /kha cig sdom bu bsod snyoms spyod chul dang / /tshong dang klog ma khan sogs su gzugs bsgyur nas/ /du mas brtags tshe ngos 'dzin lan mang byas/ /the tshom med pa'i yid ches skyes so skad/ /de tshe sa skyong don yod rdo rje yis/ /dpya khral sdud pa'i bkrabs pa zung dag la/ /brtag par bsgos nas de dag gis bos ste/ /brong rig tshong nyul du ma byas pa'i tshe/ /nyam nga med cing sgam po'i lan btab nas/ /rangs pa ra byas ces phyi dus gzhan las thos/ /gong dkar shag ba

232 dpa' bogatsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam dang i nag lhun po/ /'brug pa'i bla ma bsam gtan pa ces pas/ /bkra shis gling zhes bya bar bos pa'i tshe/ /ma yi pang par khros pa'i bzhin gyis 'dug /dro la bab nas sder gtan brims pa'i tshe/ /gog po byas nas sder gtan kun bsdus ste/ /brtsegs pa'i steng du skyil krung gis 'dug nas/ /dga' zhing 'dzum pas gzi ldan lta'o skad//gzhan yang bus pa gog po dgyid tsam nas/ /slong ba mthong na gang zin yang yang skyel/ /de slad g.yul khar khong gis mi 'khyer skad/ /snying rje che bas srog chags gnod mi byed/ /dkon mchog rten la gus cing mchod par grags/ /khyad par slob dpon pad+ma la gus ste/ /bus pa dus chos tha snyad mi shes tshe'ang / /tshes bcu nam yin snga bar langs nas kyang / /de ring tshes bcu yin pas gtor tshogs gyis/ /ces bskul rtsed mo'i gtor tshogs rang nyid shom/ /cho ga'i rnam 'gyur tshig bcas byed to skad/ /de phyir tshes bcu'i tshes grangs ma nges pa'i/ /phyi mi kun yang bdag la 'dri bar grags/ /de dag 'ga' zhig chos kyi bag chags dang / /rigs kyi mtshan ma phra mo yin par go /de nas sa skyong don yod rdo rje yis/ /bla nas bdag cag (bdag dang bdag gi ma bur rdzi bla ma bsam 'grub dgeslongagrub padang dge slong chosadabyingasapa rim gro pa gnyisarnamasayin/mag/) du ma'i 'tsho ba sbyar/ /lo lnga'i bar du yul dang nye bar 'dug/de tshe lto rgyud shar phyogs gnas shed tu/ /dge bsnyen tsha lung brag btsan zhes bya ba'i/ /sngon gyi dgon gnas rnying pa'i gzhi bdag zhig /mi la babs nas rtsub 'gyur sna tshogs byas/ /bla rdol lung bstan mang po byas pa'i zhar/ /snye thang rgya mo gong zhes bya ba na/ /da lta rnal 'gror rol pa'i ye shes yod/ /kho bo nyi zer 'di la spyan 'dren 'dod/ /khyed rnams myur du spyan 'dren mi byed na/ /zhing khams nye ba'i gnas 'dir spo 'o skad/ /rkyen des bskul ste lto phyogs rim pas bos/ /lam du sa skyong don yod rdo rje'i

'dzisprupa'i bzhin ra 'amar ba'i me long / 233bka'as/ /bskul ste skyi smad lhun po'i rtse ru phyin/ /mi dbang skyed tshal 'dug pa'i mdun du khrid/ /rang 'khor rnams kyis phyag la bskul ba'i tshe/ /kho ni khyim pa hor 'dra yin pa ste/ /nga ni btsun pa'i bla ma yin pas na/ /phyag mi byed ces nan tan smra bar byas/ /slar yang rang 'khor rnams kyis cher bsdigs nas/ /phyag gi brda tsam byas tshe dam tshig gi /thal mo sbyar tshe thal mo'ang 'di 'dra zhes/ /khong cag rgyal blon ngo mtshar gad mo byed/ /khong gis bdag mnyam byis pa 'ga' khrid nas/ /'di ni dpa' bo'isnye ba yin no zhes/ /bdag gi drung du dkri bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ /de dag bkad sa'i gral du nye ba na/ /dngangs cing ngus ste dkri bar ma nus so/ /dge tshul gzhon nu chung ngu 'ga' bkris ste/ /'di dag khyod kyi sngon gyi slob ma yin/ /ngos 'dzin byin rlabs gyis ces zer ba'i tshe/ /'di rnams bdag gis ngo mi shes ces smras/ /de sogs nyams sad du mas co dris kyang / /bdag gi sems rgyud g.yo bar ma nus pas/ /bsngags pa cher brjod zang zing mang byin ste/ /phyi nas gdong grogs thams cad nged dgyid ces/ /lam bar du yang mi snang bcas ste mngags//de nas g.yor 'bros lho shar rnams brgyud nas/ /lho phyogs sngags spyod zhing gi nub kyi cha/ /bka' brgyud chu bo'i bka' babs kun gyi mgo /dpal ldan dro bo lung gi gdan sar phyin/ /de rnams kun du'ang mngon shes phra mo dang / /sngon gyi ngos 'dzin du ma byas so zhes/ /tshur mthong skye bo du ma mgu bar gyur/ /mos gus mthar phyin shākya dhā dza dang / /mkhas cing grub pa sangs rgyas blo gros ste/ /gzur gnas skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis kyis/ /bdag gi bla ma'i sprul pa khyod nyid ces/ /khyad par ched tu nan tan bdag gir mdzad/ /chos dang zang zing du mas legs bskyangs pas/ /bka' drin rmad tu byung bar phyi nas rig /khyad par rje btsun shākya ṅgā dza la/ /bdag gis zhabs tog ci yang ma grub pas/ /deng sang sems la phreng bar bdog na yang / /ci nus dam chos sgrub las thabs

234 dpa' bo gtsug lag phrengaba'irang rnam ma brnyed/ /rgyu mtshan de dag cam zhig kho na las/ /bdag la sku skye'i ming du grags pa ste/ /sngon gnas gsal ba ci yang ma dran to/ /'on yang sngon gyi grwa slob yon bdag sogs/ /du ma gsal bar ming nas brjod sogs dang / /yo byad lhag chad nor 'khrul sel ba dang / /mgur ma len dang chos 'brel 'chad pa ni/ /gzhan gyis ma bslabs thogs med 'byung ba sogs/ /ya mtshan ltar snang mang zhig byung snang ste/ /yang na rtog med shes pa'i ngor shar ram/ /yang na lha'am bdud kyis brlams pa 'am/ /yang na dran nas phyin chad brjed gyur tam/ /ci yin gang yang bdag gis ma 'chal to//de bzhin skye ba yang snga'i tshogs kyang ni/ /sngon gnas dran pa'i mngon shes med pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis dran pa ci yang ma mchis so/ /gzhon pa'i dus su nyams snang yengs thabs su/ /rtse kun gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba yi/ /ri bo'i spo la lung sul shar lta ba/ /spang ljongs me tog bkra zhing nags phran can/ /ri dwags du ma bag yangs rgyu ba yi/ /byang gi ngos su brag phug bde ba'i nang / /rang nyid gcig pur bsam gtan dgyid pa'i tshul/ /skyo zhing dga' la shes pa gsal ba zhig /yang yang gsal ba'i ngang du yengs thabs 'gro/ /res 'ga' thang yangs lag thil lta bu la/ /nags tshal mdzes pa phreng bar bkod 'dra zhing / /phyogs 'gar spos ngad ldang 'dra'i spang ri sngo/ /mtho mdzes snying gi mun pa sel ba bzhin/ /ri ngos bar bar brag ri sngon po ni/ /ut+pal sngon po spungs pa'i phung po bzhin/ /bar bar dang ba'i chu mtsho mdzes pa ni/ /ha cang che dang chung ba ma yin pa/ /be+eḍūr+ya yis me long nyis pa bzhin/ /de la ut+pa la dang pad+ma yi/ /me tog rgyas pas kun nas khebs pa ni/ /nam mkha'i ngos la gza' skar bkra ba bzhin/ /sna tshogs chu byas kun nas mdzes pa ni/ /g.yo ba'i rin chen gcal du bkram pa bzhin/ /chu skyes mgrin pa lto rlung gis bskyod tshe/ /lha yi bu mo bro gar byed pa bzhin/ /rnam mang ri dgasartse zhing bag phebs pa/ /'phrul gyi gzugs brtan rnam par g.yo ba bzhin/ /ljon shing

bzang rnams me tog dog pa dang / /mang zhig 'bras bu bzang pos dud pa ni/ /rdzogs ldan sar du byung ba'i ljon pa bzhin/ /de ltar ya mtshan dpag med ldan pa yi/ /dben pa dben pa mchog gi ri yi sul/ /ljon shing drung na lo ma'i spyil po'i nang / /shing shun gos gyon bsam gtan dgyid snyam byed/ /dga' dang skyo ba dus gcig 'phel byed pa/ /de lta'i snang bas ring du yengs pa byung / /gzhan yang de lta mang zhig byung mod kyang / /de yi mod la nyams snang sad pa'i tshe/ /cung zad tsam yang rtog pas mi dran par/ /yid yul wal wal byed pa kho na byung / /de dag sngon skyes zhig gi bag chags sam/ /gnas skabs rtsa rlung 'dus tshul tsam zhig gam/ /ci yin rang gis 'tshal bar ma gyur to//sngon tshe rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo yis/ /sngon gnas du ma dran par zhal 'ches cing / /yid rton gtan tshigs bcas pa 'ga' snang mod/ /a 'thas 'dzin rtog rags pa zhi gyur nas/ /ting 'dzin shes pa las rung gyur pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa'i myong ba 'dres pa'i tshe/ /bla ma yi dam rgyal dang rgyal sras dang / /dus gsum rigs drug la sogs rnam mang po/ /dbyer med bdag nyid yin par mthong ba dang / /bdag nyid de dag yin par mthong ba'ang 'char/ /rang nyid ri dang ljon shing du mthong dang / /ri ljon bdag nyid yin par mthong ba'ang yod/ /mchog gi dngos grub mthar phyin mi la yis/ /rnal 'byor nyams la ci yang 'char zhes gsungs/ /de tshe de de'i skye bar khas len pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa 'di shin du mang na yang / /gcig tu yid brtan rung bar ma mthong ngo / /slob mas bla ma'i rnal 'byor rab goms cing / /cung zad spangs rtogs mtho bar gyur pa na/ /bla ma de yis byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ /de yi sprul pa'am skye bar grags pa'ang yod/ /rgyal sras gzhan don rlabs chen spyod pa rnams/ /gdul bya 'dul ba'i dgos pa'i dbang mthong nas/ /rang las spangs rtogs mtho 'am dma' yang rung / /rgyal sras gzhan gyis skye ba yin tshul sogs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'ang

236 dpa' bo gtsugalag phrengaba'i rang rnam gsungs/ /de bzhin zas nor tsam re sgrub pa'i slad/ /khas len mi len gu zhig len pa'ang mang / /sngon gnas dran pa'i mngon par shes pa yang / /bar do'i skabs dang phyi rol drang srong dang / /nyan rang rnams dang rgyal sras sems dpa' dang / /grub pa'i rnal 'byor kun la'ang yod mod kyi/ /re re'ang khyad par mtha' yas yod par go /de slad gcig du yid rton mi spra'o//de nas rang lo drug ba'i ngo shar nas/ /lo ngo gnyis su dben par mtshams bgyis ste/ /bla ma rtogs ldan dge 'dun rgya mtsho yis/ /ka kha nas bzung yig 'bru klog pa bslabs/ /lte ngag mi bde shes rab 'bring gyur yang / /slob pa 'jur pas bklag pa byang gyur nas/ /brgyad stong pa dang grwa lnga sdud pa dang / /mtshan brjod do ha phag mo'i cho ga ste/ /'di dag bklag chos kho na byas pa yis/ /blo la byang ba nyid tu chud par gyur/ /phyi dus mi ta'i rnam thar che ba dang / /zab mo'i nang don gzhung mang nyin bzhin du/ /bklags pa kho nas blo la chud pa yin/ /de dag yi ge'i don yang cung zad go /rkyen desaskyo dang res 'ga' snying rje yis/ /yun ring bar du ngu bas 'da' ba'ang byung / /khyad par brgyad stong pa nyid tshar re dang / /sum cha gcig re nyin res thon par gyur/ /de dus sgrib pa cung zad dag gyur pas/ /du sogs rtags snang du ma 'bad med byung / /khyad par thig le thig phran lu gu rgyud/ /bar snang thams cad chod pa rtag tu shar/ /ci zhig tshe na thig le thig phran rnams/ /kha dog sna tshogs phra ba'i nang rol nas/ /lha dang lha mo'i gzugasabartan rab mdzes pa/ /kha dog sna tshogs dar gyi sham thabs can/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan mang thogs pa/ /rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa mang mthong nas/ /de la ltad mo che snyam yid rab dga'/ /zhag 'ga' nas ni de dag mi snang bar/ /thig le'i nang du go mtshon gyis spras pa/ /skyes pa g.yul ngor chas 'dra mang du mthong / /ci zhig nas ni de dag rnams kyis mtshon/ /lhan cig bdag la rdeg pa nyid mthong nas/ /skrag zhing dngangs

ste brgyal nas snying rlung gyur/ /de dag lam rtags phra mor 'dug na yang / /nyams can dge ba'i bshes kyis ma zin pas/ /gong ma'i lam du dbugs phyin ma gyur to//lo drug tshe na yongs 'dzin shākya las/ /grub rgyal tshe dbang sras mkhar chos drug gi /gtum mo'i zhor khrid o rgyan gling pa yi/ /gter ma'i thang yig tho thing bka' chems rnams/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel pa tsam du thob//lo bdun tshe na 'jam dbyangs gnyis pa ni/ /dpal ldan 'chi med zhabs kyis rjes bzung nas/ /drag sgrub thing ga'i dbang dang tshe dbang sogs/ /chos dang zang zing bka' drin du ma mdzad//lo brgyad lon tshe sa skyong don yod pas/ /mchod pa'i yo byad rnam pa mang po yis/ /mchod khang gong 'og mchod par bya phyir dang / /bdag yang rab tu 'byung bar bskul ba'i slad/ /skya ser sbrel ma 'khor bcas mngags te byung / /de tshe gang la mkhan po zhu 'os ces/ /slar la pho nya sring bar byas pa na/ /rgyu mtshan du mas dogs pa bsal ba'i rjes/ /g.yung pa rtogs ldan dang nang pa rdza bum pa/ /zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin nyid mkhan por 'os/ /dang por nged kyi gan du 'ong bar gyis/ /brda spyor mthun rkyen ma lus byed to ces/ /sa skyong de yis dbugs dbyung cher mdzad kyang / /ring por ma thogs dus kyis gnam du gshegs//rang lo dgu pa sar ma thag nyid nas/ /lam du zhugs ste rim gyis dbus phyogs bgrod/ /lo de chu pho spre'u'i lo yin ste/ /'phags pa'i yul na aṅgi ra zhes zer/ /de yi dgun ra mgo zla'i mar gyis ngo'i/ /gral tshes dgu pa'i gdugs phyed nye ba'i tshe/ /dad dge dang bcas bdun gyi tshogs dbus su/ /dge bsnyen bar ma rab byung sngon

238 dpa' bo gtsug lag phrengaba'i rang rnam 'gro bas/ /dge tshul yongs su rdzogs pa'i bslab pa nos/ /gnas ni lha brgyad gangs kyi rwa ba'i dbus/ /'brang rgyas ri zhol yangs ldan gtsug lag khang / /mkhan po don gyi slad tu mtshan spros pa/ /rgyal ba zhwa dmar dbang gi cod pan can/ /chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang nyid/ /dge tshul nyid kyi las kyi slob dpon ni/ /snar thang gdan sasdom brtson shes dpal yin/ /chosargyal don grub ces par ming du btags/ /mkhan po'i drung du spyan snga phyag chen dang / /lnga ldan dwags po'i chos bzhi'i rnam bshad thob/ /dgyes par mdzad cing zang zing mang du gnang / /zla phyed nye ba'i bar du bsnyen nas kyang / /slar yang dbu ru lha ldan yul grur phyin//dgun 'bring rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes lnga la/ /thub chen chos kyi 'khor lo'i sde chen por/ /rgyal ba karma'i phrin las 'dzin pa'i zhabs/ /dgung lo nga bdun bzhes pa cig mjal ste/ /thog mar tshe dpag med mgon lha dgu ma/ /dze ta ri yi lugs kyi dbang bskur mdzad/ /grub rgyal ma dang te bu'i rgyun khyer gnang / /'jam dbyangs dkar nag mi g.yo dkar po dang / /'byung 'dul rta mgrin zla ba rgyal mtshan lugs/ /shwa na bzhi bskor phag mo'i dbang bka' dang / /ber nag lcam dral chos skyong phran lngar bcas/ /tshogasabadag dmar chen ku ru kul+le dang / /gur zhal dur khrod bdag po la sogs pa'i/ /yi dam chos skyong du ma'i rjes gnang ni/ /sgrub thabs yig snar bcas pa du ma dang / /ngan rdzong snyan rgyud sgam po snyan rgyud dang / /dme chos drug mi tra'i khrid drug sogs / /lung khrid mang zhig gzhan zhor tsam du thob/ /phyi dus klog pa kha thon byed tshe yang / /sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis dbang rgyud 'grel par bcas/ /dus mkhyen rol pa'i zhabs dang de bzhin gshegs/ /don ldan zhabs kyi bka' 'bum tshang ba dang / /rang byung bka' 'bum po ti gnyis la sogs/ /dbang lung tshang dang kha 'thor mang zhig thob/ /lhan cig skyes sbyor ro snyoms sgang dril dang / /sku gsum ngo sprod la sogs khrid kyi tshogs/ /mang zhig nyams

'khrul pa'i bzhin rasa'achar ba'ime long/ 239khrid lta bu'i tshul du gnang / /lo dgu na ni rang lor nyer brgyad bar/ /phal cher dam pa 'di la bsten mod kyang / /shas char skal pa dman zhing brtson 'grus zhan/ /bsti bstang sri zhu'i yo byad dman phyir dang / /klog pa'i dus dang 'brel ba nyid kyi phyir/ /gzhan zhor zegs ma'i chos khu 'thung ba las/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i chu gter gting yangs la/ /ji tsam 'dod par btung du ma byung ngo //rang lo bstoganyig lon ma thag nyid tu/ /spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi sprul pa ni/ /skyes chen dam pa snyug la rje dang mjal/ /bka' gdams glegs bam dbang lung khrid bcas dang / /lha bzhi'i khrid dang rjes gnang dpe chos dang / /lam yig la sogs bka' gdams skor 'ga' dang / /mkha' spyod zhabs kyi gser phreng chen mo sogs/ /zla gsum bar du nyin mtshan chos kyis 'das/ /'di la ting 'dzin bag chags bzang bar snang / /klog pa'i grwa ru 'di dag 'grib srid pas/ /sgom la gzhol ba 'thad ces yang yang gsung / /nged kyang nam 'chi mi shes re zhig du/ /'di nyid tu sdod chos kun rdzogs bya zhes/ /yang yang nan du bka' bstsal gsung na yang / /bdag gi grogs rnams nyan par ma spyod ste/ /nan gyis zhus nas 'gro bar chas pa'i tshe/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang mdzad/ /rgyas pa'i mdog can sngags mdung rab bsngags pa/ /'di la tshe yi rten 'brel yod to ces/ /nyid kyi phyag gis bdag gi mgul du btags/ /zang zing mang po'i bka' drin mdzad ste btang / /phyi rol sleb tshe slar yang shog zhig gsung / /skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i phyag sil gnang / /zhabs thil spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhag nas kyang / /smon lam mang mdzad bstan pa'i don gyis gsung / /bdag yang mos gus gdung ba drag po skyes/ /ji srid snang bar gyur ba de srid tu/ /ring du g.yo ba med par gzigs cing bzhugs/ /de ltar brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung yang / /zla ba brgyad tam dgu nas sku thim ste/ /mjal ba'i skal ba'ang bdag gis ma rnyed to//

240 dpa' bogatsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam rang mtho bcuganyi khab la dbu ru'i yul/ /lha ri yer pa'i mgul gyi gtsug lag tu/ /zhwa ljang cod pan 'dzin par rab bsngags pa'i/ /shar phyogs dwags po'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mkhas grub chos rgyal bstan pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ /rdo rje phreng ba sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / /khyad par dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun sngon 'gro bas/ /mchog dbang gong ma gsum dang gong chen bcas/ /bsdus pa'i rgyud dang 'grel chen dri med 'od/ /rnam par bshad pas gtan la phab cing gnang / /bde mchog lū hi drug bcu pa dang ni/ /nā ro lha lnga mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i/ /bzhi rdzogs dbang sogs smin byed mang zhig dang / /dam chos 'dul ba'i rtsa ba lung sde bzhi/ /bshad lung tshul du gtan la phab cing gnang / /de tshe gleng gzhi'i byung ba thams cad ni / /thos pa'i mod la par du btab bzhin byung / /zab mo'i nang gi don gyi bstan bcos la/ /bsdusapa'i don tsam zin thun bskyar chos dang / /'dren pa nyid kyi rnam bshad steng nas ni/ /rgyas bshad ya mtshan ldan pa dpag med gnang / /grub mtha'i rtsis kyi lnga bsdus nyi zlog dang / /mchod rten brgyad kyi thig tshad ltos 'phye'i thig /de sogs du ma zhar la bslab par mdzad/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang / /rang byung zhabs kyi chosadrug gser zhun ma'i/ /nyams khrid thun mong min pas dkri bar mdzad/ /zla ba bcu bzhi tsam gyi bar bsnyen ste/ /bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa spyi bos nod/ /yun ring bsgugasan lha dang mjal lo zhes/ /rgyal ba'i dbang pos yang yang bka' bstsal ba/ /de ni khyod dang phrad pa 'dir 'dug gsung / /brtse bas rjes bzung 'o skol pha bu gnyis/ /lho phyogasasu 'gro thabs gcig 'dug nas kyang / /bdag gyi chos dang yon tan ma lus pa/ /yongasardzogs khyod kyis shes par bya'o gsung / /gsung sgrub mos cing dad gus cher yod kyang / /'on yang bdag nyid bus par gyur pa'i phyir/ /grogs gzhan tshe 'di 'dod pa'i dbang gyur ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'chang ba'i skal ma rnyed/ /bka' drin med tu byung ba de

'khrul pa'i bzhin ra 'char ba'i me long / 241lta la/ /'bul nod chung ngu'am 'bring po tsam pa 'gas/ /bka' drin bsab pa tsam yang ma nus ste/ /da dung 'gyod ba'i rma la sos dus med//grub thob dam pa kun dga' bzang po yis/ /chung ngu'i dus nas rten 'brel gnang byin sogs/ /lan mang bskur zhing phyi nas phrad dgos gsung / /rjes su pho nyas yang yang bskul ba las/ /rang po bcuganyisalon ba'i dbyar zhig phyin/ /sngon tshe kho bo slob ma'i 'os yin la/ /da ni kho bo khyod kyi bla mar 'os/ /gdams pa thams cad rdzogs par sbyin no gsung / /spyan snga phyag chen yig bzhi lnga ldan dang / /lhan cig skyes sbyor shog dril bzhi pa dang / /ras chung snyan rgyud nā ro gsang spyod dang / /grub rgyal tshe khrid la sogs smar khrid tu/ /nyin re la yang chos thun bcu lhag mdzad/ /nyid kyi thugs dam gtor ma thams cad kyi/ /'og du mgo bcug bka' bsgo yun ring mdzad/ /dbang bskur thams cad yongs su rdzogs so gsung / /phyag dpe ji snyed mchis pa'i 'og rol du/ /mgo bo phyag gis bcug ste smon lam mdzad/ /gdams pa'i lung kun yongs su rdzogs so gsung / /nga yi dbang lung man ngag ji snyed pa/ /yongs su rdzogs kyis gang la gang 'dod ston/ /bstan pa'i bdag bo lta bu'i phrin las dang / /mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sku tshe dang / /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa'i sgom sran dang / /rgya nag stong kun rgyal po'i longs spyod ste/ /kun dang mnyam pa'i rten 'brel yod to ces/ /ston pa'i sku gzugs la sogs gnang bar mdzad/ /tshe dang phrin las dam chos la sogs pa'i/ /rten 'brel yod pas kho bos ming 'dogs ces/ /sprul sku kun bzanga'adzam nga nyi zla ltar/ /grag ba ces byar bdag gi ming du btags/ /nyid kyi sku las pus 'khyud phud nas ni/ /re zhig 'di ni dad pa'i rten du chongs/ /ma 'ongs 'cham pa'i dus su lus la gon/ /rtsa rlung thabs kyi rten 'brel yod to gsung / /zhag ni bdun phrag gcig las ma bsten yang / /de srid nyin mtshan dam chos kho nas 'das/ /de phyir bka' drin rmad tu byung bar rig/

242 dpa' bogatsug lag phrengaba'i rang rnam bcagasum lon tshe rgyal ba'i sras po ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros dbang phyug las/ /rdor phreng dbang dang rnam 'joms rgya ston lugs/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mtshur lugs dang / /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gsung 'bum thor bu sogs/ /dbang lung 'brel pa du ma thob par gyur/ /mtshur lugs skar rtsis sa ris legs par khrid/ /kyal rka'i tshul du'ang rtsis phran mang zhig gnang / /phan byed man ngag 'ga' zhig yang gsungs te/ /bdag la shin du rtse zhing brjod par mdzad//bcabazhi ba la lho phyogs sa'i thig le/ /dpal ldan dro bo lung gi gdan sa rtswa /mkhas grub dam pa bud+dha ma ti las/ /mar pa'i shog dril bzhi dang bco lnga dang / /gtum mo zhag bdun ma dang gsang sgrub dang / /lnga ldan lhan cig skyes sbyor yig bzhi dang / /bram ze snyan rgyud bsnyen sgrub phran 'ga' dang / /tshe sgrub rin chen nyi 'od grub rgyal bcas/ /rje btsun dpa' bo'i rnam thar mgur 'bum sogs/ /dpa' bo che las brgyud pa'i chos 'ga' thob/ /phyi ma'i dus cig sdud pa rdor gcod dang / /shes snying yi ge gcig ma lha mo'i rgyud/ /brtag gnyis 'grel pa mar pas mdzad pa dang / /phyag dreg ma dang o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor/ /zhang gi bka' rgya dbang bskur bcas pa sogs/ /du ma gnang zhing sar ma'i rgyud 'bum ni/ /glegs bam nyi shu rtsa gnyis bdag la sbyin/ /de dag rnams kyi bka' gtad mang mdzad cing / /don gyis 'di dag thob pa'ang yin no gsung / /de ltar bka' drin yang dag ldan pa yin//bcadrug lo la yar 'brog mngon dgar phyin/ /'jam dbyangs gnyis pa 'chi med zhabs pad bsnyen/ /de nyid snying po sbas don kun gsal dang / /brtag gnyis ṭīka chen lam 'bras bshad chen bcas/ /rgyud sde spyi rnam bstan pa spyi rnam rbe1gas/ /gsang bas byin gyi bstan bcos mang zhig dang / /phag mo gzhung drug sbyin sreg bcas pa dang / /

bsnyen sgrub mkhas btsun lugs dang zla sing lugs/ /de sogs lung dang rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gnang / /mtshams sbyor lnga pa ming la dang por bcas/ /sa ris nyid kyis gtan phab dpyis phyin gnang / /zla gsum nye ba tsam gyi bar bsnyen nas/ /dam chos 'khor los phal cher 'da' bar gyur/ /mkhyen pa zla med smra ba'i dbang po yi/ /ngang tshul rmad tu byung bas yid drangs ste/ /bdag gi blo gros sgo yang sar du bye/ /'chad rtsod gnyis la cung zad byang bar gyur/ /de tshe zla ba gza' yis bzung skabs cig /grogs zhig gis ni bskul nas de yi slar/ /'jam dkar ma dzi'i sbyor ba byas pa'i tshe/ /byis par gyur pas zla ba'ang yang yang bltas/ /sngon bsnyen ma song dmigs pa'ang ma gsal mod/ /'on yang myu gu yid 'bur tsam zhig snang / /tshe dbang 'ga' dang phag mo don grub ma/ /hrī bskyed ma dang bcas pa'i dbang skur ni/ /dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhal las thob/ /mdor na kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'di nyid/ /bdag gis chos thob ha cang mi mang yang / /bka' drin gzhan las mi chung lhag pa yin//bstobasnyen pa la lung rigs smra ba'i grwa/ /mkhas mang 'dun sa legs bshad gling du phyin/ /klog pa'i grar zhugs bsdus pa'i thal 'gyur sbyangs/ /lo gcig tsam na nad kyi bskal pa ni/ /bar ma 'dra ba'i mi ngas cher byung nas/ /slar yang lho yi phyogs phyin btang snyoms 'dug /res 'ga' sras mkhar gtsug lag khang chen gyi/ /zhig gsor ming du gdags pa'ang 'ga' zhig byas/ /mdor na rang gi lo tshogs de snyed tu/ /bshes gnyen bsten yun de tsam ma gtogs pa/ /phal cher 'jig rten chos su brdzus pa'i las/ /gzhan gyi ngo srung grwa slob sdud pa dang / /ming btags tsam gyi khral chos khral dbang bskur/ /zang zing len zhing lang long nyin mtshan 'da'/ /rang rgyud dred nas phal cher tshe 'dir shor/ /res 'ga' tsam ni na dogs shi dogs kyis/ /zhag 'ga' tsam re phugs su 'dug nas ni/ /srung zlog sngags 'dren res 'ga' tshe sgrub byed/ /res 'ga' drag po'i

244 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam lha bsnyen byed tshul dang / /chos skyong mchod pa'i gtong sgrub byed rlom sogs/ /tsan+dan sol bar bsgyur ba'i zas kyis 'tsho/ /thab chas gdan cha dud 'gro sog pa sogs/ /mig ltos phal cher snying rul rnams la bcas/ /tshong dang khe sbogs khyim thab don gnyer ba/ /lang tshos dregs pa'i 'khor mang dang bcas ste/ /dus min bdud kyi phye gtor 'gam bzhin du/ /yul gru rnams su rtag tu rgyu bar gyur//nyi shu pa yi rang lo sar ma thag /klog pa'i grwar phyin lo ngo gsum du 'dug /de dus gdan sa snga phyi'i bar stong dang / /'chad po'i slob dpon tsam yang med pa yis/ /gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra cam grag pa'i skabs su son/ /'on yang rnam dpyod ral gri gsal 'dzin pa/ /paṇa chen gzhon nu nor bzang grogs dan du/ /bsnyen nas skar ṭīka 'jig rten gsum sgron dang / /buXkra sbyar nas mtha' dpyad mang bsnan ste/ /lus kyi rnam bzhag rdzogs pa'i bar bstan pas/ /blo gros mig rab kun nas yangs gyur ste/ /lhag ma bde blag go ba'i shes rab skyes/ /phyi nas mkhas pa shes rab rnam rgyal las/ /grogs dan bgyis ste bzhin dang lhan cig tu/ /skabs dang spyi don 'ga' zhig nod mod kyi/ /tshig gi phreng ba tsam zhig 'dzin pa'i slad/ /blo gros mchog dman bar gsum 'dus pa'i phyir/ /sngon med sar du shes pa ma thob bo/ /thos pa ces bya gzhung rig la bsten nas/ /don rnams rang gi rgyud la go byed yin/ /de slad nyan po'i blo yis go nus na/ /nyin re la yang skabasasam le'u sogs/ /du ma du ma bshad par 'os pa'ang yod/ /blo gros rab dman don 'dzin mi nus na/ /tshigs bcad gcig yang nyan po'i blor 'tsham pa'i/ /tshig don mang pos lo zlar brda yang sprod/ /'di 'dra mkhas pa'i 'chad tshul yin mod kyang / /deng sang klog pa'ang gzugs brnyan ltar zad phyir/ /ne tshor ma ṇi slob pa ji bzhin du/ /tshig tsam dpe 'am ngag las bzung nas ni/ /tshogs pa'i dbus su 'don la mkhas par rlom/ /de slar bdag ni skyo ba'i gnas su gyur//

'khyulapa 'ibazhin ras 'char ba'i melong / 245dus der rgyal ba'i phrin las zhabs nyid las/ /rnam bshad snying po gsal ba'i steng nas ni/ /zab mo'i nang don rgya cher rnam bshad pa/ /dum bu khrigs kyis tshang ba lan 'ga' la/ /bskyar chos dang ni nan tan legs par byas/ /sa ra ha yi do ha skor gsum la/ /par 'grel gzhir byas kur ṭīka gling ṭīka dang / /bal 'grel la sogs du ma'i 'thad bsdus pa/ /rnam bshad sems kyi rnam thar gzhir mdzad nas/ /legs par bstsal zhing kho thag chod par byung / /khyad par dmangs do la ni bskyar chos byas/ /zin bris btab pas shin tu mnyes par mdzad/ /dbyug pa can gyi snyan ngag me long la/ /snar thang lo tsa'i ṭīka gzhir bkod nas/ /zab bshad mdzad la bskyar chos rtsom rgyugs bgyis/ /ha cang tshang ba'i pha mthar ma phyin yang / /lhag ma rnams kyang dngos bstan go bar byung / /de tshe mi g.yo dkar dang 'jam dbyangs dang / /dbyangs can ma la bstod pa 'ga' sbyar bas/ /cung zad rang gi blo gros 'phel bar gyur/ /rang byung zhabs kyi rtsis kun bsdus pa las/ /lo bdag spro ba'i le'u byung ste gnang / /mdzod kyi sbyor ṭīka lung du gnang mod kyang / /sngon nas gzhung tshig blo la bzung ba'i phyir/ /gzhung chos nyid dang khyad par med par byung / /klog pa'i grwa ru snga ma 'dug pa'i tshe/ /ngo khro'i slob dpon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal las/ /grogs don tshul du sum rtags rnam gnyis dang / /bsdus pa'i rgyud ༵ shā kā ṭ+wāṃ ṭī //sdu ༵༵ /rdzu /bgyi/spyad// pa'i rtsis kyi lnga bsdus tsam yang bslabs/ /de ltar skabs cig shing pho spre lo dgun stod dus/ /nyi shu lnga drug zhig gis rmi lam du/ /lho phyogs ri bo'i spros la bdag 'dug tshe/ /byang ri mthon po'i rtse na 'ja' tshon gyi/ /khang brtsegs lha dang lha mo rnam mang po/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin pas rab gang zhing / /me tog char mang lang long 'bab pa'i steng / /rgyal ba gar dbang chos kyi grags pa ni/ /zhwa dmar bsnabs cing rta la chibs mdzad nas/ /nub kyi phyogs su zhal bsgyur

246 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnamagashegs pa mthong / /bzhugs par gsol yang ma gnang zhal 'dzum mdzad/ /de shed skabs su mya ngan 'das par go/spyir du bdag ni chung ngu'i dus nyid nas/ /las gzhan kun la snying po ma mchis pas//lha chos snying nas rang rgyud la sbyar ste/ /mi med dben pa'i ri khrod rab 'grims nas/ /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa byed to ces/ /sems kyi zhe gdeng rtag par bcas pa yin/ /phyi nas g.yeng ba'i 'dam du bying tshe yang / /snying stobs de ni nyams par ma gyur la/ /rkyen dbang dag gis gsos btab bzhin du gyur/ /khyad par klog pa kha thon dgyid pa'i tshe/ /bsam gtan las 'phros cung zad sad pa'am/ /yang na cung zad sgrib pa dag pa'i rgyus//nang gi 'khor la skyo bas rkyen byas ste/ /snang ba rmi lam lta bur wal gyis shar/ /dngul chu sa la bo ba ji bzhin du/ /yul dang yul can spros mtshan thams cad dang / /shes pa 'dre ba med par rjen la bud/ /dbyar dus char chen bab pa'i nyi shar la/ /sprin dang na bun sangs cing char pa chad/ /skyi ser mi g.yo nyi 'od gsal 'dra ba'i/ /shes pa gting nas rang dngas spros bral ba/ /bcos min gnyug ma'i ngo bo ngang gis shar/ /klog pa'i tshogasachen nang na 'dug tshe yang / /thams cad na bun lang long g.yo ba 'am/ /mig sgyu'i char chen 'bab pa ji lta bar/ /ngang gis grol ste sgyu ma rang shar byung / /thos pa'i gnas la ha cang ma 'bad kyang / /tshig re la yang go don mang du brnyed/ /kun yang rang gi rgyud la 'byor snyam byed/ /rmi lam sbyong ba'i dran 'dun ma byas kyang / /mtshan snang rmi lam phal cher bde blag zin/ /res 'ga' ngo mtshar rmi lam 'ga' yang snang / /rmi lam sprul bsgyur phra mo 'ga' yang byung / /de slad rnyigs dus skye bo'i spyod tshul dang / /tha snyad tshig la zhen pa ngang gis log /rnyigs dus thos pa mang byed grwa bskor sogs/ /ming tsam gyi ni gzhan mgo bskor byas nas/ /bla slob che gnyan sgrub 'dod kho nar 'dug /de slad ming gi 'ching bas ci zhig bya/ /da ni thos don lag len gdab bo snyam/ /rang la bskul ba'i ‘

'brul pa'i bzhin ras 'char ba'i me long/ 247tshigs bcad 'ga' yang byas/ /'on yang 'bad nas grogs dang spyod lam bstun/ /nyams rnams su la'ang ma smras rang gar 'dug/de nas rang lo nyer gsum lon pa'i tshe/ /lo yi skag la skrag pa'i bsnyad thabs kyis/ /zla 'ga' bzlas pa dgyid phyir 'gro bo smras/ /bla mas zang zing rdzong ba mang mdzad nas/ /'o na aṇ+ḍa'i bsnyen chen gyis cig gsung / /rim gyis lho phyogs lam du gzhol bar gyur/ /de tshe g.yo ru'i yul gru gra zhes pa'i/ /dge gnas dpal 'byor rab brtan khang bzang du/ /nyi zla lta bu'i dam pa zhal 'dzom zhes/ /thos ste myur bar mjal ba'i slad tu phyin/ /mi zad pa ces me pho khyi yi lo/ /dbyar zla ra ba snron gyis nya ba yi/ /dmar po'i gral tshes bco lnga pa yi nyin/ /snga dro grib tshod skyes bu gcig gi dus/ /rgyal po'i skyed mos tshal gyi dbus shed tu/ /mang thos chul ldan bsnyen gyi tshogs dbus su/ /mkhan pos dbyar ngo mdzad ste gsol btab nas/ /bsnyen par yongs su rdzogs pa'i sdom pa nos/ /ma khan po don gyi slad du mtshan smos na/ /brtan mkhas gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i sa non pa/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kun mkhyen gnyis pa ni/ /'tsho chen chosaskyong bzang po'i zhabs yin no/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde mang 'dzin zhing / /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor rab grub pa/ /gnas brtan dgra gcan zin gyi rnam sprul ni/ /dpal ldan chos grub seng shes las slob mdzad/ /seng ge lta bu'i gnas brtan chos smra ba/ /nam mkha' dpal ldan zhes byas gsangs ston mdzad//de ltar rdzogs pa'i sdom pa nod pa'i tshe/ /'khor bas skyo zhing zhi la rab spro ba'i/ /dad pa bcos min drag du yod pa'i phyir/ /nges 'byung sdom pa tsam zhig thob bam snyam/ /zhag mang bar du lus sems gnyi ga la/ /sngon med bde ba rgyun chad med par myong / /mkhan po'i drung du lhung bshegs nyid 'gyur dang / /yig brgya'i bzlas lung bla ma'i rnal 'byor

248 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam ni/ /zab rgyas skyed rdzogs kun gyis brgyan pa dang / /sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe yi rang gzungs ste/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel par de dag thob/ /zhabs thil spyi bor blangs ste smon lam btab/ /sangs rgyas bstan la phan par gyis cig gsung / /las slob nyid kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ /yan lag drug gi snying por gyur pa bstsal/ /zhabs zung spyi bo'i gtsug du bkod nas kyang / /smon lam dang ni bka' sgo rgya cher mdzad/ /da ni sdom gsum rnam par dag pa yis/ /bstan la phan par gyis ces yang yang gsung / /rim gyis lho phyogs grub pa'i zhing du phyin/ /bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo yin zhes pa/ /bud med dman ma zhig la babs nas ni/ /bsu bar 'ongs ces gus pa'i phyag mang byas/ /phan gnod lung bstan sna tshogs byas par gyur//de nas gnas dang yo byad la sogs pa/ /lta gon dgyi bar 'os pa kun byas nas/ /tshe 'di don gnyer 'khor kun rgyang bsrings ste/ /dpal ldan dro bo lung gi o rgyan rtser/ /thams cad 'dul zhes bya ba me phag gi /hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas brtsams ste/ /stag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig bar/ /lo gsum 'dag sbyar dam pos bcad ste 'dug /sngon dang phyi mar bla ma'i bkas bskul nas/ /byi ba'i lo la aspyi'i bsnyen chen zlosnrolta/ /snga phyir ltongs kyi rnam pa 'ga' byung yang / /bar chad nyes pa cir yang ma skabs shed slob bu dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la/ /'jam dkar rig gtad sgrub thabs byin pa'i tshe/ /rmi nyams cig tu rang lus phyi rol ni/ /'dom gang tsam gyis 'khor ba'i sa gzhi'i nang / /mkha' las a yig dkar po'i char 'bab pa/ /kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin du snang / /phal cher 'khor zhing rang gi lus la thim/ /'ga' zhig sa gzhi'i ngos la phog pa rnams/ /mi yal rang gar gnas pa nyid mthong nas/ /de kun bdag gis

'khrulapa'i bzhin ras 'char ba'i me long / 249bsdus cing mgul du mid/ /sad nas blo gros 'phel ba'i ltas so snyam/ /bdag gis 'di la bsnyen pa ma bgyis mod/ /sngon gyi bag chags tsam zhig yod par go /re zhig tho rengs dus kyi rmi nyams su/ /bdag nyid dbu rtsa dmar po'i mdun 'dug pa'i/ /steng gi dgung sngon mthon po'i ngos dag la/ /ngang pa dpag med lho nas byang du song / /de dbus cung zad che ba gcig snang ba/ /rim gyis je dma' je dma' nyid du gyur/ /nye bar slob tshe chos rje bla ma ni / /seng ge dmar po ral dmar can chibs pa/ /zhig tu snang ste bdag gi mdun du babs/ /phyogs gcig na ni bla ma ga shed tu/ /spyan 'dren dgyid po'i pho nya yin no zhes/ /sga srab bcug pa'i rtar bcas mi 'ga' snang / /bdag gis phyag byas byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe/ /phyag gnyis dbur bcas bdag gi mgor bzhag nas/ /bu khyod de ring gsol ba gang 'debs pa/ /de ni bdag gis dam par sbyin no gsung / /khyod nyid lo brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan pa/ /de ni gsol ba 'debs ces brjod pa'i tshe/ /'o na de bzhin dgyid ces zhal bzhes nas/ /spyan dang zhal mchu'i bsgyur thabs brda mdzad pas/ /spyan 'dren de dag ga shed song bar gyur/ /phyi nas rje nyid rgyal ba'i drung byon ste/ /chos dang zang zing mchod pa rab mdzad nas/ /nyi 'og dbus kyi thig ler slar byon tshe/ /ltas de las dpags brtan bzhugs 'bul btang bas/ /smyug la'i rdzong gi ka drug rtse mo sa /sku mtshams tshe sgrub da lta mdzad rgyu yi/ /bzhugs gdan rim pas shom dang dus mtshungs pas/ /dam tshig nyes skyon med par dag pa'i phyir/ /rten 'brel mchog tu 'grig zhes mnyes par gyur//re zhig tshe na tho rengs rmi nyams su/ /ngo mtshar gtsug lag khang chen yangs pa'i nang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang rang byung rdo rje ni/ /dngos su bzhugs ces gzhan dag sgrog thos nas/ /dad gus drag pos zhugs ste mjal du phyin/ /de tshe mchog tu yangs pa'i dri gtsang khang / /mdzes pa'i dbus na rin chen khri mthon ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rang

250 dpa 'a po gtsugalag phrengaba'i rang rnam byung rdo rje dngos/ /sku chad gzhu 'dom gnyis gsum tsam gyi tshad/ /dar zab du ma'i na bzas rab bklubs cing / /thon ga'i cod pan dbu la legs bsgos pa/ /zhal dbyibs sku 'dra mi nyag rta bdun ma/ /ji bzhin dngos su gyur pa lta bu la/ /'od zer mtshungs pa med pa 'bar ba mthong / /dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag byas nas/ /spyi bos gtugs tshe phyag zung pad+ma gnyis/ /spyi bor dus gcig nan tan ring bkod pas/ /lus sems sbrid cing mchi ma'i rgyun rab zags/ /bu ram gru bzhi pa cig sder bcug nas/ /phul bas de la ljags mchil btab nas ni/ /slar yang bdag la gnang ste zhal 'jiXm mdzad/ /dga' bas snying ga'i gos kyi bar bcug nas/ /gus phyag byas pa'i mod la gnyid kyang sad/ /phyi dus zhal dbyibs tha dad med mthong bas/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs par go /bsnyen pa rnams kyi lhag chad bskang ba'i phyir/ /bsnyen grangs bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dgyid nye'i tshe/ /rmi lam nyams su bdud mgon shākad ni/ /gzugs tshad gzhu 'dom bco lnga tsam pa la/ /dar nag gos gyon rgyan dang bral ba zhig /rang gi 'brog ru'i phyugs rnams kun skyong zhing / /'di la sbyin sreg bud shing bya'o zhes/ /lci ba dar nag gos kyi thu bar sdud/ /gzims khang rgyab kyi spo la skem pa mthong / /sbyin sreg bar chad med par 'grub par go /las gsum rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byas pa'i tshe/ /me ni kha dog btso ma'i gser gyi mdog /dbyibs ni byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nyid/ /bang rim sogs kyang rab tu gsal bar snang / /dam chos rgyas par 'gyur ba yin nam snyam//stag zug zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum la/ /'dag sbyar nas byung zhag 'ga' tsam 'dug nas/ /chos rje bla ma dam pa'i spyan sngar phyin/ /legs bshad gling gi chos grwar gdan phebs nas/ /che btsun du mas bskor ba'i dbus su brtol/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs rnam pa mang po la/ /dug can zas ltar zhen pa rtag log zhing / /rtag tu dben pa nyid la goms pa'i rgyus/ /'du 'dzis dregs pa'i skye bo mang mthong tshe/ /snying rje'i mchi ma rang dbang

'grul pa'i bzhin ras 'charaba'i melong / 251med par 'brugs/ /rnyigs dus chos pa phal gyi tshul la'ang skyo/ /de slad skyo shas snying rje chen po'i nyams/ /bskyil yang 'khyil bar dka' ba rtag du byung / /des drangs mgur dang tshigs bcad 'ga' yang yod/ /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /bcos min gnyug ma'i tshul las mi 'da' ba'i/ /nges pa'i go cha slar yang brtan par gyur//de nas yol gyi theg chen rtse mo sa /nyid kyi bka' 'bum yongs su tshang ba dang / /rdo rje snying 'grel phyag rdor stod 'grel bcas/ /te lo'i chos drug ka dpe rim pa bzhi/ /sras mkhar ma dang sras don rdo rje'i mgur/ /rim lnga bsdus gsal mā ya'i rnal 'byor gsum/ /sre 'pho'i zhal gdams mi la'i chos drug ste/ /mar mi'i thugs kyi brnag pa du ma dang / /sku bzhi ngo sprod ma mgon skor gsum dang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ka kha skor gsum dang / /zab chos gdams ngag rgya mtsho mtha' yas ste/ /grub chen pag shi'i man ngag du ma gnang / /'bri khung zab chos bstan pa'i snying por bcas/ /yang mgon pa yi lhan cig skyes sbyor ni/ /gzhung khrid rgyab chos zhal gdams rnal 'byor bzhi/ /gzhan yang kha 'thor du ma'ang zhar la bstsal/ /sman mar ma dang gong khug mar bcas pa'i/ /ṭar+shad rbesnag dril bcu bdun la sogs gnang / /khyad par brtag gnyis brtag pa snga ma yi/ /le brgyad bar du skyar chos zhib bshad mdzad/ /lhag ma mgyogs bshad lung thabs tshul du gsungs/ /phyi dus rnam bshad yongs rdzogs nyid kyang bstsal/ /de tshe nyi zla lho nub nas byung ste/ /shar lho'i phyogs su 'gro ba'i rmi ltas byung / /rje btsun bla ma'i spyan sngar gsol ba na/ /dge bshes sgre pa'i lo rgyus gsungs nas ni/ /de bzhin 'chi ltas yin pas zlog dgos gsung / /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang dang / /lha khrid gsungs nas zhag 'ga' bzlas pa byas/ /bar chad sol ba'i phra mo'i rtags 'ga' byung / /dgon gnas la sogs g.yeng ba spangs nas kyang / /sgrub pa dgyid ces gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /bkyon thabs du mas 'gog par mdzad pa'i mthar/ /'on yang thams cad mkhyen
