252 dpa' bo gtsugalag phreng ba'irangarnamapa'i drung zhus la/ /ji skad bstsal ba de bzhin zung zhig gsungs/ /de nas lho rgyud grub pa'i zhing du phyin/ /sna tshogs g.yeng ba du mas nyin mtshan 'das//rang lo nyer brgyad lon pa'i lcags yos lo/ /nag zla'i yar tshes bcu gsum mtshan phyed nas/ /'jigs su rung ba'i sa g.yos bskal pa byung / /ri bo'i rtse nyil chu kun gnam du 'phyur/ /grong dang grong khyer ljongs mang phye mar brlags/ /lto phyogs gshin rje'i grong gi sgo phye nas/ /skye bo mang zhig de nas 'dong gyur yang / /bdag cag 'khor bcas phyogs dang bcas pa la/ /dkon mchog mthu yis gnod par ma gyur to/ /khyad par rgyal ba rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa legs sbyar zhing / /rten 'brel rnam pa cung zad bgyis pa yis/ /de phyin zhag 'ga'i bar du g.yos pa rnams/ /yul gru de rang bdag gi bsti gnas der/ /chung ngur gyur zhes gzhan dag sgrog par byed/ /dbyar dus dgung zla phyed dang gnyis kyi bar/ /grub pa'i ri sul dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ /gnya' gnya' zhes byar dben pa byas ste 'dug /de tshe dben pa'i yon // ḍi / ༵ sngi ga rig /da ni tshe 'di blo yis gtong snyam pa'i/ /zhe bcad drag po bskul ba de nas sras mkhar mdo khyams chen mo la/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs ris su brir bcug nas/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la bsten ste/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg mnga' dbul dang bcas pa/ /rang gis rab gnas yongs su rdzogs par bgyis/ /bgegs skrad dus dang ye shes gzhug pa'i tshe/ /byin rlabs phebs pa'i mtshan ma cung zad byung / /gzhan yang yul dus gnas skabs ma nges pa/ /du mar rab tu gnas pa mang bgyis mod/ /de dag kun la'ang gnas skabs ji bzhin du/ /nyung yang cho ga'i yan lag tshang bar bgyis/ /rgyas pa'i tshe yang lhag pa'i skyon ma sbyar/ /bshis pa brjod pa'i nas tsam 'thor

ba la/ /rab tu gnas pa'i ming du ma 'khrul tsam/ /bla ma mkhas pa'i bka' drin mthu yis bdog /rten de sngar las cung zad snum pa dang / /gzi 'od ldan snyam byed pa kun la byung / /rang gi don nam slob ma gzhug sogs ched/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa la sogs bgyis pa'i tshe/ /res 'ga' bdud rtsi khol zhing 'phyur ba dang / /dgun dus lha shos mchod yon cher 'khyag yang / /'ga' zhig mi 'khyag so mar gnas pa dang / /mar me nyung dus ring du thub pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar ltar snang de 'dra lan mang snang //khrom chen 'dus pa'i gral dpon mang bgyis tshe/ /'ga' zhig phan tshun mi srun tshig mda' 'phen/ /phan tshun phyogs bcas rtsod par rtsom mthong na/ /dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba dungs tsam btab/ /shes pa spros dang bral ba rgya bkyed nas/ /snang ba zil mnan cham gyis bzhag pa'i mod/ /rtsod pa rgyu med zhi ba lan mang byung / /de slad gang du gral dpon bgyis pa 'am/ /dbang chos zhu 'am gzhan la bshad kyang rung/ /bar chad dbang du gyur ba ma dran no/ /chu yis nyen pa'i grong dang zhing sogs la/ /snying rjes dkon mchog gsum la gsol btab nas/ /nas 'bru 'thor bas phyi nas gnod bral ba/ /lho dbu yul gru du mar lan mang byung / /char gyis 'phongs dus 'gro la snying rje'i blos/ /rdzas kyi zol gyis yig phrin skyel ba 'am/ /dkon mchog gsol ba cung zad btab pa res/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin rtag du 'bab par snang / /'di lta'i ltas kyi rnam pa phra mo rnams/ /tshur mthong 'ga' zhig mgu ba'i gnas yin mod/ /gcig du ngo mtshar yin par ma mthong ste/ /la la lha'i bulibadud kyis sbyar ba'ang srid/ /res 'ga' bsod nams tsam gyis byung ba'ang yod/ /'ga' zhig nus pa phra mo yin srid kyang / /de tshe dbyar rgyags dgun du zos pa ltar/ /mchog gi dngos grub ring du 'gyur bar go /gzhan yang brtan pa 'am ni g.yo ba yi/ /'jigs pa'i rnam pa che phran ci byung yang / /dkon mchog gsum la blo 'u1sa khel ba las/ /thabs gzhan sna tshogs nam yang ma bgyis so//

254 dpa'abogatsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam de ltar rang lo nyer brgyad bar 'das nas/ /yos lo ston zla ra ba shar ba'i tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal ras lta ba'i slad/ /'khenar dang bcas pa lam du zhugs nas mchis/ /de tshe la chen lung stong nam bgrod tshe/ /nam mkha'i mdog dngas 'ja' tshon rab tu bkra/ /nyi 'od gsal ba nyid tu byung ba yis/ /mgon des byin gyis brlabs snyam bdag nyid sems//de nas rang lo nyi shu rtsadagu ba/ /dga' ba zhes bya chu pho 'brug gi lo/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i dus chen bco lnga'i nyin/ /bod yul lte ba dbus ri nag po'i rgyud/ /kong yul bla med gsang sngags spyod pa'i zhing / /zeng po 'bum pa sgang zhes bya ba sa /sangs rgyas dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba thob/ /rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po ring mo nas/ /mthong ba tsam gyi lus kyi ba spu g.yos/ /mig nas mchi ma'i char rgyun bzlog ma nus/ /dad pa'i shugs drag rab tu rgyas pa'i sems/ /kun nas bzung bar dka' ba nyid tu gyur/ /bdag nyid sgar mtha'i ngos su son pa dang / /gso sbyong garnyi grag pa dus mtshungs gyur/ /cung zad rten 'brel legs pa tsam du go /de ma thag tu mjal ba'i slad tu phyin/ /mos gus dad pa'i gdung shugs bzod dka' yang / /lus ngag rnam 'gyur 'char ba bzlog bya'i phyir/ /rgya yan glod cing rang gar dor na yang / /slang thabs nyid tu 'char ba'i 'phro nyid la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis sku gsung thugs/ /gcig du bsdus pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /bka' drin mtshungs med spyan ras gzugs dbang gi /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla ltar gsal ba mthong / /de yi mod la sngar gyi slong po'i blo/ /mkha' la na bun yal ba bzhin gyur ste/ /nam mkha' sprin thag chad pa lta bur snang / /zang zing yo byad bdog pa ci mchis pa/ /chags thogs med par mchod pa'i slad du phul/ /sngon tshe 'jig rten che thabs zang zing kun/ /'dor 'dod blos gtang shes pa rtag yod kyang / /rtsan chod nyid tu 'dor bar ma nus mod/ /bka' drin chen po mjal ba'i mod nyid la/ /

tshe 'di'i mdud pa rtsan grol nyid tu song / /rang gi dgon gnas 'bor dang longs spyod sogs/ /mdor na tshe 'di'i bde 'byor thams cad la/ /grog tshang tsam gyi blo yang ma shar ro/ /rang gzhan don grub ma yi rdo rje'i mgur/ /thog ma'i dam chos 'brel pa nyid du gnang / /rgyal ba nyid kyi sku yi dkyil 'khor du/ /'khor lo sdom pa dril bu pa yi lugs/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par legs par bstsal/ /klu sgrub zhabs dang thogs med las brgyud pa'i/ /smon pa dang ni 'jug pa'i sems skyed ste/ /byang chub sems sdom lan grangs du mar gnang / /rtsis kun bsdus pa'i ri mo thob cig gsung / /legs par btab pas gzigs pa'i tshul du mdzad/ /gtsug lag phreng ba zhes byar ming du btags/ /rta bar rgyal 'dzin tshal gung gdan phebs tshe/ /mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i nye rgyu ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sgrub pa las gzhan med/ /khyod nyid phyin tshe kho bo'i bdud rtsi ni/ /ga bur gyur pa'i rten 'brel yang 'grig pas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sgrub pa gyis cig gsung / /phag mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag bcas pa gnang / /bdag cag tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa lngas/ /zhag ni nyer gcig bsnyen pa'i kha bsos ste/ /mtshan ldan mkha' 'gro'i thod pa smug cung dang / /'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa'i dbu thod tu/ /rtsa brgyad stong dang sgrub rdzas med byung rnams/ /rgyal ba'i phyag las 'dar ba legs blugs ste/ /zhag bdun bsgrubs nas dri ro 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /sa ga zla ba'i dus chen bco lnga'i nyin/ /dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang gnyis tsam gyis/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo'i sgra/ /ser sbreng bcas pas sgrub khang nas bsus ste/ /rgyal ba mchog nyid dri mchog reng bu yis/ /phyag gi pad+ma mdzes par rgyan bzhin du/ /seng ge'i khri chen dpe zla bral ba'i mdun/ /sa gzhi ngos la gos bzang bkram pa'i steng / /zhabs zung 'gro ba'i mchod sdong bskyod par gyur/ /las mtha' bsdu ba'i sbyin sreg mang yang bgyis/ /de ltar bdud rtsi'i ril bu bsgrubs pa la/ /bsngags pa cher mdzad cung zad mnyes pa thob//

256 dpa'abogatsugalag phreng ba'i rang rnam de nas mi bdag ngag gi dbang po nyid/ /bdag gi ched du kong por byon pa yi/ /dbyar zhal bzlog pa nyid tu ma nus nas/ /re zhig dpal ldan dro bo lung du phyin/ /dgon nas che phran phyi nang bdog par bcas/ /ma lus gdan sa pa la legs par btad/ /sbyin bdag chen po grags pa dpal 'byor ba/ /zhal ngor bcas pas bdag ni chung ngu nas/ /mig 'bras lta bur gces pas bsnyen pa'i phyir/ /sems kyis 'dor bar rigs pa ma yin yang / /bdog gu thams cad rmi lam tsam zhig ste/ /snying pos dben pa'i ngang tshul rig pa'i phyir/ /mthar thug dam chos lhan cig spyod pa yis/ /phan par 'gyur ba'i smon lam btab byas nas/ /ltos pa med par rgyal ba'i drung du phyin//bod lung rdo mtshan can na 'dug pa'i tshe/ /rgyal bas ja 'dren mngags pa yin no zhes/ /chab shog dang ni ston pa'i sku gzugs dang / /po ti gcig dang rten khebs bzang po ste/ /rnam gsum lag tu byin pa'i snang ba byung / /phyi nas de nyid mngon sum bden par gyur/ /kong yul brag phyi'i tshal du rgyal ba'i sku/ /mngon sum nyid tu lta ba'i skal ba thob/ /skabs cig thugs dam rten mang rab gnas tshe/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje yab bka' yum bka' yi/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa bdag la gnang / /gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang / /gnyis med rnam rgyal gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag /ma hā mā ya dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /gdan bzhi yab bka' yum bka' so sor bcas/ /bde mchog lo nag dril gsum bcu gsum ma/ /nā ro lha lnga rga lo lha lnga dang / /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dgyes rdor rigs bsdus dang / /rta mgrin thugs dril nag rgyal phag gsum sogs/ /dbang bskur yongs rdzogs re re'ang lan mang bstsal/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i lta gon la sogs pa/ /las kyi rdo rje dgyi ba'i skal ba brnyed/ /dus mkhyen bka' 'bum nang na gang mchis sogs/ /dbang dang rjes gnang che phran mang zhig dang / /byin brlabs khyad par gyur pa dpag med ba455//

shesaphyin man ngag gas ba'i bstan bcosani/ /drung mdzad rje btsun ngal gso'i gzhung lugs nyid/ /spros ste rnam par bshad pas gtan dbab pa/ /dum bu khrigs kyis yongs su tshang ba dang / /rigasagazhung rtsamatsho'i bstan bcosachen po las/ /tshad ma'i mdo dang rgyas pa rnam 'grel la/ /rnam bshad med tu byung bas gsal bar mdzad/ /de tshe don rnams slar yang skyor ba dang / /dka' ba'i gnas la dogs daphyod nan tan zhus/ /bde blag nyid kyis khong du chud pa yin/ /'bring dang bsdus pa'ang bklags pas go bar gyur/ /tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi bstan bcos kyang / /sde bdun ngag gi rol mtsho dang sbyar ste/ /dka' gnas dogs dpyod bcas pas dbyis phyin mdzad/ /dbu ma che la 'jug pa'i bstan bcosani/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyi rang 'grel nyid/ /dza yā n+dana'i rgyas 'grel dang sbyar ste/ /zhib bshad med du byung bas bde sprod mdzad/ /don rnams bskyar zhing dka' gnas dogs dpyod bgyis/ /sgra yi byings kyi nus pa la bsten nas/ /dgag sgrub byas pa'i phran 'ga' ma gtogs pa/ /dpyis phyin nyid du shes par gyur pa yin/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'irnam bshad ni / /nyid kyi rgyas 'grel chen mo lung du gnang / /sngon nas 'dul ba'i lung la 'dris pa'i phyir/ /dngos bstan dgongs pa bklags pa tsam gyis go /so so thar mdo legs par bkral ba dang / /snyag phu pa yi bslab bya 95 rbe1gas ba45pa//sngags la 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar rgyud bla ma/ /sa bzang ma ti'i ṭīka dang sbyar ste/ /gzhan stong smra ba'i lugs su 'grel ba dang / /red mda' pa yi ṭīka dang sbyar ste/ /rang stong smra ba'i lugs su 'grel ba gnyis/ /tshogs chos nyid du rnam bshad zhib mor bstsal/ /ha cang nan tan dgyid pa ma grub kyang / /sngon dus snyag phu pa yi 'grel pa hā/sa/ /rgyud bla lugs 'ga' nan tan byas pa'i phyir/ /de yang go ba tsam du rlom pa

258 dpa 'bogatsug lagaphreng ba'i rangarnam yid shāka gnyis kyi snying po'i 'dod tshul la/ /dpyad pa'i bstan bcos nyid kyis mdzad pa de/ /legs par brda sprod dbyis phyin rab bstsal bas/ /phyin chad gsung rnams rtogs pa sla bar gyur/ /mkhas pa chen po khro phu bu ston gyi/ /rgyud sde'i spyi rnam chen po brda sprod mdzad/ /lnga cha tsam gyi bar du nye bar ni/ /nag 'jam nyid tu gsung las bzung zhing bskyar/ /de phyin mgyogs bshad lung thabs nyid tu gnang / /ma hā mā ya'i rgyud sde zab mo la/ /tshig don rnam phye legs par gtan dbab mdzad/ /skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i rdo rje'i gsung / /dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rgyas bshad bstsal/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i tshoms la bdag nyid kyis/ /gsungs las ji tsam nges nga zin bris bgyis/ /lhag ma dka' ba'i gnas kyi 'grel pa'i tshul/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis thog mar bsdu mdzad ste/ /legs par bstsal nas de nyid gleng gzhi dang / /bar gyi mchams sbyor tha ma'i mthun 'gyur bcas/ /zin bris nyid kyi tshul du gyis cig gsung / /de ltar bgyis ste bka' 'bum nang na bzhugs/ /rdzogs rim zab mo rnam pa du ma dang / /khrid dang man ngag zab cing grangs mang ba/ /rgya cher bstsal ste phal cher nyams khrid bgyis//sngon gyi smon lam rten 'brel yod pa'i phyir/ /klog pa'i slob dpon gyis ces bka' bsgos nas/ /nyid sku'i snang brnyan rin chen las byas dang / /'dul ṭīka chen mo phyag bris ma nyid dang / /ding phon seng ge'i ris kyi rten khebs ste/ /rnam gsum rten 'brel don du gnang bar mdzad/ /de tshe rmi lam na yang lha'i gos kyi/ /rgyal mchan gser gyi yu ba rab mdzes pa/ /mtho khyad ri bo brgya phrag du ma'i tshad/ /rtse mor gser gyi nyi ma'i snying po ni/ /'od 'bar rmad du byung bas rab spras pa/ /bdag gi lag gis mngon par bzung ste 'dug /nyi ma'ang gung gi thig ler bab pa'i phyir/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer mdung tshugs lhung ba ni/ /rgyal mtshan tog la rab tu reg pa yis/ /de gnyis 'od zer dbyer med 'phros pa yis/ /nyin mo stong phrag bsdus pa'i snang ba bzhin/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu

'khrul pa'i bzhin ras 'char ba'i melong/ 259gsal bar gyur/ /de tshe steng gi nam mkha' thams cad la/ /rol mo'i sgra brnyan mang po rab grag zhing / /me tog char chen kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /khyad par sngon po shas cher gyur ba yis/ /bdag dang rgyal mtshan de la 'thor ba mthong / /bstan la cung zad phan pa'i ltas su go/ /'dug nas zhag gnyis 'das pa'i dus shed du/ /bya rog mchu yis gaṇa yog bzung nas ni/ /gaṇ+ḍi'i logs la lan 'ga' bsnun byas pas/ /la la garnyi brdungs snyam 'khrul pa skyes/ /de nas dge 'dun 'du ba'i zang thing ni/ /rgya cher 'phel zhes dge 'dun rnams las thos/ /de ltar sprul lo zla ba dgub nas/ /bya lo zla ba bzhi pa'i bar dag gi /po lnga'i bar du klog pa'i gnas brtan bgyis//de nas gdan sa chen po 'bri khung gi /yul gyi bye brag klung shod ces bya bar/ /bdag la bka' yi mching ba rab bkrol nas/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis thugs dam brtags pa bzhin/ /sde sdod gsum pa phyogs kyi glang po la/ /klog grwa'i gtsug gi ston par dbang bskur mdzad/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa dang ni gang zag gi /'jog rdzas theg par bcas pa la sogs dang / /bdag nyid dbang ba'i bdog gu legs par gtad/ /dge 'dun dam chos 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis 'bad pa don yod nyid gyur to//skabs cig bu chu gser gyi lha khang du/ /thugs rje chen po'i sku yi snang brnyan drung / /me long zhig la mu tig phra bkod nas/ /dad pas phul ste smon lam gsol btab byas/ /zhag 'ga' na ni rmi lam snang ba sa /rgyal ba nyid kyis gser gyi pad+ma ni/ /rin chen mang pos spras pa 'dzin bzhin du/ /'di ni khyod kyis kho bo la phul ba'i/ /me long de nyid yin zhes yang yang gsung / /sad tshe rgyal ba mchog nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /dngos su byon rnyi twe // shā/ /rdo ṅgi min skyes/ /sku yi snang brtan de la'ang mos pa ni/ /rgya cher 'phel

260 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnamamador na bdag 'dra mched pa'i dngos pos dben/ /rigs gzugs 'byor pas dman la thos pa zhan/ /brtson 'grus chung zhing le los dus 'das phyir/ /mnyes pa rnam gsum ci yang ma grub kyang / /dam chos byed lor mos pa tsam nyid las/ /thugs kyi sras su bzung ste brtse bas bskyangs/ /dbang dang gdams ngag gzhung bshad ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis ched du brjod pas gnang / /gnas skabs nad dang 'tshe ba ci byung yang / /gsang chab bstsal ba 'thungs pas gzhi med sos/ /yid la 'dod pa'i don kun ma lus pa/ /phal cher gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis grub/ /rnam rtog som nyi'i dra ba ci mchis pa/ /nam yang ngag du brjod par ma bgyis kyang / /dus la bab tshe tshogs sam dben pa r+sā /thogs med mkhyen pas the tshom thams cad bcad/ /shes bya ji lta ji snyed thams cad la/ /skad cig tsam yang sgrib g.yogs med pa'i spyan/ /rtag tu mnga' ba'i nges pa gting nas brnyed/ /rnam par thar pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas cing / /gting zab 'phags mchog gis kyang rtogs dka' ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mnga' bar go /dang po'i las can blo chung rnams gzung phyir/ /de dang skal ba mtshungs par ston pa'ang mthong / /dregs shing 'gying ba skad cig mi mnga' ste/ /mnyan des 'grogs bde'i rang bzhin nyid yin yang / /rigs dang thos pa'am nus pa la sogs pas/ /rab dregs tshangs bsnyems can rnams nyi ma'i drung / /srin bu'i me bzhin 'gyur ba du ma mthong / /skyon ldan rnams kyi skyon gyi bang mdzod rnams/ /chul 'chos 'ching ba du mas bsdams na /dri / /rgyal ba'i bka' yi zla zer phog tsam gyis/ /rang bzhin rab du gsal ba nyid tu 'brel tshad thams cad don dang ldan pa dang / /ci mdzad yon tan ci gsungs gdams ngag zhes/ /sngon nas tshig tsam du ni rab grags mod/ /nges par mnga' ba de ni bdag gi mgon/ /thugs rje'i gter chen rgyal ba 'di yin no/ /bdag ni phyogs zhen

'khrul pa'i bzhin ras 'char ba'i me long / 261tsam gyis gus min ste/ /zang zing gnang bas mgu bar gyur pa'ang min/ /rnyed dang bkur sti grags pa 'khor g.yog sogs/ /khe grags ched du gus pa'ang ma yin ste/ /snyan grags tsam gyis mtho 'grims bgyis pa'ang min/ /thar 'dod tshe 'di'i lam du mi sbyor zhing / /the tshom kun gcod shes bya ma lus mkhyen/ /gsol ba btab na byin gyis rlob nus pa'i/ /yid ches nges pa gting nas brnyed pa yin/ /bdag 'dra'i skye bo rnam rtog cher rags pa/ /log rtog mdud pas rab gzings 'di yis kyang / /ji lta bur yang tshad bzung ma nus ste/ /de slad bsam mi khyab par kho thag chod/ /lha bsgoms sngags bzlas lam gzhan ci bsgoms kyang / /rtog pa gcig la gcig 'thud phreng bar 'dug /mgon 'di yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'khrul snang thams cad gcig char 'jig pa dang / /gnyen po'i blo kun gcig char skye ba'i tshul/ /srang mda'i mtho dman lta bur 'gyur mthong bas/ /kun go gcig gis chod par nges shes skyes//sku gsum snang ba po yi rim pa ste/ /gzugs sku mtshan dang zhal phyag sna tshogs pa/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i brda btags tsam/ /chos gyi sku 'am ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /rang bzhin gzod nas dag pa tsam la brjod/ /de slad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skad pa yang / /brtags na bdag gi mgon 'di kho na las/ /gzhan na cung zad yod par ma 'tshal to/ /de slad phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal kun dang / /chos dang dge 'dun yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /ye shes chos skyong srung mar bcas kun yang / /gcig bsdus rgyal ba nyid tu thag chod pas/ /gzhan na yod snyam skad cig mi bdog go /bdag gi thog med 'khor ba'i dus phyin chad/ /rgyud la dge dang yon tan ci bdog pa/ /thams cad mgon po 'di yi bka' drin yin/ /bdag gi lus srog bye mar rab byas pa/ /lan grangs rab 'byam rgya mtsho'i rdul bkod kyang / /rgyal ba mchog 'di'i bka' drin cha shas kyi/ /cha shas tsam yang kheng bar mi bdog go /de phyir lha gcig skyabs gcig dpung gnyen gcig /blta bya'i

262 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam yul gcig thob bya'i 'bras bu gcig /sgrub bya'i gzhi gcig yi dam chos skyong gcig /kun go gcig chod mi bskyod rgyal ba yin/ /sgrub bya'i lam gcig lta sgom spyod pa gcig /nyams len gegs sel bogs 'don gcig pa ni / /mos gus gsol 'debs rnal 'byor kho na yin/ /de phyir chos thob bla ma mang yod kyang / /gsol 'debs blo gtad bya yul gcig nyid yin/ /gzhung lugs gdams ngag mang zhig shes na yang / /nyams len mos gus phyag chen gcig po yin/ /bla mar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos brnyed nas/ /zang zing mgo 'don re ba ma bgyis ste/ /blo gtad yid ches snying phur thebs pa'i phyir/ /dal 'byor don dang ldan snyam res 'ga' sems//gzhan yang ston pa'i bka' la mos pa'i rgyus/ /rab 'byam gsung ba tshul khrims dbang phyug las/ /rgyud 'bum mdo mang phal chen shes phyogs ste/ /bka' 'gyur nang tshan po ti don gsum dang / /grub snyen man snye chos chung brgya rtsa dang / /don dam bsnyen pa lta 'dod mdor bstan dang / /dpag bsam 'khri shing nā ro'i 'grel chen gnyis/ /chosargyal bka' 'bum khro phu brgya rtsa sogs/ /po ti brgya phrag longs pa'i bklag lung dang / /dbang dang rjes gnang che phran mang zhig nod/ /zla ba drug du nye ba tsam zhig bsten/ /de ltar skyes bu dam pa mang zhig las/ /yon tan cha shas tsam de nod par byas/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa byed par rtag spro yang / /nam yang gzhan don ltar snang gis g.yengs ste/ /g.yeng ba'i 'dam las brgal bar ma nus so/ /'on yang sngon nas rnyed dang bkur bsti dang / /tshe 'di'i bya ba gtso bor ma byas ste/ /thos bsam sgom pa spel ma'i tshul du spyad/ /dbang sdud dang ni mthu sgrub la sogs pa/ /tshe 'di'i ched du rig sngags ma sbyar zhing / /sdom pa gsum gyi spang blang gtso bo rnams/ /ci nus lag len 'debs pa'i lugs su bgyis/ /cung zad tsam gyis chog 'dzin ma bgyis ste—/ —/bku' dang bstan bcos rab 'byam gsung rab bltas/ /kun la gzu bor gnas pa'i blo yis dpyad/ /bklag lung tsam la thob

'grulapa'i bzhin ras la4 ba'i me long/ 263ces ma bzhag ste/ —/shin tu dka' na lan brgyar brtags nas kyang / /the tshom chod pa'i nges pa brnyed par byas/ /phye gtor tsam gyis gzhan mgo ma bskor ste/ /gzur gnas bden drang gsong po bgyis par rlom//tha snyad rtog ge'i gtsug lag 'ga' shes kyang / /tshig tsam dag la yid rton ma bgyis shing / /nges pa'i don la mos pa lam du bgyis/ /rim gro tshe sgrub srung zlog la sogs pa/ /lus srog gces par 'dzin pa blos btang ste/ /'dun ma'i blo phugs gang yod shog la gtad/ /dgra 'dul gnyen 'dab skyong bar ma khom ste/ /tshe 'di'i mthun 'jug kun la phyi phyag btsal/ /rang phyogs gzhan phyogs mang po mi bdog ste/ /'gro kun pha ma yin par go ba'i phyir/ /thams cad rang gi phyogs su kha tshon bcad/ /chags sdang sog cing sdig rgyun 'phel mthong nas/ /dgon gnas 'dzin dang grwa slob yon bdag gi /ngo srung phyogs ris 'dzin pa blos btang ste/ /gar skyid pha yul su byams pha ma yin/ /gnas la nges med bung ba tshang tshol ste/ /tshe 'di don gnyer rnams dang blo mi bstun/ /'tsho ba bya tshol bsod snyoms spyod pa ste/ /zas nor gsag sa'i bang mdzod bdag la med/ /gang du sdod kyang su yis mi srung zhing / /gang du 'gro yang su yis mi bshol ba/ /de phyir 'gro 'dug bde ba tsam zhig yin//lta dang grub mtha'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyang / /blos byas rtog pa'i phreng ba yin mthong nas/ /ther zug zhen pa'i blo yi sbrul mdud grol/ /yi dam lha la dngos grub mi re zhing / /lta ba gzhung lugs kun la rag ma lus/ /blos byas rnam rtog sgom par ma 'khrul zhing / /theg pa kun gyi spyod pas ma bcings pa/ /'bras bu yid smon re ba med pa yin/ /rgyal ba mchog gi byin brlabs kho na yis/ /bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs du ma ni/ /sbyangs pa bgyis dang ma bgyis mang zhig la/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog thobs pa cung

264 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang rnam zad thob/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i gzhung lugs chen po dang / /rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam phyag rgya che/ /bka' brgyud byin rlabs lam du gcig 'dres pa/ /bden gnyis dbyer med gnad gsang cung zad go/nges par gzhan la phan pa'i don mthong na/ /bdag lus dum bur gse zhing bcad byas nas/ /ster bar nus pa'i blo zhig yod mod kyang / /bdag nyid mthu dang nus pa dman pa'i phyir/ /gzhan la phan nges ci yang ma grub mod/ /'on mang 'chad rtsom ltar snang 'ga' bgyi ba/ /rnyig du dngos zhin grolamanasakyang / /brgyudanasagazhan lacung zad phan nasasnyam/ /phyi nas skye ba tshe rabs kun tu yang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod zhabs pad dang / /skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med pa yis/ /gang bzhed phrin las thams cad bde blag du/ /thogs med sgrub por smon lam btab pa yin/ /thams cad 'dun pa'i khyad par yin pa'i phyir/ /de dag rnams kyang 'grub par nges pa k+to /za//de slad rgyal ba rigs bdag mchog nyid kyis/ /rtag par rjes su 'dzin par gdon mdor na bdag nyid skyes nas da lta bar/ /spyod tshul yon tan lta bur snang ba rnams//rags par brjod pa de tsam zhig yin mod/ /skyon gyi phreng ba bgrang gis ji ltar lang //de slad rang gi rtog ba brjod zin to/ /de ltar bdag tshul drang por brjod 'di las//gal te dge ba cung zad thob srid na/ /de yis bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad ni/ /rigasabadag rgyal ba nyid du grub gyur cig/rang gi rtog ba brjod ba zhagil ba'i bzhin ra 'char ba'i me thong zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lugs gnyis kyi yon tan rgya chen po mnga' ba bying pa chos kyi rje kun spangs pa lcam sring gis thog mar nan tan ches chen pos bskul bar mdzad pa'i rgyu dang / lho gnasamachog dpal gyi tsā ri ta'i gtsug gi nor bu rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rnam par rgyal ba'i gsung gis 'phral du bskul ba'i rkyen lhan cig pa las bcom

'khrul pa'i bzhin rasal4 ba'i me long /265ldan 'das mi skyod zhabs snying gi dbus su 'dzin pa bsod snyoms pa gtsugalag phreng garang nyid kyi rang lo rdzodagub lcags mo glang gi lo nag pa'i zla ba la lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri tra/bde chen rigs bsdus kyi pho brang /kun snang sgyu 'phrul gyi zhing khams chen po'i cha/yul smad mkha' 'gro'i pho brang gi bye bragadapal ldan lha mo re ma ti'i pho brang /nags tshal stug po'i dbus rong chung bsam gtan gyi khang bur sbyar ba'o////

267dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i gadza/nga 'bum dkar chaga'adig wa ṇa badz+ra bisdidabe mdzod khang du bzhugasaba'i dpa' po gtsug lag phreng ba'igasung thor bu'isna(ra/rje btsun mar pa'i rnam par thar pa grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa ldeb/ 69phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyis man ngag ldeb/ 19thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid tshem bu lugs ldeb/ 8ri chos gnad kyi lde mig ldeb/ 18rje rang byung ba'i gsung las byung ba ri chos bdud rtsi'i nying khu ldeb/ 10skal ldan byang chub tu bskul ba'i pho nya snying po'i skyes kyi dam pa phrin yig tshigs bcad kyi snartogs ldeb/ 49 (mgur/)zab mo lta ba'i gzhung spyod 'jug gi sems bskyed blang chog dang / rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung byang sa'i lugs kyi sems skyed kyi cho ga dang / don dam pa'i sems bskyed blang chog 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rnams ldeb/ 13phyag rgyalde chen sdi lnga ldan gyi gdams pa dgos 'dod stsol ba mchog gi nor bu'i //sdu lda// 'a/bye dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'i sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong bar byed pa zhes bya ba las cho ga 'bring po ldeb/ 68rnam par 'thag pa bsdus pa'i bstan bcos log rtog rnam spyong ldeb/ 34lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi gzungs bzhugs dkar chag ldeb/ 16

268 dpa'abogatsug lag phreng ba'i dpal rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa zab mo rnam 'byed ldeb/ 135༵ dī /ba sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rnam par bshad pa theg chen chos kyi // // rdo ṭ+wāṃ nakyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rnams kyi 'gung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun las btus pa rin po che'i rgyas 'grel rin po che'i gter mdzod/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan bcos kun las btus pa'i 'das lo'i re'u mig gsal bar byed pa bklags pas sdo/ba pa chen po/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun las btus pa'i 'das lo'i re'u mig dngos rnams bzhugs so//1'og min sras mkhar gyi gnas sprul pa'i pho brang chen por gser thog ji ltar bsgrub pa las brtsa/sa pa'i dkar chag gi yig tshangs brjod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho med du byung ba'i na /zlo zlobasdu /ya/ ༵ sogs kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 73 mthu stobs gling gi bkod yig ldeb/ 84 sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i byung ba ldeb/ 95 sku mkhar rin po che la gser thog ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul mdor bsdus pa ldeb/ 67 /snad ma~X/ /༷ pa/ pho brang 'og min rtse'i rgya phubs gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'bor

gsung 'bumadakar chag 269/dril phreng gi bkod yig ldeb/ 19 5 mkhar gyi 'og min rtse'i logs bris nang gi bkod yig ldeb/ 210sku mkhar gyi bar sgo shar 'khyams kyi bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum las bya rgyud kyi gtso bo rnams kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 211theg mchog sngags kyi pho brang chen por bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum las spyod rgyud rigs gsum gyi skabs kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 1012)ga ༷chokyi pho rnying du bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum las bya rgyud rigs drug gi skabs 13hā/ /sgre/ ༵ bra~X /gi / /ra sgrol ma brgya rtsa'i lha tshogs kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 614sdong khams 'aX lagaza' yum dang tshogs bdag gis gzungs ma mgon gyi rgyud 15/ sdu// rnyiswā shā trī ṭ+wāṃ ༷r+sha/ ༵/ga /ba/ 716mchod rdzas phul ba'i zhal yig phyi mo brnyed pa rnams ldeb/ 1017 sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i dri gtsang khang du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan yig rags pa tsam ldeb/ 918 rdo ṭ+wāṃ sprako / dī dze+e ༷/༵ kā/da kyi bla ma dang gnyis med rgyud kyi lha tshogs bzhugs 19'od ldan gyi bkod yig ldeb/ 120bska|da pa bsam yas su bla med pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis bzhugs pa las nub gung bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 3821 ḍi/snye ༵ ba/ma yas su bde dgyes sogs kyi rgyud ris bsdus pa'i bkod

270 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i 22 dgyes rdor brtag gnyis/ gur/ phyag chen thig le/ ye shes snying po/ ye shes thig le/ sasgru ṭa rnams kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 1923 pha rgyud las gsang 'dus sogs kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 10nas rnyi/wa / kār+shar+sha sdus ༵ bla med pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las pha rgyud gshed skor 25 sdog mchoX sngags kyi pho brang du bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum las rnal 'byor rgyud 26 sgre/ ༵ sdu / spra/ga/༵ /pyod ldeb/ 4527 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang ldeb/ 2528 gasnaje sngags bzla tshul phreng bshad sogs dgos gal shin tu che ba'i phyag 29 /rdol /sa/ ṭ+wāṃ 1'khor lo'i man ngag rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun las btus pa'i 'das lo'i re'u mig gsal bar byed pa bklags pas grub pa chen po ldeb/ 2130 rje btsun mar pa'i rnam par thar pa grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa ldeb/ 6531 lhag rgya ༷na po lnga ldan gyi gdams pa dgos 'dod stsol ba mchog gi nor bu'i gter 32 rnaX /// rteX sku'i don yang dag par brjod pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi zhal 33 /rdol sdus/ bye 'khor lo'i man ngag rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun las btus pa chen po'i rgyas 'grel rin po che'i gter mdzod ldeb/ 25334 /drong /nga du zhal yig sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya dang gsum pa

gsung 'bum dkar chag 27135 bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan yig ldeb/ 736 mdo khyams g.yon phyogs kyi byams pa sogs gtso bo bdun gyi mtshan yig ldeb/ 137 zab mo lta ba'i sgo srungs dam can 'khor bcas kyi bkod yig ldeb/ 138 rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i mdo ris bkod yig ldeb/ 13639 sgo g.yabs steng gi bkod yig ldeb/ 640 seng khri rdo rje gdan gyi bkod yig ldeb/ 341 rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi bkod yig ldeb/ 242 snang ba rab gsal gyi bkod yig ldeb/ 543 thar 'khor gyi bkod yig ldeb/ 444 srid 'khor dang thar 'khor gyi bkod yig ldeb/ 445 'dul ba'i cho 'phrul bkod yig ldeb/ 246 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes ma'i bskyed rim lha khrid kyi rnam bshad rnam 'byed 47kyi // tram̐ //sa6 dī ldeb/ 32

272 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i ༄tsho/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i gsung 'bum dkar chag rgyas pa bsdokyigs rbedu//༄7/ /glegs bam 'di rnams kyi tho yig rang gis sbyar ba bzhugs so//phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma yi dam dang //mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun la btud byas te//dpal ldan gakhri'i lag phreng ba rang nyid kyis//brtsam pa'i chosagyi mingagi phreng ba dgod//de yang mchod brjod bstod tshogs kyi skor/ rnam thar chos 'byung gi skor/ sgra dang sman dpyad kyi skor/ mdo rgyud lung bsdus kyi skor/ rnam bshad zin bris kyi skor/ mngon dkyil sgrub thabs kyi skor/ bya ba chos spyod kyi skor/ rang gi rtogs brjod la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i skor/ nyams len khrid yig gi skor/ gnad du phog par 'doms pa zhal gdams su grags pa'i skor/ man ngag sna tshogs pa'i skor/ dkar chag bkod yig gi skor/ sngo ba bkra shis kyi skor rnams las/dang bo mchod brjod bstod tshogasakyi ra la/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po dme pa'i zhabs la bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba sogs bstod pa gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la bstod pa chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ston pa zhes bya ba/ tai lo pa la bstod pa byin rlabs 'gugs byed/ nā ro pa la bstod pa phrin las bskul ba ste gsum/byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen la bstod pa dad pa'i rnga sgra/ dpal sa ra ha chen

gsung 'bum dkar chag 273po la bstod pa grub pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gleng slong / ston pa gnyis pa klu zhabs la bstod pa bka' drin mi bskud pa'i sa bon/ slob dpon ar+ya de wa la bstod pa/ 'jigs bral zla ba'i zhabs la bstod pa bden pa'i tshig sha wa ri dbang phyug la bstod pa de kho na nyid kyi glu/ mnga' bdag mi tri pa la bstod pa yon tan gsal ba rnams la dpe tshan gcig rje mar pa la bstod pa yon tan ji lta bar brjod pa/ rje mi la la bstod pa bka' drin dran pa/ rje sgam po pa la bstod pa bla ma'i yon tan dran pa rnams/ slob dpon chen po rta dbyangs la bstod pa thub bstan snang byed/ bdag nyid chen po zhi ba'i lha la bstod pa ngo mtshar snang ba/ ston pa gnyis pa dpal ldan mar me mdzad bzang po la bstod pa dad pa'i myu gu yongs su smin pa'i snye ma/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po ma hā lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal la bstod pa yon tan yongs su dran pa/ rje btsun mkhan chen lo tsā ba chen zhonagyi sladaguma' na smos na rje chosaskyong bzangapo4༅/) po la bstod pa yon tan mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas/ mkhas grub chen po chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la bstod pa bla ma'i yon tan dran byed de rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i bstod pa rnams dang /bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i skyes pa'i rabs med du byung ba brgya rtsa brgyad la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ skyes pa'i rabs mchog tu ngo mtshar ba'i dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing chen po'i yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sdom tshig dang bcas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bstod pa gnyis/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ bdud thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar bstod pa/ blo las 'das par bstod pa/ ston pa'i bstod pa yid kyi gdung ba rnam par sel ba/ ston pa la bstod pa thugs rje rnam par bskul ba/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa la bstod pa yid kyi gdung ba sel ba/ ston pa la bstod pa bdud bzhi rab tu bcom pa rnams dpe tshan gcig bskal bzang gi sari sa rgyas stong gi mtshan gyi phreng ba la bstod pa

274 dpa' bogatsugalag phrengaba'i dad pa'i me tog kun nas kha bye ba'i myu gu/ dam pa'i chos la bstod pa/ lhag pa'i lha yi dam gyi lha la bstod pa'i tshogs las/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med la bstod pa gsum/ bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan la bstod pa rab tu brtan pa'i rdo rje/rdo rje sems dpa' la bstod pa dad pa'i rna rgyan rnams/ 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod pa rin chen phreng ba/ ku mu dwa'i phreng ba/ bstod pa yig drug dang sbyar ba ste gsum/'phags mchog 'jig rten gsum gyi dbang phyug pad+ma dkar po'i dpal la bstod pa snying rje'i ku mud mdzes par bzhad pa'i zla 'od sogs bstod pa bzhi/ bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la rgyud bzhin du bstod pa/ bcom ldan gtum po dkar po la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma dang / shes phyin dkar po la bstod pa gnyis/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs rje la bskul ma gdab pa dad pa'i 'khri shing sogs sgrol ma'i bstod pa bdun dang / dbyangs can lha mo'i bstod pa dri za'i glu dbyangs sogs bstod pa gsum dang / chos skyong la bstod pa bzhi rnams/ gsol 'debs kyi tshogs la chos tshan nyer bdun/ brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshogs la tshan pa bdun/ nye ba'i thung spyod dpal tsā ri tra'i gnas la bstod pa gnyis rnams bzhugs so//gnyisab rnam thar chosa'abyungalha ra la/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bu bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa dad pa'i 'khri shing / rje btsun mar pa'i rnam par thar pa grub pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma'i rnam thar zin bris chung ngu / rje dpa' bo sku skye na rim gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar snying po/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i legs par bshad pa la yan lag chen po lnga las/ thog mar 'jig rten gyi khams spyir bstan pa ste yan lag dang po/ yan lag gnyis pa rgya gar gyi skabs la/ ston pa'i mdzad pa bshad pa/ bka' bsdu ba khyad par du bshad pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten ji ltar byung tshul yan la dpe tshan

gsung 'bumadakarachag 275gcig rgyal po byon tshul/ yan lag gsum pa bod yul gyi skabs la/ nang tshan bcu las dang por spyi tshogs kyis bod bdag gir mdzad tshul/ gnyis pa chos rgyal rim par byon pa dang ra sa bsam yas las 'phros pa bstan pa snga dar gyi tshul rgyas par bshad pa/gsum pa 'dul ba'i chos 'byung / bzhi pa lo paṇa ji ltar byon pa/ lnga pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos 'byung dang / de'i 'phros don rnam par 'thag pa bsdus pa'i bstan bcos log rtog rnam sbyong / drug pa bka' gdams kyi chos 'byung / bdun pa bka' brgyud spyi'i chos 'byung / dam pa'i chos kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa'i bod yul gyi skabs las/skabs brgyad pa sgrub brgyud dmi rka tshang gi chos 'byung / skabs dgu pa 'bri khung bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar/ chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi gsum pa bod yul gyi skabs las/ bod yul du chos brgyud sna tshogs pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ste skabs bcu pa/ chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ yan lag bzhi pa li yul/ rgya nag snga ma/ mi nyagahor/ rgya nag phyi ma rnams kyi chos 'byung / chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ yul spyi dang bye brag ma phye bar shes bya'i gtso bo rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung ba bshad pa ste yan lag lnga pa rnams bzhugs rbe|//gsum ba snyen mong gi rig gnas dang sman dbyad kyilha(ra la/ legs sbyar bklag thabs kyi rtsa ba blo gsal 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar/ de'i 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i 'od phreng / ka lā pa'i bsdus don/ mtshams spyor mdo'i 'grel pa/ slob phan lugs kyi mtshams sbyor drug pa'i mchan 'grel/ ming le dang po'i 'grel pa/ sum cu pa lung du ston pa'i 'grel pa/ rtags 'jug gi 'grel pa tshig don gsal byed/ sum rtags lugs kyi tshig phrad/snyan ngag me long gi mchan 'grel/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi mchan 'grel/smanadabyadalkor la/ zur mkhar ba'i bye ba ring srel grangs can grangs med kyi snying po

276 dpa 'a bo gtsugalagaphreng ba'i bsdus nas bkod pa ni/ rtsa dpyad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ chu dpyad zla ba'i me long / rlung nad spyi gso ba bcud bsdus rgya mtsho/ stod 'tshangs kyi bcos bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo/ srog rlung sgos bcos bdud rtsi'i rba rlabs/ srog rlung gi bcos sems kyi bde skyed/ tsha ba spyi 'joms rgyal blon dgu sbyor/ tshad par gyi bcos thengs sos zla thigs gnyis kyi snying po/tsha ba spyi 'joms sbyor ba'i ga bur/ khris pa sha ya nag po'i bcos/ gzer bcos 'chi ba bshol 'debs/ de'i zhal gdams pra khrid/ gag bcos bsdus pa srog gi chad 'thud/a ru 'bri gang gi sman mar/ ma nu'i 'khrul 'khor char zim/ srangs 'byar reg pa zug zhing / rta bong srog gi chad 'thud/ chu 'joms rdo rje'i byug pa/ spyi 'joms go byil sbyor ba/ srin bcos sbyor ba srog ster/ mgo srin ya ma drungs 'byin/ gzhan ya ma'i bcos gsum/ grang ba spyi 'joms bdud rtsi'i bum bcud/ dngul sbyor gsang ba'i nyams yig chu nad sel ba/'dzer nad bcos/mdo 'byin sogs/gnyan kha med kyi bcos/dkar po chig thub kyi sbyor sde ngo mtshar srog skyob/'bras 'dus/khrag rlung gi gzer khrus bdun ma/rlung co spyo mgo'i bcos/smin sbyor lnga ba rgyun gcod/sbyongs kyi skor/rdo zhun gsal sgron dang rdo zhun gter mdzod/stobs bskyed/dug srung bdud rtsi'i snying thigaspyi 'joms drag po bcu gsum/ dug gi srung ba/ stongs tshad sel ba/ rkang bam gyi bcos gnam lcags rdo rje/ rma bcos bdud rtsi'i ma/ rgyu gan bcos zab mo/ rma sman yang gsang sman gcig mgo sman gsang ba lnga sbyor/ sirnyi mu la'i sbyor ba/ mig sman la sogs pa'i zin bris mang zhig rkang 'bam gyi sgos bcos/ dngul chu'i dug 'phrog sngags la brten pa rnams bzhugs rbeca//bzhi pa mdo rgyud lung brdzu kyi skor la/ mdo sna tshogs pa'i lung bsdus/ mdo sde las brgya dang gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs brjod kyi sdom tshigamado mjangs blun gyi don bsdus/ mdzangs blun gyi sdom tshig rgyud sna tshogs pa'i lung bsdus/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i

gsung 'bumadakarachag 277rgyud dang gdan bzhi'i rgyud dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud rnams las gsungs pa dbyangs bcu gnyis/ khyim bcu gnyis/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnams kyi thun mong gi mdo yig go sla bar bstan pa/ rgyud kyi gzungs dang man ngag sna tshogs bstan pa rnams bzhugs so//lnga brnam bshad na bri kyi ra la/ mdo phyogs dang / mdo sngags thun mong / thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi rnam bshad las dang po/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad gcig du 'dus pa ṭīka chen nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char bar 'gyur ba'i skya rengs kyi snang ba zhes bya ba spyi don dang bsdus don rnam par bzhag pa/dbyar gnas dang dgag dbye'i gzhi'i cho ga gso sbyong gi cho ga dus 'das 'byung ji ltar brjod pa/ dge slong gi sdom pa sbyin pa'i tshe dus brjod pa/ spyod 'jug shes le'i mchan 'grel/ rgyud bla ma'i mchan 'grel/ yan lag gi lhung ba brgyad cu'i bsdoms kyi mchan ༵ gā' 5/tsho/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rnam par bshad pa theg chen chos gnyis pa mdo sngags thun mong la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dmi pa mi bskyod rdo rje zhabs kyis skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i dbon mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rin chen rnam rgyal chos kyi grags pa la dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i bshad pa dgyes par gnang ba las/ tshoms dang po'i zin bris/ so thar gnad bsdus kyi tshoms kyi zin bris/ byang sems sdom pa'i tshoms kyi zin bris/ sngags sdom gyi tshoms kyi zin bris/chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshoms kyi zin bris/ rten 'brel gyi tshoms kyi zin bris/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i tshoms kyi zin bris/gsum pa thun mong ma yin ba sngagasakyi rnam bshad la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor

278 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i ma'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa zab mo snang 'byed/ rnam rtog chos sku'i grub pa las brtsams pa de kho na nyid kyi snying po/ rnam rtog chos sku'i don yang dag par brjod pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi zhal lung / bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam ('di 'jam dbyangs kyi zinabris mdzad pa de yin/ mig/) par 'byed pa'i 'grel bshad brjod don gsal byed/ mos gus bdun pa'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen tshul mdor bsdus pa/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i rnam par bshad pa thar pa'i 'jug sgo/ dbang gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus/rdo rje dril bu'i rnam gzhag zung 'jug gsang ba'i de kho na nyid/ bzlas pa'i rnam gzhag gsal bar byed pa dngos grub kyi gter mdzod/ mchod rten gyi thig rtsa/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig gi rnam par bzhag pa/ dkyil 'khor rnam gzhag bu lugs kyi zin bris/ zab mo nang don gyi zin bris sprul ('di yang zhabs drung na zin bris mdzad pam gtogs bdagarang gi brtsams padang 'dra ba yod/ mchan/) sku rin po ches mdzad pa mthong bas khong du chud pa/ gsang sngags zab mo nang don gyi snying po rnam par bshad pa/ rnam shes ye shes brtag pa/ zla med pa'i mchan 'grel/ phyag rgya chen po lta ba nam mkha' rdo rje'i mchan 'grel/ phyag chen gaṅga ma'i mchan 'grel/ sha wa ri'i do ha bde'i glu/ tai lo pa'i do ha mdzod/ nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus rnams kyi mchan 'grel/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun las btus pa rin po che'i rgyas 'grel rin po che'i gter mdzod/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan bcos kun las btus pa'i 'das lo'i re'u mig gsal bar byed pa bklags pas grub pa chen po/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos kun las btus pa'i 'das lo'i re'u mig dngos rnams bzhugs so//drug ba mngon dkyil sgrub thabasal/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa rgyal ba rang byung rdo rje'i dgongs pa snang bar byed pa rgyud 'grel gyi snying po las mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs/ dus 'khor lus dkyil du sgom pa/ thugs

gsunga'abum dkar chag 279dam lnga tshan lnga'i mngon dkyil/ bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang dbang gi rim pa/ rje dus mkhyen gyi thugs dam dgyes rdor lha lnga'i ting 'dzin gyi dbang blang chul/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga dgu'i cho ga'i zin bris dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don/ rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga las thams cad sgrub byed/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i sgo nas ngan 'gro rnam par sbyong ba'i cho ga thar pa mchog gi 'jug ngogs/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i de'i rtsom bskul gyi bka' shog sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi mngon dkyil mdor bsdus/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor chen pos rang bzhin gyi don ji ltar bya ba don kun sgrub byed/drung mdzad kun rig chen mo'i cho ga 'bring po zur du phye ba ngan 'gro yongs sbyong / 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'dod 'ja'i bum bzang / de'i tshe khrid/ yang de'i tshe sgrub paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa'i gsung gi snying po/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs don kun sgrub byed/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dngos grub 'byung ba/ phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ phyag rdor gtum mo'i sgrub thabs dbang mchog gi zin bris bsdus pa/ thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung dang sbyar ba/ de'i lag len blo gros sar bu'i nyer mkho/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i skyed rdzogs tshe dbang dang bcas pa/ grub rgyal tshe sgrub kyi snying po/ tshe sgrub rin chen nyi 'od kyi cho ga'i rim pa 'chi med rdo rje'i bang mdzod/ bka' gter gnyis ka dang mi 'gal ba'i gu ru drag po'i las byang dbang chog bka' gter gnyis ka dang mi 'gal ba'i gu ru drag po'i las byang dbang chog 'phags pa 'jam dpal dkar po shes rab blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs gzhan phan snang ba/ rab gnas kyi cho ga bde legs mchog gi bang mdzod/ rta mgrin lcags ral can sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang / zhing skyong gi rjes gnang / dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sgrub cing mchod

280 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i bstod kyi bya ba'i rim pa gnam lcags rdo rje me char zhes bya ba snga phyi gnyis/ de'i gtor chog 'bring po dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas/ spyan gzigs 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad/dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i gtor chog dngos grub kun 'byung / ma mgon 'khor bcas kyi drag bskul/ phud gtor gyi cho ga mchod sprin gyi rol mtsho/ bzhes 'bod log 'dren sgrol ba'i drag bskul/ bsangs yig 'gal rkyen kun sel/ dpal mgon ber nag can gyi gtor 'bul bsdus pa/ zhing skyong gi gtor chog dam can gyi gtor chogadapal mgon phyag bzhi pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rang gi 'dod lha'i tshogs la spyi gtor sngo ba'i rim pa/ dam can spyi'i gtor chog rgyun du nyams su len pa/ dpal g.yam bzang gi ma mgon rnams kyi gtor chog dngos grub 'byung zhing dgra bgegs tshar gcod/ kha 'bar ma'i sator chen/ klu gtor rgyas pa rnams bzhugs so//bdun ba bya ba chosaspyod kyiskor la/ grwa tshang dpal rkarma rig 'dzin grub mchog sde'i dge 'dun gyi bca' yig 'phros don dang bcas pa/ sems skyed kyi cho ga gsum/ yan lag nyi shu pa'i kha skong yan lag bzhi pa/ byang sems las dang po lhung ba las slong ba'i bya ba/ nyin zhag phrugs cig la chos spyod ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa dge ba'i chu bo rgyun mi 'chad pa ces bya ba/ gtor ma brgya rtsa mdor bsdus pa/ rje rang byung ba'i gsung las phyung ba ri chos bdud rtsi'i nying khu/ ri chos gnad kyi lde mig zhes bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/ bcud len sna tshogs pa'i zin bris rnams bzhugs so//brgyad ba rang gi rtogasabarjod la sog ba la/ thob yig gisnye|ra/ rtog brjod kyi skor/ sku'i ra/ zhu yig grin yig skor/ dri lan gyiskor rte lnga las/ dang po dam pa'i chos kyi zegs ma zhes bya ba thob yig dum pa bcu gnyis bzhugs pa las/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang chen po mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs drung du gsung gi bdud

gsung 'bumadakar chag 281rtsi'i thob pa'i yi ge pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa'i drung du rab byung gi bka' drin nod pa'i brgyud yig me tog gi snye ma/rje zha lu lotsā'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bka' drin nod pa'i brgyud yig thub bstan rin po che'i ljon pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun dam pa phrin las zhabs kyi bka' drin las gsung gi bdud rtsi nod pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa ku mu ta'i chun po/ rje mkhas grub chen po dwags po paṇ+ḍi ta chos rgyal bstan pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi brnyed pa'i rnam grangs brjod pa gser gyi bang mdzod/ smyug la rin po che paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa'i drung du chos thob pa'i rnam grangs brjod pa pad+ma dkar po'i chun po/ grub thob dbus smyon he ru ga'i drung du dam pa'i chos brnyed pa'i thob yig bdud rtsi'i dog pa/ rje 'chi med zhabs kyi drung du chos thob pa'i rnam grangs kyi yi ge ut+pa la yi chun po/ slob dpon rin po che byang chub sems dpa' blo 1snas dbang phyug gi gsung gi thigs pa 'thungs pa'i rnam grangs brjod pa yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng ba/ rje bud+dha ma ti las dam pa'i chos nod pa'i thob yig bdud rtsi'i zegs ma/ rab 'byams chos kyi rje tshul khrims dbang phyug gi drung du bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi thob yig thub bstan rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa'i bang mdzod chen po 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas kha bye ba las/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rgya mtsho lta bu bod yul du 'gyur ba phal mo'i che'i thob yig bde ba chen po'i grub pa ster ba/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi thob yig thub bstan rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa'i bang mdzod chen po 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas kha bye ba las/ mdo sde rin po che ji snyed pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs dang rgyud rim brjod pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i za ma tog chen po/bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi thob yig thub bstan rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa'i bang mdzod chen po 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas kha bye ba las/ shes phyogs rnams kyi thob mig zab mo'i lam la 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar/ rab 'byams chos kyi tshul khrims dbang phyug gi

282 dpa' bo gtsugalag phrengaba'i drung du rgya bod kyi bstan bcos rnams thob pa'i thob yig nye bar mkho ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/gnyisab rtogasabarjod kyisna(ra la/ dge slong gtsug lag phreng ba rang nyid kyi rtogs pa brjod pa 'khrul pa'i bzhin ras 'char ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ dpal gtsug lag phreng ba'i rang tshul mdor bsdus pa don tshan dgu pa/ rang gi rtogs brjod las brtsams pa mig 'phrul gyi rang bzhin gsal byed/ bdag gi tshul yang dag pa'i yi ge/ bla ma bar ༵ rngo tram̐ dris lan/ sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i gsum bsku'iskor la/ ched du brjod pa rdo rje'i glu snying po'i gtam gyi phreng ba mi zad pa'i bang mdzod/ ched du brjod pa rdo rje'i glu yi bang mdzod gsang ba'i gtam gyi phreng ba/dpal /tsushā 1ga phreng ba'i yang dag pa'i do ha/ gzhan bskul gyi ngor brjod pa'i glu'i bang /zhi spya ཿ yi/ dī/na yig giskor la/ rje yab sras kyi zhabs drung du phul ba'i zhu yig las kha cig rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' shog ngos bshus 'phros don dang bcas pa/skal ldan byang chub tu bskul ba'i pho nya snying po'i skyes kyi dam pa phrin yig tshigs bcad kyi tshogs/ lhug pa la/ bka' srung gzhi bdag tre1gas la gdams pa'i phrin yig zhi drag gnyis/ dge bskul gyi yi ge tshogs gnyis kyi ljon pa rnams/lnga pa dri lan gyilha ra la/ ma nges gsang gnad kyi bang mdzod 'byed pa'i lde mig zhes shā // sdis lan gyi tshogs la chos tshan bco brgyad/ thar rgyan gyi gtam rgyud rnams

gsung 'bum dkar chag 283dgu ba nyamastsolen khrid yig lte(ra la/ : dang / khyad b.rab gnyisalas/ dang bo ni/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshogs zung 'jug rdo rje'i nye lam/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdor bsdus/ bla ma sku gsung du sgrub thabs/ snying po don gsum gyi khrid yigathugs rje chen po'i smar khrid yig drug gi phan yon dang bcas pa/ tshoms bu smar khrid kyi nyams len mdor bsdus/ smar khrid byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi/de'i skyed rdzogs snying por dril ba/ thugs rje chen po'i skyed rdzogs smar khrid du nyams su blang ba'i rim par/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi snying po mdo sngags mtha' dag gi zab gnad kyi chu bo gcig tu bstan pa/ phyag chen mig bzhi'i snying po zab mo'i 'jug ngogs/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi nyams len gnad bsdus gsal ba'i sgron me/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi man ngag dgos 'dod stsol ba mchog gi nor bu'i gter/ lnga ldan gyi khrid yig bsdus pa gsum/ spyi tshogs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha khrid zin bris/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes ma'i skyed rim gyi lha khrid rnam bshad zab mo snang 'byed kyi snying po bsdus pa/ dpal ldan lhan cig ma'i sgrub thabs pad+ma'i ge sar las snying po sbrang rtsi'i bcud mchog gi lha khrid kyi zin bris nyung ngu / rlung sems gnyis med kyi zin bris/ chos drug gi spyi'i chings dang sre 'apo'i dmigs rim/ sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi man ngag smar khrid/ gcod khrid mdor bsdus/ ro snyoms kyi yang snying / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi snying po/gnyisab khyad bar ba la/ gcor lo sdom pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa/ rje'i drung gi chos drug chen mo'i zin bris las/ gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi dmigs rim gyi zin bris rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung gi thigs pa dbri bsnan med pa/ sgyu lus kyi gdams pa'i zin bris/ rmi lam gyi gdams pa'i zin bris/ 'od gsal gyi gdams pa'i zin bris/'pho ba'i gdams pa'i zin bris/ nye( rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi zin bris/ bsnyen sgrub kyi dbang gong ma'i cho ga bsnyen sgrub las lus 'dul bcu bdun pa/ byang sems 'gyur med/

284 dpa' bo gtsugalag phrengaba'i gser snye nor phreng rnams kyi 'phrul 'khor rtsa tshig /bsnyen sgrub las 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa'i bsdus don/ bsnyen sgrub las 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa lus 'dul bcun pa las 'di'i bar rnams yig cha rnying pa/ ras chung bsnyen sgrub/ lam 'bras gnad bsdus/ rje ko brag pa'i gegs sel gyi gdams pa mthug pa ha bdun bcu pa dang bcas pa/ rje'i drung gi zhal gzigs la brten pa'i khrid rnams bzhugs so//bcapa gnad du phog bar 'dom ba zhal gdamasasu gragasapa'i'o|ra la/ so so dang / 'thor bu sde tshan du bsdebs pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ lta sgom spyod pa'i rnam gzhag gi snying po gsal ba'i sgron me/ snying gi mun sel/ byin rlabs kyi snying po/ gser gyi yang zhun/ de kho na nyid mtshon par byed pa snying po don gyi man ngag phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag zab mo'i mdzod/ 'pho ba dang bar do'i gdams pa/ yang bar srid pa la gdams pa/ bar do'i ngo spyod zab mo mdor bsdus/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i don gsal bar // ༵ // ༵'i zhal lung / theg chen rtogs pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed pa de kho na gnyis ba 'thor bu la/ thor bu'i tshogs rin po che'i phreng ba/ blo sbyong skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid thor bu las snying po tshigs su bcad pa'i tshogs/ thor bu skyed rdzogs kyi rim pa las rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i skyed rdzogs kyi snying po rin po che dbang gi rgyal po spyi tshogs kyi sgom bzlas gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gnyis rnams bzhugs/bcagacig ba man ngag sna tshogasapa'ilhar la/ gtso che bdang / sna tshogasapaganyisalas/ dang po la/ ye shes mgon po'i khrid skor las/ mgon po'i thugs skyed tshul/ rgya gzhung brgyad/ nang sgrub dang mchog sgrub kyi dbang bka'/ srung zlog bsad gsum chig dril gyi man ngag mnan bsad chig dril dang gtor chen gyi zhal gdams/ rten bzhi

gsunga'abum dkar chag 285gnad gsum/ gnad yig rnams 'phrog pa dang snying chu sre ba sogs ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang / mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'khor bzhi'i sgos sgrub/gnod sbyin yab yum gyi sgos sgrub/de'i spro sgrub/sgrub thabs man ngag dang sbyar ba/de'i rgyud kyi zin bris/grib sel lugs gcigaganyisapa sna tshogabatab la/rta mgrin gsang sgrub/khyung po'i mgur brgyad/rgyud sde lnga lus dkyil du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi yang snying /jo bo'i rnal 'byor srung ba'i skor dang /khro bo bha ya na pa'i srung zlogabaka' bsgo bden tshigang dmar srog sgrub/ paṇa chen nags rin lugs kyi ṭ+wāṃ dmar rnams kyi zin bris/ rnam 'joms ber lugs sogs lugs bzhi'i zin bris/ rnam 'joms lus dkyil/ jo bo rje'i rja dkar gyi zin bris/ dzam dmar gter ma'i zin bris/ log tri'i sngags rgod kyi zin bris/'jam dpal nā ga rak+ṣa pa'i sgrub thabs zin bris rgyas pa/de bsdus pa/khro bo rme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i zin bris/yang de'i sgrub thabs/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i srung zlog steng gdon zhi byed rigs gsum gyi zin bris/ dam pa/rten 'brel brgyad cu 'byug dpyad dkar nag khra gsum ste man ngag sna snardogs pa rnams bsdokyigs rbe1//bcwa gnyi capa dkar chag bkod yig gi lha/ra la/ 'og min sras mkhar gyi gnas sprul pa'i pho brang chen por gser thog ji ltar bsgrubs pa las brtsams pa'i dkar chag gi yig tshang brjod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho med du byung ba'i gtam/ sku mkhar rin po che'i dkar chag bsdus pa/ bka' 'gyur snga phyi'i dkar chag don legs grub pa/ 'og min rtse'i gnam rgyan dang / de'i logs bris phyi nang / bar sgo shar khyams rnams kyi bkod yigam mgod gyi thang sku'i bkod yigamachod rdzas phul ba'i zhal yigasar ma'i bkod

286dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i yig chen mo las/ bla ma lha khang du bka' brgyud kyi bla ma dang gnyis med rgyud kyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i bkod yig 'od ldan gyi bkod yig bkod pa bsam yas su bla med pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis bzhugs pa'i bkod yig theg mchog pho brang du bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum gyi bkod yigamathu stobs gling du chos skyong rnams kyi bkod yig ste sngags phyogs dang / mdo ris la sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i dri gtsang khang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan yig rags pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan snye stong bzhi brgya nga gsum pa/(drugasartsom 'phro gnang dgos rgyu 4zha/) rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i pho brang du rgyu'i theg pa'i sde snod gsum gyi ri mo rnams bzhugs pa'i bkod yig g.yam ring la dkon brtsegs dang las brgya pa/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs brjod brgya pa/ lang gshegs sogs mdo ris sna tshogs pa'i bkod yig seng khri rdo rje'i gdan gyi bkod yig srid 'khor sogs thar 'khor sogs rung khang phyi'i bkod yig sgo srung rnams kyi bkod yig steng 'og skor gyi mdo ris dang sgo g.yabs steng du rgya bod kyi lo paṇa rnams dang /dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan rnams kyi bkod yig snang ba rab gsal du mgron thabs kyi lha rnams bzhugs pa'i bkod yig thams cad kyi gdung sogs kyi gzungs kyi mtshan yigagleg bam 'dirnam kyi tho yig rangalha sbyar ba/bcugasum badzo( ba smon lam bas sagasum las/dang po la/rnam dkar gyi dge ba mi zad cing 'phel bar byed pa sngo ba'i tshogs la tshan pa gsum/ sngo ba'i tshul rgyas pa tshogs gnyis spel ba'i gtsug lag gnyis pa don thams cad grub pa smon lam gyi tshogs la chos tshan bco lnga dang /gzhan yang smon lam gyi rigs mang ba/gsum pa phun sum tshogs par byed pa'i shis brjod dang bde legs kyi tshogs la chos tshan lnga/ bkra shis gong 'phel gyi dga' ston rnams bzhugs so//bdag gis 'dir 'bad dge ba yis//sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi//smon lam thams cad bdag gis grub//'gro kun rtag tu thul bar shog/
